paragraphs: 津菈敎的內戰尚未止息。雖然站在優勢的那一方，羅賓遜主教仍苦惱不已。在方努爾市的教堂書庫內，一本被津菈敎典藏的魔法書，《雪の化身の目覚め》遭竊了。究竟是怎麼失竊的？小偷又是誰？雖然線索不足，但是在羅賓遜主教的心中已經有了答案。
津菈敎內戰的反對勢力由人稱「長城爵士」的川納唐普爵士領導。《雪の化身の目覚め》一書極有可能落入他的手中，以扭轉他陷入敗北之地的悲慘命運。
在羅賓遜主教的號招之下，幾名勇者來到了教堂內，接受主教發派的任務—到一座無名小島上，找尋《雪の化身の目覚め》的蹤跡。這幾名勇者包括：地精嘿嘿嘿王子、半身人芬恩、半獸人拉雅米、妖精泰瓦爾、半獸人南恩，以及人類伊努。經過主教的說明，以及對賞金的討價還價後，冒險者們來到了方努爾市的港口，尋找傳聞中的瑪琳船長。
路上民眾的眼光沒有離開過這群裝扮奇異，行為更是古怪的冒險者們。終於來到了港口，芬恩出示了羅賓遜主教給的介紹信後，守衛便將他們帶到了瑪琳船長的船邊。冒險者們陸續與瑪琳船長自我介紹，登上了船。拉雅米興奮地從岸邊直接跳上甲板，驚動了正在甲板上忙碌的船員尼爾森與他的妻子海耶斯。待瑪琳船長在附近買了頭痛藥，重新登船後，他便拿起噴水器，向新船員們要求乖乖聽話，否則噴水器不會對他們手下留情。
詢問了新船員們的需求後，瑪琳船長指派了最後一位船員，萊恩去採買芬恩提出的菸草，以及伊努提出的帳篷與火把。同時間，瑪琳船長也帶著冒險者們在船上熟悉環境：船艙、餐廳、船長室，以及下層貨艙。南恩對船長室感到十分有興趣，卻在伸手要打開船長室的私人用品櫃時發現被鎖住了。其他人則對地下貨艙中堆積如山的麵包較有興趣。
隨著萊恩的歸來，大家紛紛領取貨品後便前往餐廳用餐。餐廳內，萊恩正和尼爾森以及海耶斯說明近期的戰事，伊努也同時在一旁聆聽，以及詢問關於長城爵士的消息。同時，嘿嘿嘿王子也詢問了關於瑪琳船長與津菈敎之間的事。南恩身在餐廳，心卻在船長室，想著船長的床，究竟是什麼味道？拉雅米因為不懂普通語，不知道大家到餐廳用晚餐了，因此跑到了下層貨艙大啖麵包。泰瓦爾則是躲在船艙內吃自己身上的乾糧。
晚餐後，拉雅米跑到了甲板上，做起了他平日會做的「獸人戰爭體操」。同為半獸人的南恩看見此狀，也開始跟著跳了起來。而身為戰爭牧師的泰瓦爾對此頗有意見，親自示範了正確的戰爭體操給他們看，他精湛的演出讓兩位半獸人感到無地自容。隨著萊恩的告誡，大夥兒才離開甲板，回到了臥艙內。
芬恩拿了整盒方才取得的高級雪茄，想漫步到甲板抽根菸。他分享給了跟在後頭的南恩以及正在甲板上清潔的萊恩各一根雪茄。夜色被雲霧給遮蓋住，散發出一股不安的氣息。遠處傳了一陣如咒語般的吟唱聲。芬恩和南恩都深刻感到一股惡寒，以及一道妖異的紅光，在黑夜中閃耀。萊恩見狀不妙，趕緊到船長室告知瑪琳船長。瑪琳船長來到了甲板，想利用望遠鏡觀測，船卻撞上了什麼似的劇烈晃動。瑪琳船長請芬恩和南恩到臥艙將夥伴們叫上甲板。
從臥艙往甲板的路有些狹窄，嘿嘿嘿王子突然想起自己的隨身物品還放在臥艙內，於是折返，卻發現臥艙已被海水浸入。黑暗的甲板上，伊努想在甲板上生火，以照亮視野，泰瓦爾見狀趕緊阻止，並利用法術將伊努的褲襠點亮，作為替代方案。
在船長的安排下，南恩和拉雅米協助將左側的救生艇從船上放下，而尼爾森和海耶斯則將右側的救生艇放下。積極的拉雅米一馬當先，卻在不理解滑輪和繩索的結構下，意外將降下救生艇的機關徹底破壞。瑪琳船長見狀，趕緊前往救援。在嘿嘿嘿王子一發火球的協助下，左側的救生艇終於放下，萊恩、泰瓦爾、拉雅米、伊努、南恩和芬恩等人隨著左側的救生艇降到了海面；瑪琳船長、尼爾森、海耶斯和嘿嘿嘿王子則搭上右側的救生艇。
兩艘救生艇漸行漸遠。到了荒島的岸上時，兩群人已經遙遠到見不到彼此的蹤影了。
跟隨著紅光，南恩和拉雅米將救生艇划向了荒島的沙灘上。疲憊的大家在沙灘上快要睡去，但是伴隨著他們的是一股詭異的刺骨之寒，因此在拉雅米和南恩的體力活下，砍下了一些柴，並生起了火，大家圍繞著火堆，才漸漸睡去。

另一艘救生艇上，瑪琳船長遞給了嘿嘿嘿王子一件禦寒的外套，上面充斥的不是嘿嘿嘿王子想像中女子的香氣，而是一陣極為濃厚的男子氣味。在瑪琳船長的導航下，他們停在了一處懸崖底下的沙灘旁。跟隨著詭異的紅光，四人爬上了山坡，向紅光的來源—懸崖上的燈塔前進。也因為逐漸寒冷的氣溫，眾人更不假思索的闖入了燈塔內。燈塔的一樓有廚房、休息室，以及兩間臥室。經過調查後，出乎眾人的意料，大家發現廚房內儲藏櫃內還有可以食用的糧食。憑著自身的夜視能力，嘿嘿嘿王子帶領大家到室外收集了一些柴火，帶回燈塔內，但是他們卻在森林中發現了一具乾枯卻沒有明顯外傷的屍體，最終他們決定將屍體帶回燈塔內，以便後續調查。在燈塔內，嘿嘿嘿王子與瑪琳船長繼續調查，發現了在休息室內的窗戶都被木板給釘死了。同時，嘿嘿嘿王子也在其中上鎖的金屬置物櫃內找到了一把長劍。
另一群登島的冒險者們在短暫的睡眠後醒來。眾人在狀態不佳的情況下，終於也找到了燈塔，便趕緊進了燈塔內，也終於見到了走散的其他夥伴們。
在繼續進行的調查中，嘿嘿嘿王子在臥房中找到了大量散落的紙張。將手寫的草稿收集並重新整理後，嘿嘿嘿王子發現這些手稿應該是針對《雪の化身の目覚め》書中內容的註記，但是由於內容繁多且似乎牽涉了複雜的魔法，嘿嘿嘿王子必須在不受干擾的情況下花足夠的時間才能讀完。在休息已充足的條件下，泰瓦爾接手了閱讀手稿的任務，而瑪琳船長也指派因較早開始休息，精神較為飽滿的尼爾森與海耶斯前往收集更多木材。

撿完木材並回到燈塔內的尼爾森與海耶斯選擇到了二樓的臥房休息。經過簡單閱讀後，泰瓦爾發現手稿主要分為四個部分：冬天之主的介紹、召喚冬天之主的儀式與活祭的奉獻、冬天之主的奴僕，以及面具。興奮的泰瓦爾用了三倍大的音量向眾人說明自己得到的資訊，卻被在二樓休息的尼爾森訓斥，表示自己的太太還在休息，請泰瓦爾放低音量。稍有收斂的泰瓦爾還是讓尼爾森感到不滿，而決定獨自外出收集更多木材。在泰瓦爾的說明下，大家理解到《雪の化身の目覚め》是用來召喚冬天之主的魔法書。冬天之主會伴隨著寒氣與暴風雪一同現身，當祂的形象具體化的瞬間，將會把週邊變成極寒世界。要成功召喚冬天之主的話需要獻上大量的活祭。另外冬天之主的僕人會嘗試召喚冬天之主。手稿上有記載冬天之主的僕人的召喚儀式以及僕人的弱點是他的冰冷心臟。只要手持炙熱的長槍貫穿僕人的心臟，僕人就會瞬間死亡。
大家聽完泰瓦爾的說明後面面相覷。瑪琳船長詢問了尼爾森與海耶斯的去處，得知尼爾森又到外頭收集木材，而海耶斯則在二樓休息。大夥兒決定對燈塔的內部繼續進行調查。

前往陰暗的地下室，泰瓦爾將拉雅米身上唯一的裝束：他的內褲，點亮，作為大家的光源。在踏入地下室的那一刻，大家便發現了地上用鮮血繪製而成的巨大儀式圖案，與泰瓦爾在書中看見的圖案一致。芬恩也在暖爐中找到一根撥火棒。伊努也在房間內找到了一本日記，內容包含了以下：「這真的是現實會發生的事情嗎？如果這是真實，那麼人類所構築的文明社會到底有多麼脆弱啊……。」、「將神召喚到此……。這個存在卑微且矮小的我將會完全改變這個世界。但是，只有我一個人是辦不到的。要獻上活祭品？還是說需要一個給建議的人？那從者呢？」、「這天終於來了。我將會超越自我存在，看見新世界的曙光…。若能顛覆一個常識，則可以在那裡建構出一個全新的理論。」。

回到一樓閒逛的芬恩發現了燈塔的後門，就在他推開後門的瞬間，看見大量殘破的屍塊散落在燈塔後方的雪地。身後的泰瓦爾便趕緊大聲通報大家。眾人來到了雪地探查，卻因為外頭太過寒冷，無法久留，而折返回燈塔內。大家到了二樓尼爾森與海耶斯的房間，想在裡頭討論，卻發現門縫散發出了寒冷的氣息—打開門後，迎面而來的是從敞開的窗外撲面的寒氣。還有一股香氣，以及門後有個重物……。是神情恐怖而扭曲的尼爾森的頭。芬恩連忙跑回燈塔後門外的雪地，發現屍體是被用蠻力撕碎，並從二樓的窗戶直直拋下，但芬恩卻無法從他的記憶中回想起有什麼動物有這般的能力。跟隨在後的拉雅米則在燈塔周圍，持續尋找線索。
嘿嘿嘿王子接手泰瓦爾閱讀的手稿，試圖將最後的內容讀完，卻屢屢受到打斷，讓他十分氣憤。伊努則在二樓找到了一間儲藏室，裡面堆滿了各式的儲藏品。
拉雅米繞著燈塔，發現眼前的腳印越來越多、越來越多，這一定是剛剛才留下的！掌握了（他覺得）極其重要的線索，拉雅米趕緊跑回燈塔內，向大家回報。
此時，眾人感到了比過往更加嚴寒的氣息。大家跑到了燈塔外，嘿嘿嘿王子發現燈塔頂端的紅光旁，有個晃動的人影，正吟唱著。嘿嘿嘿王子試圖利用火球攻擊塔頂的人，卻沒有射中，但也打斷了儀式的進行。那黑影從背後長出了翅膀，然後朝樹林飛去。
看見此相，芬恩掏出了小刀，在自己的手臂上劃了一道切口，並幻化成狼，讓嘿嘿嘿王子跳到他的背上，兩人便朝著森林的彼端衝刺。在南恩的呼喊下，拉雅米也拿起了大砍斧，朝著森林奔去。瑪琳船長從地下室拿了撥火棒，遞給南恩和泰瓦爾。然而因為拉雅米跑得太快，南恩和泰瓦爾只能朝著遠處內褲發出的光芒，追蹤拉雅米的方向。越跑越遠，嘿嘿嘿王子與芬恩也看見數量逐漸增加的動物屍體。而此時站在懸崖頂端的伊努看著森林，喊道：

paragraphs.quote: 「他們進去森林了嗎？我要對著森林放火。」
paragraphs.cite: 伊努，（有極大潛力成為）縱火累犯

paragraphs: 瑪琳船長見狀趕緊阻止伊努。森林中泰瓦爾和南恩發現一頭鹿竟然和其他動物朝著不同的方向，向燈塔衝去。南恩對他射了一發火球，讓小鹿現出了他的真面目—煙霧之中，那雙翅膀再次展開，朝著燈塔頂端飛去。泰瓦爾於是利用奇術，大聲喊出怪物朝著燈塔飛去的消息。所有人都聽見了，並掉頭往燈塔奔去。

怪物先飛回到懸崖底下，將屍體拾起後回到了燈塔頂端，繼續吟唱。隨著咒語不斷持續，氣溫陡然下降。回到燈塔下方的南恩和泰瓦爾想起了手稿中的文字「只要手持炙熱的長槍貫穿僕人的心臟，僕人就會瞬間死亡」。南恩將撥火棒遞給伊努讓它加熱，然後遞給了拉雅米，用簡單的獸人語解釋作戰計畫：熾熱、長槍、心臟、貫穿。拉雅米點了點頭，然後便透過伊努的傳送術來到了燈塔頂端。眼前鮮血繪製而成的召喚法陣與吟唱中的怪物並沒有嚇到拉雅米，他舉起長槍，朝怪物的心臟刺下。怪物發出尖銳的嘶吼聲，然後倒下。
隨著怪物的死去，氣溫很快地就恢復正常，然後變得炎熱。來到塔頂的泰瓦爾看見他們此趟的目標：《雪の化身の目覚め》，正躺在儀式法陣的正中央。破損了。回到地面的泰瓦爾透過傳訊術，告知羅賓遜主教任務已經完成了，請求他派出船隻來進行救援。
冒險者們鬆了一口氣，卻沒注意到天空中出現的一道裂痕，一隻纏繞著雷霆以及冰雪的手臂從裂縫中向下抓了一把，大家倉皇閃躲。大家以為危機解除了，卻發現泰瓦爾落入了巨掌之中，消失在次元之外了。
數天之後，羅賓遜主教派了船隻將冒險者們從荒島送回了方努爾市。冒險者們也將殘破不堪的《雪の化身の目覚め》交還給了主教，並領取了獎賞。
也因為本次任務對津菈敎的重要性，冒險者們都被津菈敎奉為聖徒，而他們的冒險故事，都將成為津菈敎眾口耳相傳的傳說，永遠流傳。

The civil war within the Church of Keinra had not yet ended. Though his faction held the advantage, Bishop Robinson remained troubled. A spellbook kept in the church archives at Fanaur, 雪の化身の目覚め, had been stolen. How had it disappeared, and who was the thief? There were few clues, but Bishop Robinson already had an answer in mind.

The opposition in the Church of Keinra’s civil war was led by Syr Tronald Dump, known as “Syr Great Wall.” 雪の化身の目覚め had most likely fallen into his hands, and he intended to use it to reverse his faction’s impending defeat.

At Bishop Robinson’s call, several heroes came to the church and accepted a mission to search an unnamed island for traces of 雪の化身の目覚め. They were the gnome Prince Hei-Hei-Hei, the halfling Fynn, the half-orcs Rayami and Nann, the elf Tyvar, and the human Inu. After the bishop’s briefing and some bargaining over their reward, the adventurers went to Fanaur’s harbor in search of the renowned Captain Marin.

Townspeople stared continuously at the strangely dressed and even more strangely behaved adventurers. When they finally reached the harbor, Fynn showed the guards Bishop Robinson’s letter of introduction, and they were escorted to Captain Marin’s ship. The adventurers introduced themselves one by one and boarded. An excited Rayami leaped directly from shore to deck, startling the sailors Nelson and his wife Hayes as they worked. After returning from a nearby shop with medicine for her headache, Captain Marin picked up a spray bottle and ordered the new crew to behave, or the sprayer would show them no mercy.

After asking what the newcomers needed, Captain Marin sent the final crew member, Ryon, to buy the tobacco Fynn requested and the tent and torches Inu wanted. Meanwhile, she showed the adventurers around the ship: the cabins, dining room, captain’s quarters, and lower cargo hold. Nann was particularly interested in the captain’s quarters, but found her personal cabinet locked when he tried to open it. The others were more interested in the mountain of bread below deck.

When Ryon returned, everyone collected their purchases and went to eat. In the dining room, Ryon told Nelson and Hayes about the recent war while Inu listened and asked about Syr Great Wall. Prince Hei-Hei-Hei asked Captain Marin about her relationship with the Church of Keinra. Nann’s body was in the dining room, but his thoughts remained in the captain’s quarters as he wondered what her bed smelled like. Rayami did not speak Common and never realized dinner had begun, so he went below and feasted on bread. Tyvar hid in the cabins and ate his own rations.

After dinner, Rayami went on deck to perform his customary “orcish war calisthenics.” Nann, also a half-orc, saw him and joined in. Tyvar, a War Domain cleric, objected and personally demonstrated the proper exercises. His masterful performance left both half-orcs ashamed. Only after Ryon warned them did everyone leave the deck and return to their berths.

Fynn took the whole box of premium cigars he had acquired and strolled toward the deck for a smoke, sharing one with Nann and another with Ryon, who was cleaning outside. Clouds obscured the night sky, lending it an ominous air. A spell-like chant sounded in the distance. Fynn and Nann felt a profound chill and saw an eerie red light gleaming through the darkness. Alarmed, Ryon hurried to inform Captain Marin. She came on deck and raised her spyglass, but the ship suddenly lurched as though it had struck something. Captain Marin sent Fynn and Nann below to summon their companions.

The passage from the berths to the deck was narrow. Prince Hei-Hei-Hei suddenly remembered that his belongings were still below and turned back, only to find seawater flooding the sleeping quarters. On the darkened deck, Inu tried to start a fire for light. Tyvar stopped him and instead used magic to make Inu’s crotch glow.

At the captain’s direction, Nann and Rayami lowered the port lifeboat while Nelson and Hayes handled the starboard boat. Eager to help but ignorant of pulleys and rigging, Rayami completely destroyed the port boat’s lowering mechanism. Captain Marin rushed to assist. With the help of a fireball from Prince Hei-Hei-Hei, they finally launched it. Ryon, Tyvar, Rayami, Inu, Nann, and Fynn descended to the sea in the port lifeboat, while Captain Marin, Nelson, Hayes, and Prince Hei-Hei-Hei took the starboard boat.
The lifeboats drifted farther and farther apart. By the time they reached the deserted island, the two groups were too distant to see one another.

Following the red light, Nann and Rayami rowed their boat onto the island’s beach. Exhausted, everyone nearly fell asleep on the sand, but a strange and piercing cold surrounded them. Rayami and Nann chopped firewood and built a fire, and only once the group had gathered around it did they gradually drift off.

In the other lifeboat, Captain Marin gave Prince Hei-Hei-Hei a warm coat. It carried none of the feminine fragrance he imagined, but instead an overpoweringly masculine odor. Under Marin’s navigation they landed on a beach beneath a cliff. Following the eerie red glow, the four climbed toward its source: a lighthouse atop the cliff. As the temperature fell, they entered without hesitation. The ground floor held a kitchen, lounge, and two bedrooms. To their surprise, an inspection found edible provisions in the kitchen cupboards. Using his darkvision, Prince Hei-Hei-Hei led the others into the woods to gather firewood, where they discovered a desiccated corpse with no obvious wounds. They brought it back for further study. Continuing their search, Prince Hei-Hei-Hei and Captain Marin found every lounge window boarded shut, and the prince discovered a longsword inside a locked metal cabinet.
The other group awoke after a short sleep. Despite their poor condition, they finally found the lighthouse, hurried inside, and reunited with their separated companions.

Continuing the investigation, Prince Hei-Hei-Hei found papers scattered throughout a bedroom. After collecting and sorting the handwritten drafts, he concluded that they were notes on 雪の化身の目覚め. There were many pages involving complex magic, and he would need uninterrupted time to finish them. Having rested enough, Tyvar took over the reading. Captain Marin sent Nelson and Hayes, who had slept earlier and were better rested, to gather more wood.

After returning with wood, Nelson and Hayes retired to a second-floor bedroom. Tyvar’s initial reading divided the notes into four subjects: the Lord of Winter, the ritual and living sacrifices needed to summon it, the Lord of Winter’s servant, and masks. An excited Tyvar reported his findings at three times his normal volume until Nelson, resting upstairs with his wife, scolded him and asked him to be quiet. Even Tyvar’s reduced volume annoyed Nelson, who went out alone for more wood. Tyvar explained that 雪の化身の目覚め was a spellbook for summoning the Lord of Winter. The entity would arrive with cold and blizzards, transforming the surrounding area into a frozen world the moment it fully manifested. Its summoning required many living sacrifices, and its servant would attempt the ritual. The notes described how to summon the servant and revealed its weakness: its frozen heart. Piercing that heart with a blazing spear would kill it instantly.

Everyone exchanged uneasy looks. Captain Marin asked where Nelson and Hayes were and learned that Nelson had gone back outside while Hayes rested upstairs. The group decided to continue searching the lighthouse.

As they entered the dark basement, Tyvar enchanted Rayami’s only garment—his underwear—to serve as a light. They immediately found a huge ritual diagram painted in blood across the floor, identical to one in the book. Fynn found a fire poker in the stove, while Inu discovered a journal containing passages such as: “Could this truly happen in reality? If it is real, how fragile is the civilized society humanity has built?”; “To summon a god here... Lowly and insignificant though I am, I will transform this world completely. But I cannot do it alone. Must I offer living sacrifices? Do I need an adviser? And what of the servant?”; and “At last, the day has come. I will transcend my existence and behold the dawn of a new world... If one can overturn a single convention, an entirely new theory may be built in its place.”

Wandering back on the ground floor, Fynn discovered the rear door. The moment he opened it, he saw mangled body parts scattered across the snow behind the lighthouse. Tyvar immediately shouted for everyone. The group investigated, but the cold forced them back inside. They went to Nelson and Hayes’s upstairs room to discuss their findings, only to feel freezing air leaking through the door. When they opened it, frigid wind rushed through an open window, accompanied by a fragrance and something heavy behind the door: Nelson’s head, its expression twisted in terror. Fynn ran back to the bodies outside and determined they had been torn apart by brute force and thrown directly from the second-floor window, but he could recall no animal capable of such a feat. Rayami searched around the lighthouse for more clues.
Prince Hei-Hei-Hei took over the notes from Tyvar and tried to finish them, but repeated interruptions left him furious. Upstairs, Inu found a storeroom packed with supplies.
Circling the lighthouse, Rayami saw more and more footprints before him. They had to be fresh! Convinced that he had found a vital clue, he hurried inside to report.

A cold more intense than anything before suddenly descended. Everyone ran outside, where Prince Hei-Hei-Hei saw a swaying figure chanting beside the red light atop the lighthouse. He hurled a fireball at it and missed, but still interrupted the ritual. Wings burst from the figure’s back, and it flew toward the forest.

Fynn drew a knife, cut his own arm, transformed into a wolf, and let Prince Hei-Hei-Hei climb onto his back before sprinting into the forest. At Nann’s shout, Rayami grabbed his greataxe and ran after them. Captain Marin retrieved the fire poker from the basement and gave it to Nann and Tyvar. Rayami moved so quickly that the two could only follow the distant glow of his enchanted underwear. As Fynn and the prince ran deeper, they passed growing numbers of dead animals. Watching from the clifftop, Inu shouted:

paragraphs.quote: “Did they go into the forest? I’m going to set the forest on fire.”
paragraphs.cite: Inu, a repeat arsonist (with tremendous potential)

paragraphs: Captain Marin hurriedly stopped Inu. In the forest, Tyvar and Nann saw a deer running toward the lighthouse, opposite all the other animals. Nann launched a fireball at it, revealing its true form. Wings spread once more through the smoke, carrying the creature toward the top of the lighthouse. Tyvar used thaumaturgy to shout that it was returning. Everyone heard and turned back.

The creature first flew beneath the cliff to collect a corpse, then returned to the lighthouse roof and resumed chanting. The temperature plummeted as the spell continued. Back at the lighthouse, Nann and Tyvar remembered the notes: “Pierce the servant’s heart with a blazing spear, and it will die instantly.” Nann gave Inu the fire poker to heat, then passed it to Rayami and explained the plan in simple Orcish: blazing, spear, heart, pierce. Rayami nodded, and Inu teleported him to the roof. Neither the blood-painted summoning circle nor the chanting monster frightened him. He raised the improvised spear and drove it through the creature’s heart. It shrieked and fell.

With the monster dead, the temperature quickly returned to normal and then became hot. Reaching the roof, Tyvar saw their objective, 雪の化身の目覚め, lying damaged at the center of the ritual circle. Back on the ground, he used a sending spell to tell Bishop Robinson that the mission was complete and request rescue.

The adventurers relaxed, failing to notice a rift opening in the sky. An arm wreathed in lightning and snow reached down through it, and everyone scrambled aside. Thinking the danger had passed, they then realized Tyvar had been caught in the colossal hand and carried beyond their plane.
Several days later, Bishop Robinson sent a ship to bring the adventurers back to Fanaur. They returned the badly damaged 雪の化身の目覚め and collected their reward.
Because the mission had been so important to the Church of Keinra, the adventurers were venerated as saints. The story of their deeds would become a legend passed forever among the faithful.
本次支線創角種族與職業皆由特定清單內隨機選擇，六項基本數值為 3、3、3、18、18、18，排序也是隨機分配。等級為 3 等。其餘角色設定皆參考《玩家手冊》內設定。
鬆動的柵門，是引領著我們逃出生天，還是墜入深淵？
13891，新卓尼森王朝建立後 429 年，人類依然對非人生物有著很大的厭惡。
「叭—叭—叭—」巨大的聲響在牢房內響起，受刑人們本來就不安穩的睡眠更因此被打斷。
同房的龍人紅龍與魔人阿基拉起床看了看，發現牢房外的走廊上沒有任何動靜，但是柵門似乎是鬆動的。用力一扳，柵門似乎滑開了。
另一間牢房內，妖精巴巴與地精查德也被警鈴吵醒，扳開了意外鬆脫的柵門，走了出去。
獄友前一天剛被保釋的半獸人魔法香蕉先生聽見了警鈴聲，機警地躲到了牢房的陰暗角落，神經兮兮的東張西望，卻沒有動靜，因此決定用他熟悉的忍者語大喊。
混雜著普通語和其他沒有聽過語言的忍者語在牢房之間迴盪，巴巴與查德決定朝聲音的來源前進。隔幾間的牢房似乎有點動靜，兩人探了頭過去，一個臉上有著繽紛色彩的男人將臉緊緊靠了上來，十分神經質的和巴巴與查德對話。在兩人的協助下，這位名為洛根的男人便和他們一起朝著忍者語的方向前進。
與巴巴和查德不同，紅龍和阿基拉決定朝著反方向走。經過了幾間牢房，他們看見有兩人坐在地上，不發一語。紅龍試圖與他們溝通，得到的回音卻是他聽不懂的語言。在各種比手畫腳與威脅利誘下，兩名獄友終於站了起身，走近了他們。這兩名獄友似乎是妖精。扳開牢房的柵門後，四人便朝向忍者語的反方向前進。
扳開了柵門，魔法香蕉先生謹慎的靠著牆，躲在角落。此時巴巴、查德和洛根剛好從另一側的轉角走了過來。似乎對「忍者語」有一點了解的巴巴試著和在角落大叫的魔法香蕉先生溝通，對於巴巴竟然能如此順暢溝通大感震驚的魔法香蕉先生跑了出來，對著巴巴大喊忍者大師。
紅龍和阿基拉以及尾隨他們之後的兩名妖精走向另一側的轉角，看見了一扇鐵門。其中一名妖精掏出了工具，蹲了下來，在門的底下開始動手，而他的獄友則在一旁協助。紅龍和阿基拉分別站在轉角的兩側，深怕發生了什麼突發事件。
「叭—叭—叭—」警鈴聲再次大聲地響起。
鐵門被撞開。
槍聲響起。
蹲在地上的妖精倒地不起。
另一名妖精跪在地上，用妖精語朝著闖入的獄卒求饒，換來的卻是一發子彈，打入他的腦袋。
聽見妖精語，巴巴發現事情似乎不太對勁，便和身邊的夥伴們討論接下來該怎麼做。洛根似乎躍躍欲試，劃開了自己的前臂，將流出的鮮血化為一把鮮紅色的劍，便朝著槍聲的來源衝去。其他三人則決定慢慢靠過去。
見到兩名突然死去的妖精，紅龍試著放火，阿基拉則朝著旁邊逃跑。
槍聲不斷響起，四名重裝的獄卒不斷開槍，獄友們努力抗戰，在生與死之間掙扎。終於，四名獄卒中有三名倒地不起，另一名則暫時消失在獄友們的視線範圍內。
眼看大好機會，巴巴趕緊從獄卒進來的門跑了出去，誰知道在他踏出門的那一刻，倒在地上的獄卒身體突然爆炸，站在獄卒旁的獄友們全數重傷，甚至死亡，而門外，盡是一片漆黑。跟隨著巴巴，紅龍和魔法香蕉先生兩人也成功地逃到了門外，一次次地踏出，一次次的爆炸，那些機械般的獄卒像是沒有血肉般的爆炸機器，除了流出黑色的油以外，毫無動靜。
走在漆黑的空間內，魔法香蕉先生摸著牆壁前行，紅龍與巴巴跟隨其後，最終找到了一口奇異的井：除了貼在地面上的井口外，還有個貼在他們頭頂上方，長得一模一樣的井，而洶湧的井水從上方的井口朝著下方沖。魔法香蕉先生試著爬上上方的井口，並釘上岩釘，卻在將岩釘牢牢釘上，並掛上他的繩子後，因為沒有抓穩，而落入井底的深淵。
看著魔法香蕉先生釘上的岩釘，巴巴抓著魔法香蕉先生掛上的繩索—此刻，他發現在急流的井水中竟然還有一根更為牢固的繩索，於是巴巴和紅龍便攀著繩索，努力的朝上爬。
爬了好一陣子後，似乎到了一層地面。兩人爬出了地面的井口，朝著旁邊的通道向前走。好一段時間後，他們開始聽見人聲，也看見了一扇木門。打開木門，似乎是一間小倉庫。巴巴和紅龍找到了倉庫通往外面的門，他們置身於巷弄之中。
問題是，此刻兩人依然穿著著獄衣。
兩人決定先躲回倉庫內，隨著兩名僕人出現在倉庫內，巴巴將兩人擊倒，換上了僕人裝，兩人小心翼翼的走了出去。
跟隨著大多數僕人的方向，兩人走到了一處柵門。衛兵似乎看見了紅龍身上有種不對勁的感覺，攔住了他，巴巴則順利的穿越了柵門外的王宮花園，邁向了自由。
被帶到一旁的紅龍機警的召喚出了兩隻冒火的生物，著實讓衛兵嚇得一身冷汗，便也決定放他離開。
最終，紅龍也走過了麥克嵩的王宮花園，遠離了他被關了好久好久的監獄。

For this side story, each character’s race and class was selected at random from a fixed list. Their six ability scores were 3, 3, 3, 18, 18, and 18, assigned in random order. Every character was level 3, and all other details followed the Player’s Handbook.
Would the loosened bars lead us to freedom—or cast us into the abyss?
It was 13891, 429 years after the founding of the New Dranison Dynasty, and humanity still harbored a deep hatred of nonhuman beings.
“Bwaa—bwaa—bwaa—” A deafening alarm rang through the cells, interrupting the prisoners’ already troubled sleep.
The dragonborn Red Dragon and the tiefling Akira, who shared a cell, got up to look around. Nothing moved in the corridor, but their barred door seemed loose. One hard pull made it slide open.
In another cell, the elf Baba and the gnome CHAD also woke to the alarm, pried open their unexpectedly loose bars, and stepped out.

The half-orc Magical Banana-san, whose cellmate had been released on bail the previous day, heard the alarm and hid in a dark corner. He glanced about nervously, but when nothing happened, he shouted in the Ninja language he knew well.

The bizarre Ninja language—a mixture of Common and tongues they had never heard—echoed between the cells. Baba and CHAD followed the sound. Hearing movement several cells away, they peered inside and found a man with a brightly painted face pressed close to the bars. He spoke to them with extreme nervousness. With their help, the man, Logan, escaped and joined them on the way toward the Ninja speech.

Red Dragon and Akira chose the opposite direction. After passing several cells, they saw two silent prisoners seated on the floor. Red Dragon tried to speak to them, but they answered in a language he did not understand. After much gesturing, threatening, and coaxing, the pair finally rose and approached. They appeared to be elves. Once the bars were pried open, all four continued away from the Ninja speech.

Magical Banana-san opened his bars and pressed cautiously against the wall, hiding at the corner. Baba, CHAD, and Logan then appeared from the opposite turn. Baba, who seemed to understand a little “Ninja,” tried speaking with the man shouting from the corner. Amazed by Baba’s fluency, Magical Banana-san ran out and cried, “Ninja Master!”

Red Dragon, Akira, and the two elves following them rounded another corner and found an iron door. One elf produced tools, crouched, and began working beneath it while his cellmate assisted. Red Dragon and Akira guarded opposite sides of the corner, fearing an ambush.
“Bwaa—bwaa—bwaa—” The alarm blared again.
The iron door burst open.
A gunshot rang out.
The crouching elf fell and did not rise.
The other elf dropped to his knees and begged the entering guards for mercy in Elvish. A bullet to the head was their answer.

Hearing Elvish, Baba realized something was wrong and discussed their next move with his companions. Logan seemed eager. He sliced open his forearm, shaped the flowing blood into a crimson sword, and charged toward the gunfire. The other three approached more cautiously.
Seeing the two elves die without warning, Red Dragon tried to breathe fire while Akira fled to the side.
Gunfire continued as four heavily armored guards fired relentlessly. The prisoners fought for their lives. At last, three guards lay motionless while the fourth temporarily vanished from sight.

Seizing the opportunity, Baba ran through the door the guards had used. The moment he crossed the threshold, a fallen guard exploded, gravely injuring or killing every prisoner nearby. Beyond the door lay total darkness. Red Dragon and Magical Banana-san followed Baba outside. Each departure brought another explosion: the mechanical guards burst like machines without flesh, leaking only black oil before falling still.

In the darkness, Magical Banana-san felt his way along the wall with Red Dragon and Baba behind him. They eventually found a strange well. One opening lay in the floor; an identical opening hung directly above them, pouring a torrent of water downward. Magical Banana-san tried climbing to the upper opening and hammered in a piton. After fastening his rope, he lost his grip and fell into the abyss below.
Looking at Magical Banana-san’s piton, Baba took hold of the rope he had left behind. Then he noticed a sturdier rope within the rushing water. Baba and Red Dragon grabbed it and struggled upward.

After a long climb, they seemed to reach another floor. They emerged from its well and followed a passage until they heard voices and saw a wooden door. It opened into a small storeroom. Finding another door outside, Baba and Red Dragon stepped into an alley.
The problem was that both were still wearing prison uniforms.
They hid in the storeroom. When two servants entered, Baba knocked them out, and the escapees changed into their clothes before cautiously venturing outside.
Following the flow of servants, they reached a gate. A guard sensed something amiss about Red Dragon and stopped him, but Baba crossed the palace garden beyond the gate and walked toward freedom.
Taken aside, Red Dragon cleverly summoned two flaming creatures. The guards broke into a cold sweat and decided to let him leave.
At last, Red Dragon too crossed the royal garden of Macksohn and left far behind the prison that had held him for so very long.
克里歐門王國首都歐倫市，王國的宮殿內，熱鬧的晚宴上，外地來的冒險者們桌上擺滿了空酒瓶。在現任女王瑪瓦和他的女兒烏瑪公主的款待下，冒險者們和前來參與的賓客們各個吃飽喝足。
夢想完成「大幹一票」儀式的狗頭人希岡、愛耍酷的荒咬薄刃、身材彪悍的黑毛貓人阿嘿尼，以及此時已經酩酊大醉的妖精泰坦妮亞，在這充滿矮人的宴會廳顯得格格不入，但此時他們是宴會的焦點。雖然喝醉了的他們已經不記得女王的指示，但是隔天，他們被指派前往一座礦脈，去尋找一件寶物。
在女王的安排下，四名冒險者住進了王宮二樓的兩間雙人房。
一早醒來，冒險者們的房門被重重的敲擊。一名矮人催促著冒險者們趕緊出發。這名名為札克的矮人是他們這次任務的嚮導。冒險者們連離開房間都花了不少時間，不耐煩的札克連早餐都不讓冒險者們吃，便把他們趕上馬車，準備出發。
馬車上，札克翻開通往後車廂的座椅，一個機器人便翻身而出。札克介紹這名機器人，名為啵啵V，是他的夥伴，這次出任務也會協助帶領大家在礦脈內前進。接著，札克也從倉庫番出了不少啤酒，分給冒險者們。
在冒險者們的詢問下，札克和啵啵V簡單說明了這次的任務，是要從礦脈內帶回一件寶物：龍之球。
天色漸暗，馬車終於停在礦脈外。大家在礦脈口簡單吃點東西後，便進到礦脈內。啵啵V走在前頭，似乎對於裡面的環境十分清楚，遇到路口便直接轉彎。然而，走到其中一個路口時，卻突然無法判斷該走哪一側。殿後的札克繞到最前面，最終選擇了左轉，而啵啵V則改為殿後。

其中一處岔路口，札克向右轉，但走在第二的阿嘿尼的直覺告訴他應該要向左走才對，況且，一路喝酒的札克看起來判斷力也不太好。阿嘿尼想向走在最後的啵啵V確認，卻發現啵啵V似乎故障了。最後，阿嘿尼決定向左走。不久後，跟隨著阿嘿尼的眾人聽見了後方傳來了慘叫聲。回頭，大家發現札克竟然掉入了陷阱。努力拉出後，發現陷阱內的長矛已刺入了札克的身體內，他已失去了生命跡象。荒咬薄刃翻了翻札克的衣服，找到了一張紙條，上面有他看不懂的文字，以及畫了一顆蛋：淡淡的藍色，上面有著紫色的紋路。在希岡的解讀下，這是龍語，寫著「布萊茲大人」。
眾人苦惱著，此時啵啵V卻突然恢復正常，並繞到最前面，要為大家帶路。然而，啵啵V走了好幾個小時，希岡卻發現看見了自己丟在地上作為記號的碎骨頭—啵啵V似乎在重複相同的道路。冒險者們決定先暫時停下來，讓啵啵V繼續繞，反正如果他一直在重複相同的路徑，肯定也會繞回來的。同時，希岡也聞到了這裡除了他們與啵啵V外，還有其他生物的味道，而那似乎是他所熟悉的生物：龍。
過了超過預期的時間，冒險者們發現啵啵V竟然沒有再次出現，於是決定繼續往前。憑著冒險者們的直覺，他們選擇了和之前不同的岔路，走了一陣子，似乎聽見了前方有聲響。等待後，他們發現似乎是啵啵V朝著他們走了過來。在啵啵V的解釋後，大家還是跟著他繼續前進了。然而，這次啵啵V走的速度有點快，大家要趕上十分辛苦。

一段時間後，除了希岡外，大家已經跟不太上了。希岡則刻意和啵啵V保持一點距離，以偷偷觀察他的行為。他聽見了啵啵V嘴裡似乎碎念著什麼，但是他聽不懂。啵啵V進入了一個圓形的廣場，停在廣場的另一端。希岡躲在廣場邊緣偷看，其他冒險者則在外頭的長廊等待。接著，希岡看見啵啵V前方黑暗的空間亮起來一雙眼，一頭成年藍龍飛了出來，鑽過希岡正上方的門口，飛越長廊，停在其他冒險者背後。藍龍發出了一陣聲響，但冒險者們完全聽不懂。接著，在一陣光芒下，藍龍化身成了一名身著藍裝的藍眼女子，用著普通語，叫冒險者們通通進到廣場去。

在藍龍飛向長廊時，希岡看見了原本藍龍所處的位置，有成堆的龍蛋—和荒咬薄刃發現的紙條上畫得一模一樣。同時，啵啵V伸長了他的機械手臂，取出了一顆蛋，置於他的頭上，但竟然滑順的融入了他的身子，原本人形的啵啵V此刻竟產生了變化，除了身高變高、身外披了一層淺藍色帶有紫色斑紋的皮膚外，背後也長出了一對翅膀。希岡詢問啵啵V這是怎麼回事，啵啵V只回應了自己現在已經進化成了啵啵W，便展翅飛去，穿過了長廊、冒險者與藍龍，消失了。

在藍龍的要求下，其他冒險者們也回到了廣場。藍龍向冒險者們詢問他們來到這裡的目的，但大家的回應（不小心繞進來這裡）不滿意，執意覺得大家肯定是為了龍蛋而來。藍龍透過龍語，向希岡提出了交易：只要一個冒險者留下，他就讓剩下三名安全離開；兩名留下，剩下兩名安全離開，還能帶走一顆蛋；三名留下，唯一離開的一名可以帶走兩顆蛋；四名留下，便通通殺死。希岡表示自己願意留下來，請藍龍放其他人走。接著，藍龍便用通用語向其他冒險者們說明自己和希岡提出的交易，但其他冒險者們都不願意留下來。藍龍朝著廣場天花板施放了閃電，讓電在廣場頂端不斷穿梭。藍龍透過心靈感應，一一向冒險者們詢問是否願意留下來，不願回答的話，他便讓閃電從上方打下來。然而，除了希岡外，大家都不想留下來。於是，藍龍便依約讓其他三名冒險者向外走去。
希岡鬆了一口氣，但他沒想到，藍龍竟然化身成了龍，朝著長廊飛去，朝著剛被放走的三名夥伴各打了閃電。荒咬薄刃和泰坦妮亞當場喪命，阿嘿尼則全身焦黑（雖然原本就是黑毛），奄奄一息。看傻了的希岡完全沒想到事態的發展，他看著藍龍飛了回來，遞給了他一顆龍蛋，同時讓他坐上自己的背，承諾他會帶他離開這裡，接著藍龍便載著希岡飛到了礦脈口，藍龍也化成了人形。
礦脈外，馬車停在原處。藍龍詢問希岡是否會駕馬車，希岡點了點頭，坐上馬車，藍龍則抱著蛋，坐上了馬車。然而，緊張的希岡讓藍龍不甚滿意，於是藍龍自己下了車，將龍蛋抱給希岡，自己駕起了馬車，將希岡載回歐倫市，停在了王宮前。
藍龍下了馬車，為希岡開了車門。希岡看見正在王宮門口等待他們的瑪瓦女王。女王向他了解了其他夥伴的狀況，並詢問起這名藍裝的女子。藍龍表示自己是在路邊被希岡救起的。
女王將藍龍和希岡帶入王宮內，將希岡帶入了一間寶物室，裡面儘是黃金與各種寶物。女王讓希岡隨意挑選，只要他能雙手帶的走的都能拿取，接著女王便帶藍龍走了。希岡還處在驚慌的狀態下，什麼寶物都沒有想拿走，只是靜靜的看著。不久後，烏瑪公主跑了進來，看見希岡什麼都沒拿，覺得真奇怪。但希岡只是默默的走了出去，然後離開了王宮。
被燒焦的阿嘿尼緩慢地爬向了廣場，他知道自己離死亡也不遠了。終於來到了廣場，阿嘿尼趴了下來。而在他閉上雙眼前，他看見一顆龍蛋掉落了下來。他似乎聽見了蛋殼碎裂的聲響。

In the royal palace at Orun, capital of the Kingdom of Chryomen, empty wine bottles covered the visiting adventurers’ table at a lively banquet. Queen Marva and her daughter, Princess Uma, had ensured that adventurers and guests alike were thoroughly fed and drunk.

The kobold Sigom, who dreamed of completing the “Big Score” rite; the ever-cool Wildbite Thinblade; the powerfully built black-furred catfolk Aheni; and the thoroughly intoxicated elf Titania looked out of place in a banquet hall full of dwarves, yet they were the center of attention. Too drunk to remember the queen’s instructions, they learned the next day that they had been assigned to retrieve a treasure from a mine.
At the queen’s arrangement, the four adventurers stayed in two double rooms on the palace’s second floor.

Early the next morning, heavy pounding shook their doors. A dwarf urged them to depart at once. His name was Zach, and he would guide their mission. The adventurers took so long merely leaving their rooms that an impatient Zach denied them breakfast, herded them into the carriage, and set off.

Inside the carriage, Zach flipped open a seat leading to the rear compartment, and a robot tumbled out. He introduced it as BoBo-V, his partner, who would help guide everyone through the mine. Zach then hauled several beers from storage and passed them around.
At the adventurers’ request, Zach and BoBo-V briefly explained their task: recover a treasure called Dragon’s Orb from the mine.

Dusk was falling when the carriage finally stopped outside the mine. After a quick meal at the entrance, the group went in. BoBo-V led with obvious familiarity, turning decisively at each junction—until he suddenly reached one where he could no longer choose a direction. Zach came forward from the rear, selected the left passage, and sent BoBo-V to bring up the rear.

At another fork, Zach turned right, but Aheni, second in line, instinctively felt they should go left. Zach had also been drinking throughout the journey, and his judgment looked unreliable. Aheni tried to confirm with BoBo-V at the back, only to find that the robot seemed to have malfunctioned. He ultimately took the left path. Soon afterward, the group following Aheni heard a scream behind them. They turned and found that Zach had fallen into a trap. When they finally pulled him free, they saw that its spears had pierced his body and killed him. Wildbite Thinblade searched Zach’s clothes and found a note bearing unreadable writing and a drawing of a pale blue egg patterned in purple. Sigom identified the writing as Draconic: “Lord Blaze.”

As the group struggled with what to do, BoBo-V abruptly returned to normal, moved to the front, and offered to lead. After several hours, however, Sigom spotted a bone fragment he had dropped as a marker. BoBo-V had been leading them in circles. The adventurers stopped and let the robot continue alone, reasoning that if it kept repeating the route it would eventually return. Meanwhile, Sigom caught the scent of another creature besides the party and BoBo-V—one he knew well: a dragon.

BoBo-V did not reappear when expected, so the adventurers pressed on. Following their instincts, they chose a different branch and soon heard something ahead. After waiting, they saw BoBo-V approaching. They accepted his explanation and followed again, but this time he moved so quickly that keeping pace became exhausting.

Before long, only Sigom could keep up. He deliberately hung back to watch BoBo-V in secret and heard the robot muttering something he could not understand. BoBo-V entered a circular plaza and stopped at its far side. Sigom observed from the edge while the others waited in the outer corridor. A pair of eyes lit within the darkness before BoBo-V. An adult blue dragon flew out, passed directly over Sigom through the entrance, crossed the corridor, and landed behind the other adventurers. It made sounds no one understood. Then light flared, and the dragon transformed into a blue-eyed woman dressed in blue, ordering everyone in Common to enter the plaza.

As the dragon flew into the corridor, Sigom saw heaps of dragon eggs where it had been—identical to the egg drawn on Wildbite Thinblade’s note. BoBo-V extended a mechanical arm, took an egg, and placed it atop his head. The egg flowed smoothly into his body. The humanoid robot grew taller, acquired pale blue skin with purple markings, and sprouted wings. When Sigom asked what was happening, the robot replied only that he had evolved into BoBo-W. He spread his wings, flew through the corridor past the adventurers and dragon, and vanished.

At the blue dragon’s demand, the other adventurers returned to the plaza. She asked why they had come, but rejected their answer—that they had wandered in by accident—and insisted they wanted the eggs. In Draconic, she offered Sigom a bargain: if one adventurer stayed, the other three could leave safely; if two stayed, the other two could leave with one egg; if three stayed, the sole survivor could take two eggs; and if all four stayed, she would kill them all. Sigom volunteered to remain and asked her to release his companions. The dragon repeated the bargain to the others in Common, but none volunteered. She fired lightning into the ceiling, where it continued to arc overhead, then questioned each adventurer telepathically. If one refused to answer, she struck with lightning. Still, no one but Sigom agreed to stay, so the dragon honored the bargain and let the other three leave.

Sigom relaxed, never expecting the blue dragon to resume her true form, fly into the corridor, and blast each newly released companion with lightning. Wildbite Thinblade and Titania died instantly. Aheni, blackened from head to toe despite already having black fur, barely clung to life. Stunned by the betrayal, Sigom watched the dragon return and give him an egg. She invited him onto her back, promised to take him away, and carried him to the mine entrance before transforming into a woman again.

The carriage still waited outside. The dragon asked if Sigom could drive; he nodded, climbed up, and took the reins while she boarded with the egg. His nervous driving dissatisfied her, however, so she stepped down, handed him the egg, and drove them back to Orun herself, stopping before the palace.

The blue dragon opened Sigom’s carriage door. Queen Marva was waiting at the palace entrance. She asked what had happened to the other adventurers and who the woman in blue was. The dragon claimed Sigom had rescued her beside the road.

The queen brought both of them inside and led Sigom into a treasury filled with gold and treasures. She told him he could take anything he could carry in both hands, then departed with the blue dragon. Still in shock, Sigom wanted none of it and simply stood staring. Princess Uma soon ran in and found it strange that he had taken nothing. Sigom silently walked out and left the palace.

The burned Aheni slowly crawled toward the plaza, knowing death was near. When he finally reached it, he lay down. Before closing his eyes, he saw a dragon egg fall. He thought he heard its shell crack.
如同 27 年前般，克里歐門王國歐倫市的王宮宴會廳正熱鬧地款待著冒險者們，不過此時坐在主桌的，是現任的女王，也就是當年的烏瑪公主。
龍之球在這二十多年內，已成功讓克里歐門王國產出了永續的電力，除了龍蛋上的紫色斑紋變得更淡之外，效力還是十分強烈。此時，龍蛋已被放在王國的博物館內，而這次女王聘請的冒險者們，任務是護送這顆蛋到指定的交易地點，與妖精的洛森王國進行交易，換取好幾箱妖精釀的美酒。
同樣的桌上，四名冒險者包含皮膚黝黑的猩猩獸人穆斯、喜愛彈奏與歌唱的漁人烏鯊大、把自己包得厚厚的、似乎非常怕冷的半妖精韓流，以及頭上有著四顆光球的闇妖精米亞拉。
在烏鯊大的烘托下，宴會非常熱鬧。米亞拉向烏瑪女王詢問關於一位名為泰坦妮亞的前輩，似乎過去也曾來這裡出任務，卻沒有了消息。女王簡單說明了自己所知的事：泰坦妮亞是過去前往取得龍之球的冒險團成員之一，但那些人只有一名狗頭人回來而已。
聽見了米亞拉對泰坦妮亞的打聽，一名矮人走向他，表示自己知道一些消息，要拉他到外頭談。烏鯊大和穆斯想跟著去，但在矮人的要求下被打發走了。走到王宮側門外，矮人遞給了米亞拉一根菸，將手搭在他的肩上，表示 27 年前，泰坦妮亞在離開前往出任務前，和他共度了一個美妙的夜晚。不過除此之外他沒有別的消息可以提供了。米亞拉陷入沉思，但同時，他看見了矮人的手伸向腰際一處，閃著金屬光澤。

paragraphs.quote: 「幹你娘死妖精！」

paragraphs: 矮人從腰際掏出一把匕首，對著米亞拉的肚子便是一陣猛刺。米亞拉一陣驚慌，趕緊掙脫，逃回王宮內，並透過自己的法術爭取了一些時間。米亞拉抱著肚子回到了宴會廳，引起了一陣騷動。烏瑪女王趕緊傳喚了醫師，肇事的矮人回到了宴會廳口後，在女王的譴責下，拿起剛剛刺殺米亞拉的匕首，劃破了自己的喉嚨，倒地不起。冒險者們檢查了矮人身上的狀況，發現那把匕首上似乎刻著妖精語，其中只有「純血」的字樣可以解讀而已。在其他矮人的說明下，這名矮人是名打鐵鋪的老闆，而這把武器看起來像是他自己鍛造的，不過對於他仇恨妖精的行為，沒有人有觀察到任何跡象。
烏瑪女王不斷向冒險者們賠不是，同時也答應讓韓流前往那名矮人的打鐵鋪探索一下。穆斯和烏鯊大則留下來陪伴受傷的米亞拉。在女王的安排下，烏鯊大和米亞拉同住一房，穆斯則先入住雙人房，等待韓流回來。
韓流和兩名矮人一同前往打鐵鋪的過程中，為了不讓一樣有妖精血脈的韓流感到不適，一名矮人表示自己的老婆也是妖精，另一名矮人則表示自己是同性戀，懂得身為少數族群的那種感受。到了打鐵鋪，眾人發現打鐵鋪的門已被敲破，裡面一片混亂，但是可以翻到不少和行兇的匕首相似的匕首，但看起來都是半成品。除此之外，並沒有多少收穫。
離開打鐵鋪後，在獲得同意下，韓流便前往老婆是妖精的矮人家過夜，另一名矮人也興致勃勃地一同前往。在妖精老婆的閱讀下，匕首上的文字沒有更多的解讀，但四人共度了美妙的一晚。
一早醒來，穆斯發現自己的室友還沒回來。復原完整的泰坦妮亞、在澡盆內睡得很好的烏鯊大，以及穆斯一同來到樓下宴會廳用早餐，並等待韓流回來。
用餐到一半，一名矮人女子來向他們打招呼，表示自己是本次和他們一同出任務的夥伴，但奇異的是，他不願透露自己的名字。
用完早餐後，女子抱著龍之球，與他們四人一同上了馬車，準備出發。女子向他們介紹，這次駕車的是一名機器人，叫啵啵C。
車上，女子從後車廂拿出了不少啤酒，讓烏鯊大和穆斯享用，韓流和米亞拉則向她詢問關於這次任務的事，但女子似乎不太願意透露太多，不過女子表明了自己的名字叫波波，小時候因為名字和機器人系列啵啵相似，被開了很多玩笑，因此不喜歡自己的名字。
波波在馬車前行一段時間後，似乎向兩名清醒的冒險者施放了法術，韓流靠著意志保持清醒，米亞拉則因為天生的特性，不會被影響。米亞拉感到異狀，便也施了法，讓波波必須說實話。

在誠實的波波說明下，兩人得知這次的任務除了烏瑪女王外，似乎有另外的勢力透過波波想做其他事，但重要的資訊卻被干擾了，讓波波無法完整透露。波波表示自己施法只是想讓大家安靜地度過這趟旅程，畢竟這趟旅程要五天才會到，還有很久。經過詢問後，兩人得知波波其實也是機器人。在韓流的要求下，波波將龍之球遞給米亞拉後，開始將自己拆解，直到成為掉落在馬車上的零件。在零件中，有個面板，上面寫著大大的「啵啵OMEGA」，像是商標一樣。
韓流向駕車的啵啵C詢問，得知附近有個村莊。韓流和米亞拉將烏鯊大和穆斯叫醒後，說明剛剛發生的事。四人在村莊停車，找了附近的旅店用餐和住宿，同時也請啵啵C將剛才波波的零件裝在他的肚子內。眾人試著從啵啵C打聽關於剛才波波相關的消息，卻只發現啵啵C是較為初階的機器人，而且他並不知道這件任務背後還有烏瑪女王外的勢力在干預。
啵啵C背後的一個紅色小燈亮起，在他的解釋下，附近有他的夥伴正在接近中。一段時間後，旅店門口的光線被遮蓋住，接著，一名看起來與啵啵C相似的機器人走進了酒館內。啵啵C向大家介紹，這是他的同類啵啵W。啵啵W和他長相相似，只是長得更高，皮膚淺藍色且有紫色斑紋，另外背後長了翅膀。
在啵啵W和啵啵C的說明下，冒險者們決定提早出發到交易點。冒險者將龍之球遞給啵啵W，卻看見他把龍之球放在啵啵C頭上，龍之球融入啵啵C，啵啵C逐漸轉化成與啵啵W相似的模樣，只是稍微小了一點點。進化後的啵啵C自稱自己已變成了啵啵Z。
冒險者們協調著該怎麼「搭乘」啵啵W和啵啵Z。烏鯊大坐上了啵啵W的背，米亞拉則坐上了啵啵Z的背。穆斯和韓流抱起了啵啵W和啵啵Z的大腿，但兩名機器人都表示這樣不平衡，沒辦法飛，穆斯只好改抱啵啵Z的大腿，啵啵W便往外走去。然而，啵啵Z表示這樣太重，他飛不起來，韓流於是決定回到房間去，不管這一切了。在啵啵Z的協調下，穆斯抱著他的兩隻腿，啵啵Z便騰空飛起，跟上已飛在空中的他的前輩。
夜已深，空中的三名冒險者敵不過睡意，米亞拉和烏鯊大都在機器人背上睡著了，穆斯則在迷濛之中，發現自己還抱著啵啵Z的大腿，睡意襲來，他撐不住，便從高空掉了下去。
天亮後，啵啵W和啵啵Z都抵達了約定好的會面點。米亞拉和烏鯊大看見走來的妖精，想向他們說明龍之球溶到機器人身體的事，沒想到一名妖精走向啵啵W和啵啵Z，熟練地在他們機體幾處按了一下，兩顆龍之球便滑順地從他們的身體落了下來，兩名機器人則化回了原本的啵啵V和啵啵C，跟著抱著龍之球的妖精們便往回走，留下詫異的米亞拉和烏鯊大，以及幾箱約定好的美酒。
沒了馬車，美酒無法直接帶走，烏鯊大打開其中一罐酒，大口一飲，這的確比烏瑪女王在晚宴請他們的酒都好喝多了。米亞拉透過法術，向烏瑪女王、留在旅店的韓流，以及不知去向的穆斯傳遞了訊息，告訴他們交易已經完成了，但是沒有馬車，他們回不去。女王表示他會派人過去，但是需要五天的時間才會到；韓流表示既然任務完成了，那他也不用再回去見女王了；穆斯則沒有消息。
五天後，韓流已前往了溫暖的南方，而女王的兩台馬車也到了交易點，馬車上，一台機器人都沒有。

As it had twenty-seven years earlier, the palace banquet hall in Orun, Kingdom of Chryomen, bustled with adventurers. This time, however, the reigning queen at the head table was the former Princess Uma.

For more than two decades, Dragon’s Orb had provided the Kingdom of Chryomen with sustainable electricity. Though the purple markings on the dragon egg had faded, its power remained formidable. The egg now rested in the royal museum, and the queen had hired the adventurers to escort it to a designated trading point. There it would be exchanged with the elven Kingdom of Lawson for several crates of elven wine.

Four adventurers shared the table: Mus, a dark-skinned simian beastfolk; Wu-Sha-Da, a fishfolk who loved playing music and singing; Han-Liu, a half-elf bundled in heavy layers and apparently terrified of cold; and Miara, a dark elf with four spheres of light floating over his head.

Wu-Sha-Da kept the banquet lively. Miara asked Queen Uma about a senior adventurer named Titania, who had reportedly undertaken a mission here and then disappeared. The queen shared what little she knew: Titania had been part of the group sent to retrieve Dragon’s Orb, and only one kobold had returned.

Overhearing Miara’s question, a dwarf approached and claimed to know something, pulling him outside to speak. Wu-Sha-Da and Mus tried to follow but were dismissed at the dwarf’s insistence. Outside a side entrance, the dwarf gave Miara a cigarette, put a hand on his shoulder, and said that twenty-seven years ago he and Titania had shared a wonderful night before her departure. He knew nothing more. As Miara considered this, he saw the dwarf’s hand reach toward a metallic glint at his waist.

paragraphs.quote: “Fuck you, filthy elf!”

paragraphs: The dwarf drew a dagger and repeatedly stabbed Miara in the stomach. Panicking, Miara broke free, fled inside, and used magic to buy time. He stumbled into the banquet hall clutching his wounds, causing an uproar. Queen Uma immediately summoned a doctor. When the attacker returned to the entrance, the queen denounced him. He responded by taking the same dagger, cutting his own throat, and collapsing. The adventurers examined him and found what appeared to be Elvish engraved on the blade, though only the word “Pureblood” could be read. Other dwarves identified the attacker as a blacksmith and said the weapon looked self-forged. No one had ever noticed any sign of his hatred toward elves.

Queen Uma apologized repeatedly and allowed Han-Liu to investigate the dwarf’s smithy. Mus and Wu-Sha-Da stayed with the wounded Miara. At the queen’s arrangement, Wu-Sha-Da shared a room with Miara, while Mus took one bed in a double room and waited for Han-Liu.

Two dwarves accompanied Han-Liu to the smithy. Hoping not to discomfort a fellow person of elven blood, one mentioned that his wife was an elf; the other said he was gay and understood life as a minority. They found the smithy’s door smashed and the interior in disarray. Several daggers resembled the murder weapon, but all were unfinished. They learned little else.

After leaving the smithy, Han-Liu accepted an invitation to spend the night at the home of the dwarf with an elven wife. The other dwarf enthusiastically joined them. The wife could decipher no additional text from the dagger, but the four shared a wonderful night.
In the morning, Mus found that his roommate had not returned. A fully recovered Miara, Wu-Sha-Da—who had slept soundly in the bathtub—and Mus went down to breakfast and waited for Han-Liu.
Midway through the meal, a dwarf woman greeted them and said she would accompany them on the mission. Strangely, she refused to reveal her name.
After breakfast, the woman carried Dragon’s Orb into the carriage with the four adventurers. She introduced their driver, a robot named BoBo-C.

On the road, the woman retrieved beer from the rear compartment for Wu-Sha-Da and Mus. Han-Liu and Miara questioned her about the mission, but she revealed little. She did admit that her name was Bol-Bol. As a child she had been mocked because it sounded like the BoBo line of robots, so she had grown to dislike it.

After the carriage had traveled for some time, Bol-Bol apparently cast a spell on the two adventurers who remained awake. Han-Liu resisted through sheer will, while Miara’s innate nature made him immune. Sensing something wrong, Miara cast a spell of his own that compelled Bol-Bol to tell the truth.

From the now-honest Bol-Bol, they learned that some power besides Queen Uma was using her to pursue another goal through this mission. Interference blocked the crucial details, preventing her from revealing everything. Bol-Bol said she only wanted magic to keep everyone quiet during the five-day journey. Further questioning revealed that she too was a robot. At Han-Liu’s request, Bol-Bol handed Dragon’s Orb to Miara, then dismantled herself piece by piece until only components littered the carriage. Among them was a panel stamped like a trademark with the large words “BoBo-OMEGA.”

Han-Liu asked BoBo-C about the area and learned that a village was nearby. He and Miara woke Wu-Sha-Da and Mus and explained what had happened. The four stopped at the village, found an inn for food and lodging, and asked BoBo-C to store Bol-Bol’s parts inside his abdomen. Their attempts to question him revealed only that BoBo-C was a relatively basic robot and knew nothing about any power interfering with the mission beyond Queen Uma.

A red light illuminated on BoBo-C’s back. He explained that one of his companions was approaching. Some time later, a shadow blocked the inn’s entrance, and a robot resembling BoBo-C stepped inside. BoBo-C introduced his fellow machine, BoBo-W. BoBo-W looked similar but was taller, with pale blue skin, purple markings, and wings.

After hearing from BoBo-W and BoBo-C, the adventurers decided to reach the trading point early. They gave Dragon’s Orb to BoBo-W, who placed it atop BoBo-C’s head. The orb merged into BoBo-C, transforming him into a slightly smaller version of BoBo-W. The evolved BoBo-C announced that he had become BoBo-Z.

The adventurers worked out how to “ride” BoBo-W and BoBo-Z. Wu-Sha-Da sat on BoBo-W’s back and Miara on BoBo-Z’s. Mus and Han-Liu clung to one leg of each robot, but both machines said the imbalance made flight impossible. Mus moved to BoBo-Z’s other leg, and BoBo-W headed outside. BoBo-Z then complained that the load was too heavy to fly, so Han-Liu returned to his room and abandoned the whole affair. At BoBo-Z’s direction, Mus held both his legs, allowing the robot to take off and follow his senior into the sky.

Late that night, the three airborne adventurers succumbed to exhaustion. Miara and Wu-Sha-Da fell asleep on the robots’ backs. Through a haze, Mus realized he was still clinging to BoBo-Z’s legs, but sleep overcame him and he fell from the sky.

By dawn, BoBo-W and BoBo-Z had reached the appointed meeting place. Miara and Wu-Sha-Da saw elves approaching and tried to explain that Dragon’s Orb had merged into the robots. Instead, one elf stepped forward and expertly pressed several points on each machine. Two Dragon’s Orbs slid smoothly from their bodies, restoring the robots to BoBo-V and BoBo-C. The elves walked away carrying the orbs, leaving behind a stunned Miara and Wu-Sha-Da and the promised crates of wine.

Without a carriage, they could not transport the wine. Wu-Sha-Da opened a bottle and drank deeply; it truly was far better than anything Queen Uma had served at the banquet. Miara used magic to message Queen Uma, Han-Liu at the inn, and the missing Mus. The trade was complete, he told them, but they had no carriage home. The queen said she would send someone, though they would take five days to arrive. Han-Liu replied that with the mission complete, he had no need to see the queen again. Mus did not answer.
Five days later, Han-Liu had traveled to the warm south, and two royal carriages reached the trading point. Neither contained a single robot.

paragraphs.quote: 「親愛的子民們，今天，是我們建立王朝的第78年紀念日，很高興各位在這裡，和我一起共同慶祝。希望大家開心！」

paragraphs: 《洛林精神》響遍佛萊特境廣大的野餐區，舞台上，征服者洛林帶領著大家齊聲哼唱，底下的妖精們齊聲歡呼，一同享受屬於妖精們的榮耀。

一群來自各地的妖精們坐在同一桌。海精靈贊蘭逃避著其他人的目光，專心吃著眼前的食物；騎著一匹靈魂馬的伊莉娜戴著頭盔，始終不下馬，顯得格格不入；興致高昂的湯瑪斯・韋克大口大口地狼吞虎嚥，比起妖精，他似乎更像隻哥布林；梅梅也逃避著其他人的視線，自顧自地享用美食；阿德看起來很疲憊，像是期望著這場晚宴盡快結束，可以到帳篷內休息；維爾法・寇斯莫斯則不斷試著和同桌的妖精們宣傳自己信仰的星界大蛇，希望有人能加入他的信仰，不過很顯然的，沒有人想要理他。
這時，一名看起來十分有威嚴的男子走上了舞台。這名中年的妖精清了清喉嚨，表示自己叫諾威爾，今天這場晚宴是他為洛林國王所策劃的，洛林先去準備休息了，有任何問題歡迎向他詢問，也希望大家可吃得開心。
不久後，用完餐，妖精們紛紛從野餐區離開，尋找附近帳篷的空位。帳篷的大小可以容納 10 名左右的成年妖精，不過有些帳篷內似乎有人正在忙碌著，因此冒險者們花了不少時間找到自己舒服的位置。而梅梅則待在野餐區，找了附近的一棵大樹，爬上去休息。

睡著前，維爾法聽見了帳篷外似乎有幾個人正在談話，談話的內容讓他感到十分好奇，好像在討論著和洛林國王有關的內容。維爾法悄悄揭開了帳篷的簾幕，看見其中一人是剛才在舞台上的諾威爾，另一人是這裡的宗教領袖，樹林之神的主教法倫，最後一人他不認識，不過從他的口中，聽起來是名醫生。三人談話的內容，聽起來像是與洛林國王之間的溝通有些隔閡，其中似乎牽涉到了某種宗教信仰。為了不被發現，維爾法躲回帳篷內，不過剛才聽見的內容，他知道自己需要一些時間消化。
一早，妖精們紛紛在不同時間清醒。
維爾法想著昨晚聽見的內容，心不在焉地走在路上，不過看見騎著靈魂馬的伊莉娜，他還是很努力想向他宣傳自己星界大蛇的宗教信仰。突然，他感受到自己身後搭上了一隻手。一回頭，昨晚看見的法倫主教正對他微笑。法倫主教表示大家的宗教信仰都很棒，我們是個大家庭，歡迎維爾法也加入。維爾法頓時腦內一陣迷糊，微笑著，便跟著法倫向前走了。伊莉娜感到有點奇異，便決定悄悄跟在後頭。

帳篷內，湯瑪斯看見一名妖精夥伴的虎口似乎受傷了，熱情地想用自己的雙手斧幫忙治療。然而其他妖精看了覺得沒有幫助，於是跑出帳篷外，去尋找醫生來治療。不久後，一名被稱為艾蒙的醫生進了帳篷。湯瑪斯看見醫生從背包內拿出了一綑材質特殊的繃帶，敷上傷者的傷口後，傷口快速地癒合了。湯瑪斯覺得神奇，偷偷地從艾蒙醫生的背包偷走了一綑繃帶。繃帶的材質看起來是從動物身上取得的，但湯瑪斯不確定是怎麼製作的。艾蒙醫生看見了，對湯瑪斯微笑，表示他如果想要，可以拿去，沒問題的。湯瑪斯很開心，拿走繃帶後便在帳篷外到處跑跳，見人便質疑別人是不是要偷走他的繃帶。
法倫帶著維爾法和跟在後頭的伊莉娜走到了野餐區，朝著一旁的樹林深處走去。在另一側樹上休息的梅梅看見了，感到好奇，便也在後面跟上。不久後，他看見昨晚同桌用餐的贊蘭似乎也來到了野餐區，似乎是在跟蹤著騎在馬上的伊莉娜。兩人結伴，在後頭看著法倫帶著的兩人到底要幹嘛。
森林深處，一個突兀的平地上圍繞著一圈的妖精們。法倫走入圈中，讓信徒們空出一個空位，給維爾法加入。看見站在後方騎在馬上的伊莉娜，法倫禮貌性地詢問他是否也要加入，信徒們則與看見維爾法時歡迎的模樣不同，面無表情地死盯著伊莉娜。伊莉娜表示沒關係，自己站在維爾法身後就好。而遠處，梅梅和贊蘭則躲在能聽見他們談話，但看不見人群的樹後默默聆聽。

圓圈內，法倫帶領著信徒們詠唱，祈禱，維爾法很快地便融入其中。一段時間後，維爾法感到身體開始發癢，有種過敏的不適感，在他身後的伊莉娜也有一樣的感覺。維爾法想站起身子，卻發現身體使不上力。信徒們觸摸維爾法的身體，給他安慰，但並沒有消除任何不適感，唯有法倫觸碰他的肩膀時，才有一股暖流流過他的身體，暫時消除那股刺癢感，但維爾法仍沒能站起身。伊莉娜的身體跨在靈魂馬上，他策馬轉頭離開，身上雖然感到不適，但仍有辦法移動身體。

梅梅和贊蘭看見從前方調頭離開的伊莉娜，便決定跟上，一探究竟。但伊莉娜騎在馬上，離開的速度還是比較快，因此一下就甩開他們兩人了。回到帳篷區，伊莉娜在詢問其他妖精後，找到了走在一起的洛林國王和諾威爾。伊莉娜向洛林國王表示剛剛在森林內看到了奇怪的宗教活動，建議洛林去看看。諾威爾試著將話題引開，有些可疑，洛林則表示他會找機會去看看。同時伊莉娜詢問了附近哪裡有河水，他想去沖洗一下身體，在諾威爾指引後，他便策馬離開。

雙手高舉著拿到的神奇繃帶，湯瑪斯感到很開心，但此時他突然覺得自己的手癢癢的，不舒服，於是他奮力將繃帶丟到地上。沒想到一旁路過的妖精看見掉在地上的繃帶，便把它拿走了。湯瑪斯跟在那名妖精身後，竟發現那名妖精帶著繃帶，走入了一個漂亮的帳篷內，而在帳篷內的似乎是剛剛看見的艾蒙醫生。醫生對於那名妖精將繃帶為他取回感到很滿意。在那名妖精離開帳篷後，湯瑪斯便跟蹤他，直到他走到人煙稀少處後，便襲擊他，把他綁到旁邊的空帳篷內拷問。
聽見隔壁傳來很大的吵鬧聲，換了個帳篷休息的阿德意興闌珊地跑來看，發現昨晚同桌用餐，長得像哥布林的妖精湯瑪斯正在拷問一名妖精。不久後，湯瑪斯發現好像也問不到什麼，便拋下那名妖精跑走了，阿德也跟了上來。兩人討論著湯瑪斯對於艾蒙醫生的疑慮。不久後，阿德覺得疲倦，便將自己傳送到遠處一棵樹旁休息。
湯瑪斯走在路上，遇見了剛從樹林深處出來一段時間的梅梅和贊蘭。梅梅和贊蘭也告訴了他剛才在樹林聽見的奇怪宗教活動。三名妖精都覺得事情不太對勁，想去找洛林國王。經過打聽，洛林國王和諾威爾似乎正在前往佛萊特境的入口處。
三名妖精朝著打聽到洛林國王的方向前行，恰巧阿德在路過的樹邊休息，便加入了他們，四名妖精一起前進。好不容易追上了洛林國王，大家訴說著艾蒙醫生和法倫主教的異狀，但諾威爾似乎一直想將話題敷衍地回答。
好不容易來到了佛萊特境的入口，妖精們看見了兩名衛兵抓著一名人類女子。人類喊著自己只是經過這裡而已，沒有別的意圖。洛林國王對妖精們解釋想確認他沒有別的意圖，畢竟人類對妖精是很有敵意的。誰知道在洛林國王說話的同時，諾威爾便快步走了上去，從腰際拿起匕首，迅速地劃破人類的喉嚨。眼看事情不對勁，妖精們紛紛拿起武器，準備和諾威爾進行對抗。
洛林國王試著和諾威爾喊話，表示不需要這樣子做，卻被諾威爾強行推倒在地。贊蘭躲在後方，極力讓自己不受到傷害。湯瑪斯、阿德和梅梅則合力將諾威爾擊潰，但倒在地上的諾威爾竟然化為一盤散沙，而湯瑪斯和阿德身上都開始有了非常不舒服的反應。

不久後，艾蒙醫生和幾名妖精來到了現場。洛林國王心情沉重，但在梅梅的詢問下，得知洛林國王對艾蒙醫生的可疑似乎也早就有了個底。艾蒙醫生在諾威爾的「屍體」旁蹲了下來，偷偷抓了一把散去的沙塵放入口袋，然後才站了起來，走向洛林國王，問了幾句話。洛林國王快速地將艾蒙醫生支開，然後在艾蒙醫生跟他的夥伴們離去後，也朝著帳篷區走回去了。阿德和湯瑪斯身上起了非常嚴重的搔癢感，感覺像是蜘蛛在他們身上爬一樣，躺在地上用力的抓都無法消除，一旁看見的贊蘭心裡也開始焦慮，懷疑自己身上是否也有蜘蛛在爬。三人慌張地扭動著身體，直到疲倦。眼看就要日落。在場唯一沒事的梅梅走出了佛萊特境外，三名恐慌的妖精也努力撐著身體，離開了這個是非之地。但是阿德和湯瑪斯隱隱約約的知道，這不適的搔癢感，恐怕會跟隨著他們一輩子。
河水內，伊莉娜脫下了包覆全身的盔甲，卻發現自己除了兩隻手掌外，全身上下的肌肉與皮膚都被啃食殆盡了，撲通撲通跳的心臟還運作著，但這一切怎麼樣都難以用科學解釋。他感到絕望，但想著自己也還沒死去，就再重新穿回護甲，朝著帳篷區回頭。
走在帳篷區，伊莉娜看見剛才跟隨著的維爾法站在一個華麗的帳篷前。維爾法向伊莉娜邀請共進晚餐，但伊莉娜感到隱隱約約的有問題，因此便離開了。但充滿好奇的他，還是躲在野餐區附近，觀察事情的發展。
走入帳篷內，維爾法加入了剛才一同繞圈的夥伴，聽著法倫主教的說明，接著便一起走出了帳篷，朝著野餐區前進。他們一人坐到一桌去，面帶微笑，朝著舞台盯著。伊莉娜從後方看著，感到可疑。

日落。法倫主教和艾蒙醫生走上了舞台，洛林國王似乎沒有在這裡。在法倫主教的說明下，他看著台下滿滿的妖精們，表示今天大家要在這裡見識一個新的宗教的誕生。他從背後拿出一把點燃的火把，艾蒙從口袋掏出一把沙子—那是剛才從諾威爾屍體處取得的沙子—丟向火內，然後火把燒向兩人的衣服。法倫主教和艾蒙醫生相擁，兩人帶領著舞台下的妖精們大聲狂喊：「艾蒙、法倫、諾威爾！艾蒙、法倫、諾威爾！艾蒙、法倫、諾威爾！艾蒙、法倫、諾威爾！」吶喊聲逐漸模糊，然後融在一起，形成了類似「艾爾、法、諾爾！」的聲響，最終成了一個名字。阿爾芬諾。就像被火包圍的兩人一樣，融成了一個怪物，一個恐懼的化身，一個高大而醜陋的孽物，一個不再能被稱為妖精的存在。
怪物淒厲的嘶吼，然後邁開他的步伐，朝著森林深處跑去。信徒們也紛紛離開野餐區，跟上怪物的步伐。維爾法意識到這新的宗教，並不是他想像中的星界巨蛇，有些失落，但他突然感受到了一股內心的衝動，有個聲音，要他「跟上」。維爾法邁開腳步，朝著怪物的方向前進，那騎在馬上、穿著盔甲的妖精跟隨其後。
森林深處的一個洞穴內，怪物停了下來，跟隨著的妖精數量已經少了一些。洞穴內除了還血肉模糊的阿爾芬諾、疲憊不堪的妖精們，以及滿滿的蜘蛛外，還有一隻巨型的蜘蛛。那蜘蛛似乎有著人類的面孔。年長的容貌，難以解讀的表情，像是個老婆婆一樣。
「母親大人。」阿爾芬諾如此稱呼他。
母親大人抓起洞穴內的妖精，張口便是一吞。伊莉娜眼看不對勁，試著想逃脫。直到最後，他是最後剩下的妖精了。擋在洞口的蜘蛛們剛好露出了個縫隙，伊莉娜見機便衝了出去，頭也不回地離開了這個恐怖的洞穴。

paragraphs.quote: “My dear subjects, today marks the seventy-eighth anniversary of our dynasty’s founding. I am delighted that you are here to celebrate with me. Enjoy yourselves!”

paragraphs: “The Spirit of Lorin” rang across the vast picnic grounds of the Freit Domain. Onstage, Lorin the Conqueror led the humming while the elves below cheered and celebrated the glory of their people.

Elves from many lands shared one table. The sea elf Zanlan avoided every gaze and concentrated on his food. Irina, helmeted and mounted on a spirit horse, never dismounted and looked wholly out of place. An exuberant Thomas Wake devoured his meal so ravenously that he seemed more goblin than elf. MayMay likewise avoided everyone’s eyes and enjoyed the food alone. Ade looked exhausted and appeared to be waiting for the banquet to end so he could rest in a tent. Vayrpher Cosmos persistently preached his faith in the Astral Serpent, hoping someone at the table might join him, though no one showed the slightest interest.

An imposing middle-aged elf stepped onto the stage and cleared his throat. He introduced himself as Norvelle, explained that he had organized the banquet for King Lorin, and said the king had retired to prepare for bed. Guests could bring any questions to him, and he hoped everyone enjoyed the feast.

After the meal, the elves left the picnic grounds to find space in the nearby tents. Each could hold about ten adults, but some occupants appeared to be busy, so it took the adventurers some time to find comfortable places. MayMay remained near the picnic grounds and climbed a tree to rest.

Before falling asleep, Vayrpher heard several people talking outside about what seemed to be King Lorin. He quietly lifted the tent flap and recognized Norvelle from the stage, Fallon, bishop of the forest god, and an unfamiliar man whose words suggested he was a doctor. Their conversation hinted at difficulty communicating with King Lorin and appeared to involve some religious belief. Vayrpher withdrew before he was noticed, knowing he would need time to digest what he had heard.
The elves awoke at different times the following morning.

Distracted by the conversation from the previous night, Vayrpher wandered along until he saw Irina on the spirit horse and once more tried earnestly to spread the faith of the Astral Serpent. A hand suddenly touched his shoulder. He turned to find Bishop Fallon smiling. Fallon said every faith was wonderful, that they were all one family, and that Vayrpher was welcome to join them. Vayrpher’s thoughts instantly blurred. Smiling, he followed Fallon away. Irina found this strange and quietly followed.

In one tent, Thomas noticed an injury between a fellow elf’s thumb and forefinger and enthusiastically offered to treat it with his greataxe. The others decided that would not help and fetched a doctor instead. A physician named Elmond soon entered. Thomas watched him take an unusual roll of bandage from his bag and apply it to the wound, which healed rapidly. Fascinated, Thomas secretly stole a roll. The material appeared to come from an animal, though he could not tell how it was made. Elmond noticed, smiled, and said Thomas could keep it if he wanted. Delighted, Thomas bounded around outside, accusing everyone he met of trying to steal his bandage.

Fallon led Vayrpher and the trailing Irina through the picnic grounds and deep into the woods. MayMay saw them from his tree and followed out of curiosity. He soon noticed Zanlan, who had shared their table, apparently following Irina. The two joined forces and watched from behind to learn what Fallon intended.

Deep in the forest, a ring of elves surrounded an unnatural clearing. Fallon entered and had his followers make a place for Vayrpher. Seeing Irina still mounted at the rear, he politely invited him to join. Unlike their warm welcome for Vayrpher, the followers stared blankly at Irina. Irina declined and said he would stand behind Vayrpher. In the distance, MayMay and Zanlan listened from behind a tree close enough to hear but hidden from the circle.

Fallon led the circle in chants and prayers, and Vayrpher quickly joined in. Soon his body began to itch with an allergic discomfort; Irina felt the same. Vayrpher tried to stand but had no strength. The followers touched him reassuringly, but brought no relief. Only when Fallon touched his shoulder did warmth flow through him and briefly ease the itching, though he still could not rise. Astride his spirit horse, Irina could still move despite his discomfort and turned away.

MayMay and Zanlan followed Irina, but his mount quickly left them behind. Back among the tents, Irina asked around and found King Lorin walking with Norvelle. He reported the strange religious gathering and suggested that Lorin investigate. Norvelle suspiciously tried to change the subject, while Lorin promised to look when he could. Irina asked where he might find a river to wash himself, then followed Norvelle’s directions and rode off.

Thomas happily held the miraculous bandage overhead until his hands suddenly began to itch. He threw it down, where a passing elf picked it up. Thomas followed the elf into an ornate tent and found Dr. Elmond inside. Elmond was pleased to have the bandage returned. Once the courier left, Thomas followed him to an isolated place, attacked him, tied him up in an empty tent, and interrogated him.

Ade, who had moved to another tent to rest, listlessly investigated the commotion next door and found the goblin-like Thomas from last night interrogating an elf. Thomas soon concluded that he would learn nothing, abandoned the prisoner, and ran off. Ade followed, and the two discussed Thomas’s suspicions about Dr. Elmond. Growing tired, Ade teleported to a distant tree to rest.

Thomas encountered MayMay and Zanlan shortly after they emerged from the forest. They told him about the strange religious gathering. All three agreed something was wrong and decided to find King Lorin. They heard that he and Norvelle were heading toward the entrance of the Freit Domain.

The three followed. Passing Ade’s tree, they recruited him, and the four eventually caught up with the king. They described the troubling behavior of Dr. Elmond and Bishop Fallon, but Norvelle repeatedly tried to dismiss their concerns.

At the entrance to the Freit Domain, they found two guards holding a human woman who shouted that she was only passing through and meant no harm. King Lorin explained that they needed to verify her intentions because humans were so hostile to elves. While he spoke, Norvelle strode forward, drew a dagger, and swiftly cut the woman’s throat. Realizing the danger, the elves drew their weapons to confront him.

King Lorin shouted that this was unnecessary, but Norvelle shoved him violently to the ground. Zanlan hid behind the others and did everything possible to avoid injury. Thomas, Ade, and MayMay defeated Norvelle together, only for his fallen body to collapse into loose sand. Thomas and Ade immediately began to suffer disturbing reactions.

Dr. Elmond soon arrived with several elves. King Lorin was grave, and when MayMay questioned him, it became clear that he had long harbored suspicions about the doctor. Elmond crouched beside Norvelle’s “corpse,” secretly pocketed a handful of its sand, then rose and questioned the king. Lorin quickly sent him away and returned to the tents after Elmond and his companions departed. Ade and Thomas developed a terrible itch, as if spiders crawled over them, and no amount of desperate scratching helped. Watching them, Zanlan grew anxious and imagined spiders on himself as well. The three writhed in panic until exhaustion overcame them. As sunset approached, MayMay—the only unaffected elf—left the Freit Domain, and the other three forced themselves to follow. Ade and Thomas sensed that the tormenting itch might remain with them for life.

In the river, Irina removed the armor covering his entire body and discovered that, apart from his palms, all his skin and muscle had been eaten away. His heart still beat, though science could not possibly explain how. Despairing but not yet dead, he put the armor back on and returned toward the tents.

There Irina saw Vayrpher standing before an ornate tent. Vayrpher invited him to dinner, but Irina sensed trouble and declined. Curiosity nevertheless drew him into hiding near the picnic grounds to watch.

Inside the tent, Vayrpher joined the companions from the morning’s circle and listened to Bishop Fallon. They then walked together to the picnic grounds and each sat at a separate table, smiling and staring at the stage. Watching from behind, Irina remained suspicious.

At sunset, Bishop Fallon and Dr. Elmond took the stage. King Lorin was nowhere to be seen. Fallon faced the crowd and proclaimed that they would witness the birth of a new religion. He produced a burning torch. Elmond took the sand collected from Norvelle’s corpse and threw it into the flame, then the torch set both their clothes alight. Fallon and Elmond embraced and led the elves below in a frenzied chant: “Elmond, Fallon, Norvelle! Elmond, Fallon, Norvelle! Elmond, Fallon, Norvelle! Elmond, Fallon, Norvelle!” The words blurred and fused into “El, Fa, Nor”—and finally into one name: Alfenor. As the two figures burned, they merged into a monster: an incarnation of terror, a tall and hideous abomination that could no longer be called an elf.

The monster gave a piercing howl and ran deep into the forest. The faithful abandoned the picnic grounds and followed. Vayrpher was disappointed to realize that the new religion was not the Astral Serpent he had imagined, but then an urge rose within him and a voice commanded him to “follow.” He ran after the monster, with the armored, mounted elf close behind.

The monster stopped in a cave deep in the forest, with fewer elves still following. Inside were the raw and bleeding Alfenor, the exhausted faithful, countless spiders, and one giant spider with an apparently human face—aged, unreadable, and grandmotherly.
“The Mother,” Alfenor called her.

The Mother seized elves from the cave and swallowed them whole. Irina saw the danger and tried to escape, until at last he was the only elf remaining. A gap opened among the spiders blocking the entrance. Irina seized the opportunity, charged through, and fled the dreadful cave without looking back.
睜開雙眼，冒險者們感到困惑。除了他們之外，身邊倒了一個人。那人似乎是帶他們來到這裡的嚮導，名叫帕瑞爾・亨德里克斯，但是他死透了。
除此之外，眼前的巨像似乎正在攻擊他們。冒險者們努力與他對抗，卻發現在怎麼用武器攻擊，或是甚至透過魔法，都對他沒什麼影響。那巨像堅不可破，甚至可說是所向無敵。
對戰的同時，冒險者們逐漸想起自己為何會出現在這無助的場景。幾天前，著尼森帝國遭到一群平民推翻，掀起了暴動。皇帝雖然沒死，但已失去了對帝國的控制權。而在反抗的群眾中，由崔尼斯教組成的「崔尼斯的聖騎士」是最大的勢力。

冒險者們受聘於卓尼森帝國的皇帝喬森十三世，奉命找到崔尼斯教的神秘武器，邁爾斯坦巨像，並將其摧毀。傳說中，邁爾斯坦是崔尼斯的弟弟，但在崔尼斯成神後，邁爾斯坦拒絕他的邀約，決定留在凡間，保護崔尼斯的信徒，因此十分受崔尼斯信徒們的愛戴。邁爾斯坦也受到崔尼斯的祝福，以人類之姿活了近兩百歲才死去。在他死後，信徒們建起了一座雕像來紀念他，稱為「邁爾斯坦巨像」。不過隨著時間久遠，邁爾斯坦逐漸被遺忘，巨像的存在也成為了傳說。
隨著與巨像的戰鬥持續著，冒險者們發現自己在所處的平面，似乎是個浮在空中的圓盤，且隨著時間，圓盤邊緣的石塊逐漸剝落，一不小心就會掉下去。而下方，距離大家所熟知的地面極為遙遠。
沃特西掉到了圓盤的邊緣，永恆的墜落下去；拉斐爾被巨像擠壓，斷光了骨頭；哈拉爾德沒能逃過巨像的一拳。最終只剩下苟延殘喘，爬在巨像身上的瑪娜・珍和化身為鳥的歐巴，逃過一劫。在圓盤周圍全數崩塌後，巨像蜷起身體，不動了。瑪娜・珍和歐巴兩人停在巨像頂端，稍作休息。但是他們不知道巨像何時會再動起來，也不知道要怎麼活著回到地面……

瑪娜・珍和歐巴從夢中驚醒，發現自己睡在帳篷中。周圍的沃特西、拉斐爾和哈拉爾德還沒醒來。帳篷被拉開，活生生的帕瑞爾催促著他們，說距離石像只剩一天的路程了，要大家趕快出發。瑪娜・珍和歐巴清楚記得「剛剛」發生的事。叫醒其他夥伴後，大家也對與巨像的戰鬥感到歷歷在目。大家將完全搞不清楚狀況的帕瑞爾打暈了後，歐巴、拉斐爾和哈拉爾德決定要帶著帕瑞爾回到巨像那裡，探索清楚到底發生什麼事；瑪娜・珍和沃特西則決定放棄任務，回去找皇帝索取獎金。
被打到受傷的帕瑞爾走路速度慢了不少，原本一天就會抵達的路程，他們沒能趕上，中間只好停下來過夜。
冒險者們依據記憶中圓盤的範圍估算，在肉眼可見到巨像時，開始擬定戰略。拉斐爾先前往巨像旁，簡單探索是否有什麼魔法或機關，隨後歐巴和哈拉爾德也趕上。接著，拉斐爾透過魔法，要求帕瑞爾攻擊巨像，同時三名冒險者躲到附近的樹林觀察。
圓盤隨著轟隆聲響起而逐漸升起，正如歐巴化為鳥時所見，那並不是個圓盤，而是個圓柱。
一天過去，圓柱已上升到冒險者們看不見他的頂部了。他們計算著這時離開是否安全，然後就聽見「啪」的一聲，一團模糊不清的肉塊從天而降，墜落在圓柱的周圍。那想必是帕瑞爾的屍體了。

沃特西和瑪娜・珍依照記憶，回到了帝國首都桑普塔諾市，但衛兵的穿著似乎變得不太一樣了。詢問了路人後，才知道卓尼森帝國已不復存在，現在是崔尼斯帝國掌權了。瑪娜・珍清楚狀況後，便決定離開這裡，回家去了。沒領到賞金的沃特西很不甘心，透過各種方法，混進了戒備森嚴的王宮內，偽裝成被新聘來上工的平民，並四處尋找金庫的蹤跡。他成功見到了新任的皇帝霍里森一世，告訴他有人要襲擊對他們來說應該很重要的邁爾斯坦巨像。皇帝對於他知道邁爾斯坦巨像這件事感到詫異，但也沒有因此太過慌張，僅派了人去調查而已，沃特西終究沒有得到他想要的獎賞。
拉斐爾、歐巴和哈拉爾德回到了桑普塔諾市，在了解到卓尼森帝國已經瓦解了後，他們很清楚自己的賞金是沒能拿到了（當然，他們也沒能完成任務就是了），於是他們便離開了。
多待了一天，沃特西清楚知道自己在這裡什麼也拿不到，於是他利用機會，將手上的掃把扔了，走出了王宮。首都的居民們各有忙碌的事，沃特西走在路上，沒有什麼人特別關注他，直到他發現自己的肩膀被拍了一下。他回頭，一名披著斗篷，看不見臉的人用手比了個「噓」的手勢。沃特西急忙想問清楚那人是誰？這代表什麼意思？但他只得到了一個模糊的答案：「卓尼森會再回來的。」然後他就昏過去了。
清醒後，他回想起，在昏倒之前，他似乎看見了那斗篷底下一抹微笑，以及聽見一個姓氏：伯納斯。
The adventurers opened their eyes in confusion. A man lay beside them. He appeared to be Parrell Hendrix, the guide who had brought them here, and he was thoroughly dead.
A colossus before them was attacking. The adventurers fought back, but neither weapons nor magic had any effect. The colossus was unbreakable—perhaps invincible.

As they fought, the adventurers gradually remembered why they were trapped in this hopeless scene. Several days earlier, commoners had overthrown the Dranison Empire in a violent uprising. The emperor survived but lost control, and the largest rebel faction was the “Paladins of Trinix,” followers of the Church of Trinix.

Emperor Joson XIII had hired the adventurers to find and destroy the church’s mysterious weapon, the Mylstan Colossus. Legend called Mylstan the younger brother of Trinix. When Trinix became a god, Mylstan declined his invitation and remained in the mortal world to protect Trinix’s faithful, who loved him dearly. Trinix blessed him, allowing him to live nearly two hundred years as a human. After his death, the faithful built a statue in his honor: the Mylstan Colossus. Over time, both Mylstan and the colossus faded into legend.

As the battle continued, the adventurers realized that they stood on a disk floating in the sky. Stones steadily crumbled from its edge, threatening to send anyone nearby plunging toward the familiar ground far below.

WotCy fell from the disk’s edge into an endless descent. The colossus crushed every bone in Raphael’s body. Harald failed to escape its fist. Only Mana Jane, desperately clinging to the statue, and Obba, transformed into a bird, survived. Once the entire disk had collapsed, the colossus curled into itself and stopped moving. Mana Jane and Obba rested atop it, not knowing when it might awaken or how they could return alive to the ground.

Mana Jane and Obba awoke from a dream inside a tent. WotCy, Raphael, and Harald still slept nearby. A living Parrell opened the flap and urged everyone onward, saying the statue was only a day away. Mana Jane and Obba clearly remembered what had “just” happened. Once awakened, their companions also vividly recalled fighting the colossus. They knocked out the utterly confused Parrell. Obba, Raphael, and Harald decided to take him back to the statue and discover the truth, while Mana Jane and WotCy abandoned the mission and returned to demand payment from the emperor.
Injured from the beating, Parrell walked much more slowly. They could not complete the one-day journey and had to camp overnight.

Using their memories to estimate the disk’s radius, the adventurers began planning as soon as the colossus came into view. Raphael approached first to inspect it for magic or mechanisms, followed by Obba and Harald. Raphael then magically compelled Parrell to attack the statue while the three adventurers observed from the nearby woods.
With a thunderous rumble, the disk began rising. As Obba had seen in bird form, it was not a disk at all, but the top of a cylinder.

A day later, the cylinder had risen so high that its top was no longer visible. As the adventurers calculated whether it was safe to leave, a wet smack sounded and an indistinct mass of flesh fell from the sky beside the column. It could only be Parrell’s body.

Following their memories, WotCy and Mana Jane returned to the imperial capital, Samptano, but the guards’ uniforms had changed. A passerby told them that the Dranison Empire no longer existed; the Trinix Empire now ruled. Once she understood, Mana Jane left for home. Bitter at losing his reward, WotCy used every trick he knew to infiltrate the heavily guarded palace, disguised himself as a newly hired common laborer, and searched for the treasury. He reached the new emperor, Horison I, and warned that someone intended to attack the Mylstan Colossus, which should be important to the regime. The emperor was surprised that WotCy knew of it but showed little alarm and merely sent investigators. WotCy never received the reward he wanted.

Raphael, Obba, and Harald also returned to Samptano. Once they learned that the Dranison Empire had collapsed, they knew they would never be paid—though, of course, they had not completed the mission either—so they left.

After one more day, WotCy accepted that there was nothing for him here. He threw away his broom and walked out of the palace. The capital’s people were busy and ignored him until someone tapped his shoulder. WotCy turned to a cloaked, faceless figure holding a finger to its lips. He demanded to know who the stranger was and what this meant, but received only a vague answer: “Dranison will return.” Then he lost consciousness.
When he awoke, he recalled a smile beneath the hood and a surname spoken just before he fainted: Berners.

legends-os08.title: Lord Octavian von Oderick’s Dungeon of Randomness

image.alt: Lord Octavian von Oderick’s Dungeon of Randomness banner

paragraphs: 冒險者們一一醒來，發現自己被困在一個狹小的房間內。五名互不相識的人們想不起自己怎麼會出現在這裡，只直覺知道，必須逃離這個鬼地方。
門被推開，一名身材高壯的女性半獸人矗立在大家面前。他自稱莉莉絲，或者依他老闆給他的稱呼「小莉莉」。在小莉莉的說明下，冒險者們在自己身上分別找到了兩張小紙，他們被交付要在逃離這座地城前完成小紙上的任務，如果不做到，就會「暴斃」，而小莉莉則是充當他們的嚮導。
踏出小房間的門外，冒險者們發現地上有放了一個小木箱，打開後，竟然是一罐啤酒。此時，小莉莉有些尷尬、扭捏地喊出了「歐德里克啤酒，歐歐歐歐歐……五告讚！」雖然搞不清楚是怎麼回事，冒險者們拿了啤酒，便繼續往後走了。

paragraphs.quote: 歐德里克啤酒，歐歐歐歐歐……五告讚！

paragraphs: 過了幾個房間，冒險者在觸摸牆壁的過程中，發現了異狀，這個房間內似乎有個陷阱。在小心測試後，冒險者刻意觸發了陷阱，確定沒有危險後，才踏入下個房間。
映入眼簾的是三隻骷髏妖。仔細一看，與其說是骷髏妖，他們更像是穿著骷髏裝扮的……半身人？冒險者們眼見危險，發動攻勢，不久後，骷髏妖們都被踩在冒險者們的腳下了。聽他們的哭訴，似乎他們只是奉「老闆」的命行事，並不是什麼真的有威脅的生物。在冒險者們的邀請下，他們跟在隊伍的後方，一同繼續這趟旅程。
註：此處應有一任務，為將骷髏的骨頭拼好（依照三隻骷髏妖的說法，他們的夥伴死了，因此他們要將他下葬，但其實骷髏的骨頭都是塑膠做的。假的！），但因為地城主一時找不到道具，只好先跳過，抱歉了冒險者！
長廊中，一個龐大的身影擋住了大家的去路。一隻食人魔搖搖晃晃地走著，然而，他黑色眼罩下的眼睛，似乎看不見。在冒險者們和他溝通後，得知他名為「古古」，口口聲聲要著「糖糖」，不過對冒險者們並沒有威脅。
冒險者們繞過古古，繼續往前走。他們在前方的房間看見了一個寶箱。在小莉莉的說明下，寶箱內放著的是「混沌之王巴頓」的將軍，水獺奧托。而實際上在寶箱內的，是隻水獺的布偶。冒險者們將玩偶帶走後，便繼續向前行。

paragraphs.quote: 他十分有魅力，召集了反巴頓的勢力，攻進了巴頓的宮殿，將他封印。

paragraphs: 接著，冒險者走入了一處長廊，看見了三隻「石像鬼」。此時的他們，已經很清楚這個「地城」似乎並不是多危險的地方，甚至有些簡陋。這些石像鬼，也當然不是真的石像鬼，而是身上塗滿灰色顏料的魔人，在矮小的房間內騰空盤旋。冒險者們作勢攻擊他們，同時跟他們要「石像鬼的眼睛」，最終，石像鬼們從口袋拿出了五、六顆糖果，作為石像鬼的眼睛，交給冒險者們。扣掉其中一位冒險者任務小卡上需要的三顆眼睛，幾名冒險者們回到古古的長廊，把糖果遞給他，古古露出滿意的表情。
在長廊的一端，冒險者們找到了另一個寶箱，裡面是一隻青蛙的布偶，依照小莉莉的說明，他是「混沌之王巴頓」的大臣，青蛙菲菲，他善於言詞，因此巴頓被他所欺騙。

paragraphs.quote: 他善於言詞，因此巴頓被他所欺騙。

paragraphs: 長廊的另一端，一座高台上，放著一個有些簡陋的「王冠」，他似乎有著「隨機王冠」之稱。冒險者們有人對他毫無興趣，有人則想嘗試戴上。在戴上王冠後，經過每一扇門，冒險者們都聽見了相同或不同的莫名語句從王冠冒出。
經過了幾扇門，幾名冒險者都被突如其來的王冠音效嚇到了，因此他們要求其他冒險者們把王冠留下來，不准戴著他繼續走。其中一名冒險者在其他人離開後，嘗試用自己的繩子把王冠釣在門框上，讓王冠前後擺動，不斷發出不同的音效，惹得在遠處仍能聽到的其他冒險者十分不爽。
又經過了幾處簡陋的陷阱和啤酒盒（每次打開，小莉莉和其他「員工」都會一起高喊「歐德里克啤酒，歐歐歐歐歐……五告讚！」，但幾名冒險者表示厭煩後，他們降低了音量，喊得也較為七零八落）。接著，冒險者們找到了第三個寶箱，裡面是一隻怪獸的布偶，小莉莉說明，這是渾沌之王巴頓。

paragraphs.quote: 傳說中巴頓是造物者，是天帝，是宇宙之王，但是在他準備大開殺戒之前，被他的左右手水獺奧托以及青蛙菲菲叛變，封印在這座地城底下。

paragraphs: 穿過房間後，冒險者們看見了一間較大的房間，但地上除了兩瓶空的啤酒外，什麼也沒有。此時小莉莉明顯露出了不開心的情緒。依照他的說法，原本要在這裡的是兩隻「半人馬」，他們一定是蹺班跑去喝啤酒了。於是大家只好繞過這個房間，繼續向前行。
又經過了幾處啤酒箱和陷阱，冒險者們看見一名有著類似魔法師裝扮的人類，在看見他們之後便匆匆跑進一個大房間內，於是他們便跟上。大房間內有個祭壇，上面躺了一個人，那名魔法師裝扮的年輕女子自稱貝拉。

paragraphs.quote: 你們膽敢打斷混亂之王的召喚儀式？我，貝拉，會奉混亂之王巴頓之名，將你們擊滅！

paragraphs: 在貝拉的呼喚下，祭壇上打扮為殭屍的男子嘗試坐起來，但是冒險者們很快就把他踩在腳下，讓他動彈不得，而貝拉很顯然的也對戰鬥興致缺缺。裝扮為殭屍的男子，傑羅姆，和冒險者們悄悄話，說自己想要表現得帥一點，他想在扮演貝拉的女孩面前帥一波。在冒險者們的幫助下，傑羅姆稍微有點發揮的機會，但很顯然女孩對他不屑一顧，搞得傑羅姆灰心喪氣。原本應為地下城的最終決戰處，在一片尷尬下，大家趕緊逃離，只留下其中一名冒險者聽著傑羅姆的傾訴。他一邊聽著，一邊詢問傑羅姆，之後能否讓他來扮演混沌之王巴頓？
繞回剛剛的長廊，冒險者們發現了一條排滿啤酒的長廊，兩名冒險者便衝了過去。為了達成其中一名冒險者任務的項目，他發瘋似的狂灌歐德里克啤酒（然而因為酒精濃度太低，還沒喝醉，他就得先找地方小解）。最終，他終於達成喝醉的目標，倒在長廊中間，讓另一名冒險者扛著他走。
另一側，冒險者們打開了半鎖的門，發現在員工休息室內，一隻半人馬和一對人類兄弟早以酩酊大醉，小莉莉破口大罵，但酒醉的他們早已無法正常回應。
從擺滿啤酒的長廊和員工休息室，各有一扇門往後走。冒險者們走入了最後一個房間：怪奇藝廊。裡面放了各式各樣對老闆而言「有價值」的藏品，讓冒險者們自由索取，冒險者們挑了幾個自己覺得還過得去的收藏（最後一名冒險者把剩下所有的藏品都搜刮走了）。

其中一名冒險者不等其他人，自行推開了藝廊朝外的門，夕陽餘暉下，他直直往前走。依照小莉莉一開始的說法，老闆似乎正在等他們吃晚餐。他走入了餐廳，老闆熱烈的歡迎他入座，但冒險者對老闆十分不開心，表示為何要這樣對他的員工，讓他們十分不情願的工作？甚至還把體型過大的古古放在狹小的空間內，讓他無法離開？老闆無法給出令冒險者滿意的回答，只能請他先坐下來，等等邊吃飯邊說，但冒險者已經受不了了，對著老闆威脅後，便走出餐廳的另一側，離開了。

當其他冒險者與員工們一同走入餐廳時，狼狽的老闆故作鎮定的歡迎他們。他自我介紹名為「屋大維・馮・歐德里克」，是歐德里克啤酒的老闆。在冒險者們用餐的同時，歐德里克說明自己靠著釀造低廉的啤酒，以遠低於市價的金額賣出，賺了很多錢。如今財富滿滿的他決定涉足娛樂業，因此在無意間找到這處迷宮後，請員工將它打造為一座地城。冒險者們便是他的第一批試營運的顧客。至於為何冒險者們不記得自己怎麼來的，歐德里克表示他請人隨機找人參與測試，大概是他底下的員工將冒險者們迷暈了後運了過來，他自己也不清楚。問及古古，冒險者們才發現歐德里克根本不知道這一隻食人魔被關在地城內，究竟古古為何會在地城內？恐怕沒有人會知道。最後，其中一名冒險者為員工們的福利打抱不平，卻在歐德里克請小莉莉親口說出薪資後傻了眼：小莉莉的日薪是 20 枚金幣。歐德里克藉機挖角，最終請了兩名冒險者們留下來做他的員工，日薪給到 150 至 180 金幣，且隨時要走都可以，冒險者們毫無拒絕的理由，便開心留下了。剩下的兩名冒險者們（一名正默默吃著晚餐，另一名則還沒從酒醉中清醒）則被歐德里克的員工們請離了。
誓死保護小莉莉。離開地城前，需使用第三人稱溝通。不能用手碰門。帶走至少一項怪奇藝廊的展品。找到隨機王冠並戴上它。至少觸發三個陷阱。找到水獺奧托、青蛙菲菲和巴頓的布偶。將骷髏的骨頭拼好。搜集三顆石像鬼的眼睛。離開地城前要喝醉！
歐德里克全家福。創意頭盔。巴頓的指甲。歐德里克的親筆簽名。巴納沃二世喝過的歐德利克啤酒。榮耀之雞的羽毛。歐德里克與諾曼爵士的繪畫。《歐德里克的隨機地城》門票。
The adventurers awoke one by one in a cramped room. The five strangers could not remember how they had arrived, but instinct told them that they had to escape this cursed place.

The door opened, revealing a tall, powerfully built half-orc woman. She introduced herself as Lilith, or “Lil’Lily,” as her employer called her. Following her explanation, each adventurer found two slips of paper on their person. They had to complete the tasks written there before escaping the dungeon or they would “drop dead.” Lil’Lily would serve as their guide.

Outside the small room stood a wooden chest. Inside was a bottle of beer. Lil’Lily awkwardly and bashfully cried, “Oderick Beer, oh-oh-oh-oh-oh... so damn good!” Confused, the adventurers took the beer and continued.

paragraphs.quote: Oderick Beer, oh-oh-oh-oh-oh... so damn good!

paragraphs: Several rooms later, the adventurers noticed something strange while touching the walls: a trap. After careful testing, they deliberately triggered it and, once certain it was harmless, entered the next room.

Three skeletons awaited them—or rather, three halflings in skeleton costumes. The adventurers attacked the apparent danger and soon had all three beneath their feet. The halflings tearfully explained that they were only following the “boss’s” orders and posed no real threat. At the adventurers’ invitation, they joined the rear of the party.

Note: This section was supposed to feature a task in which the adventurers reassembled a skeleton. According to the three “skeletons,” their companion had died and needed burial, though the bones were actually plastic. Fake! The DM could not find the prop in time, so the task was skipped. Sorry, adventurers!

A huge figure blocked the corridor. It was a staggering ogre whose eye beneath a black patch appeared blind. Conversation revealed that his name was Guu-Guu and that he constantly asked for “gum-gum,” but he posed no threat.

The party went around Guu-Guu and found a treasure chest in the next room. Lil’Lily said it held Otto the Otter, general of the “Lord of Chaos, Bah’Duum.” In reality it contained an otter plush. The adventurers took it and continued.

paragraphs.quote: He was immensely charismatic. He rallied the forces opposed to Bah’Duum, stormed his palace, and sealed him away.

paragraphs: The next corridor contained three “gargoyles.” By now the party understood that the dungeon was neither dangerous nor impressive. These were, of course, not gargoyles but tieflings painted gray and hovering in a low-ceilinged room. The adventurers pretended to attack and demanded “gargoyle eyes.” The performers finally produced five or six candies from their pockets. After reserving the three eyes needed for one adventurer’s task, the group returned to Guu-Guu and gave him the rest. He looked satisfied.

At one end of the corridor, another chest held a frog plush. According to Lil’Lily, this was Fifi the Frog, minister to the “Lord of Chaos, Bah’Duum.” His gift for words had allowed him to deceive his master.

paragraphs.quote: He was skilled with words, and thus Bah’Duum was deceived.

paragraphs: At the corridor’s other end, a crude “crown” sat on a pedestal. It appeared to be known as the Crown of Randomness. Some adventurers ignored it, while others tried it on. Whenever its wearer passed through a door, the crown spoke the same—or a different—nonsensical phrase.

After several doors, the crown’s sudden sound effects had startled everyone repeatedly. They ordered its wearer to leave it behind. Once the others departed, one adventurer suspended the crown from the doorframe with a rope and swung it back and forth, making it emit endless sounds that infuriated the companions who could still hear it in the distance.

They passed more crude traps and beer chests. Each opening prompted Lil’Lily and the other “employees” to cry, “Oderick Beer, oh-oh-oh-oh-oh... so damn good!” When several adventurers complained, the staff lowered their voices and chanted with far less coordination. A third treasure chest held a monster plush, which Lil’Lily identified as Bah’Duum himself.

paragraphs.quote: Legend says Bah’Duum was the creator, the Celestial Emperor, and king of the universe. Before he could begin his great slaughter, however, his closest retainers—Otto the Otter and Fifi the Frog—betrayed him and sealed him beneath this dungeon.

paragraphs: The next room was larger but empty except for two beer bottles. Lil’Lily was visibly unhappy. Two “centaurs” were supposed to be stationed there, she explained, but they had clearly skipped work to drink. The party passed through and continued.

After more beer chests and traps, the adventurers saw a human dressed like a wizard hurry into a large chamber. They followed. An altar stood inside with someone lying atop it, and the young “wizard” introduced herself as Bella.

paragraphs.quote: You dare interrupt the summoning ritual of the Lord of Chaos? I, Bella, will destroy you in the name of Bah’Duum!

paragraphs: At Bella’s call, a man dressed as a zombie tried to sit up, but the adventurers quickly pinned him beneath their feet. Bella was clearly uninterested in an actual fight. The “zombie,” Jerome, whispered that he wanted to look cool and impress the girl playing Bella. The adventurers gave him a chance to show off, but she remained dismissive, leaving him dejected. Everyone hurried away from the awkward scene that should have been the dungeon’s climactic battle, except one adventurer who listened to Jerome’s troubles and asked whether he might play Bah’Duum next time.

Returning to the previous corridor, the party found a passage lined with beer, and two adventurers charged in. To fulfill a task, one frantically drank Oderick Beer. Its alcohol content was so low that he had to stop to urinate before becoming drunk. He eventually achieved his goal and collapsed in the corridor, forcing another adventurer to carry him.

On the other side, the party opened a half-locked door to the staff lounge. One centaur and two human brothers were already hopelessly drunk. Lil’Lily cursed them furiously, but they were incapable of a coherent response.

Doors from both the beer-lined corridor and staff lounge led to the final room: the Gallery of Curiosities. It displayed assorted items the boss considered “valuable,” which the adventurers could take freely. They selected several barely acceptable pieces, and the last adventurer looted everything that remained.

Without waiting, one adventurer opened the gallery’s outer door and walked into the sunset. Lil’Lily had said the boss awaited them for dinner. The adventurer entered the dining room and was warmly welcomed, but angrily demanded to know why the boss mistreated unwilling employees and confined the oversized Guu-Guu in a space too small to escape. Unable to give a satisfying answer, the boss asked him to sit and discuss it over dinner. The adventurer had had enough; after threatening the boss, he walked through the far door and left.

When the others and the employees entered, the rattled boss pretended composure and welcomed them. He introduced himself as Lord Octavian von Oderick, owner of Oderick Beer. During dinner, he explained that he had become wealthy by brewing cheap beer and selling it far below market price. He now wished to enter the entertainment business. After discovering this maze by chance, he had employees convert it into a dungeon, and the adventurers were its first test customers. As for their lost memories, he had hired someone to recruit random testers; his employees had probably drugged and transported them, though he did not know the details. When asked about Guu-Guu, Oderick revealed that he had no idea an ogre was trapped below. Why Guu-Guu was there would likely remain a mystery. One adventurer advocated for the employees, only to be stunned when Oderick had Lil’Lily state her wage: twenty gold pieces per day. Oderick then recruited two adventurers at daily salaries of 150 to 180 gold, with freedom to quit at any time. They had no reason to refuse and happily stayed. The remaining two—one quietly eating dinner, the other still unconscious from drink—were escorted out by the staff.

Protect Lil’Lily with your life. Speak in the third person until leaving the dungeon. Never touch a door with your hands. Take at least one exhibit from the Gallery of Curiosities. Find and wear the Crown of Randomness. Trigger at least three traps. Find the plush toys of Otto the Otter, Fifi the Frog, and Bah’Duum. Reassemble the skeleton’s bones. Collect three gargoyle eyes. Get drunk before leaving the dungeon!

en.date: Exhibits in the Gallery of Curiosities
paragraphs: The Oderick family portrait. A creative helmet. Bah’Duum’s fingernail. Oderick’s autograph. A bottle of Oderick Beer once drunk by Barnavor II. A feather from the Chicken of Glory. A painting of Oderick and Syr Norman. A ticket to Oderick’s Dungeon of Randomness.

legends-os09.title: To the Deep and Back 往返深淵

image.alt: To the Deep and Back 往返深淵 banner

paragraphs: 冒險者們在昏暗的地下室依序醒來，發現自己的身體哪裡怪怪的。仔細一看，每名冒險者身上都有各自不同的殘缺之處。不過，如果沒有記錯……大家不是都已經死了嗎？
在冒險者的回憶中，他們受聘於布萊特沃斯家族，與他們安插的人手，人稱「魅影」的法內羅・懷特，一起入侵敵對的貴族希爾維羅姆家族宅邸。然而，在幾日探勘完成，預計入侵的前一晚，魅影趁著大家睡著時一一綁起，自己一人綁架了希爾維羅姆家所有的成員，帶到冒險者們藏匿的洞窟。在洞窟內，魅影將希爾維羅姆家虐殺完後，逐一將冒險者們肢解。
但此時，冒險者們確實的醒來了。在你們正中間的地上，有鮮血繪製的法陣。從當中深淵語的內容，冒險者們判斷這是個復活儀式，上面留有一段話：「醒來，你們還沒完成你們的任務」。冒險者們也發現被復活的自己，已經成了不死生物。
在一段時間的掙扎後，冒險者們發現地上留有一排腳印，從腳印可以依稀判斷是個成年人類，而且很有可能是個貴族。冒險者們隨著腳印，推開沒有上鎖的門，走上了樓。
冒險者們發現自己處在一座未曾見過宗教的祠堂內，空蕩蕩的，只有牆上有些觸手的裝飾。突然，他們看見一名人形生物從祠堂內走出門口。冒險者透過魔法，命令生物朝著他們走來。定睛一看，那隻生物竟然有著魚頭人身的外型，冒險者們過去未曾見過這樣的生物。透過魔法，他們成功和這隻生物溝通，然而他的名字難以用冒險者們熟知的語言呈現，因此他們以最接近的語句，稱呼他為阿巴努。
與阿巴努簡單溝通後，他答應帶冒險者們去見他會用通用語的老大。大家走在空曠的路間，一個人也沒見著。
一段時間後，冒險者們來到了一個聚落，其中除了他們停下來的房子有兩、三層之外，剩下的房子都只有一層樓。阿巴努推開門，讓冒險者們直接進入。
房子內深處的沙發上，一隻巨大的蛙人癱坐著。他看向冒險者們，以稀客稱呼他們。蛙人向冒險者們以通用語自我介紹，其名為霍布。霍布為冒險者們準備了餐點（枯葉、骨頭等看起來不怎麼美味，甚至不確定是否能稱為食物的東西）。在冒險者們的詢問下，他們得知自己的復活儀式，很有可能是現在住在霍布樓上客房的一名人類的傑作。除此之外，他們也從霍布身上得知，這裡是個稱為「深淵」的時空，與冒險者們生前所處的「物質時空」平行。

paragraphs.quote: 「平行的意思是同時存在，且互不干涉。」

paragraphs: 深淵內居住的生物中，有部分被稱為「深淵人」是被從物質世界抓來深淵的生物（除了人類外，偶爾也會有其他物種），而在深淵待久了後，他們會逐漸失去理智，成為深淵人。除了深淵人之外的物種，便簡單以「深淵生物」稱之。深淵生物具有可以自由穿梭深淵與物質時空的能力，深淵人與誤闖深淵的生物則無法。
