帕拉丁試著止痛，但此時恐懼和痛覺兩者並起，帕拉丁一時不知道該說什麼，便又昏了過去。
當帕拉丁再次醒來時，他看見遠處站著一名女子，那人似乎不是安娜，因此他大聲喊叫，希望能獲救。那人趕緊靠近，帕拉丁認得她，是蘿琳。蘿琳看見他的手，關心了一下，帕拉丁這才發現斷指的部分指頭竟然被接上了一節像是昆蟲或節肢動物的指節，銜接處癢癢的，讓他感到很困惑。

蘿琳催促著帕拉丁趕快逃，兩人便在地下水道奔馳。跑了好久，帕拉丁沒有概念到底這個方向對不對，只能盲目跟著蘿琳。中間，蘿琳問了帕拉丁關於龍恩的問題，但帕拉丁無法給予什麼有用的資訊，也只能在情緒上安撫蘿琳。突然，蘿琳朝他昆蟲般的指節咬了下去，然後開始狂笑，帕拉丁嚇了一跳，仔細一看，才發現他眼中的「蘿琳」竟然是安娜喬裝而成的。安娜說著，帕拉丁剛剛還沒說好要給母親大人什麼。她提議，也許可以讓帕拉丁和他結婚，帕拉丁貴族的身份在地面上是很好用的。安娜嘗試用法術控制帕拉丁，但帕拉丁努力對抗，沒有中招。帕拉丁趕緊拔腿就跑，並隨時留意安娜是否跟在後頭。安娜沒有跟上，但帕拉丁在他腦中聽見安娜狂笑，以及說著「來不及啦」。

好不容易找到了一處地面有開口，且地上有夠大的石頭，讓帕拉丁有機會爬上去的機會。帕拉丁從地上搬了石頭，嘗試將身體撐上去，但幾度嘗試都沒能成功，且地面上似乎沒有其他人在活動，叫喊也沒用。帕拉丁急中生智，從背包內拿出他的弓，將弓撐在洞口，再利用繩子綁在弓上，攀著繩子，想將身體撐上去。然而，此時他聽見洞底下熟悉的聲音。安娜碎念著為何不願意娶她？她也年輕貌美，沒什麼壞處。帕拉丁大喊他知道安娜上一任老公，瑟巴諾的鎮長是怎麼死的，他可不想落得一樣的下場。為了脫離險境，帕拉丁趕緊利用法術，在地面上製造荊棘，在阻礙安娜的同時，也讓荊棘將地面上的石頭撐起，他便用力拉起繩子，終於將自己撐到地面上，然後趕快跑走。
地面上，帕拉丁看見在自己眼前的是母親大人的寺廟，他知道非趕快離開不可，附近他比較熟悉的地方是城門旅店，於是他便跑回旅店去。旅店老闆凱文看見他，表示剛剛有個自稱叫蘿琳的女生來找他，他就讓那名女子先去他們房間等待了，同時凱文朝著樓上喊著蘿琳的名字。帕拉丁一聽不妙，趕緊逃走。

離開舊城區，帕拉丁在附近的街區想買點東西，然而他注意到附近其他人看他的眼神都有點古怪，似乎自己衣著有些破爛，身上還有些味道，在這裡十分格格不入。帕拉丁先找了附近的雜貨店，想進去買點藥品，卻被店員擋在店外。帕拉丁簡單描述了自己想要的藥品後，店員自己走到店內去取了藥品，還是賣給了帕拉丁三罐。帕拉丁先服用了其中一罐後將另一罐塗抹在自己的傷口上，傷痛暫時緩解。同時，帕拉丁注意到藥罐的蓋子底部有個眼睛的符號。
接著帕拉丁找了附近的服飾店想買衣服，門口的店員看向他身後，詢問那人是他的老婆嗎？帕拉丁心頭一震，看見在他身後的竟是蘿琳。他趕緊確認這名蘿琳到底是真的蘿琳還是又是安娜的偽裝。蘿琳捏了自己的臉頰，也說了上次在王宮他們逃走後，自己花了好多時間才脫困，暫時讓帕拉丁放心了。蘿琳花了錢，讓帕拉丁先買了簡單的衣服後，找了個巷子快速換裝。
馬可斯・詹斯的宅邸內，冒險者們和馬可斯詢問了關於潘蜜拉、伯納德，以及蜘蛛神教相關的問題。馬可斯說明了伯納德似乎在貴族間是比較弱勢的家族，不過被殺死這件事他也是剛剛聽冒險者們的說明才知道。華生想起昨晚看見潘蜜拉出現在伯納德宅邸前時，也看見馬可斯出現在附近看著，讓他感到馬可斯說的話也許不能完全相信。
馬可斯提議，和華生等人一起去王宮找國王，和國王警告關於潘蜜拉可能的叛變。他提到自己和國王關係並不密切，有個貴族可以一同參與會是比較有效的做法。但華生對於這樣的提議還不太確定是否合適。
伊聽見了客廳門口有奇怪的騷動聲，示意了大家後，悄悄走向門口。大家做好準備，伊便將門打開。眾多刺客在門口試圖跑進來，蘇加魯趕緊跑到門口一一將刺客解決掉，同時華生也召喚出了兩隻殭屍，來到門口做阻擋。圖伊特則在旁邊的窗簾後躲著。

眼看伊被刺客打了幾下，馬可斯趕緊用手上的魔法球，將伊傳送回了他身邊。同時，他請伊到樓上他的辦公桌拿「那一盒」。伊很清楚知道他的M伯爵在說什麼，趕緊用最快的跑速跑了上去，將一盒精緻又有點重量的盒子拿了出來，跑回一樓，遞給馬可斯。馬可斯打開盒子，裡面是個看起來做工複雜的機械，馬可斯小聲說了句「抱歉了半獸人」，接著朝著中心的按鈕按下去，門口附近的地面便落了下去，同時原本通往二樓的樓梯旁冒出了一個走向地下室的樓梯。
蘇加魯落到地下，看見他和其他刺客們以及將失落在一個像是監牢一樣的空間。在華生的協助下，殭屍們堆疊自己的身體，將蘇加魯撐到地面。大家走到地下室，在馬可斯的指引下，對刺客們進行拷問。馬可斯再次丟了一顆魔法球到監牢中。伊仔細看，這顆魔法球比起像水晶球一樣的硬的材質，更像軟泥一般可以塑形。接著華生和伊輪番向刺客們拷問，在馬可斯的操控下只要刺客們有好好回答，便會被電。

他們得知這群刺客是潘蜜拉派出的，潘蜜拉至少有快要100名像這樣的傭兵，他們分別會出不同的任務，昨晚伯納德宅邸的現場就是他們的人。在華生的詢問下，他也得知之前認識的貴族中，馬爾科姆・希克斯似乎也是和潘蜜拉積極合作的其中一人，而亞辛・烏斯塔和衛斯理・凡斯也被他們注意過和潘蜜拉是一夥的，昆頓・里奧納德則似乎沒有被聽見和潘蜜拉討論。潘蜜拉方計畫利用馬爾科姆手下的奴隸們結合他底下的傭兵，一起攻入王宮，發動政變。
最後，馬可斯在華生的建議下，放走了兩名刺客，喬和湯瑪斯，並將其於剩下的刺客電死。

It was close to noon. After the adventurers woke up, they came to the first floor of the hotel. Kevin obviously didn't get the note written by Yi last night, and only bread can be given to the adventurers. The adventurers took the bread back to the room on the second floor and distributed the bread to Tweeter, who was still unable to move, and Watson, who had just woken up.

Then, with the help of Watson, Paladin asked Oliver who was brought back from the dead and got some useful information: the person who was imprisoned in the palace prison and related to the Spider Cult was called Marianne Jens, and the struggle between the pro-King faction and the anti-King faction known to Watson had no direct relationship with the Spider Cult. Hearing the name Marianne Jens, Watson remembered the mysterious noble Marcus Jens he met at Pamela's mansion the night before, and Yi also realized that Jens was the surname of his employer, Earl M.

The adventurers put Oliver, who was starting to smell a little bit, back into Tweeter's backpack, and Bernard, who showed no signs of life, was covered with a heavy quilt to avoid being discovered by Kevin or other interested parties.

Led by Yi, the adventurers came to The Mother's temple. Yi repeatedly warned the adventurers to be respectful to The Mother, and also reminded Paladin not to show his noble status. Yi softly opened the temple door and led the adventurers to kneel in front of The Mother's bed. Watson and The Mother first thanked them for removing the curse the day before, and then explained their purpose, but he accidentally let slip and leaked the identity of Sir Paladin.

The Mother first extended his tentacles to Tweeter's body, picked him up in the air, and then told him that this was just part of the ceremony and that he was sorry. The Mother's tentacles completely enveloped Tweeter. When it was released, Tweeter had returned to its original state. He could sense and move normally, and the curse disappeared, but Tweeter still felt a little tired.

The Mother then wrapped the back of Sugalu's neck with its tentacles. Sugalu felt the strong pressure from the tentacles, and even the pain of being cut and blood oozing out, which made him almost pass out. However, The Mother stretched its tentacles back soon, and the pattern on the back of Sugalu's neck disappeared.

Finally, The Mother stretched out more tentacles towards Paladin, which was invisible in the dark, wrapped it completely, and then lifted it up in the air. "I said, I hate nobles!" The Mother roared with extreme anger. Yi and the adventurers tried their best to comfort and persuade The Mother, hoping that he would not hurt Paladin. In the end, The Mother left the words "I will not kill him", and then retreated towards the space behind the bed, pulling Paladin, who was wrapped in the tentacles, unable to move or speak, into the void.

The adventurers hurried to the bedside, and they saw a symbol similar to the one on the bedside of The Mother on the third floor of Bernard's house. Under the interpretation of Tweeter and Yi, this symbol is like a landmark, but it only records the location of this place. The adventurers discussed whether to bet on jumping into the mysterious black hole behind the bed, but Watson still remembered that after his mouse entered the hole last night, he lost contact with him, making him shrink back, so the adventurers decided to look for clues elsewhere first.

Yi suggested that taking them to meet a person might be of some help to them, but before that, they should go back to his secret base and let him prepare. Under the guidance of Yi, the adventurers climbed up the wall, climbed through the rope, and finally climbed to Yi's hiding base high up. Yi went to change clothes first, while the adventurers briefly explored the secret base and found some books related to religion, which contained notes on the Spider God Religion. Tweeter secretly took away a book. Watson also saw a record book in which many names appeared, but among them he found that there was a name he recognized repeatedly, Marcus Jens.

Yi After changing his clothes, he took his mask and cloak from the closet. He found that the things seemed to have been tampered with, but when he questioned the adventurers, they all said that they had not taken the things. He felt there was something fishy about these people.

Yi led the adventurers to Count M's mansion via a path he was familiar with. A beautiful abandoned garden without anyone, the villa inside looks elegant and beautiful. Yi put on his cloak and mask, asked the adventurers to stay at the door, and went to Count M to inform these visitors. During the brief absence of Yi, Watson also warned Sugalu and Tweeter that Count M was most likely Marcus Jens, whom he met at the noble dinner the night before. However, this person seemed to be able to see through his magic. He also appeared when Pamela and others attacked Bernard's mansion the previous night, so he did not trust Marcus.

Yi opened the door and let the adventurers in. Everyone was waiting for Count M in the hall, admiring the paintings he had placed. These works appear to be delicately made, with abstract yet mysterious themes. It is impossible to tell that they are the work of a well-known painter, but if there is a name on them, they will definitely sell for a very high price.

"Hi, Miss Lucia." A familiar voice came over. Watson saw that the man was indeed Marcus Jens whom he had just met the night before, which made him feel very wary. Watson also introduced other partners to Marcus. Everyone was sitting on the sofa in the hall. After Marcus understood everyone's purpose, he said that the adventurers could trust Yi, and as his representative, he would follow everyone on their adventures. At the same time, Marcus also ordered the servants to prepare desserts and various drinks for the adventurers to enjoy.
Paladin Open your eyes.
"Drip, drip, drip..." The sound of water dripping.
"Da, da, da..." Some kind of footsteps.
Paladin turned his head and saw a mouse appearing in his sight, but it seemed that the footsteps did not come from it. The mouse was lying upright. Whether it was dead or alive, he didn't know.
Then it became dark, and something crawled across his eyes. A face appeared directly in front of Paladin, pressing against him, forcing him to move.

"What are you going to pay in exchange for your freedom?" That voice was indeed that of The Mother, but The Mother did not show his appearance as a wrinkled old man's face at this time, but as the most primitive and terrifying spider, staring at Paladin.
Paladin half-jokingly held out his cursed index finger, indicating that he could accept this. He also said that he would give anything except his life.

"That finger of yours is for me, not for The Mother." A familiar voice came from beside The Mother, it was Anna who disappeared from Sebano. After a sharp pain, Anna opened his mouth and bit off Paladin's index finger, chewed it, and then spat out the nails and bones. "So what are you going to give The Mother?"
Paladin tried to stop the pain, but fear and pain both arose at this time. Paladin didn't know what to say for a moment, so he passed out again.

When Paladin woke up again, he saw a woman standing in the distance. That person did not seem to be Anna, so he shouted loudly, hoping to be rescued. The person quickly approached, Paladin recognized her, it was Roline. Roline saw his hand and was concerned about it. Paladin Then he discovered that part of the severed finger was actually connected with a knuckle that looked like an insect or arthropod. The joint was itchy, which made him very confused.

Roline urged Paladin to escape quickly, and the two of them ran in the underground waterway. After running for a long time, Paladin had no idea whether this direction was correct or not, so he could only follow Roline blindly. In the middle, Roline asked Paladin about Ron, but Paladin could not give any useful information and could only comfort Roline emotionally. Suddenly, Roline bit his insect-like knuckles, and then started laughing wildly. Paladin was startled. After a closer look, he realized that the "Roline" in his eyes was actually Anna in disguise. Anna said, Paladin hadn't decided what to give The Mother just now. She suggested that maybe Paladin could marry him. Paladin's noble status was very useful on the ground. Anna tried to control Paladin with spells, but Paladin tried hard to resist and was not hit. Paladin ran away quickly and kept an eye on whether Anna was following behind. Anna did not follow, but Paladin heard Anna laughing wildly in his head and saying "It's too late."

Finally found an opening in the ground and a large enough stone on the ground to give Paladin a chance to climb up. Paladin moved rocks from the ground and tried to lift his body up, but failed several times. There seemed to be no one else moving on the ground, and shouting was useless. Paladin, out of desperation, took out his bow from his backpack, propped the bow at the entrance of the hole, tied it to the bow with a rope, and climbed on the rope, trying to push his body up. However, at this moment he heard a familiar voice under the cave. Anna wondered why he didn't want to marry her? It doesn't hurt that she's also young and pretty. Paladin yells that he knows how Anna's last husband, the mayor of Sebano, died, and he doesn't want to end up with the same end. In order to get out of danger, Paladin quickly used magic to create thorns on the ground. While hindering Anna, the thorns also propped up the stones on the ground. He pulled up the rope with all his strength, finally propped himself up on the ground, and then ran away quickly.

On the ground, Paladin saw the temple of The Mother in front of him. He knew he had to leave quickly. The nearby place he was more familiar with was the Gate’s Inn, so he ran back to the hotel. The hotel owner Kevin saw him and said that a girl named Roline had just come to see him, so he asked the woman to go to their room to wait while Kevin shouted Roline's name upstairs. Paladin When you hear something bad, run away quickly.

Leaving the old city, Paladin wanted to buy something in a nearby neighborhood. However, he noticed that other people nearby looked at him a little strangely. It seemed that his clothes were a little tattered and he still smelled a bit, which made him very out of place here. Paladin first found a nearby grocery store and wanted to go in to buy some medicine, but was blocked by the clerk. After Paladin briefly described the medicines he wanted, the clerk walked to the store to pick up the medicines and sold Paladin three cans. Paladin took one bottle first and then applied the other bottle to his wound. The pain was temporarily relieved. Meanwhile, Paladin notices an eye symbol on the bottom of the medicine jar's lid.

Then Paladin went to a nearby clothing store to buy clothes. The clerk at the door looked behind him and asked if that person was his wife. Paladin was shocked when he saw that the person behind him was Roline. He quickly confirmed whether this Roline was the real Roline or another disguise of Anna. Roline pinched her cheeks and said that after they escaped last time in the palace, it took her a lot of time to get out of trouble, which temporarily reassured Paladin. Roline spent money and asked Paladin to buy simple clothes first, and then found an alley to change clothes quickly.

In Marcus Jens's mansion, the adventurers and Marcus asked questions about Pamela, Bernard, and the Spider Cult. Marcus explained that Bernard seemed to be a relatively weak family among the nobles, but he only found out about being killed after hearing the explanations from the adventurers. Watson remembered that when he saw Pamela appearing in front of Bernard's mansion last night, he also saw Marcus appearing nearby and watching, which made him feel that maybe he couldn't fully believe what Marcus said.

Marcus suggested that he go to the palace with Watson and others to find the king, and warn the king about Pamela's possible rebellion. He mentioned that he did not have a close relationship with the king, and it would be more effective to have a nobleman who could participate together. But Watson is not sure whether such a proposal is appropriate.

Yi heard a strange commotion at the door of the living room. After signaling to everyone, he quietly walked towards the door. Everyone gets ready and Yi opens the door. Many assassins tried to run in at the door. Sugalu quickly ran to the door and eliminated the assassins one by one. At the same time, Watson also summoned two zombies and came to the door to block them. Tweeter was hiding behind the curtain nearby.

Seeing Yi being beaten several times by the assassin, Marcus quickly used the magic ball in his hand to teleport Yi back to him. At the same time, he asked Yi to go to his desk upstairs to get "that box". Yi knew exactly what his Count M was talking about, so he ran up as fast as he could, took out a box of delicate and heavy boxes, ran back to the first floor, and handed it to Marcus. Marcus opened the box, and inside was a seemingly complex machine. Marcus whispered, "Sorry, Orcs," and then pressed the button in the center. The ground near the door fell, and at the same time, a staircase to the basement appeared next to the stairs that originally led to the second floor.

Sugalu fell to the ground and saw that he and other assassins were lost in a prison-like space. With the assistance of Watson, the zombies stacked their bodies and pushed Sugalu to the ground. Everyone went to the basement and, under the guidance of Marcus, tortured the assassins. Marcus once again throws a magic ball into the prison cell. Yi Look carefully. This magic ball is more like soft clay than a hard material like a crystal ball. It can be shaped. Then Watson and Yi took turns to torture the assassins. Under Marcus' control, as long as the assassins answered well, they would be shocked.

They learned that this group of assassins was sent by Pamela. Pamela had at least nearly 100 mercenaries like this. They would go out for different tasks. They were the ones who were at the scene at Bernard's mansion last night. After Watson's inquiry, he also learned that among the nobles he had met before, Malcolm Hicks seemed to be one of the people who actively cooperated with Pamela. Yashin Usta and Wesley Vance were also noticed by them as being in the same group with Pamela. Quinton Leonard seemed not to have been heard discussing with Pamela. Pamela plans to use Malcolm's slaves and his mercenaries to invade the palace and launch a coup.
Finally, Marcus, on the advice of Watson, released two assassins, Joe and Thomas, and electrocuted the remaining assassins.

paragraphs: 華生和蘇加魯搜刮著監牢內的屍體，發現了剛才差點丟中蘇加魯的飛鏢，上面似乎塗有深如黑色的顏料，很有可能是毒藥。同時，華生也在一名刺客的口袋內找到一罐看起來曾經裝過這種顏料的玻璃罐，蓋子底下有個眼睛的符號。
在馬可斯和伊暫時回辦公室的期間，華生告訴蘇加魯自己看見馬可斯出現在伯納德事發現場的事，表示對他還是要有戒心。同時，他們討論著想和馬可斯商借一些錢的事。

伊在M伯爵的辦公室，伊似乎對於剛才沒能對於這場戰鬥做出什麼貢獻感到可惜，在M伯爵的安慰下，伊有感覺好些。伊擔心剛剛放走的兩名刺客可能會帶來後患，但在馬可斯的說明下，這些被送走的刺客可以幫他在潘蜜拉那邊帶來一些有用的影響。最後，在伊的詢問下，馬可斯送了他一顆剛剛使用過的魔法球，表示這東西讓他研究研究，但是要注意，只能用一次而已。過去他和一名商人買了這個神奇的魔法球，用了十分滿意，因此進了以大批的貨。
伊回到大廳，聽見遠處的門口傳來敲門聲，便趕緊趕過去，打開門後發現是王國巡邏中的衛兵來關切，在伊簡單說明後，衛兵便離去了。

在華生的要求下，伊帶著華生和蘇加魯，以及剛剛一直躲在窗簾後的圖伊特到二樓找馬可斯。華生表示接受對於先前馬可斯提議的去見國王這件事，但他也提議想商借一些錢，讓他們可以做好準備。馬可斯對於他們提出的150金，表示如果他們願意幫一個忙的話就沒問題。馬可斯提到了他的妹妹瑪莉安・詹斯，被關押在王宮的監獄內，希望他們可以將她解救出來。在冒險者們的詢問下，得知瑪莉安曾經離開過家裡一陣子，回來時馬可斯才得知她已成了蜘蛛神教在麥克嵩的間諜。然後有一天她就不見了，後來才得知應該是被當時的國王，巴納沃二世，關押在監獄內了。
馬可斯表示他知道監獄的位置，但裡面似乎沒有獄卒，但也沒有聽過有人逃出來過，聽說是個進得去但出不來的地方。

Everyone was discussing carefully outside the door of the laundry room when they accidentally bumped into a female laundry worker walking out of the alley holding a basin of washed clothes. When they saw a female worker carrying clothes for the second time, they attacked him from behind and knocked him unconscious. Watson imitated his appearance, put on his clothes, and moved the clothes in the basin together with the female worker to a nearby alley, letting Paladin nest in the basin. He then walked back to the laundry room with the basin in his arms, leaving Yi and Tweeter on standby outside.

Walking back into the laundry room, Watson was immediately called by an older woman who seemed to be the manager, asking him why he came back and whether he had caused trouble again? Watson learned that the female worker he pretended to be was named Ada. She had only worked here for about a week and had already made a lot of money. It was only through the favor of the manager's sister that he could continue to stay here.

Watson told the manager sister that he had two friends who also wanted to join the work, so he called Tweeter and Yi in. The manager sister thought it was great that someone was willing to join, but she didn't want it to interfere with everyone's work. However, at the request of Watson, she still asked him to introduce himself to everyone in the workspace on the left and right with two new partners.

At this time, Paladin, who was placed in front of the stove in the middle of the laundry room, was already so hot that he was about to die. However, Watson also discovered that there was a carpet in front of the stove that seemed to have been placed there deliberately. The secret door was probably under the carpet. After "self-introduction" was completed, Watson and his two partners returned to the middle of the laundry room, quickly cast a dark spell, lifted the carpet, opened the secret door, and jumped into the ground. At the same time, Tweeter asked his quasai demon to clean up the aftermath on the ground, close the secret door, and pull back the carpet. Underground, Paladin was finally able to escape the sweltering tub.
地底下一片空蕩蕩，漆黑無比。
帕拉丁和伊兩人只能靠著圖伊特和華生的引導，或是偶爾靠著點有光亮術的東西才能知道自己周圍有什麼。
靠著馬可斯給的魔法球，大家一路往前走。中間有座朝下的井口，伊拿出了自己的繩子，在井邊將繩子綁好，讓大家除了井中央十分緊繃的繩子外，還有額外的抓握處。大家依序抓著繩子爬下，華生和圖伊特因為能看得見，相對安全很多，伊在夸塞魔的協助下，順利降落到了下一層，帕拉丁則在自己什麼都看不見的狀況下，兩度險些喪失了性命，但在夸塞魔和華生的幫助之下，他也迷迷糊糊地抵達了地面。
大家在井邊短休息了一下，發現距離監獄已經不遠了，便趕緊啟程。

遠方似乎有些許亮光，大家停在了一座金屬門前，將門推開，裡面全是熾熱的白光。大家一邊適應光線，一邊隨著魔法球的引導，在這儼然像是一座小城區的「監獄」內穿梭。繞過好幾個巷弄，來到了一個特定的區域。按照魔法球的指示，馬可斯的妹妹瑪莉安就是關在這裡了。帶頭的圖伊特在瑪莉安的牢房前，看見他虛弱地窩在牆角，眼睛閉上，感覺精神狀況非常不好。眾人討論了一下，原本這次只是要來做個探查，下次做好準備再進行救援，但已經這麼艱辛的來到了這裡，不如一口氣完成任務，將瑪莉安救出。
大家走回瑪莉安的牢房門口，瑪莉安看見大家，以為他們是母親大人派來拯救他的，殊不知背後的主事者竟然是他的哥哥。華生試著用萬能鑰匙開鎖卻失敗了，瑪莉安覺得莫名，自己在牢房內拿了個工具，便把牢房的們從內而外的打開，讓大家也覺得奇異。如果這麼好逃獄，為什麼不逃走。瑪莉安表示剛剛大家應該已經經過中間的路，知道有多難逃。大家不是逃不走，而是知道就算逃出了牢房，也很難離開地底下。
冒險者們思索著要不要同時將其他犯人也放出，但是想在不驚擾任何人的前提下將瑪莉安救出，因此作罷。
走出日光燈照射的監牢區，瑪莉安馬上狂吐，並跪坐在了地上，體力看起來十分糟糕。大家攙扶著他，慢慢往井口的方向前進。在討論之後，大家不想再從原本洗衣房的出入口出去，覺得太有可能驚動大家，而且華生不久前透過老鼠的眼睛，發現總管姊姊似乎不在現場，很有可能他已經去回報剛才的騷動了。
大家計畫著從井口直接爬到最上方去，那邊似乎是接到舊城區去。華生飛了上去，利用伊提供的滑輪組固定繩子，讓大家透過繩子可以攀爬上來。虛弱的瑪莉安則從手中射出了蜘蛛絲，將洞口牢牢覆蓋著，大家測試了一下，發現這蜘蛛絲堅固又有彈性，就算掉下來，應該也蠻安全的，於是大家便分批爬著繩子，來到了地面。
漆黑的舊城區，艱難的任務在通力合作下終於完成了。
半夜的舊城區，異常寧靜的讓人感到害怕，伊提醒大家要提高警覺。在華生的帶領下，大家試圖朝著馬可斯宅邸的方向前進。花了一段時間，終於來到舊城區有人活動的地區了，於是伊便作回嚮導，帶著大家走回馬可斯宅邸的小捷徑。

漆黑的巷弄中沒有任何照明，但因為對這裡相當熟悉，伊按照自己的記憶向前邁進。一瞬間，似乎有什麼絆倒了他，於是他停了下來，看見巷弄右側的木門前，一張邪笑的紅臉在手中光源的照射下看起來更加邪佞。伊趕緊用他們倆熟識的盜賊手勢溝通，得知這位魔人，他的徒弟，羅特，對於好一陣子沒有他的消息覺得奇怪，因此跑來攔截他。伊向他表示自己正在執行M伯爵的任務，就快完成了，完成後會再去找他。羅特接收完訊息後便轉身推開木門跑走了，留下滿臉無奈的伊停在半路上。

在隊伍後方的圖伊特也看得懂盜賊手語，因此向伊詢問發生了什麼事。在伊簡單說明是自己不識相的徒弟後，圖伊特感受到自己的肩膀被輕拍了一下。他轉頭，看見一張邪笑的紅臉在他的眼前，距離不到五公分。那傢伙烙了一句「在下便是伊的徒弟，羅特。如果你們欺負我師父，就給我小心一點。」語畢，他便耍起腰間的匕首，但一不小心，匕首就掉到地上，落的羅特十分尷尬，蹲到地上趕緊撿起來。說完後，他便慢慢向後退，像是要消失在黑暗之中一樣。但在可清楚看見他的圖伊特眼中，可以看見羅特在退後一段距離後，便拔腿就跑，剛剛威嚇的神氣蕩然全失。
滿臉尷尬的伊頓在原地，不斷喃喃自語的唸著他那蠢徒弟。眼看帶頭的伊暫時喪失了行動能力，在隊伍中間攙扶著瑪莉安的華生便走到最前面。馬可斯的宅第在這裡已經可以用肉眼看見了。
在華生的帶領下，大家向馬可斯宅邸走去，也看見有個成年人類形體的傢伙似乎試著要開馬可斯家的門但是失敗了。圖伊特一看就認出那是他們去喝酒的夥伴蘇加魯。華生從遠處喊著蘇加魯，眾人便會合了。在瑪莉安的協助下，大門很輕鬆的就扭開了，大家走入昏暗的一樓，但在黑暗中看不見的帕拉丁沒注意到門口陷阱的地洞，直直落了下去。在圖伊特的指引下，他才從地下一樓透過樓梯走回地面。

華生將瑪莉安扶到沙發上後，便問他是否有需要協助的地方，瑪莉安請他向他哥哥要點宵夜，指定要「他愛吃的」。華生、伊，和圖伊特隱身的夸塞魔一同走到馬可斯的辦公室，輕輕敲他的門。穿著華麗睡袍的馬可斯睡眼惺忪，在了解狀況後拿了兩袋布袋給他們，表示一袋是瑪莉安要的「宵夜」，另一袋則是他們的報酬。但他對於自己妹妹被拯救帶回來這件事，似乎沒有表現出什麼雀躍的心情，只有想趕緊回到床上睡覺的疲憊模樣。圖伊特的夸塞魔留在辦公室內，發現馬可斯在門關上之後便倒頭就睡，打呼聲轟隆作響。
客廳，帕拉丁很快就陷入熟睡，蘇加魯則在瑪莉安身邊仔細觀察他身上的配件，發現他似乎藏有一些匕首、小刀和繩索在身上。對於一個似乎被關在監獄中很久的人來說，身上有這些東西，讓他感到十分訝異。
回到一樓，華生輕輕拍醒瑪莉安，將裝滿「宵夜」卻異常地輕的布袋遞給他。瑪莉安拿起布袋放在嘴前便是一吸，布袋瞬間被吸成扁的。華生感到十分詫異，這宵夜到底是什麼東西？瑪莉安很快就陷入沈睡，而且看起來氣色恢復得極好。
蘇加魯從熟睡的瑪莉安手中拿走布袋，從布袋的底端嘗試觀察看看到底有什麼酷東西，發現有一些殘餘的黃色粉末，他便吸了一下，瞬間感到精神百倍，感官大開，半夜的時間，什麼睡意都沒有了。伊好奇的拿了布袋，自己也小吸一口。圖伊特感到好奇，拿來了布袋，沾了一點，放到熟睡的帕拉丁嘴前，沾到他的嘴裡。圖伊特觀察了一下，認為這很顯然是毒品，但看起來沒什麼副作用，應該沒問題。華生則覺得不妥，但也沒有特別去制止。
伊搖搖晃晃，爬上樓上自己的房間準備就寢，但完全沒有睡意，心情亢奮到極點，看著窗外不斷扭動身體。樓下蘇加魯則試著讓自己睡著，但完全無法，看著其他人都睡去了，自己則到天亮才漸漸睡去。
一早，瑪莉安便睡醒了，盤腿坐在客廳沙發上，似乎正在盤腿打坐，口中念念有詞，絲毫沒有任何嗑藥的跡象；帕拉丁則向巡視領地般，在客廳各處不斷逡巡，東張西望，但什麼也不說；華生移動到瑪莉安身邊，等待馬可斯下樓；圖伊特閉眼休息；蘇加魯則陷入了熟睡之中。
馬可斯下樓時，伊還徹夜未眠。他走到妹妹面前，兩人相視，卻不說話，但華生可看見他們兩人的表情不斷變化，似乎正在進行某種溝通。一段時間後，他們兩人像是放鬆下來了。此時樓上傳來伊不理智的話語聲，馬可斯嘆了一口氣。
華生主動向馬可斯以及瑪莉安詢問了不少事，此時清醒的圖伊特和半睡半醒的蘇加魯也一同參與，帕拉丁則認真的巡查「自己的領地」。經過詢問，他們得知馬可斯對於潘蜜拉等反王派的舉動，想繼續觀察，因此想再待在麥克嵩一段時間，但比起國王的安危，很顯然馬可斯還是比較在意自己與家人的安全。
另外大家在詢問下得知昨晚馬可斯給瑪莉安服用的「宵夜」是一款被稱為「檸檬」的毒品，在市面上很常見，通常是拿來當作興奮劑的，和有時拿來在宗教儀式上作法用的毒品不同。

詢問瑪莉安後，他們也得知現任國王艾略特四世的母后瑪莉恩女士過去似乎是他蜘蛛神教的同夥，但在不知何時與拉索斯教合作的他的背叛下，身為蜘蛛神教在麥克嵩代言人的瑪莉安被揭發臥底的身份，關入地牢，原名瑪麗蓮的瑪莉恩也改了名字，在麥克嵩繼續發展。另外安娜過去似乎也是瑪莉安的手下，但他沒想過安娜如今竟然可以發展得強大到能把一座城鎮以一己之力毀滅。對於瑪莉恩的崛起，瑪莉安感到十分不滿，但是對於魁儡國王艾略特，他則似乎不太在乎。
同時，瑪莉安也表示雖然阿爾芬諾被當作蜘蛛神，但蜘蛛神教忠實的信徒都知道母親大人才是真正的神，阿爾芬諾不過是他創造出來的孽物，卻收拾不掉罷了，而安娜現在似乎靠向了阿爾芬諾，而非和自己一樣忠誠於母親大人。
在經過對話後，馬可斯對於待在麥克嵩的決定動搖了，他認為將大家捲入宮廷鬥爭不是一件安全的事，試著說服大家先離開邁克嵩。但在離開前，他想帶圖伊特去一個地方。出發前，馬可斯換了一身樸素的裝扮，同時也在圖伊特的請求下，準備了一金幣量的檸檬，讓他拿來研究研究。
出發前，蘇加魯也將昨晚華生從馬可斯那裡拿到的金幣分給大家：總共400枚金幣，華生、圖伊特和伊一人分100枚，沒有參與簽約的帕拉丁和沒有參與任務的蘇加魯則一人分50枚。

在圖伊特的要求下，其他人也跟著馬可斯一起出發，留下瑪莉安照顧昏睡過去的伊。馬可斯帶著大家走到舊城區的一處廢棄房屋。漆黑的一樓裡面儘是才破的傢俱，馬可斯帶大家從樓梯往下走到地下室。地下室有一座壁爐，和一張桌子。桌子後坐著一個披著有星星符號斗篷的人，一動也不動。在馬可斯的示範下，他拿出一枚金幣放在桌子上，那人便伸出手，將金幣拖走。馬可斯開口問了他「今天我妹妹說的那些話有說謊或隱瞞嗎？」，那人便回應了他，表示沒有說謊，但是有隱瞞。那人的聲音似乎是個年輕女子的聲音，大家聽了覺得異常的熟悉。

接著華生、圖伊特也給了些金幣，和這人問了些問題。他們得知，拉索斯教在麥克嵩最大的聚集地在崔尼斯劇院的地下通道；以他們身形被霍布製造出來的泥人從瑟巴諾出發，快要到麥克嵩了，只剩幾個月的路程；圖伊特與交易之神意外達成的開眼交易無法取消，但會有命定之人拯救蘿琳；最後，蘿琳的軀體在命定之人拯救他之前，都會安全地被保護好。在離開前，圖伊特張開了他額頭的眼睛，發現如他所猜測：斗篷底下的那人便是化為陶瓷的蘿琳，但蘿琳背後似乎有個木偶，身體的零件都被拆開掉落在地上了。
離開這間小黑屋後，馬可斯在華生的請求下，回答了帶他們來這裡的原因。他表示這裡是交易之神在麥克嵩的重要據點，同時他也想讓大家可在這邊得到無法從他或瑪莉安那邊得到的解答。最後，他其實早就料到蘿琳最後會來到這裡，因此想讓大家可以來這邊看看，確保蘿琳過得好好的。
回程的路上，華生和其他夥伴討論著下一步該往哪裡去？他們提出了幾個方案：去崔尼斯劇院樓下的地下通道將拉索斯教一網打盡、回堵往麥克嵩來的泥人、帶馬可斯到寇林菲爾德避難，或是去見蘇加魯信仰的神王大人。
麥克嵩的局勢已經難以掌握，來自拉索斯教的威脅，與反王派壓倒性的勝利都難以對抗。團隊的下一步，充滿了不確定性。
The underground was empty and pitch black.
Paladin and Yi can only rely on the guidance of Tweeter and Watson, or occasionally rely on something with light magic to know what is around them.

Relying on the magic ball given by Marcus, everyone moved forward. There was a wellhead facing downwards in the middle. Yi took out his rope and tied the rope at the edge of the well, so that in addition to the very tight rope in the center of the well, everyone had an extra place to hold on. Everyone grabbed the rope and climbed down in sequence. Watson and Tweeter were relatively safe because they could see. Yi successfully landed on the next floor with the help of Quasaimo. Paladin almost lost his life twice when he could not see anything. However, with the help of Quasaimon and Watson, he also reached the ground in a daze.
Everyone took a short rest by the well and found that they were not far from the prison, so they quickly set off.

There seemed to be some light in the distance. Everyone stopped in front of a metal door and pushed it open. It was filled with blazing white light. While adapting to the light, everyone followed the guidance of the magic ball and shuttled through this "prison" that looked like a small city. After going around several alleys, we came to a specific area. According to the instructions of the magic ball, Marcus's sister Marianne was imprisoned here. The leader, Tweeter, was in front of Marianne's cell and saw him sitting weakly in the corner with his eyes closed, feeling that his mental state was very bad. Everyone discussed it. Originally, they were just going to do an exploration this time, and be prepared for rescue next time. But since they have come here so hard, it is better to complete the task in one go and rescue Marianne.

Everyone walked back to the door of Marianne's cell. When Marianne saw everyone, she thought they were sent by The Mother to save him, but she didn't know that the person in charge behind it was actually his brother. Watson tried to open the lock with the universal Kaname key but failed. Marianne felt inexplicable. She took a tool in the cell and opened the cell from the inside out, which made everyone feel strange. If it's so easy to escape from prison, why not escape. Marianne said that everyone should have passed through the middle road just now and knew how difficult it was to escape. It's not that everyone can't escape, but they know that even if they escape from the cell, it will be difficult to leave the underground.
The adventurers considered whether to release other prisoners at the same time, but they wanted to rescue Marianne without disturbing anyone, so they gave up.

Walking out of the prison area illuminated by fluorescent lights, Marianne immediately vomited and knelt on the ground. Her physical strength looked very bad. Everyone supported him and slowly moved towards the wellhead. After the discussion, everyone did not want to go out through the original entrance and exit of the laundry room, because it was too likely to alarm everyone. Moreover, Watson not long ago discovered through the eyes of a mouse that the manager sister did not seem to be at the scene. It is very likely that he had gone to report the commotion just now.

Everyone planned to climb directly from the wellhead to the top, which seemed to be connected to the old city. Watson flew up and used the pulley set provided by Yi to fix the rope so that everyone could climb up through the rope. The weak Marianne shot out spider silk from her hand and covered the hole tightly. Everyone tested it and found that the spider silk was strong and elastic. Even if it fell, it should be quite safe, so everyone climbed the rope in batches and came to the ground.
In the dark old city, the difficult task was finally completed with joint efforts.

The old city in the middle of the night is extremely quiet and scary. Yi reminds everyone to be alert. Under the leadership of Watson, everyone tried to move towards the Marcus mansion. After a while, we finally arrived at an area of ​​the old city where people were active, so Yi acted as a guide and took everyone on a shortcut back to Marcus's mansion.

There was no lighting in the dark alley, but because he was quite familiar with it, Yi moved forward according to his memory. Yi quickly communicated with the thieves gestures they were familiar with, and learned that this demon, his apprentice, Lott, felt strange that there had been no news from him for a while, so he came to intercept him. Yi told him that he was performing Count M's mission and was about to complete it, and would go find him again after completion. After receiving the message, Lott turned around and pushed open the wooden door and ran away, leaving Yi with a helpless face stopped halfway.

Tweeter, who was at the back of the team, could also understand thieves' sign language, so he asked Yi what happened. After Yi simply explained that he was his ignorant apprentice, Tweeter felt a tap on his shoulder. He turned his head and saw a red face with an evil smile in front of him, less than five centimeters away. The guy said, "I am Yi's apprentice, Lott. If you bully me, Shifu, be careful." After saying this, he picked up the dagger on his waist, but accidentally, the dagger fell to the ground. Lott was very embarrassed when he fell, so he squatted on the ground and quickly picked it up. After saying that, he slowly backed away, as if he was going to disappear into the darkness. But in the eyes of Tweeter, who could see him clearly, he could see that Lott backed away for a distance and then ran away. The intimidating look he had just lost was completely gone.

Yi, whose face was full of embarrassment, paused in place and kept mumbling to himself about his stupid apprentice. Seeing that the leader Yi was temporarily unable to move, Watson, who was supporting Marianne in the middle of the team, walked to the front. Marcus’ mansion is already visible to the naked eye from here.

With Marianne's help, the door opened easily, and everyone walked into the dim first floor. However, Paladin, who was invisible in the darkness, did not notice the trap hole at the door and fell straight down. Under the guidance of Tweeter, he walked back to the ground through the stairs from the first floor of the basement.

Watson, Yi, and Tweeter The invisible Quasaimon walked to Marcus' office and knocked lightly on his door. Marcus, who was wearing a gorgeous nightgown with sleepy eyes, took two bags to them after understanding the situation, indicating that one bag was Marianne's "late night snack" and the other bag was their reward. Tweeter's Quasaimon stayed in the office and found Marcus falling asleep after the door was closed, snoring loudly.

Living room, Paladin soon fell into a deep sleep, while Sugalu carefully observed the accessories on his body next to Marianne and found that he seemed to have some daggers, knives and ropes hidden on his body. For a man who seemed to have been in prison for a long time, these things were surprising to him.

Back on the first floor, Watson gently patted Marianne awake and handed him an unusually light cloth bag filled with "late night snacks." Marianne picked up the bag and put it in front of her mouth and sucked on it. The bag was instantly sucked into a flat shape. Watson was very surprised, what on earth is this midnight snack? Marianne soon fell into a deep sleep and seemed to be recovering beautifully.

Sugalu took the bag from the sleeping Marianne and tried to look at the bottom of the bag to see what cool stuff there was. He found some residual yellow powder and inhaled it. He instantly felt energized and his senses were widened. In the middle of the night, there was no sleepiness at all. Yi curiously took the bag and took a sip himself. Tweeter was curious, so he brought a cloth bag, dipped a little in it, put it in front of the sleeping Paladin's mouth, and dipped it into his mouth. Tweeter looked at it and thought it was obviously a drug, but it didn't seem to have any side effects, so it should be fine. Watson felt it was inappropriate, but did not specifically stop it.

Yi staggered and climbed upstairs to his room to go to bed, but he was not sleepy at all. He was extremely excited and kept twisting his body while looking out the window. Downstairs, Sugalu tried to make himself fall asleep, but was completely unable to do so. He watched everyone else fall asleep, and he gradually fell asleep until dawn.

Early in the morning, Marianne woke up and sat cross-legged on the sofa in the living room. She seemed to be meditating cross-legged, muttering words, without any signs of taking drugs; Paladin, as if patrolling the territory, kept patrolling around the living room, looking around, but saying nothing; Watson moved to Marianne's side, waiting for Marcus to come downstairs; Tweeter He closed his eyes and rested; Sugalu fell into a deep sleep.

When Marcus went downstairs, Yi was still up all night. He walked up to his sister, and the two looked at each other but said nothing. However, Watson could see that their expressions were constantly changing, as if they were communicating with each other. After a while, the two of them seemed to relax. At this time, Yi's irrational words came from upstairs, and Marcus sighed.

Watson took the initiative to ask Marcus and Marianne a lot of things. At this time, Tweeter, who was awake, and Sugalu, who was half asleep, also participated. Paladin was carefully patrolling "his territory". After questioning, they learned that Marcus wanted to continue to observe the actions of Pamela and other anti-king factions, so he wanted to stay in Macksohn for a while longer. However, compared to the safety of the king, it was obvious that Marcus still cared more about the safety of himself and his family.

In addition, after asking, everyone learned that the "late night snack" Marcus gave Marianne last night was a drug called "lemon", which is very common on the market and is usually used as a stimulant. It is different from the drug that is sometimes used in religious ceremonies.

After questioning Marianne, they also learned that the current king King Elliot IV's queen mother, Ms. Marian, seemed to be an accomplice of his Spider God Cult in the past. However, under the betrayal of him who had cooperated with the Lassos Cult at an unknown time, Marianne, who was the spokesperson of the Spider God Cult in Macksohn, was exposed as an undercover agent and was imprisoned in the dungeon. Marian, whose original name was Marilyn, also changed her name and continued to develop in Macksohn. In addition, Anna seemed to have been Marianne's subordinate in the past, but he never thought that Anna could now become so powerful that it could destroy a town by itself. Marianne was very dissatisfied with Marian's rise, but she didn't seem to care much about the puppet king Eliot.

At the same time, Marianne also said that although Alfenor is regarded as the Spider God, loyal followers of the Spider God Sect know that The Mother is the real god. Alfenor is just an evil created by him, but he cannot clean it up. And Anna now seems to be leaning on Alfenor, rather than being as loyal to The Mother as herself.

After the conversation, Marcus wavered in his decision to stay in Macksohn. He believed that it was not a safe thing to involve everyone in the palace struggle, and tried to persuade everyone to leave Mike Song first. But before he left, he wanted to take Twitter somewhere. Before setting off, Marcus changed into a simple outfit, and at the request of Twitter, he prepared a lemon worth of gold coins for him to study.

Before departure, Sugalu also distributed the gold coins that Watson got from Marcus last night to everyone: a total of 400 gold coins, Watson, Tweeter and Yi each received 100 gold coins, and Paladin who did not participate in the contract and Sugalu who did not participate in the task each received 50 gold coins. pieces.

At the request of Tweeter, the others also set off with Marcus, leaving Marianne to take care of the unconscious Yi. Marcus leads everyone to an abandoned house in the old town. The dark first floor was filled with broken furniture. Marcus led everyone down the stairs to the basement. There is a fireplace and a table in the basement. Sitting behind the table was a man wearing a cloak with a star symbol, motionless. Following Marcus's demonstration, he took out a gold coin and placed it on the table. The man stretched out his hand and dragged the gold coin away. Marcus asked him, "Did I lie or conceal what my sister said today?" The man responded and said that he did not lie, but he concealed something. The man's voice seemed to be that of a young woman, and everyone felt unusually familiar.

Then Watson and Tweeter also gave some gold coins and asked this person some questions. They learned that the largest gathering place of the Rathos Cult in Macksohn was in the underground passage of the Trinis Theater; the clay figures created by Hobb in their bodies set out from Sebano and were about to arrive at Macksohn, with only a few months left; the eye-opening deal that Tweeter unexpectedly reached with the God of Transactions could not be canceled, but someone destined to save Roline; finally, Roline His body will be kept safe until the destined One rescues him. Before leaving, Tweeter opened the eyes on his forehead and found that as he guessed: the person under the cloak was Roline who had turned into ceramics, but there seemed to be a puppet behind Roline, and all the body parts were disassembled and fell to the ground.

After leaving this small dark room, Marcus answered the reason why he brought them here at the request of Watson. He said that this is an important stronghold of the God of Trading in Macksohn. At the same time, he also wants everyone to get answers here that cannot be obtained from him or Marianne. Finally, he had actually expected that Roline would come here in the end, so he wanted everyone to come here to see and make sure Roline was doing well.

On the way back, Watson and other partners discussed where to go next? They came up with several plans: go to the underground passage downstairs of Trinis Theater to wipe out all the Rathos cult, block the clay figures coming to Macksohn, take Marcus to Cornfield for refuge, or go to meet the God King of Sugalu faith.

Macksohn's situation has become difficult to control. The threat from the Rathos Cult and the overwhelming victory of the anti-king faction are difficult to resist. The team's next step is full of uncertainty.

Marcus and Marianne left the room to the master and apprentice. Lott expressed concern for Yi and hoped that he would be well. After some time, Lott heard a knock on the door. Marcus took Lott out and gave him a magic ball, saying that if he held him down, he would be able to find the location of the group of adventurers just now.

The adventurers felt relieved when they discovered that Lott was missing. As they prepare to head to the ruins of the Trinis Theater, they discover a second-hand bookstore on the side of the road. Tweeter decided to sell the religious books he had stolen from Yi's secret base, but he was not satisfied with the price offered by the waiter. Paladin tried to exert some influence by using Violet's medal. Unexpectedly, the waiter grabbed the book handed to him by Tweeter, grabbed Paladin's medal, and ran out. Tweeter quickly caught up and knocked out the waiter. Books and medals flew out of the store's second-hand store, and the onlookers on the roadside rushed to grab them. Tweeter In desperation, he attacks the crowd. In addition to the three unconscious and unstable people, several people also fainted. Tweeter, Watson and Paladin rushed to stabilize their injuries. Soon after, these unconscious people sat up one after another. Everyone was puzzled by the strange things they saw in front of them, as if it was just a magic show.

Hurrying away from the embarrassing scene, everyone headed to the ruins of the Trinis Theater. At this time, the alert Tweeter found that someone seemed to be following them not far behind. He turned around and saw a cat man carrying a suitcase walking towards them. He tried to communicate with the cat man and wanted to know his purpose. The cat man and Tweeter were very tense, and the conflict seemed to be about to break out. Catman took the syringe out of the suitcase and walked over to Tweeter. At the moment when Tweeter launched the attack, Lott, who finally caught up and was hiding aside, jumped out to save the catman's life and tried to communicate with Tweeter. Lott said that there should be no ill intentions on both sides and there was no need to hurt each other immediately, and Tweeter's mood gradually eased. But by this time the cat man had disappeared.

Lott Join the adventurers as they search for an entrance to the ruins of the Trinis Theater. Everyone walked in through the door that led to the underground and could be opened without force. Walking down the stairs, the tunnel was filled with murals and texts recording the history of Trinis Cult. However, as we walked deeper and deeper inside, the murals disappeared, leaving only a somewhat primitive tunnel.

The adventurers discovered that there seemed to be a figure in front of them, resting against the wall. Lott came to visit out of curiosity. He first used magic to try to make some sounds in the humanoid creature's ears, but the man seemed to have no reaction, so Lott walked directly next to him and tried to talk to him.

The creature leaning against the wall is a dwarf woman who was suddenly teleported from his hometown. He said his name was Caramip Mango and he didn't know much about things in this world. After the adventuring party and Caramip confirmed that they meant no harm to each other, they decided to go together.

Watson used magic to summon an invisible magic eye to detect the front. He found that there seemed to be a wooden fence at the end of the corridor, and behind it were two creatures he didn't recognize. As everyone walked there, Paladin recognized it as the Razite beast he had encountered before, but he only remembered that his partner Brock had been transformed into such a creature in the past, and that his fur seemed to be able to be made into an invisibility cloak. As for how it changed? He doesn't know either.

Hearing that his fur could be used, Sugalu took out his weapon and tried to poke the Razite beast's skin, but its skin was too thick and there was no sign of being poked, which Sugalu found very interesting. According to Paladin, the adventurers judged that the Razit beasts seemed to have been transformed into humanoid creatures. Perhaps releasing them was to relieve them, so Sugalu opened the wooden fence, and the Razit beasts walked out extremely slowly, as slowly as if they were not moving. Watson also discovered that Razitmon seemed to be able to see his invisible magic eyes.

Caramip found the Razite beasts very interesting, and wanted to try to pick one up, but found that it was too heavy to be picked up, so he took out his own rope, wrapped it around it, like tying the reins to a horse, and then sat on him, driving him forward. Regardless of shouting to him, shaking food in front of him, or even lighting a fire behind his butt, Razitmon's speed did not speed up. It was not until Watson cast magic that Razitmon's forward speed could be discerned with the naked eye, but it was still too slow and unreasonable.

At this time, Lott suddenly discovered that there seemed to be footsteps coming from the other end of the corridor. He quickly climbed to the wall of the cave, observed from the dark, and prepared for an ambush. Sugalu, Paladin and Watson were hiding in the corner next to the Razitmon's fence, while Caramip tried to climb on Razitmon's body, trying to hide on his belly, while Tweeter was hiding under the body of another Razitmon.

Two humans in dark cloaks gradually approached. The one in front was holding the chain tightly with both hands and looking at Lott who was hiding in the corner, while the humans behind were staring straight ahead. In an instant, the human in front threw the chain towards Lott and dragged him to the ground, and a battle began.

In the narrow tunnel, Sugalu rushed directly in front of The Hooded Figure and started fighting fiercely. Everyone took turns trying to attack, but The Hooded Figure seemed to be more durable than everyone thought. The Hooded Figure in front recited a series of spells before falling down. The two Razit beasts rushed forward at an unimaginable speed like crazy, injuring two or three adventurers in one breath. This was in great contrast to the incredibly slow Razit beasts seen earlier.

Seeing his partner fall, the second player The Hooded Figure, after injuring Lott's shoulder, performed a small ritual and teleported away the two Razite beasts along with himself. Lott, who suffered a shoulder injury, and Caramip, who lost his potential pet, both felt very lost after the battle.

Everyone decided to rest first, but Tweeter vaguely felt that something was wrong with Sugalu. He used his third eye and discovered that there was a force in Sugalu's body that was constantly expanding, almost to the point of being uncontrollable.

Lott, who was in a calmer mood, took out the small carving that he wanted to give to his friend from his backpack. As soon as he handed Sugalu the carving of a bat, he saw cold sweat breaking out on Sugalu's face, and then with a burst of bright light, Sugalu suddenly disappeared. Everyone seemed to hear Sugalu leaving his "last words" in their minds: "God King".

Who is the God King? Or what? Only Paladin in the scene has ever heard it. He briefly told everyone the story of his partner Usioni during their past adventures and the goblin King Knicol they had crowned.

After the break, everyone continued to move forward. Not far away, the mouse called by Watson was caught by a ghostly hand emerging from the side. Everyone seemed to hear the sound of the mouse being crushed. Everyone moved forward cautiously, looking for opportunities to attack the hand. Lott used illusion to create a fake mouse to attract the hand's attention. The ghost hand seemed to be fooled, Tweeter quickly attacked, and the hand quickly retracted into the door and disappeared.

The space inside the door seems to be a meeting place, and everyone saw traces of burning in the tunnel, which seems to have started from here. All that remains of the assembly hall are the burnt wooden cabinets. Everyone looked through the wooden cabinet and found a robe for each person. This seemed to be the same style as what they saw the two Lassosians wearing earlier. At the same time, after investigation, it seemed that a simple ceremony had been held here, which was most likely an initiation ceremony for the Rathos religion.

After leaving the assembly hall and walking for a long time, everyone found that there seemed to be a gap in the ceiling of the tunnel. After pushing it, there seemed to be a door panel above. Everyone climbed up one after another. It was a private house that had been unoccupied for a long time. In the room, a large bed seemed to be sunken in the middle, leading directly to the ground, but it was not the section they came up from. Everyone explored the house and found some clothes and a drum set with a signature: Brock. Everyone decided to take away this set of drums, which was also the only thing that might be valuable in the house.

When we arrived at the Cultural and Creative District, we found a musical instrument store and decided to sell the Brock drum. The boss knows Brock, but he doesn’t know where Brock has gone. He can only ask everyone to say hello to Brock next time he sees him. Brock's drum set seems to be able to sell for a certain price. Under Tweeter's induction, he found several magical instruments. In the end, Tweeter bought a magical ocarina, and Lott bought a flute that looked very special and smelled like a fairy. In addition to the two instruments, Brock's drum set is available for a little more money.
Tweeter also went to the bookstore he went to earlier and sold the book he stole from Yi to the boss.
羅特提議應該要去見一下母親大人，於是他便帶著大家來到母親大人的神殿。
黑暗之中，羅特跪下，祈求母親大人治療他重傷的肩膀。在母親大人的觸碰下，羅特瞬間痊癒。喜極而泣的他，馬上決定加入蜘蛛神教，在母親大人的輕咬下，他知道母親大人完美的填補了他從小便沒有的的父母的位置。
母親大人也看向帕拉丁，感受到了他加入蜘蛛神教的事。然而，一個瞬間，母親大人突然像是癱軟了一樣，八隻腳撐著的身體重重摔在床上。圖伊特直覺式的睜開他的第三隻眼，看見一股能量在空中竄啊竄，然後直直射入母親大人的體內。母親大人再度站起，但整個氛圍感覺不太一樣，或者應該說，不太對勁。
「謝謝你啊，帕拉丁。」重生的母親大人對著帕拉丁説，但比起母親大人，他聽起來……更像是安娜的聲音。「你的任務已經完成了。」

語畢，母親大人的腳快速地朝著帕拉丁的脖子伸去。戰鬥一觸即發，冒險者們在逃跑與攻擊之間難以抉擇。圖伊特看見母親大人的靈魂在他被奪走的軀體與帕拉丁之間竄動，大喊了一聲，要靈魂鑽進帕拉丁的體內。靈魂快速竄入帕拉丁倒在地上的體內，這時他的肚子突然破開，八隻蜘蛛的腳破體而出，將他仰躺的身體從地面撐起，帕拉丁的臉望著天花板，頭殼裂了開來，成了蜘蛛的嘴。然後這副軀體便飛快的朝著神殿之外飛奔而出。羅特追了上去，比起夥伴的死亡，母親大人的失勢對他來說打擊更大。他嘗試追上蜘蛛，詢問他今後該怎麼辦？是否還有機會見到祂？羅特的腦中浮現了母親大人的聲音：「不是是否會見到，而是何時會見到。」然後蜘蛛便消失了蹤影。
房間內，被安娜奪走軀體的母親大人逐漸向後退去，伸出後腳，朝牆上的印記按了一下，然後就被傳送走了。圖伊特和華生決定到床頭探索，但也同時發現芒果不見了。
牆上的印記和之前見過的相同，羅特向前檢視，這印記他從小在貧民窟看過不少次，相同的形式，但多多少少有差異。圖伊特也感受到這應該附著有傳送魔法。印記旁是過去母親大人退回的洞穴。華生決定先前往洞穴內探索，要圖伊特和羅特先在洞外等他。
洞穴內毫無聲響，像是被下了魔法般的寂靜。走了好久，華生突然發現自己似乎踩到了一個陷阱。仔細觀察，「陷阱」像是一個按鈕，他輕輕把腳抬起，發現按鈕逐漸提升，無數隻的小蜘蛛從像是水管的通道爬了出來（水管的材質像是蜘蛛絲做成的，十分堅硬。），沒有目的的四處亂竄。華生對此感到十分困惑，在穴壁上做了個記號，然後就繼續前進了。
等了十分鐘，圖伊特和羅特決定也進到洞穴內探索。他們看見了華生留下的記號，以及突出的陷阱。
華生繼續向前走，最終走到了盡頭。洞穴的底端是個佈滿陷阱，多到足以觸發密集恐懼症的半球形凹槽。此時華生已經不再刻意避開陷阱了，地上滿是爬出來的小蜘蛛。華生採集了一些蜘蛛，便決定回頭走。

停留下來的圖伊特和羅特也採集了一些蜘蛛—活的，以及被踩死的。其中還有一些是看起來活動不太順暢的個體。圖伊特將看起來怪怪的蜘蛛用小刀剖開，發現不但沒有流出任何體液，這些小蜘蛛體內甚至比起組織，更像機械。他拿起正常的蜘蛛，剖開，發現裡頭也是機械。圖伊特膽大地將一隻小蜘蛛放在掌心，手掌傳來一陣刺痛，他的掌中心多了一個洞，肉眼看過去是透的，卻沒有留任何血。此時與他們會合的華生也見到了這樣的狀況。然而洞穴內無法說話，於是三人決定回到神殿去。
圖伊特將自己的發現分享給華生。三人決定去詢問大衛醫師，同時也將他們說好要還他的錢交給他。如果情況允許，也許也能見見他的弟弟，半神丹尼斯。
因為不知道大衛醫師私下的住處，三人只好先前往原本診所的廢墟。第一次見到這裡的羅特滿臉吃驚。圖伊特找了附近的路人，得知大衛醫師的住處就在附近，於是三人便趨身前往。

管家將大門打開，三人踏入大衛醫師家的大廳，大衛醫師不久後便從二樓下來。他得知帕拉丁的慘況後，因為帕拉丁是名有領地的爵士，趕緊叫管家去通知王室，準備為他舉行國葬。在華生和圖伊特和大衛醫師還錢的過程中，羅特偷偷溜上二樓，卻在二樓樓梯上看見了一個滿臉驚恐的人，喊著羅特是深淵來的。羅特滿臉困惑，然後得知這是大衛醫師的弟弟，自稱是半神的丹尼斯。他的偷竊計畫泡湯。大衛醫師將他的弟弟帶了下來，同時羅特也趕緊闡明自己只是從來沒進來過這麼大的房子，很好奇，所以才到處亂跑。

大衛醫師檢查了圖伊特的傷口，也看了他們帶回來的蜘蛛，覺得好奇，但也完全沒有頭緒。冒險者們決定給丹尼斯一個機會，畢竟完全沒有任何頭緒。丹尼斯看了看，提出一個說法：圖伊特的手被下了傳送魔法，他掌心的那一塊肉被傳送到其他地方去了。這話雖然聽起來十分荒唐，但又有一定程度的可能性。華生嘗試讀取丹尼斯的大腦，丹尼斯似乎在過去被抓到深淵去時，有見過類似的事。為了博取丹尼斯的信任，華生也自稱是半神，而丹尼斯也不假思索地相信他。出於好奇，他們也問了丹尼斯究竟是什麼宗教信仰的半神？丹尼斯則表示自己是「宇宙神」的半神。雖然對這神祇沒有概念，但因為說話的人是丹尼斯，冒險者也沒有什麼多想了。

三人與大衛醫師兄弟告別，決定去一趟小黑屋。華生在小黑屋門口等待，圖伊特和羅特準備下樓去，他們卻撞見了一名穿著斗篷，只露出下半臉的人，從樓梯走了上來。這是他們第一次在小黑屋見到另一名活人。圖伊特看了看那人，發現竟然是個他想不到還存在的人—那人的臉，和他前陣子看見了王宮大學士伊什頓長得一模一樣。圖伊特將第三隻眼睜開，想一探究竟，沒想到這人一看見他的第三隻眼，便跪了下來，表示自己奉月神之命，無條件服從圖伊特—有第三隻眼的他，地位非凡。圖伊特和他詢問為何伊什頓已死，他的軀體卻在這裡活動？這人表示月神讓他借用了伊什頓的身體，但裡面的靈魂是不同的。他告訴圖伊特需要他的時候，在心中默念他的名字—薩姆，他便會盡可能地快速趕來。語畢，他便離開了。
來到地下室，圖伊特和羅特向他們知道批在斗篷底下的陶瓷蘿琳詢問了一些問題，得知圖伊特掌心的肉被傳送到了麥克嵩的地下水道，同時也是蜘蛛神教的聚集場所；母親大人正朝著妖精王國內蜘蛛神教的發源地跑去；羅特詢問了自己的身世，了解到自己的父母：兩名魔人，當年偷偷潛入麥克嵩，將他拋棄在貧民窟後便逃走了，同時他也得知自己體內有魅魔的血統，如果要學習使用魅魔的力量，要練習拋棄理智，遵從本能。
離開小黑屋後，三人一起走回馬可斯家去。瑪莉安前來應門，發現他們又少了人，表示要是馬可斯知道，他一定會氣瘋的。等馬可斯從樓上下來，大家便先用晚餐。羅特詢問了他的師父伊的狀況，瑪莉安表示伊還在昏迷中，狀況並不好。

餐桌上，馬可斯的表情十分凝重，甚至他的餐盤一動也不動。他嘆了口氣，表示自己警告過大家要趕快離開麥克嵩，否則明天餐桌上不知道會不會又再少一人？華生提到有聽說之前在瑟巴諾，他、圖伊特、蘇加魯和伊努被殺死後再製而成的泥人，似乎正在前往麥克嵩的路途中，要是他們抵達了麥克嵩，肯定不會有好事，因此希望可以把他們除掉後，再啟程離開。同時，羅特也提到他想去找母親大人，這也得到了瑪莉安的認可，因此大家計劃在解決完泥人的問題後，便出發前往妖精王國。然而，沒有人懂妖精語，因此在華生的說服下，馬可斯決定和他在妖精王國的線人聯繫。
飯吃到一半，羅特看見窗外突然出現了一道亮光，然後一個看起來搞不清楚狀況的傢伙出現在窗前，那人意外的眼熟。是他們今天在地道遇見的那名地侏，芒果。羅特趕緊和他揮手，並告訴馬可斯這件事。馬可斯判斷這人也是他們的同伴，於是便到門口應門。
晚餐後，圖伊特和羅特去二樓的貴賓室就寢，而華生和芒果則在瑪莉安的招待下，暫時住在他的房間。瑪莉安則因為要照顧伊，這幾天都在伊的房間休息。
睡夢中，羅特感到無比的孤單。他分不清夢境與真實，只是想起自己被父母拋棄的事，就覺得難受。無盡的黑暗中，彷彿一切都是空的。他的手一伸，觸碰到了一個毛毛的東西。身體湊近，一股熟悉的味道。他突然感受到了一種他不曾擁有過的感覺，叫歸屬感。
Lott suggested that he should go see The Mother, so he took everyone to the temple of The Mother.

In the darkness, Lott knelt down and prayed to The Mother to heal his seriously injured shoulder. Under the touch of The Mother, Lott healed instantly. He cried with joy and immediately decided to join the Spider God Cult. Under the bite of The Mother, he knew that The Mother perfectly filled the position of his parents that he had not had since he was a child.

The Mother also looked at Paladin and felt that he had joined the Spider God Cult. However, in an instant, The Mother suddenly seemed to be paralyzed, and his body supported by eight legs fell heavily on the bed. Tweeter intuitively opened his third eye and saw a stream of energy rushing through the air, and then shot straight into The Mother's body. The Mother stood up again, but the whole atmosphere felt different, or should be said, something was not right.
"Thank you, Paladin." The reborn The Mother said to Paladin, but compared to The Mother, he sounded... more like Anna's voice. "Your mission has been completed."

After finishing speaking, The Mother's feet quickly stretched towards Paladin's neck. The battle is about to break out, and the adventurers have a hard time choosing between escape and attack. Tweeter saw The Mother's soul moving between his stolen body and Paladin, and shouted, asking the soul to get into Paladin's body. The soul quickly rushed into the body of Paladin who was lying on the ground. At this time, his stomach suddenly burst open, and eight spider legs broke out of the body, lifting his body lying on his back from the ground. Paladin's face looked at the ceiling, and his head shell split open and became the spider's mouth. Then the body quickly flew out of the temple. Lott chased after him. Compared with the death of his partner, The Mother's loss of power was a bigger blow to him. He tried to catch up with the spider and asked him what he should do next? Is there still a chance to see Him? The voice of The Mother appeared in Lott's mind: "It's not whether we will see it, but when we will see it." Then the spider disappeared.

In the room, The Mother, whose body was taken away by Anna, gradually moved backwards, stretched out his hind legs, pressed on the mark on the wall, and was then teleported away. Tweeter and Watson decided to explore the bedside, but they also discovered that Mango was missing.

The mark on the wall was the same as the one he had seen before. Lott looked forward. He had seen this mark many times in the slums since he was a child. It was the same form, but more or less different. Tweeter also felt that there should be teleportation magic attached to this. Next to the mark is the cave that The Mother returned to in the past. Watson decided to explore the cave first and asked Tweeter and Lott to wait for him outside the cave.

There was no sound in the cave, as if it had been cast into magical silence. After walking for a long time, Watson suddenly realized that he seemed to have stepped into a trap. Observing carefully, the "trap" looked like a button. He gently lifted his foot and found that the button gradually lifted, and countless small spiders crawled out from the passage that looked like a water pipe (the material of the water pipe seemed to be made of spider silk, very hard.), scurrying around aimlessly. Watson was very confused by this, made a mark on the wall of the cave, and then moved on.
After waiting for ten minutes, Tweeter and Lott decided to explore the cave as well. They saw the marks left by Watson and the prominent traps.

Watson continued to move forward and finally reached the end. The bottom of the cave is a hemispherical groove filled with traps, enough to trigger trypophobia. At this time, Watson no longer deliberately avoided the trap, and the ground was full of little spiders crawling out. Watson collected some spiders and decided to turn back.

Tweeter and Lott who stayed here also collected some spiders - both alive and trampled to death. Some of them are individuals who seem to have difficulty moving around. Tweeter cut open the strange-looking spiders with a knife and found that not only did they not leak out any body fluids, but the insides of these little spiders were even more like machines than tissues. He picked up a normal spider, cut it open, and found that it was also mechanical inside. Tweeter boldly placed a small spider in the palm of his hand. There was a stinging pain in his palm. There was a hole in the center of his palm. It was see-through to the naked eye, but no blood was left. Watson who met them at this time also saw this situation. However, they could not speak in the cave, so the three decided to return to the temple.

一早，圖伊特就醒了。看見依偎在自己身上的羅特，他十分好奇，以學者的角度觀察並記錄。他想起昨日羅特提到自己擁有魅魔的血統，便嘗試去思考，他的種種行為，是否是因為他的血統導致的？

當華生和圖伊特回來時，發現羅特不見了。芒果表示自己剛剛很認真在雕刻，也沒注意到他消失。這時，一樓的後沒被推開，羅特拿著兩袋食物走了進來。他邀請夥伴們享用他剛剛去找了僕人，在餐廳自己做的餅乾。餅乾倒了出來，看起來讓人食不下嚥—原料的昆蟲形狀太過完整，讓人很不放心。但是吃起來，卻是蠻好吃的。羅特將其中一袋送給還在辦公室的馬可斯後，大家便準備出發。
