paragraphs: 在冒險者們收到了來自羽王的信後，他們便朝著羅特指認的方向前進。路上，靠著接簡單的任務，沒有多消耗費用。
四個多月後，一片廣袤的平原出現在他們面前，一座偌大的莊園遺世獨立地矗立在他們的視野正中央。冒險者們向前邁進，推開未上鎖的柵門。
莊園內，宅邸門口，兩排穿著正式又奇異的僕人並列著。他們臉上接戴著一致的短吻鳥類造型的面具，不論性別，身著西裝，左胸口上，則分別別著不同顏色與形狀的一根鳥羽。那是唯一能識別他們差異的地方了。羅特想起過去羽王派出與他交涉的傳話者，那位名為低語，毫無記憶點的人。他身上散發著一樣的氣味，很顯然的是羽王的人沒錯。
而宅邸的門雖然敞開，裡面卻漆黑一片。隨著冒險者們一一靠近，「羽僕」們紛紛開始向他們招呼，以各自不同的稱呼，向他們道「歡迎回家」，這讓冒險者們感到十分困惑：怎麼每個人都知道他們的名號？而且用了「回家」這麼奇異的字眼？
烏波見這些羽僕有趣，擅自化形成他們的模樣。他朝宅邸門口走近，聽見裡頭傳來響亮的腳步聲，在空蕩的宅邸，回聲更佳明亮。漆黑中的蠟燭逐漸變大，一名憂傷但不失禮節的貴族男子走了出來，向冒險者們微笑。他自我介紹為利希恩・阿莫雷，也就是信中提及的「羽王」，不過比起稱謂，他更偏好大家直接稱他為利希恩或阿莫雷。
利希恩帶著小心謹慎的冒險者們走入宅邸，隨著最後一人踏入房子，門也應聲關上了。長長的走廊上空無一人，只有左右對稱的好幾扇門，以及掛在牆壁上的肖像畫，用華麗的金框裝飾著。冒險者們端詳著肖像畫，看起來都有一些年代了，似乎是宅邸的主人們。他們也確認了利希恩並未出現在畫上。
「我人還在這呢，當然不會在畫上啦！」利希恩微笑道。看著烏波將其中一幅畫扯了下來，吞進他的肚子內，利希恩也沒有什麼情緒的波折，繼續緩緩地領著冒險者們向前走。
長廊底端有一扇門。利希恩推開門，走了進去。一張長桌的兩個長邊，分別擺了五張和一張椅子，桌上則放著乾淨的餐盤。利希恩示意冒險者們坐下，自己也坐在對面一側，靜靜看著。
冒險者們感到不知所措，除了烏波。他很快地就把盤子拎了起來，吞了下肚，但利希恩也沒有多加以評論。他再次鄭重地歡迎冒險者們來到他的「覆羽莊園」，並感謝大家完成了他的任務。冒險者們拿出答應的月神王冠，利希恩也依約，給了每個人50枚金幣作為回禮，接著他就請一名羽僕將王冠拿走了。
羽僕們端了香檳，遞給冒險者們飲用。利希恩緩緩地打量著冒險者們，也允諾回答任何他們提出的問題。冒險者們小心翼翼地確認上來的各道料理是否可能混有任何可疑的藥品，卻只發現利希恩選用的都是上等的食材，吃起來也都非常可口。
香檳之後，是第一道開胃菜—鵝肝醬，以及第二道開胃菜—煙燻鮭魚切片。冒險者們開始慢慢地放下心防。從利希恩的口中，他們得知他取得月神王冠，並不是想製造出更多月神的傳教士。相反的，利希恩對月神似乎有著極大的反感。
「芬尼爾曾經賜予我愛，但又擅自將它帶走。如今，我甚至不確定那份愛到底是否曾經存在過。」利希恩輕輕低下頭，呢喃道。
在開胃菜後是綜合蕈菇湯。儘管錯誤的菇類很有可能讓人身體產生不適，冒險者們卻也發現這碗湯沒有任何問題。

到了主菜，羽僕們一人端著一盤，每個人，都有不同的料理。一份高檔的牛排放在了庫登面前；賽柏的主菜則是一盤各式蔬菜；烏波拿到了一碗各類雜燴燉飯，看不太出來裡面到底包含哪些食材；GoR的盤子上放了章魚、花枝、魷魚等軟體動物；而羅特眼前的，則是一隻烤烏骨春雞。烏波看了一眼，放在利希恩面前的，竟然是幾塊切片麵包，與冒險者們的料理相比，差異挺大的。在快速吞食完自己的主菜後，烏波便將他的手伸向其他冒險者夥伴們的盤子，被利希恩輕聲警告「每個人的主菜都是特別挑選的，吃別人的主菜，這樣好嗎？」烏波不顧一切，卻發現比起自己的料理，其他人的菜，吃起來像是沒有味道一樣。他最後也將手伸向利希恩的盤子，利希恩也任他拿走一片自己的麵包。
當烏波嚷著應該要來杯紅酒時，羽僕們正好推開餐廳的門，紅酒這就端上了大家的面前。輕輕一聞，這酒十分香甜。
酒後，甜點是剛烤好的蘋果派，撒上肉桂粉，香氣撲鼻。配上最後的飲料，一頓精心準備的晚宴就此結束。
利希恩站起身，向冒險者們輕輕鞠躬，表示自己先行離開，他們可以在宅邸各處參觀。若有需要，利希恩以及羽僕們隨時可以幫忙。利希恩也告訴冒險者們，他們可以在莊園內待到任何時間。但之後會有一場儀式，他會邀請冒險者們一起來見證：這便是他取得月神王冠的使用之處。最後，他也善意地提醒冒險者們，莊園內的時間流動方式，和外界不太一樣，希望他們不會被嚇著。
在利希恩離開餐廳後，冒險者們先繞了一下餐廳內部，想看看有沒有什麼可疑之處。除了沒有任何窗戶外，這裡就是個高級的餐廳罷了。另外，剛才用餐的坐法，和普遍貴族宴客的坐法有所差異：一般來說，主人會坐在長桌的前端，賓客們坐在兩側或尾端。這場晚宴，座位彷彿更像談判一樣。
冒險者們向餐廳出口走去。然而，與方才的寂靜不同，走廊上傳來了喧嘩、笑鬧聲，甚至還有酒杯碰撞的聲音。冒險者們推開門，差一點就撞上了長廊上的客人。眼看出去，至少有十來個客人，而這還甚至不包含穿梭其中的羽僕。
庫登大感震驚，找了其中兩名看起來微醺但未醉去的客人，試圖和他們詢問，卻只得知客人們「都已經來很久了」，而且都是利希恩邀請來的。他們甚至也不清楚來這裡的目的，只覺得受邀參加一場貴族的宴會，肯定是要赴約了。仔細一看，冒險者們也發現這兩人面色十分慘白，懷疑他們可能是吸血鬼，但卻沒有找到決定性的證據。除了他們之外，冒險者們也發現長廊上的賓客，並不是全都是人類，甚至還有如僵屍般的個體存在。
在兩名客人與冒險者們分開後，烏波發現原本被他啃食掉的畫像位置竟然被填補上了，而其他的畫像，也都很明顯的換成了不同的人。
庫登嘗試走到進入宅邸的那扇門，一推開，卻發現自己步入了剛才用餐的餐廳，餐桌上放滿了各式佳餚，滿滿的賓客們正拿著餐盤，邊享用餐點邊談天。對於這混亂的一切，冒險者們確定了一件事：這裡有很濃厚的魔法，但是是由各種不同魔法層層建構而成的。而當中，還混有非常微弱的芬尼爾的神性在裡頭。
再次離開餐廳，看見賓客們穿梭在不同房間與長廊之間，冒險者們決定踏入其中一個門口看看。
推開門，裡頭是一座舞廳。昏暗的燈光下，數不清的舞客交錯著。一名舞客向庫登伸出了手，邀請他共舞。奮力跳著舞，縱使對方舞步熟練，庫登仍發現對方腳步已經開始踉蹌了。
「你還好嗎？是不是跳很久了，要不要休息？」庫登問道。
「沒事的，我一直都在跳，但沒事的！」舞伴的身體很顯然地開始有些狀況，卻遲遲不放手。
看著庫登有了舞伴，羅特也嘗試尋找舞池外落單的人。他瞇起眼一看，遠處的牆邊，站了一個低著頭的人。羅特竄過舞池，朝著那人走去，伸出他的手，邀請他一起踏入舞池。
鳥人抬起頭，銳利的嘴喙懸在空中，深邃的雙眼看向驚詫的羅特。他輕輕吻了羅特的手背。而這讓羅特有種不知名的悸動與熟悉感。「你終於來了，羅特。」
「你、你的名字是？」羅特顫抖著說著。
「名字什麼的不重要。」鳥人牽起羅特的手，一同踏入舞池。
「你……是我很重要的人嗎？」
「重不重要，這要問你啊！」鳥人微微笑道。舞池中，羅特的眼神彷彿只有鳥人。但此刻的他，一時不知該說什麼好。
剎那間，在音樂交錯之下，羅特瞬間換了舞伴：庫登詫異的眼神出現在他面前。
「對不起！」羅特甩開庫登的雙手，拚了命的想從人群中找到消失的鳥人，卻彷彿他從未存在般。庫登則對於觀察到的異象被打斷，也不知所措。
發現找不到鳥人，羅特哭著走回方才找到鳥人的牆角，低下頭啜泣。
「沒事的，羅特。」一道女聲在他耳邊響起。那聲音極似一名曾與他一起冒險的女子，讓他哭得更慘了。「別哭。」
羅特擦了擦眼淚，朝著舞廳的門口離去。路上，有人搭了他的肩。
「回憶就是這樣。」利希恩在舞廳內看著他，微微說道。「隨時都會散去的。」語畢，利希恩便從容地向外走去。羅特追趕著，卻也追丟了，只見到堵在門口觀望的賽柏。看見羅特哭喪的臉，賽柏也就不多問了。
另一方面，烏波看見庫登和羅特都有了舞伴，便找到了幾名正在跳舞的舞客，把他們都拉了過來，像是圍成一個小圈一樣，繞著、繞著、旋轉著。舞客們開心地大笑，烏波也感到不亦樂乎，直到他瞥見遠方利希恩的身影，正朝著舞廳深處走去。烏波喚出他的烏鴉魔寵，要他往利希恩的方向追去，隨即，他便將舞伴紛紛甩出去，朝著利希恩的方向前行。
被甩出的舞伴們躺在地上哈哈大笑，看見烏波朝著一個方向不斷前進的庫登則趕上，跟在烏波身後。走了好一陣子，烏波停在舞池底端的牆前。他的魔寵烏鴉正停在這。很顯然的，他跟丟了利希恩。
在烏波的指示下，魔寵烏鴉飛越舞池，停在哭喪著臉的羅特的頭上，隨著羅特步出了舞廳。
羅特步出舞廳，走向正對面的門。推開，裡面是一座酒吧。羅特找了吧台最角落的位置坐了下來。酒保立刻調了一杯五顏六色的酒，遞給了羅特。
烏波和庫登走到了舞廳出口，看見賽柏正在門口等待。賽柏指出剛剛看見羅特走入正對面的門，大家卻也發現在離開餐廳後，他們就沒看見GoR了。
烏波、庫登和賽柏踏入了剛才羅特走進的門，裡頭是一座偌大的圖書館，十分安靜。利希恩坐在門口不遠處像是櫃檯一樣的座位，一手拿著書，另一隻手則在書上抄抄寫寫。

冒險者們向利希恩大聲質問，卻得到沒任何幫助的答案。賽柏在發現圖書館內的讀著們看的書都是全白的後，試圖翻出幾本書來看看，卻發現儘管書的封面都有文字，裡面卻全都是空白的。庫登決定繞繞看這個圖書館，卻發現走了超過20分鐘，才繞完整座圖書館。但在意識到剛才的舞廳有至少一座籃球場的大小後，這似乎也不是什麼令他感到訝異的事了。烏波，則將書櫃上的書抓起，啃碎，剩下的殘渣丟在地上。然而，當他視線沒有在那些殘渣上，一回頭，地面上卻又是乾淨的。
酒吧內，羅特喝著悶酒。他感到微醺，多喝了好幾杯相同的酒，卻不見任何醉意增長，只好向酒保要濃度更高的酒，純酒最好。微醺的羅特對著酒保喃喃自語，問他是否懂他的感受：見到了以為再也見不到的人，卻又再次失去了他。想起了，卻又再次遺忘；重拾了，卻又再次失去。酒保裝好了酒，轉過頭來，羅特卻只見到利希恩的臉。
有著利希恩臉的酒保坐了下來。羅特試圖和他分享發生在自己身上的事，利希恩卻回他說「你的事，我非常清楚」。利希恩反過來，告訴羅特「覆羽莊園」的羽毛，是天使的羽毛。那是他的天使，是芬尼爾賜予他的天使。
「要是我永遠留在這裡，我還有機會再見到他一面嗎？」羅特灌著酒，卻發現再怎麼喝，某部分的自己卻總是清醒，醉不了。「我好想……永遠留在這裡……。」轉過頭去為他裝酒的利希恩，卻已變回原本的酒保，就像羅特見到的鳥人一樣消失了。
離開圖書館，烏波和庫登決定推開不一樣的門。這次他們走入了一間劇場。舞台上是一名小丑，正在用浮誇的動作譁眾取寵。烏波在牆角試圖尋找小石子，想朝著小丑丟去；庫登則朝著舞台走去。
小丑朝著兩人揮揮手，眼看庫登快要走到舞台上，小丑大聲喊道，要請特別來賓上台。
小丑看著庫登，邀請他來場特別的演出。他向庫登分享了自己想到的劇本：他要庫登扮演一隻牛頭怪冒險者，再一次的冒險途中，桌補了一支由他扮演的哥布林，而為了讓哥布林乖乖聽話，牛頭怪藉由砍斷哥布林的手指頭，來嚇阻他。現在，哥布林只剩下了九隻手指頭了。若有需要，牛頭怪甚至可以將哥布林綁在背上，繼續冒險。
聽了小丑的發言，庫登感到怒不可遏，激問小丑是不是在嘲笑他是牛頭怪這件事？同時，撿了石頭的烏波正朝著舞台亂丟石頭。
小丑露出了誇張而狂妄的表情，對著庫登大笑。被激怒的庫登，拔出武器，朝著小丑的脖子劃去。只見小丑的頭應聲落地。
幾秒鐘後，落在地上的小丑頭卻大聲喊著：「謝謝來自我們嘉賓的演出！」隨後，失去了頭的他，將頭拾起，重新接回脖子上，彷彿什麼也沒發生一樣。
「這，就是你所尋求的血腥嗎？」小丑將臉湊在庫登耳邊，輕聲說道。
「再次謝謝我們的特別嘉賓！」小丑向著舞台下大聲喊道，如雷貫耳的掌聲響起。庫登從驚詫中恢復，顫抖著步下舞台。
After the adventurers received the letter from King Feather, they headed in the direction indicated by Lott. On the road, I took on simple tasks without spending too much money.

More than four months later, a vast plain appeared in front of them, and a huge manor stood alone in the center of their field of vision. The adventurers moved forward and pushed open the unlocked gate.

In the manor, at the entrance of the mansion, two rows of servants in formal and strange clothes lined up. They wore uniform masks in the shape of short-beaked birds on their faces. Regardless of their gender, they wore suits. On their left chests, there were bird feathers of different colors and shapes pinned to them. That's the only way to identify their differences. Lott recalled the messenger sent by King Yu to negotiate with him in the past, a person named Whisper with no memory. He exuded the same smell, and it was obvious that he belonged to King Yu.

Although the door of the mansion was open, it was pitch dark inside. As the adventurers approached one by one, the "Feathered Servants" began to greet them one after another, saying "Welcome home" to them with different names. This made the adventurers very confused: Why does everyone know their names? And he used such a strange word as "go home"?

Ubbo Seeing how interesting these servants are, I customized them to look like them. He approached the door of the mansion and heard loud footsteps coming from inside. In the empty mansion, the echo was even brighter. The candles in the darkness gradually grew larger, and a sad but polite noble man came out and smiled at the adventurers. He introduced himself as Lysien Amoret, the "Feather King" mentioned in the letter, but he preferred to be called Lysien or Amoret instead of a title.

Lysien led the cautious adventurers into the mansion. As the last person stepped into the house, the door closed with a sound. The long corridor was empty, except for several symmetrical doors and portraits hanging on the walls, decorated with ornate gold frames. The adventurers looked at the portraits. They seemed to be some years old and seemed to be the owners of the mansion. They also confirmed that Lysien did not appear in the painting.

"I'm still here, of course not in the painting!" Lysien smiled. Watching Ubbo tear off one of the paintings and swallow it into his stomach, Lysien showed no emotion and continued to slowly lead the adventurers forward.

There is a door at the bottom of the corridor. Lysien pushed open the door and walked in. There were five chairs and one chair on the two long sides of a long table, with clean dinner plates placed on the table. Lysien motioned for the adventurers to sit down, and he sat on the opposite side, watching quietly.

The adventurers were at a loss, except for Ubbo. He quickly picked up the plate and devoured it, but Lysien didn't comment. He once again solemnly welcomed the adventurers to his "Feathered Estate" and thanked everyone for completing his mission. The adventurers took out the promised Luna Crown, and Lysien followed the promise and gave everyone 50 gold coins as a return gift. Then he asked a feathered servant to take the crown away.

The servants brought champagne and handed it to the adventurers to drink. Lysien looked at the adventurers slowly and promised to answer any questions they had. The adventurers carefully checked whether any suspicious drugs might be mixed with each of the dishes served, only to find that Lysien used only high-quality ingredients and they all tasted very delicious.

After the champagne, there was the first appetizer - foie gras, and the second appetizer - smoked salmon slices. The adventurers began to slowly let down their guard. From Lysien's words, they learned that he had not obtained the Lunar Crown as a missionary who wanted to create more Lunarians. On the contrary, Lysien seems to have a great dislike for Luna.
"Phynoir once gave me love, but then took it away without permission. Now, I'm not even sure if that love ever existed." Lysien lowered his head slightly and murmured.
After the appetizers was the mixed mushroom soup. Although the wrong mushrooms may cause physical discomfort, the adventurers also found that there was nothing wrong with this bowl of soup.

When it came to the main course, the servants each carried a plate, each with a different dish. A high-end steak was placed in front of Kudan; Psyber's main course was a plate of various vegetables; Ubbo got a bowl of various chowder stews, but it was hard to tell what ingredients were included; GoR's plate was filled with octopus, flower branches, squid and other molluscs; and Lott's front was a roasted silky spring chicken. Ubbo took a look and saw that what was placed in front of Lysien was a few pieces of sliced ​​bread. Compared with the adventurers' food, it was quite different. After quickly devouring his own main dish, Ubbo stretched his hand to the plates of other adventurers, and was gently warned by Lysien, "Everyone's main dish is specially selected. Is it okay to eat other people's main dishes?" Ubbo was desperate, but found that compared to his own cooking, other people's dishes tasted like they had no taste. He finally reached for Lysien's plate too, and Lysien let him take a piece of his own bread.

When Ubbo shouted that he should have a glass of red wine, the servants just opened the door of the restaurant, and the red wine was served in front of everyone. Upon first sniff, this wine is very sweet.
After drinking, the dessert is freshly baked apple pie, sprinkled with cinnamon powder, and the aroma is fragrant. With the last drink, a well-prepared dinner comes to an end.

Lysien stood up and bowed slightly to the adventurers, indicating that he would leave first and that they could visit various places in the mansion. Lysien and his feathered servants are always available to help if needed. Lysien also tells the adventurers that they can stay in the manor as long as they like. But there will be a ceremony afterwards, and he will invite adventurers to witness it: this is what he will use to obtain the Lunar Crown. Finally, he also kindly reminded the adventurers that the way time flows in the manor is different from the outside world, and he hopes they will not be scared.

After Lysien left the restaurant, the adventurers first walked around the interior of the restaurant to see if there was anything suspicious. Except that there are no windows, this is just a high-end restaurant. In addition, the way you sit during the meal just now is different from the way common aristocratic guests sit at banquets: Generally speaking, the host will sit at the front of the long table, and the guests will sit on the sides or at the end. At this dinner, the seating seemed more like a negotiation.

The adventurers walked towards the exit of the restaurant. However, unlike the silence just now, there was noise, laughter, and even the sound of clinking wine glasses in the corridor. The adventurers pushed open the door and almost ran into the guests on the corridor. From what he could see, there were at least a dozen guests, and that didn't even include the servants traveling among them.

Kudan was shocked and found two of the guests who looked tipsy but not drunk. He tried to ask them, but only learned that the guests "have been here for a long time" and that they were all invited by Lysien. They didn't even know the purpose of coming here. They just felt that when they were invited to attend a noble banquet, they must keep the appointment. Upon closer inspection, the adventurers also found that the two men were very pale and suspected that they might be vampires, but no conclusive evidence was found. In addition to them, the adventurers also discovered that not all the guests on the corridor were human beings, and there were even zombie-like individuals.

After the two guests separated from the adventurers, Ubbo found that the position of the portrait that he had eaten had been filled, and the other portraits were obviously replaced by different people.

Kudan tried to walk to the door that entered the mansion, and when he opened it, he found that he had entered the restaurant where he had just dined. The dining table was filled with all kinds of delicacies, and the guests were holding dinner plates and chatting while enjoying their meals. Regarding all this chaos, the adventurers are sure of one thing: there is a very strong magic here, but it is built up from layers of different magics. And there is also a very weak divinity of Phynoir mixed in it.
Leaving the restaurant again and seeing guests walking between different rooms and corridors, the adventurers decided to step into one of the doorways to take a look.

Pushing the door open, there is a dance hall inside. Under the dim lights, countless dancers mingled. A dancer reaches out to Kudan and invites him to dance. Dancing hard, even though the opponent was proficient in dance steps, Kudan still found that the opponent's steps had begun to stagger.
"Are you okay? Have you been dancing for a long time? Do you want to rest?" Kudan asked.
"It's okay, I've been dancing, but it's okay!" The dance partner's body was clearly starting to suffer, but he still refused to let go.

Watching Kudan have a dance partner, Lott also tried to find someone who was alone outside the dance floor. He squinted his eyes and saw a man with his head lowered standing by the far wall. Lott rushed across the dance floor, walked towards the man, stretched out his hand, and invited him to step onto the dance floor with him.

The birdman raised his head, his sharp beak hanging in the air, and his deep eyes looked at the surprised Lott. He kissed the back of Lott's hand gently. And this gives Lott an unknown throbbing and familiar feeling. "You're finally here, Lott."
"What's your name?" Lott said tremblingly.
"The name is not important." Birdman took Lott's hand and stepped onto the dance floor together.
"Are you... a very important person to me?"
"Whether it's important or not, that's up to you!" Birdman said with a slight smile. On the dance floor, Lott looked like a birdman. But at this moment, he didn't know what to say.
In an instant, under the interplay of music, Lott instantly changed his dance partner: Kudan appeared in front of him with surprised eyes.

"I'm sorry!" Lott threw away Kudan's hands and tried desperately to find the missing birdman from the crowd, but it was as if he had never existed. Kudan was also at a loss as to why the vision he observed was interrupted.
Finding that the Birdman could not be found, Lott cried and walked back to the corner where he had just found the Birdman, lowered his head and sobbed.
"It's okay, Lott." A female voice sounded in his ear. The voice was very much like a woman who had taken adventures with him, which made him cry even harder. "Don't cry."
Lott wiped his tears and left towards the door of the ballroom. On the way, someone put a hand on his shoulder.

"Memories are like this." Lysien looked at him in the ballroom and said slightly. "They will disperse at any time." After saying this, Lysien walked out calmly. Lott chased after him, but lost him. He only saw Psyber blocking the door and watching. Seeing Lott's sad face, Psyber didn't ask any more questions.

On the other hand, Ubbo saw that both Kudan and Lott had dance partners, so he found a few dancing dancers and pulled them over, like forming a small circle, spinning around, around, and spinning. The dancers laughed happily, and Ubbo also felt very happy, until he caught a glimpse of Lysien's figure in the distance, walking towards the depths of the dance hall. Ubbo called out his crow familiar and asked him to chase in the direction of Lysien. Then he threw his dancing partners away and headed in the direction of Lysien.

The thrown-out dance partners were lying on the ground laughing. Seeing Ubbo moving in one direction, Kudan caught up and followed behind Ubbo. After walking for a while, Ubbo stopped in front of the wall at the bottom of the dance floor. His familiar crow is stopping here. It was obvious that he had lost track of Lysien.
Under the instruction of Ubbo, the familiar crow flew across the dance floor, stopped on the head of the crying Lott, and followed Lott out of the dance hall.

Lott stepped out of the ballroom and walked towards the door directly opposite. Push open and there is a bar inside. Lott found a seat in the corner of the bar and sat down. The bartender immediately made a glass of colorful wine and handed it to Lott.

Ubbo and Kudan walked to the exit of the dance hall and saw Psyber waiting at the door. Psyber pointed out that he had just seen Lott walking into the door directly opposite, but everyone also discovered that they did not see GoR after leaving the restaurant.

Ubbo, Kudan and Psyber stepped into the door that Lott just entered. Inside was a huge library, very quiet. Lysien was sitting on a counter-like seat not far from the door, holding a book in one hand and copying on the book with the other.

The adventurers asked Lysien loudly, but received unhelpful answers. Psyber After discovering that the books read by readers in the library were all white, he tried to take out a few books to look at, but found that although the covers of the books had text, the insides were all blank. Kudan decided to walk around this library, but found that it took more than 20 minutes to walk around the entire library. But after realizing that the ballroom just now was at least the size of a basketball court, this didn't seem to be a surprise to him. Ubbo, grabbed the books on the bookcase, chewed them up, and threw the remaining residue on the ground. However, when his eyes were not on the debris, when he turned around, the ground was clean again.

In the bar, Lott was drinking. He felt tipsy and drank several more glasses of the same wine, but he didn't feel any increase in drunkenness. He had to ask the bartender for a more concentrated wine, pure wine was best. The slightly drunk Lott murmured to the bartender and asked him if he understood how he felt: seeing someone he thought he would never see again, but losing him again. I remembered it, but forgot it again; I picked it up, but lost it again. The bartender filled the bottle and turned around, but Lott only saw Lysien's face.

The bartender with Lysien's face sat down. Lott tried to share with him what happened to him, but Lysien replied to him, "I know your story very well." Lysien, in turn, told Lott that the feathers of "Feathered Estate" are angel feathers. That is his angel, the angel given to him by Phynoir.

"If I stay here forever, will I have a chance to see him again?" Lott drank wine, but found that no matter how much he drank, a certain part of him was always sober and could not get drunk. "I really want to...stay here forever..." Lysien turned around to fill the bottle for him, but he had turned back into the original bartender and disappeared just like the birdman Lott saw.

Leaving the library, Ubbo and Kudan decided to open different doors. This time they entered a theater. There is a clown on the stage, using exaggerated actions to impress the crowd. Ubbo was looking for pebbles in the corner and wanted to throw them at the clown; Kudan was walking towards the stage.
The clown waved to the two of them. Seeing Kudan approaching the stage, the clown shouted loudly to invite a special guest to the stage.

The clown looks at Kudan and invites him to perform a special performance. He shared the script he came up with with Kudan: He wanted Kudan to play the role of a minotaur adventurer. During another adventure, a goblin played by him was added to the table. In order to make the goblin obedient, the minotaur frightened him by cutting off the goblin's fingers. Now, the goblin only has nine fingers left. If necessary, the Minotaur can even strap the Goblin to its back and continue the adventure.

After listening to the clown's speech, Kudan felt furious and asked the clown if he was mocking him for being a minotaur? Meanwhile, Ubbo, who had picked up rocks, was throwing rocks towards the stage.
The clown showed an exaggerated and arrogant expression and laughed at Kudan. Enraged, Kudan drew his weapon and slashed towards the clown's neck. The clown's head fell to the ground.

A few seconds later, the clown's head fell to the ground and shouted loudly: "Thank you for the performance from our guest!" Then, having lost his head, he picked it up and put it back on his neck, as if nothing happened.
"Is this the blood you are looking for?" The clown put his face close to Kudan's ear and whispered.
"Thank you again for our special guest!" The clown shouted towards the stage, and thunderous applause broke out. Kudan recovered from the surprise and stepped off the stage tremblingly.

paragraphs: 當羅特再次回過神來，酒館內只剩下他與酒保了。儘管他知道酒精已無法麻痺他的情緒，他還是數不清自己到底喝了幾杯。羅特站了起身，想換到身後的圓桌去。定睛一看，其中一張圓桌上，放了一本破舊的筆記本。
羅特拾起筆記本，封面是空的，但翻開，裡面是滿滿的生物筆記，用羅特熟悉的筆跡，理性地寫著某人的觀察，以及那人的註記。羅特翻到其中一頁，寫著的物種是「魔人」，裡面的文字讓他想起了什麼，卻又說不明白，只感到內心滿滿的悸動。而最後一頁，則畫上了羅特的肖像畫。
有人拍了拍羅特的肩，他一回頭，是滿面愁容的利希恩。利希恩提醒著他，下次別忘記帶走自己的筆記本了。羅特感到困惑，他知道這不是屬於他的東西，但利希恩卻非常明確的告訴他，那是羅特自己帶來的。而不論這是否是羅特自己的東西，他很清楚，他會非常珍惜它。畢竟那與他喪失的某段珍貴回憶有很大的關聯。
羅特在小圓桌做了下來，利希恩承諾羅特可以在這裡待到他想離開為止，羅特便拿出了一塊小木頭，開始雕刻，利希恩則悄聲離去。
「我……還有機會見到他嗎？」羅特在利希恩推開門前問到。
「你知道，你可以待在這裡，直到你想離開為止。」利希恩回應他。「多久都可以。」
看見庫登與烏波走入了劇場，站在門口的賽柏卻被長廊上的某個東西吸引住了。那是一幅剛才還不存在的肖像畫。畫中的人不是別人，而是……說來也怪，晚餐時，他們的夥伴GoR不是還在嗎？怎麼就不見人影了？畫中這個GoR怎麼好像已步入老年，還穿得一身正裝？怎麼看都不對勁？
賽柏思忖著，還是決定向內心最可靠的奈西斯祈禱。他感受到莊園內還存有奈西斯的神力。閉上眼，賽柏跟隨著奈西斯賜予他的直覺向前走。睜開眼，他卻發現一名羽僕正領著他，最終他們停在一扇門前。羽僕將門打開，伸出手，示意賽柏進入。想著這也是奈西斯引導他來的地方，賽柏就這樣摸黑走入房間內了。
房內一片漆黑，只有正中央有一簇火苗。但當門關上時，周圍瞬間化作一片森林，那是奈西斯權能的象徵。賽柏還來不及喘口氣，就發現正中央的火苗已換成了一株盆栽，生機盎然。但森林的周圍，卻開始出現火光。
賽柏走向盆栽，他聽見了一道他認不得的聲音，說著：「你是遵循著自己的意志，追尋奈西斯，還是只是盲目的跟隨著別人叫你做的事呢？」賽柏回頭跑向來的方向，卻發現那道格格不入的門轉不開。
火勢漸漲，賽柏趕緊跑向盆栽。
「燃燒我，或是成為我。」他聽見自己的聲音，從盆栽的方向傳來。眼看火就要燒到盆栽了，賽柏抱起盆栽，跑向那扇門，門把輕易的被轉開。賽柏踏出門檻，回頭看向焚燒過後的房間，大聲喊道：「我的生命是奈西斯救來的，我遵循奈西斯之道，不是因為任何人要我這樣做，而是我自己的決定！」他便步回長廊去。他手中的盆栽在他回到長廊時，化成了一片金色的葉子，賽柏謹慎地將它收好。
重新回到劇院門口，賽柏看見庫登正僵直地站在舞台上，一旁的小丑正在鼓譟著觀眾們鼓掌。庫登默默走下台，徑直朝向出口走去。在舞台前丟小丑石頭的烏波則跟上庫登。
三人會和後，賽柏向他們兩人指著他看見的GoR的肖像。庫登皺起眉，烏波則翻起畫框，著急地看著畫框喊著：「你怎麼跑進畫裡去了？」一旁的羽僕小聲卻說著烏波不可以破壞畫像，但烏波直接把畫連同畫框摘下，羽僕也沒辦法做什麼。
羅特完成了他的木雕，那是一隻鳥人的半身雕刻。既熟悉，又陌生，就好像那是他潛意識的某個重要的東西，但他在怎麼努力都還想不起來。烏波之前召喚出的烏鴉看見完成的雕刻，夾起雕刻的脖子處，朝著不知何時被打開的酒館門口跳去，羅特小心翼翼地追上，祈求木雕不會被牠破壞，也就跟著跑回了長廊。從烏鴉口中拿回了木雕，羅特趕緊把它收好。
另一名羽僕在長廊上喊著晚餐已經準備好了，烏波一聽，便夾著GoR的肖像畫衝向餐廳。此時羅特正好從酒館跑了出來。看見熟悉的夥伴們正步向餐廳，他也就跟上了。
走入餐廳，門口旁，一名羽僕將餐盤與餐具紛紛遞給踏入的賓客，烏波趕緊衝向餐點區，將豬肋排夾了幾塊到他的盤子內，然後將原本拿來盛裝給賓客的鐵盤整盤端走，只留下他的小瓷盤放在桌上。
冒險者們靠向牆邊，互相交換著資訊。同時，烏波也不忘記餵食「被困在畫裡的GoR」他拿的豬肋排，搞得畫像一團亂。
突然間，熟悉的小丑再次出現在庫登面前，嚇著了大家。「我們的主角上次鬧了場，這次要不要換個劇本演啊？」小丑戲謔的看著庫登，烏波則拾起他吃剩的豬肋排骨頭，丟向小丑。庫登回過神來，也朝向小丑施展魔法。一瞬間，小丑滑稽地定格，然後倒下，但他身後，一個姿勢一模一樣的小丑拍了拍手，看著群眾，喊著「謝謝我們主角的演出！」對冒險者們一一鞠了躬後便消失在人群之中了。倒在地上的小丑，只留下一套小丑裝，賽柏將它收起。
冒險者們重新回到長廊，而在原本GoR的畫像處，已經掛了另一幅畫，畫中的是一名中年的紅色魔人男子，頭上一支角斷了，套上了環，像極了羅特。不過表情嚴肅的他身穿一套西裝，而且身邊還站了個神情相似的人類女子，身著婚紗，兩人牽著手。羅特一看大驚失色，人類、女性，這都不是他心之所向，這到底是怎麼回事？

羅特驚慌地看著四周，卻發現畫中的女子竟然出現在他的身後，哭泣著。賓客們紛紛劇了過來，大聲地祝賀著羅特新婚快樂，不知道從哪裡走來的樂隊更開始奏樂。羅特慌亂，大聲問著女子是什麼人？而女子哭得更傷心，念著羅特怎麼會連自己的老婆都認不得？女子喊著要樂隊停下來，他覺得太尷尬了，但樂隊停下來後，現場的一片寂靜更為尷尬。羅特也發現自己竟然換了身與畫中相同的西裝。為了化解危機，羅特決定做他不想做的事—他俯身向女子親吻，女子瞬間破涕為笑，眾人也大聲歡呼。
接著羅特以上廁所為藉口，朝著餐廳方向跑去。其他冒險者們也隨後跟上。關上餐廳的門，羅特大力喘氣，確保「新娘」沒有跟上。但他也發現他原本的衣服不僅沒有在身上，也沒有在他的背包內，他只能繼續穿著這套西裝了……。
餐廳內，冒險者們看見利希恩自在地穿梭著，手上拿著一本筆記本，時不時停下來寫一寫。
「當羽落下，我便不再為人；那條路，將無人同行……」
「他們說，我將成為永恆。但若永恆是孤單，那又有誰能見證我的愛？」
「我將是愛的化身，或只是愛的遺骸……」
羅特決心必須離開莊園，儘管他念念不忘那名鳥人。踏回長廊，他們又發現有個詭異的肖像畫了，上面是與烏波相似的流漿人，但卻很明顯穿著的是不同於他所信仰的芬尼爾的宗教服裝，很顯然是個神職人員的模樣。姿態肅穆，與混亂而愚蠢的烏波大相徑庭。羅特決定將這幅畫取下。
這時，羅特聽見一個年老的聲音從他背後傳來。「有些事情，你們該知道。」他一回頭，發現一個矮小的斗篷人。斗篷下的臉，是他的師父，伊，不過年紀非常非常大，還拄著拐杖。羅特看了趕緊扶著伊。
同時，其他冒險者們看見的，卻與羅特不同。賽柏和烏波都看見了一名他們不認得的人，庫登則看見了一位他憎恨不已的人：修洛。
羅特跟著伊，走向一扇門，賽柏、烏波也跟上，庫登雖然不想跟著修洛走去，但也好奇這是怎麼回事，於是殿後。
斗篷人推開門，緩緩走入昏暗的房間。
羅特走入了房間，裡面有一張木桌。伊坐在木桌後，示意羅特坐下。伊拿出一疊紙牌，翻了三張放在桌上，讓羅特選擇。羅特選了中間一張，伊將它翻開。
「羅特，這是你的卡，無盡的雙人舞。那暖的手，熟悉的旋律……如果我說，你可以永遠留在這裡，你會怎麼做？」
賽柏走入房間，卻沒見到在他前面的羅特，只有斗篷人坐在桌子後。賽柏仔細一看，這人很明顯是奈西斯的神職人員，只是他認不出來。
斗篷人遞給了賽柏一疊牌，讓他隨意選一張。
「賽柏，這是你的卡，焚燒的森林。森林已被燒盡，而你聽不見涅西斯的聲音。如果涅西斯不再與你溝通，你還會信仰他嗎？」
當烏波坐下時，他發現坐在他對面的，是與他相同的流漿人，就像在模仿他一樣。同時，他也聽見身旁傳來嘻笑聲。他一看，幾隻孽物在他身邊遊走，倒也令他感到安心。
流漿人將牌遞給烏波，示意他切牌。烏波切了一次後，流漿人便將牌翻開。
「烏波，這是你的卡，無神的殿堂。你走進月神芬尼爾的聖所，卻發現月神不曾存在，一切，都只是你的幻想。你該怎麼做？」
「月神是真的！你騙人！」烏波大喊，拿出武器，將眼前的木桌劈成一半。被劈開的木桌化成流漿，落在地上。
庫登走入房間內，有所不甘地坐了下來，瞪視著他恨的那人—他這輩子第二恨的人。
「庫登，你坐啊。」修洛邪佞的笑著。「來，選一張牌吧！」他洗了洗牌後，將牌隨機的丟在桌上，但庫登雙手叉腰，繼續瞪著他，沒有要做出選擇。「你不選的話，我就幫你選囉？」
「庫登，這是你的卡，操線的木偶。你認為演員是什麼？是自由的創作者，還是受劇本操控的傀儡？」
在羅特依依不捨地離開伊之前，他知道了一件事：那不是他的伊。那只不過是騙人的魔法罷了，但他還是無法壓抑住內心悸動的情緒。
踏出門，羅特看見其他冒險者們在外面等著。
冒險者們在長廊上，不斷聽見羽僕們竊竊私語，說著「雖然時間還沒到，但需要開始準備了」、「再不準備就要來不及了」、「已經開始了嗎？還是已經結束了嗎？」等的話語。他們攔下一名羽僕，詢問是什麼事情。羽僕解釋是稍晚的儀式。
冒險者們詢問羽僕儀式場地在什麼地方？羽僕便帶他們前往一扇鎖上的門，然後就離開了。
門把轉不動，但開鎖是羅特的專長。他輕鬆的用了自己的工具，把門鎖解開，大家一起踏入這個偌大的陰暗的空間。
門在背後關上，視野內，是一張如同王座的座椅，大小卻有點小，頂多只能坐一個未成年的瘦弱孩子。
庫登繞到座椅前，發現椅子上放了一本筆記本，而更令他感到在意的是，那張座椅的後方，竟然有一扇張開翅膀的造型，誇張而狂妄；椅子手把的兩側，竟然還有鐵鍊。
庫登拿起筆記本開始翻閱，烏波則索性坐在座椅上，玩弄著鐵鍊。筆記本的外型，與冒險者們看見利希恩時不時抄寫的那本筆記本相同，而內容，則很顯然的是他的日記和情詩。
庫登發現其中一頁，畫著他眼前的座椅，而上面，坐著的是一名翅膀垂落的瘦小女子，長髮散落在他垂下的頭前。
「天使」是他第一個想到的字眼，也是利希恩曾說過芬尼爾曾賜予他，卻又奪走的。
而筆記本的最後一頁，則留下了這樣的字句：「世上最可怕的，不是沒有人愛，而是愛過之後，發現你的愛，只是想像。」
烏波聽見遠方傳來腳步聲。定睛一看，利希恩沈穩的朝冒險者們走來。
「你們提早來了，儀式還沒準備好。」利希恩說道。「不過沒關係。」
冒險者們不清楚這儀式要做什麼，但很顯然利希恩也沒有要透露。烏波也知道這和芬尼爾常見的靈魂交換儀式是不同的。
「你們先出去吧，等到時機到了，羽僕們會再喚你們來的。」利希恩請示冒險者們離開。「反正儀式還沒開始，你們待在這裡什麼也看不到。」
冒險者們知道留下來也沒有意義，便轉身離開。但在推開門的前一刻，烏波轉頭一看，利希恩的身影在黑暗之中，似乎頭邊散出了淺淺的光暈。

When Lott came to his senses again, he and the bartender were the only ones left in the tavern. Although he knew that alcohol could no longer numb his emotions, he still lost count of how many drinks he had. Lott stood up and wanted to move to the round table behind him. Taking a closer look, he saw a worn notebook placed on one of the round tables.

Lott picked up the notebook. The cover was empty, but when he opened it, it was full of biological notes. In Lott's familiar handwriting, someone's observations and notes were written rationally. Lott turned to one of the pages, and the species written on it was "Demon". The words inside reminded him of something, but he couldn't explain it. He only felt full of throbbing in his heart. On the last page, there is a portrait of Lott.

Someone patted Lott on the shoulder. When he turned around, he saw Lysien with a sad face. Lysien reminded him not to forget to take his notebook with him next time. Lott was confused, he knew it was not something that belonged to him, but Lysien told him very clearly that it was brought by Lott himself. And whether or not it was Lott's own, he knew full well that he would cherish it. After all, it has a lot to do with a certain precious memory he lost.
Lott finished at the small round table. Lysien promised Lott that he could stay here until he wanted to leave. Lott took out a small piece of wood and started carving, and Lysien left quietly.
"Do I... still have a chance to see him?" Lott asked before Lysien opened the door.
"You know, you can stay here until you want to leave." Lysien responded to him. "As long as it takes."

saw Kudan and Ubbo walking into the theater, but Psyber standing at the door was attracted by something on the corridor. It was a portrait that didn't exist just a moment ago. The person in the painting is none other than... Oddly enough, wasn't their partner GoR still there during dinner? Why is there no one there? Why does GoR in the painting seem to be in old age and still dressed in formal clothes? Nothing seems right no matter how you look at it?

Psyber After thinking about it, he decided to pray to Nessis, the most reliable person in his heart. He sensed that Nessis's divine power still existed within the manor. Closing his eyes, Psyber followed the intuition given to him by Nessis. When he opened his eyes, he found a feathered servant leading him, and finally they stopped in front of a door. The feather servant opened the door, stretched out his hand, and motioned for Psyber to enter. Thinking that this was where Nessis led him to, Psyber walked into the room in the dark.

The room was dark except for a cluster of flames in the center. But when the door closes, the surroundings instantly transform into a forest, a symbol of Nessis's power. Psyber Before he could take a breath, he discovered that the fire in the center had been replaced by a potted plant, full of life. But fire began to appear around the forest.

Psyber walked towards the potted plant and heard a voice he did not recognize, saying: "Are you following your own will and pursuing Nessis, or are you just blindly following what others tell you to do?" Psyber turned back and ran in the direction he came from, only to find that the incompatible door could not be opened.
As the fire grew stronger, Psyber hurriedly ran towards the potted plants.

"Burn me, or become me." He heard his own voice coming from the direction of the potted plant. Seeing that the fire was about to burn the potted plant, Psyber picked up the potted plant and ran towards the door. The doorknob was easily turned open. Psyber stepped out of the threshold, looked back at the burned room, and shouted loudly: "My life was saved by Nessis. I follow the way of Nessis, not because anyone wants me to do so, but because of my own decision!" He walked back to the corridor. The potted plant in his hand turned into a golden leaf when he returned to the corridor, and Psyber put it away carefully.

Returning to the entrance of the theater, Psyber saw Kudan standing stiffly on the stage, and the clown beside him was encouraging the audience to applaud. Kudan silently walked off the stage and headed straight for the exit. Ubbo, who threw clown stones in front of the stage, followed Kudan.

After the three met, Psyber pointed to the two of them at the portrait of GoR he saw. Kudan frowned, while Ubbo turned over the picture frame, looked at the picture frame anxiously and shouted: "Why did you run into the painting?" The servant on the side whispered that Ubbo should not destroy the portrait, but Ubbo directly took off the painting and the frame, and the servant could not do anything.

Lott has completed his wood carving, which is a half-length carving of a birdman. It was both familiar and unfamiliar, as if it was something important in his subconscious, but he couldn't remember it no matter how hard he tried. The crow summoned by Ubbo saw the completed carving, picked up the neck of the carving, and jumped towards the door of the tavern that was opened at some point. Lott cautiously caught up with it, praying that the wood carving would not be damaged by it, and ran back to the corridor. After taking back the wooden sculpture from the crow's mouth, Lott quickly put it away.

Another servant shouted in the corridor that dinner was ready. Upon hearing this, Ubbo rushed to the restaurant with GoR's portrait under his arm. At this time Lott happened to run out of the tavern. Seeing his familiar companions walking towards the restaurant, he followed them.

Entering the restaurant, a servant handed plates and cutlery to the guests at the door. Ubbo rushed to the dining area, put a few pieces of pork ribs on his plate, and then took away the entire iron plate that was originally served to the guests, leaving only his small porcelain plate on the table.

The adventurers leaned against the wall and exchanged information with each other. At the same time, Ubbo did not forget to feed "GoR trapped in the painting" with the pork ribs he took, causing a mess in the painting.

Suddenly, the familiar clown appeared in front of Kudan again, scaring everyone. "Our protagonist made trouble last time, do you want to change the script this time?" The clown looked at Kudan jokingly, while Ubbo picked up the leftover pork rib bones and threw them at the clown. Kudan came to his senses and also cast magic on the clown. For a moment, the clown froze comically, and then fell down, but behind him, a clown with exactly the same posture clapped his hands, looked at the crowd, shouted "Thank you to our protagonist for your performance!" He bowed to the adventurers one by one and disappeared into the crowd. The clown fell to the ground, leaving only a clown suit, and Psyber put it away.

The adventurers returned to the corridor, and where the original portrait of GoR was, another painting had been hung. The painting showed a middle-aged red demon man with a broken horn on his head and a ring on it, which looked very much like Lott. But he was wearing a suit with a serious expression, and there was a human woman with a similar look standing next to him, wearing a wedding dress, and they were holding hands. Lott was shocked when he saw it. Human beings and women were not what he wanted. What on earth was going on?

Lott He looked around in panic, only to find that the woman in the painting appeared behind him, crying. The guests all jumped up and loudly congratulated Lott on their happy wedding, and the band that came from nowhere started to play music. Lott panicked and asked loudly who the woman was? The woman cried even more sadly, thinking Lott. How could he not even recognize his wife? The woman shouted for the band to stop, which he felt was too embarrassing, but after the band stopped, the silence was even more embarrassing. Lott also found that he had changed into the same suit as in the painting. In order to resolve the crisis, Lott decided to do something he didn't want to do - he leaned over and kissed the woman. The woman burst into laughter instantly, and everyone cheered loudly.

Then Lott used the toilet as an excuse and ran towards the restaurant. Other adventurers followed soon after. Closing the restaurant door, Lott gasped vigorously to make sure the "bride" didn't follow. But he also found that his original clothes were not only on his body, but also not in his backpack. He could only continue to wear this suit...
In the restaurant, the adventurers saw Lysien walking freely, holding a notebook in his hand, stopping to write from time to time.
"When the feathers fall, I will no longer be human; no one will walk on that road..."
"They say that I will become eternity. But if eternity is loneliness, then who can witness my love?"
"I will be the incarnation of love, or just the remains of love..."

Lott Determined to leave the manor, he could not forget the birdman. Stepping back to the corridor, they found a strange portrait again. It showed an ooze similar to Ubbo, but it was obviously wearing religious clothing different from the Phyneal he believed in. It was obviously like a clergyman. The posture is solemn, which is very different from the chaotic and stupid Ubbo. Lott decided to take the painting down.

The curtain was lowered, the lights dimmed, and the adventurers heard clapping from behind. They turned around and saw Lysien sitting in the corner closest to the exit, standing up to leave. Ubbo tried to attack him, but the hit had no effect. Lott hurriedly chased after him and ran to the corridor, only to find that there were so many guests that he could not find Lysien at all.

The adventurers followed, and everyone heard that the guests were waiting for the ceremony to start, but no one knew when it would start. Impatiently, everyone walked into the restaurant, only to find that the restaurant was empty at this time. The food in the buffet had been eaten up, leaving only bones, or it had already rotted. Ubbo transformed into a fire element and wanted to burn down the restaurant, while Lott discovered the back door of the restaurant, which led to a small storage room, but there was nothing useful in it except tableware.

Ubbo Stepped out of the restaurant and found that all the guests on the corridor were gone, but countless feathers were floating in the air. Ubbo burned it with the fire on his body, and the feathers were burnt black when they fell to the ground. Not knowing when the ceremony would begin or how to arrive, the adventurers felt at a loss.

Everyone tried to open all the doors, but found that they all led to the direction of the restaurant, and all the doors led to the same location. The adventurers tried various possibilities and found that the space inside each door was like a replicated space. If they walked in and then walked out, multiple versions of themselves would appear on the corridor, along with items, such as money, of course. However, the adventurers can tell which one is the current question and which one is their own copy. If they push the copy back to the restaurant, they will disappear.

Ubbo tried to burn the door frame between the doors and found that the restaurants on both sides of the door frame were merged together. However, this also confirmed that it was impossible to definitely burn down the entire mansion.

Finally when Ubbo walked towards the door again, he found himself in a dark space with some glimmer of light in front of his eyes. The other adventurers noticed that Ubbo had disappeared and ran over. Everyone appeared in this dark space, and the light in front of them came from the throne in the ceremony venue they saw not long ago. But this time, the throne is not empty.
GoR knows that the one fastened to the throne is Guns.
The adventurers also found that there were people standing around them on their left and right. The guests and servants are all here, staring and waiting in unusual silence.

The sound of footsteps came from the distance again. Ubbo rushed forward and tried to hug Lysien, who was holding the Luna Crown in the form of fire element, but found that Lysien was just an illusion. The adventurers also discovered that Guns sitting on the throne was also just an illusion.
Then the real Lysien walked out.
"So I say it needs to be rehearsed." Lysien laughed. "It's almost time for the ceremony to begin."

lite-c10-chpt04.title: Chapter 4: The Divine Dominion of Everlasting and Love

image.alt: The Divine Dominion of Everlasting and Love chapter art

paragraphs: 隨著利希恩・阿莫雷一手拎著攤軟的岡斯踏入儀式現場，冒險者們也看見跟在一旁的一名羽僕雙手端著他們從卓茲克莊園取得的「月神王冠」。
冒險者們對利希恩的情緒各個不同：羅特因為利希恩能對愛情與他有所共鳴，所以格外同情；烏波則視利希恩為月神芬尼爾的敵人，勢不兩立；賽柏認為自己被困在這裡離不開，都是利希恩的錯；GoR則看著被固定在座椅上的岡斯，情緒激動，對利希恩十分不開心；庫登在這莊園內也被困住太久，對於利希恩的情緒一言也說不盡，於是他慢慢地退後，決定保持一點距離，看看夥伴們決定怎麼做。
利希恩詢問GoR他對於先前的提議有何想法：用一個更重的靈魂，來取代岡斯？看著背上硬生生插著金屬「翅膀」的岡斯，以及不知何時從他身上爬下來的蘿絲，早已到座椅旁，拚命的呼喚岡斯，輕拍他那被固定住的無力的手。
GoR最終還是答應了。
利希恩卸下固定住岡斯雙手的裝置。說時遲那時快，GoR試圖利用這個空隙將岡斯奪走，但利希恩輕易地就阻止了他。「就算你帶走了他，你也離不開這裡的。」
在利希恩的引導下，GoR坐上了這個不屬於他的座椅—在權衡之下，他坐在座椅的扶手上，盡可能保持平衡。接著，利希恩拿過羽僕手上的王冠，輕輕置於GoR的頭頂。與過去在卓茲克莊園戴上王冠不同，GoR的感受並不是刺骨的痛，而是一種輕微的不適。
烏波將岡斯、蘿絲和其他平時攀附在GoR身上的孽物一一裝在自己的背包內，作為保護。GoR以外的冒險者們都慢慢退到羽僕與賓客們觀禮的位置前方。接下來的，就看利希恩了。
利希恩口中唸起一段月神教的禱文，祈求著月神芬尼爾最後一次藉助他力量，以喚回他的被奪走的愛。
霎時，儀式會場的天花板破了一個洞，天光如祝福般灑下，但與利希恩預期的不同，這道光並非照射在頭戴王冠的GoR頂上，而是在他，利希恩・阿莫雷的頭上。冒險者們看著利希恩緩緩的騰空浮起，彷彿聽見他顫抖著喃喃自語：「怎麼會是我？」
接著，一道強光閃瞎了眾人的眼。再次睜開雙眼時，曾經名為利希恩的那人，已高高浮於空中，以類似半透明態的模樣，俯視眾生。

「原來，這就是永恆與愛的力量嗎？」
永恆與愛之神阿莫雷
利希恩，或者應該說，現在被稱為永恆與愛之神阿莫雷（阿莫雷, 永恆與愛之神），以一個與過往不同的聲音，平穩地說著。
仰望神跡，地面上卻不平靜。冒險者們發現賓客們逐一化為半透明的黑影，開始攻擊羽僕們。冒險者們盡可能優先拯救自己的夥伴，先將被固定在座椅上的GoR放了下來。一離開座椅，GoR卻感到王冠格外的痛處—就像當時在卓茲克莊園時一樣。不過，他輕易的就將王冠取了下來，交給了烏波。
冒險者們擺好陣型，準備迎接來自賓客，或是羽僕的襲擊。浮在空中的阿莫雷以他的神聖力量將大量的賓客黑影們擊滅，同時也好好地保護著他的羽僕們。「與愛為敵的人，都是我的敵人。」阿莫雷如此說道。然而，方才照下天光的天花板破洞，卻逐漸崩塌，巨石砸向冒險者們、羽僕們，和賓客們。冒險者們在黑影們被全數擊破後逐一昏了過去。
「有些事情，也許你已經忘記了，但真正對你重要的事情，你絕對、絕對不會忘記。不要放棄，羅特，要記得……不要忘記。」
「芬尼爾走了，但你還停在原地。如果你還是不願意改變，烏波，不妨回到當初你被製造出來的地方吧。」
「賽柏，你和奈西斯的連結不只是神與信徒，繼續追隨奈西斯，接受神諭，成為祂的忠誠僕從吧！」
「岡斯和蘿絲已經團圓了。你的冒險目的已經達成了。那你的下一步，是什麼呢，GoR？」
「放下仇恨吧，庫登，因為世界是由愛構成的。你心中萬惡不赦的仇人，很有可能有他的不得已之處，也很有可能和你想得很不一樣。」
GoR從昏迷中甦醒，身邊是一片的金色羽毛，鋪在地上、鋪在他熟睡的夥伴們的身上。
GoR逐一叫醒烏波和賽柏，但羅特卻陷入了沉睡之中。庫登則完全沒見到他的身影。
醒來的冒險者們看向四周。偌大的莊園憑空消失，留下一大片金羽，一觸即碎。烏波看見不遠處有一間小房子，雖然很小，卻金碧輝煌，四面八方的平民百姓們慢慢走向那兒。他們的聲音，彷彿在呼喚著「永恆與愛之神阿莫雷」。但烏波的內心中只有憤怒。身為芬尼爾的忠實信徒，他可以深刻感受到此時芬尼爾抵不住的怒火—愛，那原本屬於他的權能，竟然被利希恩・阿莫雷這傢伙奪走了。
承載著這股憤怒，烏波衝向那幢金房子。裡面，是簡陋的裝設，還沒擺好的木桌、木椅、幾根蠟燭，一座小型祭拜壇上，掛著一幅屬於利希恩的肖像畫。
烏波一怒之下，將燭火吹大，房子內瞬時間是一片大火。烏波讓自己變得好幾倍大，不斷敲著房子和逃出來的人。賽柏和GoR發現了異狀趕了過去，但在烏波的操弄下，他們也只能默默看著，出不了手。
直到現場只剩下一片殘骸。四眼望去，除了冒險者外，已經沒有任何生還者了。
冒險者們對於烏波的暴怒感到害怕。與烏波冒險了好一段時間，羅特從未看見他這樣的行為過。
「我討厭小偷。」烏波喃喃自語道，同時在營帳旁的營火邊煮著一碗綠綠的粥。
羅特醒來時，發現揣在他懷間披風下，是一張屬於羽僕的面具。他知道不能讓此時的烏波看見它，太危險了。看著烏波煮的綠粥，太危險了。羅特掏出自己的口糧，分給了賽柏和GoR。
冒險者們思索著接下來該去哪，而烏波似乎執意要去某個地方。他模糊的指了一個方向，說著大概要一個月左右的步行時間可以到。羅特透過心靈感應，分別和賽柏以及GoR溝通，並達成了共識—雖然羅特知道那肯定是屬於月神的地方，是他極度想避免接近的地方，但他們也害怕獨自放行失控的烏波，會造成多大的損傷，因此答應他陪他一起去。
夜已深，覆羽莊園已消失，但一個新的神，也誕生了。

As Lysien Amoret entered the ceremony site carrying the limp Guns in one hand, the adventurers also saw a feathered servant following beside him holding the "Crown of the Moon God" they obtained from Drozik Manor in both hands.

The adventurers have different emotions towards Lysien: Lott is particularly sympathetic because Lysien can resonate with him about love; Ubbo regards Lysien as an enemy of Phyneal, the moon god, and they are irreconcilable; Psyber thinks that it is Lysien's fault that he is trapped here and cannot leave; GoR looks at Lysien who is fixed on the seat. Guns, agitated, was very unhappy with Lysien; Kudan had been trapped in this manor for too long and couldn't say enough about Lysien's emotions, so he slowly backed away, deciding to keep a little distance to see what his friends decided to do.

Lysien asked GoR what he thought about the previous proposal: to replace the Guns with a heavier soul? Looking at Guns with metal "wings" stuck on his back, and Rose who climbed off him at some point, she had already reached the seat, calling Guns desperately and patting his weak hand that was fixed.
GoR finally agreed.

Lysien removes the device holding Guns' hands in place. Soon enough, GoR tried to take advantage of this gap to snatch Guns away, but Lysien easily stopped him. "Even if you take him away, you can't leave here."

Under Lysien's guidance, GoR sat on the seat that did not belong to him—under consideration, he sat on the armrest of the seat, trying to keep his balance as much as possible. Then, Lysien took the crown from the servant's hand and gently placed it on GoR's head. Unlike in the past when wearing the crown at Drozik Manor, what GoR felt was not a sharp pain, but a slight discomfort.

Ubbo puts Guns, Rose and other evil objects that usually cling to GoR one by one in his backpack as protection. The adventurers other than GoR slowly retreated to the front where the servants and guests were watching the ceremony. Next, it’s up to Lysien.
Lysien chanted a Lunar cult prayer, praying to the moon god Phyneal to use his power for the last time to regain his stolen love.

In an instant, a hole was broken in the ceiling of the ceremony venue, and light from the sky poured down like a blessing, but unlike Lysien's expectation, this light did not shine on the top of GoR wearing a crown, but on his head, Lysien Amoret. The adventurers watched Lysien slowly rise into the air, and seemed to hear him trembling and muttering to himself: "How could it be me?"
Then, a bright light blinded everyone's eyes. When he opened his eyes again, the man once named Lysien was already floating high in the air, looking down at all living beings in a translucent state.

"So, is this the power of eternity and love?"
Amoret, God of Eternity and Love
Lysien, or rather, now known as Amoret, God of Everlasting and Love, spoke steadily with a different voice than before.

Looking up at the miracle, the ground is not peaceful. The adventurers discovered that the guests turned into translucent black shadows one by one and began to attack the servants. The adventurers gave priority to saving their friends as much as possible, and first put down GoR, which was fixed on the seat. As soon as he left the seat, GoR felt the pain of the crown - just like when he was at Drozik Manor. However, he easily took off the crown and handed it to Ubbo.

The adventurers set up their formations, preparing to receive attacks from guests or servants. Amoret, floating in the air, used his divine power to destroy a large number of guest shadows, while also protecting his servants. "Anyone who is an enemy of love is my enemy." Amoret said. However, the hole in the ceiling that had just illuminated the sky gradually collapsed, and huge rocks fell on the adventurers, servants, and guests. The adventurers fainted one by one after the black shadows were all defeated.
"Maybe you have forgotten some things, but you will never, never forget the things that are really important to you. Don't give up, Lott, remember...don't forget."
"Phyneal is gone, but you are still where you are. If you are still unwilling to change, Ubbo, you might as well go back to the place where you were created."
"Psyber, your connection with Nessis is more than just a god and a believer. Continue to follow Nessis, accept the oracle, and become his loyal servant!"
"Guns and Rose We have been reunited. Your adventure goal has been achieved. What is your next step, GoR? "
"Let go of hatred, Kudan, because the world is made of love. The evil enemy in your heart may have his own reasons, and it may be very different from what you think."
GoR When he woke up from a coma, he was surrounded by golden feathers spread on the ground and on his sleeping companions.
GoR wakes up Ubbo and Psyber one by one, but Lott falls into a deep sleep. Kudan did not see him at all.

The adventurers woke up and looked around. The huge manor disappeared out of thin air, leaving behind a large piece of golden feather that shattered at the touch of a touch. Ubbo saw a small house not far away. Although it was small, it was splendid. Common people from all directions were slowly walking towards it. Their voices seemed to be calling "Amore, the God of Eternity and Love." But inside Ubbo there was only anger. As a loyal believer of Phyneal, he could deeply feel Phyneal's irresistible anger and love at this time. The power that originally belonged to him was actually taken away by this guy Lysien Amoret.

Carrying this anger, Ubbo rushed towards the golden house. Inside, there is a simple decoration, with a wooden table, wooden chairs, and a few candles that have not yet been set up. On a small altar of worship, a portrait belonging to Lysien hangs.

Ubbo In a rage, he blew out the candle and the house was instantly ablaze. Ubbo makes himself several times bigger and keeps knocking on the house and the people escaping. Psyber and GoR noticed something strange and rushed over, but under the manipulation of Ubbo, they could only watch silently and could not take action.
Until there is only a piece of wreckage left at the scene. Looking around, there were no survivors except the adventurers.
The adventurers are afraid of Ubbo's rage. Having been adventuring with Ubbo for quite some time, Lott has never seen him behave like this.
"I hate thieves." Ubbo murmured to himself while cooking a bowl of green porridge by the campfire next to the tent.

Lott When he woke up, he found that under the cloak in his arms was a mask belonging to a feather servant. He knew he couldn't let Ubbo see it at this time, it was too dangerous. Watching Ubbo cook green porridge is too dangerous. Lott took out his own rations and gave them to Psyber and GoR.

The adventurers were thinking about where to go next, but Ubbo seemed determined to go somewhere. He vaguely pointed in a direction and said it would take about a month to walk there. Lott communicated with Psyber and GoR through telepathy and reached a consensus - although Lott knew that it must be the place belonging to the moon god, a place he desperately wanted to avoid approaching, they were also afraid of how much damage would be caused by letting the out-of-control Ubbo alone, so they agreed to accompany him.
It is late at night, Feathered Estate has disappeared, but a new god has also been born.
羅特、烏波、賽柏和GoR花了一個月左右的時間，從覆羽莊園，單純依著烏波的直覺，往他的出生地前進。而在抵達的前一晚，GoR守夜時不留下任何消息地消失了。眼看目的地只需要不到一天的路程，羅特和賽柏決定繼續跟隨著烏波前進。
雖然他們依然不知道自己為何要往這地方去，但他們知道必須要阻止烏波因為衝動幹下什麼蠢事。對月神芬尼爾越加厭惡的羅特，也只能在深夜時，透過在覆羽莊園撿到的面具試圖和愛神阿莫雷溝通。他也決心再一次相信自己的決定，與阿莫雷簽下了契約，成為了祂的契術師。另一方面，烏波在夢中接收到了月神芬尼爾的神諭，除了學習了新的力量外，在使用新的力量時，也展現了不同的樣貌。
在這個被稱為雅洛斯（雅洛斯）的地區，烏波終於看見了那座宗祠：當年他第一次與世界接觸的地方，也就是他的出生地。但如今破敗的小小宗祠，此刻似乎有個「客人」，鬼鬼祟祟地在裡頭。

冒險者們趨步向前，烏波甚至大聲疾呼，詢問那人的身份。一名披著斗篷，毛髮鬆脫，似人似猴的生物歡喜地看著烏波，直呼歡迎他回家。他自稱名為唐，並逐一與冒險者們確認身份。此時，烏波感到一股清晰明確的直覺，關於他在此出生的記憶：他感覺到，那股記憶似乎不是屬於他的記憶，而是被硬生生植入他腦中的記憶，令他感到古怪。唐聽見冒險者們的介紹後，慌張的警告他們，超過一個音節的名字會讓他們陷入危險之中，因此，羅特、烏波和賽柏分別以蘭、波和潤的單音節名字作為化名。
接著，唐便將宗祠正中央的圓形孔蓋翻開，邀請冒險者們一起爬下這充滿著穢氣的地底世界：他們稱為「斐納札（斐納札）」的地方，也是烏波真正出生的地方。
順著梯子向下，不確定過了多久，唐和冒險者們終於碰觸到了地面。底下雖然光線不如地面，但由魔法點亮的環境，還是個運作機能十分完整的小城鎮。唐在確保冒險者們一切安好後，便說著自己該趕去工作了，和冒險者們道別。
冒險者們不確定自己應該要做什麼，東張西望。這時，突然三聲的鐘聲響起，眼看所有居民都雙膝落地，賽柏和烏波也應聲跪下，羅特趕緊也跪了下來：雖然不知道賽柏和烏波為何如此自動地跟隨，羅特不想當特別突出不一樣的人，也只好跟著做了。接著，當地人們口中開始誦著月神的禱詞，烏波很開心的跟著念著，賽柏和羅特則沒有跟隨。五分鐘後，居民們站了起來，彷彿什麼事都沒發生一樣，繼續忙於他們的工作。
羅特看見居民們清一色穿著白色的衣服，但深淺不一，有的特別深而混濁，像是髒污一般，但也有潔白到快要可以反光的衣著。接著，他看見數名穿著純白鎧甲，疑似衛兵裝束的人，朝著他們走來。
衛兵確認了他們是「外來者」後，便拋給他們一人一件類似的衣服，要他們穿上。這些衣服顏色也是相對混濁的，但頂多就是灰色，稱不上黑色。三名冒險者們乖乖穿上後，被衛兵們喝斥要他們去工作，接著衛兵們就離開了。
冒險者們還摸不著頭緒，決定到處繞一下。羅特看見了一間「溫室」，有些興趣，決定過去看看，卻發現剛才那幾名衛兵正圍在溫室前，而在他們正前方的，有幾名跪在地上發抖的人們。不過更有趣的，在這些衛兵身後，有一大批十來個平民，手拿磚頭，似乎正要襲擊他們。
羅特不確定該怎麼做，於是決定先在附近找個牆邊躲起來，烏波和賽柏則因為距離較遠，只能觀望而已。
一瞬間，一名「反叛者」掄起磚頭，一擊將一名衛兵敲暈，衛兵與平民之間的衝突就此發生。羅特利用地利之便，朝向衛兵偷襲，射了一箭；烏波衝向群眾，將自己的體型變大；賽柏則還在猶豫該怎麼做。衛兵們說著他們眼前的「被懲罰者」因為違反了規則，需要被懲罰，原因是他們怠工，而且他們的判斷依據是這些人衣服的顏色。

「衣服會說話。」
斐納札衛兵
烏波與羅特對這樣的「規定」感到不解，甚至他們也發現衛兵們只是聽命行事：到底規則是誰訂的、為什麼規則這樣合理，他們都不知道。在烏波將衛兵和平民們用他伸長的手隔開後，衝突暫時化解，而大家也都離開了，就好像剛剛什麼都沒發生過一樣。兩名被敲昏在地上的衛兵則被羅特綑綁手腳，被簡單問過話以後也就被冒險者們留在那裡。
羅特還是對溫室挺有興趣的，因此帶著其他冒險者們走了進去。他們看見溫室內主要是種植菇類和其他食用植物。但其中有幾區，似乎種的是觀賞植物。在烏波詢問後，溫室的領班登記了他們的名字，讓他們在這裡工作。但因為他們剛來這裡工作，衣服顏色還很深，只能做最初階的工作：搬土。
冒險者們來到溫室後方，在該區域領班的指揮下，將土一批一批的搬往室內。羅特試圖用魔法偷懶，還被領班喝斥。他們詢問領班今天的目標為何，得到的卻是「搬土到放飯」。
幾個小時後，清脆的鈴聲響起，冒險者們跟隨著其他工人一起走回溫室入口旁，從旁邊的門口走入大餐廳，享用晚餐：一大盆的土和一些乾草。羅特和賽柏吃不下去（賽柏還是忍著把乾草吃了，但是土他真的吃不下去），把他們的份送給了烏波，他們之中唯一享受其中的人。
等大餐廳所有人吃完後，門打開了，大家依序往外走，排成隊伍一起離開。走了好一陣子，他們看見了這裡少數的高樓：好幾棟毫無設計感的方形建築。人們排隊依序走入大樓內。大樓門口的人員登記每個人的名字，並給予他們分別的房號（烏波是3-B、賽柏是3-C，而羅特是4-A）。他們才得知這是他們今晚住宿的宿舍。
烏波和賽柏入住後，決定在賽柏在房間內偷吃完自己攜帶的乾糧後，去四樓找羅特。
當羅特也在他的房內吃乾糧時，敲門聲響起。他聽見了一個陌生的聲音，小心翼翼地開了門。一名看起來有點變異、神經兮兮的青年女子催促著他讓他進房間。羅特不明所以，但還是讓這人進來了。
這名人類自我介紹名為譚・寇爾，但他也特別警告，在這裡只能用單音節的名字。他同時也要求羅特供出自己的全名。譚解釋自己在地面上時是研究月神芬尼爾的學者，為了得到更多資訊，才潛入這裡。但時間久了，自己已經變異到覺得自己再也回不去地面上了。
此時烏波和賽柏也來到了羅特房間，和譚有了簡單的認識。譚和他們解釋了自己遊走在體制外的做法：雖然大家都被要求要工作，但其實沒有上工，也不會有人特別來捉捕他。同時他也解釋了衣服顏色的意義：一開始，大家衣服的顏色都是深色的，隨著累積「對月神的貢獻」，像是認真工作，或是有特別的功績，就能讓自己衣服的顏色變得更白。而譚衣服的顏色可以說是黑到不能再黑了。
突然，譚頓了一下，提醒大家是晚禱的時間了，接著熟悉的重力感來襲。冒險者們不是被重力將膝蓋往地面拉，就是自動自發地跪了下來。譚和烏波熟練地唸出月神的禱詞，羅特則一樣不情願。禱告結束後，譚建議大家都要學會月神的禱詞，不是為了真正的祈禱，而是不要被衛兵抓到任何反抗的把柄。

透過譚，冒險者們得知斐納札分成了六個不同的地區，分別由不同的「議員」統治。而現在他們所處的「心空域（心空域）」正處於一個特別的狀態：「心空席」的議員似乎消失了，但議會刻意封鎖這個消息。對於這個空缺的職位，烏波展現了些許的興趣，譚也表示規則上「人人有機會」，甚至衣服的顏色不影響大家得到這個席位的機會，但據說其他議員們分別有內定的人選。譚透露有個稱為「靈魂議會」的地區，是共屬於議員們的特別區域，可以到這裡找他們（不過他們只有工作時間會在該地區，放飯後都會各自回到他們領導的地區休息）。
譚提醒到，不同區域都會有各自的結界，而心空域因為現在沒有領導者，結界暫時失效了：這對冒險者們來說，是最沒有負擔的。烏波提議明天白天一起往靈魂議會的方向前進，其他冒險者們也同意。
將其他人趕離自己房間後，羅特準備休息，卻也發現他一直收在包包內的芒果鑽破了一個洞，溜走了。他回想起，芒果在他們下到斐納札之前都還在，也表示了他對斐納札的興趣。他推測，芒果很有可能偷偷溜了出去，而這讓他十分不開心。
一早，羅特在四樓的公共區域準備盥洗，也看見了譚。譚對他眨了一眼，羅特也很清楚知道他們在外面最好不要讓別人知道他們互相認識這件事。整個斐納札給他一種十分不舒服的感覺。
烏波和賽柏一起來到羅特的房間，三人一起走到一樓。他們看見人們走入另一棟大樓，也跟隨進去，用了早餐。比起昨晚在溫室的晚餐，這餐是麵包，讓羅特和賽柏放心多了。賽柏將麵包裝進背包內，他剛才在房間內已經先吃了乾糧，以免早餐還得吃土和乾草。
用完早餐後，人們排隊走出，紛紛往工作區域前進，冒險者們則脫隊，沿路詢問其他路人，得知要往靈魂議會，得往北方走。
突然，走在最前面的羅特感到腳步一沉。他想起昨晚譚講到的不同地區結界一事。他們踏入了「不動域（不動域）」，腳步變得沉重而緩慢，手也變得難以使力。
不過，左手邊在心空域與不動域的邊界，有個工廠般的地方引起了他們的注意。冒險者們走了過去，看見兩名衛兵守衛著。經過一番交涉，烏波卸下了裝束，被允許進去裡面，但羅特和賽柏則不被允許入內，原因為「這是上頭的意思」，讓他們感到不解。
走入這座工廠，烏波看見了看起來十分有設計感的櫃檯，裡面的人對他的表情都十分不自然，但也沒多說什麼。在櫃檯的允許下，他走入了後方的門內。左右手邊各有三扇門，裡面有躺在手術台上的小型電漿人、倉庫間、會議室等。最後，烏波走入了正前方的雙開門。
映入眼簾的，是左右側分別數十個巨型的培養箱，裡頭的竟然是與烏波極為相似的電漿人，在培養液中載浮載沉。
而在走道的正中間是一座雕像。一名雙翼展開的天使人，雙手撫在胸前，遮掩著他已被挖空的心。

Lott, Ubbo, Psyber and GoR spent about a month traveling from Feathered Estate to his birthplace simply following Ubbo's intuition. And the night before arrival, GoR disappeared without leaving any message during the vigil. Seeing that the destination was less than a day away, Lott and Psyber decided to continue following Ubbo.

Although they still didn't know why they went to this place, they knew they had to stop Ubbo from doing something stupid out of impulse. Lott, who became increasingly disgusted with Phyneal, the moon god, could only try to communicate with Amoret, the god of love, through the mask he picked up in Feathered Estate late at night. Determined to believe in his decision once again, he signed a contract with Amoret and became his Pactmaster. On the other hand, Ubbo received the oracle from the moon god Phyneal in his dream. In addition to learning new powers, he also showed a different appearance when using the new powers.

In this area called Yarros (Yarros), Ubbo finally saw the ancestral hall: the place where he first came into contact with the world, which was also his birthplace. But in the now dilapidated little ancestral hall, there seems to be a "guest" sneaking inside.

The adventurers moved forward, and Ubbo even shouted loudly, asking for the man's identity. A cloaked, loose-haired, human-like, monkey-like creature looked at Ubbo happily and welcomed him home. He called himself 唐 and confirmed his identity with the adventurers one by one. At this time, Ubbo felt a clear intuition about the memory of his birth here: He felt that the memory did not seem to belong to him, but was a memory that was forcibly implanted in his mind, which made him feel weird. After hearing the adventurers' introduction, 唐 panicked and warned them that names with more than one syllable would put them in danger. Therefore, Lott, Ubbo, and Psyber used the monosyllable names of 蘭, 波, and 潤 as aliases respectively.

Then, 唐 opened the circular hole cover in the center of the ancestral hall and invited the adventurers to climb down into this filthy underground world: the place they called "Fenadra (Fenadra)" was also the place where Ubbo was truly born.

Going down the ladder, not sure how long it took, 唐 and the adventurers finally touched the ground. Although the light below is not as good as on the ground, the environment lit by magic is still a small town with complete functions. After making sure that the adventurers were all well, 唐 said it was time to go to work and said goodbye to the adventurers.

The adventurers were not sure what they should do and looked around. At this time, three bells suddenly rang, and all the residents fell to their knees. Psyber and Ubbo also knelt down in response. Lott quickly knelt down as well: Although I don't know why Psyber and Ubbo followed so automatically, Lott didn't want to be the one who stood out, so he had to follow suit. Then, the local people began to chant the prayers of the Moon God. Ubbo followed happily, but Psyber and Lott did not follow. Five minutes later, the residents stood up and continued about their work as if nothing had happened.

Lott I saw that the residents were all wearing white clothes, but they were of different shades. Some were extremely dark and turbid, as if they were dirty, but there were also clothes that were so white that they were almost reflective. Then, he saw several people wearing pure white armor, suspiciously like guards, walking towards them.

After the guards confirmed that they were "outsiders", they gave each of them a similar piece of clothing and asked them to put it on. The color of these clothes is also relatively turbid, but they are gray at best and cannot be called black. After the three adventurers put them on obediently, the guards yelled at them to go to work, and then the guards left.

The adventurers were still confused and decided to look around. Lott saw a "greenhouse" and was somewhat interested. He decided to go over and take a look, only to find that the guards just now were surrounding the greenhouse, and directly in front of them were several people kneeling on the ground trembling. But what's more interesting is that behind these guards, there is a group of about ten civilians holding bricks, seemingly about to attack them.
Lott was not sure what to do, so he decided to hide near a wall first. Ubbo and Psyber could only wait and watch because they were far away.

In an instant, a "rebel" picked up a brick and knocked a guard unconscious with one blow, and a conflict broke out between the guards and civilians. Lott took advantage of the convenient location to sneak attack on the guard and shot an arrow; Ubbo rushed towards the crowd and increased his size; Psyber was still hesitating on what to do. The guards said that the "punished people" in front of them had broken the rules and needed to be punished because they were slacking off in their work, and their judgment was based on the color of these people's clothes.

"Clothes can talk."
Fenadra Guards

Ubbo and Lott were puzzled by such "rules". They even found that the guards were just following orders: they didn't know who made the rules and why they were so reasonable. After Ubbo separated the guards and civilians with his outstretched hand, the conflict was temporarily resolved, and everyone left as if nothing had happened. The two guards who were knocked unconscious were tied up hand and foot by Lott. After being briefly questioned, they were left there by the adventurers.

Lott was still very interested in the greenhouse, so he led the other adventurers in. They saw that mushrooms and other edible plants were mainly grown in the greenhouse. But there are several areas that seem to be planted with ornamental plants. After Ubbo inquired, the greenhouse foreman registered their names and allowed them to work here. But because they had just come here to work, their clothes were still very dark and they could only do the most basic work: moving soil.

The adventurers came to the back of the greenhouse and, under the command of the area foreman, moved the soil indoors one by one. Lott tried to use magic to be lazy and was scolded by the foreman. They asked the foreman what their goal was today, but what they got was "moving soil until putting food on the table."

A few hours later, the crisp bell rang, and the adventurers followed other workers back to the greenhouse entrance, walked into the large dining room from the side door, and had dinner: a large pot of soil and some hay. Lott and Psyber couldn't eat any more (Psyber still managed to eat the hay, but he really couldn't eat it), so they gave their portion to Ubbo, the only one among them who enjoyed it.

After everyone in the big restaurant finished eating, the door opened and everyone walked out in order and lined up to leave together. After walking for a while, they saw a few tall buildings here: several square buildings with no sense of design. People lined up to enter the building. The person at the building door registers each person's name and gives them their respective room numbers (Ubbo is 3-B, Psyber is 3-C, and Lott is 4-A). They learned that this was the dormitory where they would stay tonight.
After Ubbo and Psyber checked in, they decided to go to the fourth floor to find Lott after Psyber secretly ate the dry food he brought with him in the room.

While Lott was also eating dry food in his room, there was a knock on the door. He heard an unfamiliar voice and opened the door cautiously. A young woman who looked a little mutated and nervous urged him into the room. Lott didn't know why, but let this person in anyway.

This human introduced himself as Tam Quorr, but he also warned that only monosyllabic names could be used here. He also asked Lott to reveal his full name. Tam explained that he was a scholar studying the moon god Phyneal when he was on the ground, and he sneaked here in order to get more information. But as time passed, I had mutated to the point where I felt I could never return to the ground.

At this time, Ubbo and Psyber also came to Lott's room and got to know Tam briefly. Tam explained to them his way of living outside the system: although everyone was required to work, he actually didn't work, and no one would come to catch him. At the same time, he also explained the meaning of the color of clothes: In the beginning, everyone's clothes are dark in color. As they accumulate "contribution to the moon god", such as working hard or having special achievements, the color of their clothes can become whiter. And the color of Tam's clothes can be said to be as dark as possible.

Suddenly, Tam paused to remind everyone that it was time for vespers, and then the familiar feeling of gravity hit. The adventurers either had their knees pulled toward the ground by gravity, or they knelt down automatically. Tam and Ubbo recited the Lunar Prayer skillfully, Lott just as reluctantly. After the prayer, Tam suggested that everyone should learn the Lunar Prayer, not to actually pray, but so as not to be caught by the guards in any way to resist.

Through Tam, the adventurers learned that Fenadra was divided into six different regions, each ruled by different "members". And now the "Realm of Hollow Heart" they are in is in a special state: the members of the "Realm of Hollow Heart" seem to have disappeared, but the parliament deliberately blocked the news. Ubbo has shown some interest in this vacant position. Tam also said that according to the rules, "everyone has a chance." Even the color of clothes does not affect everyone's chance of getting this seat. However, it is said that other members of Congress have their own nominees. Tam revealed that there is an area called the "Soul Parliament", which is a special area belonging to the councilors. You can find them here (but they will only be in the area during working hours, and after meals, they will go back to the area they lead to rest).

Tam reminded that different areas will have their own barriers, and since there is no leader in the Heart Space Zone, the barrier is temporarily ineffective: this is the least burdensome for adventurers. Ubbo proposed that we go to the Soul Council together during the day tomorrow, and the other adventurers also agreed.

After driving the others out of his room, Lott was about to rest, but he also found that Mango, which he had kept in his bag, had broken a hole and slipped away. He recalled that Mango was still there before they downloaded Fenadra, and expressed his interest in Fenadra. He speculated that Mango might have sneaked out, which made him very unhappy.

Early in the morning, Lott was preparing to take a shower in the public area on the fourth floor and saw Tam. Tam winked at him, and Lott knew very well that it would be best if they didn't let anyone know that they knew each other outside. The whole Fenadra gave him a very uncomfortable feeling.

Ubbo and Psyber came to Lott's room together, and the three of them walked to the first floor together. They saw people going into another building, followed them, and had breakfast. Compared to last night's dinner in the greenhouse, this meal was bread, which made Lott and Psyber much more relieved. Psyber packed the bread into his backpack. He had already eaten dry food in the room just now to avoid having to eat dirt and hay for breakfast.

After breakfast, people lined up and walked out, heading towards the work area. The adventurers left the queue and asked other passers-by along the way. They learned that they had to go north to go to the Soul Council.

Suddenly, Lott, who was walking at the front, felt his footsteps sink. He remembered what Tam had said last night about enchantments in different areas. They entered the "Realm of Motionless", their steps became heavy and slow, and their hands became difficult to use.

However, on the left hand side, at the boundary between the Heart Space Domain and the Immovable Domain, there was a factory-like place that caught their attention. The adventurers walked over and saw two guards guarding the place. After some negotiation, Ubbo took off his costume and was allowed to go inside, but Lott and Psyber were not allowed in because "this is what the superiors meant", which puzzled them.

Walking into this factory, Ubbo saw a counter that looked very designed. The people inside looked very unnatural towards him, but they didn't say much. With the permission of the counter, he walked into the rear door. There are three doors on the left and right, which contain a small plasma man lying on the operating table, a warehouse, a conference room, etc. Finally, Ubbo walked through the double doors directly ahead.
What came into view were dozens of giant incubators on the left and right sides. Inside were plasma figures very similar to Ubbo, floating and sinking in the culture fluid.
And in the middle of the aisle is a statue. An angel with wings spread out, hands on his chest, covering his hollowed-out heart.
