Then Siri asked if there were any other clues that could help him know more about his true self. Saturn tried to say something to Siri, but no sound came out of his mouth. Saturn muttered to himself that it seems you are not allowed to know this yet. So he asked everyone present to hold hands and form a circle. As time passed, a strange thick fog rose and surrounded everyone present.

After the thick fog cleared, the adventurers found that they were in another place. Siri was surprised to find that this was the place where he saw the little girl's figure walking through the well. Immediately afterwards, a little girl with green hair ran up from the slope. Mary seemed to recognize the little girl and was surprised. The panting little girl kept walking through the ruins of each house, eager to find something. The adventurers discovered that the little girl seemed unable to see them. So Mary and several adventurers followed the little girl through the ruins, but Saturn took Siri straight to the largest of the ruins. After entering, Saturn walked to a bookcase and waited. Siri tried to open the bookcase, but found she couldn't reach it, so she asked Saturn what was going on. Saturn just gives a nonchalant indication that this is something you have to do. While they were talking, the adventurer and the green-haired little girl also came to the room. The little girl quickly opened the bookcase, took out an old book and left. The entire space was once again shrouded in thick fog.

Saturn's voice came from the thick fog: "Maybe that girl will be helpful in understanding your true identity. Try to find her and use your wisdom to judge whether to help her." Then, Siri woke up from the bed.

The next morning, everyone discussed last night's dream and the next course of action at breakfast. It can be known from the letter left by Yuki that the ceremony is expected to be held on the next full moon day (5/14), and the time is quite tight. However, Midori is still imprisoned, limiting everyone's movement.
Ultimately, they decided to go to the church first and ask the bishop if they could speed up the Midori case so they could find Yuki and stop the ceremony before 5/14.
Just when everyone decided on their goals, left the Moquis Cafe, and prepared to go to the cathedral, Mogis quietly came to Siri and whispered in his ear:
"I hope you can help me get that book back."
As soon as he finished speaking, the black cat quickly disappeared into the alley.

Soon after, Watson hurried over and told the adventurers that there was an emergency in the church and that Bishop Robinson was looking for them. Everyone asked for details, but Watson said that it was not convenient to talk here and asked them to go to the cathedral immediately.

At this time, YHWH asked Watson if he could borrow "Soul, Bone and Blood" and said that it would be returned in the afternoon. At YHWH's insistence, Watson handed the book to Siri, who seemed more reliable, and informed them that she would stay at the Jewelers Guild in Fannur City in the afternoon and could return it then.

After being separated from Watson, the adventurers came to the vicinity of the cathedral and found that the number of guards increased significantly and the security was extremely tight, which was completely different from the situation the previous day. Full of doubts, everyone entered Robinson's office, and what they saw was the injured bishop.

The bishop asked the guards to retreat, leaving only Sister Mary and the adventurer, and then told them a shocking news - Midori attacked him last night and escaped from prison, and his whereabouts are now unknown.

Everyone was shocked and quickly asked why. The bishop explained that Midori's failure to abide by the norms of the Paladin was actually a minor violation of discipline, and they originally only asked her to write a confession to express repentance. However, when Midori completed his self-report and prepared to submit the documents to the archives, he accidentally discovered an old file recording Yuki's transaction information.

Midori always thought that Yuki was adopted by a noble, but the document revealed that the orphanage had sold children for profit. This revelation shook her trust in the church to its core. Furious, she broke into the bishop's office with documents in hand to confront Robinson. In the face of her doubts, the bishop did not say much in defense, and she took this silence as acquiescence.
Eventually, Midori attacked the bishop, dropped the holy symbol and fled the church.

The bishop went on to say that he did not blame Midori because it was indeed the Zinla cult that had failed her in this matter. However, assaulting a bishop was still a felony, so he was bound by duty to issue a warrant and pursue him. But he hoped that the adventurers could find Midori first, calm her down, and return the Holy Emblem to her.
At the same time, he handed the adventurers a signed permit, allowing them to move freely within the church.

When asked about the whereabouts of Midori, everyone speculated that she was most likely going to Natasha Port to find Yuki, which coincided with their original plan to go there on May 14 to stop the ceremony.

Therefore, the adventurers decided to split up: first go to the church archives and prison to search for clues, then go to the Jewelers Guild in the afternoon to return the books, and finally take a boat arranged by the bishop to Natasha Port at night.
Beau, YHWH and Ron went to the prison below the church, where they met Father Emoran, the director of the orphanage and the person arrested for Ron's report.

Beau angrily accused him of the evil deeds of child trafficking, and Emoran defended in a low voice, saying that he was also helpless - the orphanage had long been short of funds, and he just did "what he had to do."

These words made Beau even more angry, and he banged on the prison bars, alerting the guards. Seeing that they could no longer get any more information from Emoran, the three decided to leave and join the others.

Samuel and Siri went to the church archives to try to find more clues related to the transaction information, but found nothing. In the end, they accidentally discovered the borrowing record of "Soul, Bone and Blood" in the restricted book area-this book had been lent out a long time ago and was never returned.
The last borrower's name reads: "Fox".
This name was the informant whom the city owner of Great Citadel suggested they could contact in Fannur city.
While the two were thinking about why the book ended up in Watson's hands, they returned to join the others.
The adventurers then performed the "rope trick" in an alley near the church, creating a secret space for resting and exchanging information.

After a little tidying up, they headed to the Jewelers Guild. Outside the door on the second floor, everyone heard Watson talking to the cat man Yamada. Watson seems to be very interested in the gem "Heart of the River" that the adventurer obtained in the mine.
After the conversation came to an end, the adventurer knocked on the door and entered.

They asked about the origin of "Soul, Bone and Blood". Watson said that she found the book at an old bookstall in Fannur city, and that only half of the volume was left. Although this statement is suspicious, the adventurer has no evidence to refute it for the time being.

Watson further explained that the first half of the book records methods of reviving the souls of the dead and transforming humans into undead creatures; while the second half of the book records methods of fighting these undead creatures.

Since she has only read the first half of the book, she only knows that in order to transform humans into undead creatures, she must collect three stones containing powerful magic and place them in a magic circle to guide the power within.

Ron recalls that there is indeed a magic circle under the orphanage, with a large number of Lababi stones placed on it. These stones not only enhance necromancy but also release toxins that corrode surrounding creatures. Various clues gradually coincide with their previous experiences.
Watson hopes to see the most special Lababi stone - "Heart of the River". She suspects that this may be one of the three stones, but it is still not confirmed.
That night, according to the bishop's arrangements, the adventurers went to the Fannur military dock, boarded the ship and set off for Natasha Port.

plus-c07-chpt04.title: Chapter 4: Before the Next Full Moon

image.alt: Before the Next Full Moon chapter art

paragraphs: 冒險者上船後，對船隻進行了一番調查，但並未發現任何異狀。
深夜時分，喜利・歐喜利隱約聽見一個聲音低語，告訴他——有人跟著他們上船了。
於是，他獨自搜尋整艘船，最終在船艙中找到了瑪莉。瑪莉表示，既然冒險者是要去幫助米多莉，她也希望能盡一份力，因此才偷偷跟了上來。
隔天，瑪莉提醒眾人，由於娜塔莎港對正統派津菈教極為反感，他們應避免暴露與教會的關係。同時，她也提供斗篷與藥水，協助冒險者後續行動。
傍晚過後，船隻在細雨中緩緩駛入娜塔莎港。港口空無一人，整座小鎮顯得破敗而死寂。
就在眾人下船之際，一道黑影從船上竄出，迅速消失在夜色之中。
眾人面面相覷，但仍決定先前往津菈教在當地的據點——新津菈教會。該處由希娜修女負責。
冒險者刻意隱瞞來此尋找米多莉的真正目的，只表示自己是瑪莉修女的朋友。希娜修女提到，5/13晚上川納唐普爵士將舉辦一場晚宴，鎮上居民皆會出席，這讓冒險者感到十分可疑。
他們同時推測，米多莉最有可能出現的地方，就是位於小鎮另一端山丘上的唐普宅邸。詢問前往方式後得知，這座破敗小鎮幾乎只有一條主路，只需沿著港口的道路前行即可抵達。
於是，冒險者暫時借住在教堂，準備隔天一早在鎮上打聽消息，尋找潛入宅邸的機會。
隔天一早，冒險者來到鎮上，偶然幫助了一名名叫彼得的男子。他正忙著將大量物資搬上車。
在協助過程中，他們與彼得攀談，得知這些物資正是要送往唐普宅邸，用於晚宴準備。
於是，冒險者找了個理由加入他的工作，打算藉此混入宅邸。
After the adventurers boarded the ship, they conducted an investigation on the ship, but found nothing unusual.
Late at night, Siri vaguely heard a voice whispering, telling him that someone was following them on the boat.
So he searched the entire ship alone and finally found Mary in the cabin. Mary said that since the adventurer was going to help Midori, she also wanted to do her part, so she followed him secretly.

The next day, Mary reminded everyone that since Port Natasha was extremely antipathetic to the orthodox Zinla sect, they should avoid revealing their ties to the church. At the same time, she also provides cloaks and potions to assist adventurers in their follow-up actions.
After dusk, the ship slowly sailed into Natasha Harbor in a drizzle. The port was deserted and the whole town looked dilapidated and lifeless.
Just as everyone was getting off the boat, a black shadow emerged from the boat and quickly disappeared into the night.
Everyone looked at each other in shock, but still decided to go to Xinjinla Church, the local stronghold of Jinla Sect first. The place is in charge of Sister Hina.

The adventurer deliberately concealed the real purpose of coming here to find Midori, and only said that he was a friend of Sister Mary. Sister Hina mentioned that Sir Dump will hold a dinner party on the evening of May 13th, and all the residents of the town will attend, which makes the adventurers feel very suspicious.

They also speculated that the most likely place for Midori was the Temple Mansion on the hill at the other end of the town. After asking how to get there, I learned that there is almost only one main road in this run-down town, and you only need to follow the road to the port to reach it.
Therefore, the adventurer temporarily stayed in the church and prepared to inquire about information in the town the next morning, looking for opportunities to sneak into the mansion.
Early the next morning, the adventurer came to the town and accidentally helped a man named Peter. He was busy loading a large amount of supplies into the car.
While assisting, they chatted with Peter and learned that these supplies were going to the Temple Mansion for dinner preparations.
Therefore, the adventurer found a reason to join his work and planned to sneak into the mansion.

wilds-c01-chpt01.title: Chapter 1: The Town of Trades and Goods

image.alt: The Town of Trades and Goods chapter art

paragraphs: 在麥丁頓王國內被稱為「貿易之都」的貝瑟頓，日暮低垂，當地最有名氣的酒館「吟遊詩人之歌」如往常的生意興隆。
用手杖滑動自己的推車，人魚鑰・佩洛西婭熟練地滑進酒館內，不需要其他人在身後推車。然而，他似乎感覺到進酒館後，自己的背包被人動了手腳。他停下推車，檢查了一下，發現了兩團原本不在自己身上的紙團，但上面寫的內容並不完整。酒館一樓還有一張空桌子，於是鑰趕緊滑到座位旁，隨意點了個餐點。
不久後，一名身材嬌小的斑貓人也在酒館門口經歷了與鑰相似的經歷，他也在背包內翻出了兩團紙團。看見只坐了鑰一人的圓桌，毛毛趕緊湊了過去。在幾番自然的撒嬌下，鑰豪爽地掏了自己的錢，為毛毛點了他的餐點。兩人也各自拿出自己翻到的紙團，嘗試拼起來，但得到的資訊非常不完整。
表情冷酷的妖精羅羅不知不覺走進了吟遊詩人之歌。他不清楚自己怎麼決定要來到這的，但他也知道自己其實不太有辦法依自己的意識下決定—一切都得經過「它」的意思。那隻手。那懸在空中，時而出現的傢伙。「那裡有空位呢，去坐吧。」那聲音指使著羅羅，他也只好加入鑰和毛毛的座位，但他們都能看得出新加入的妖精朋友似乎不太想理他們。在熱切問候之後，羅羅表示自己沒有被塞紙條，這讓鑰和毛毛更感困惑。問題還沒解決。

一個大塊頭的身影吸引了酒館內一些人的注意，一名穿著些許破爛制服的藍色皮膚龍人，何阿龍走進了酒館。他沒有多想，便看見尚有空位的圓桌，加入了鑰、毛毛，以及雖坐同桌，但看起來沒有和他們互動的羅羅。阿龍向三位自我介紹後，把錢包掏了出來，大辣辣的算著自己身上有多少錢，然後點了酒館最貴的餐點：國王的饗宴。雖然阿龍也沒有感覺到自己有被動了包包，在鑰和毛毛說到自己被塞了紙團後，他也翻了翻自己的背包。羅羅看見，也決定翻翻看有沒有紙團。兩人掏出紙團後，羅羅似乎對眼前的謎題有些興趣，將四人的紙團拼湊在一起—只剩下一點漏缺了。看來……還會有新的人出現？雖然不知道這是什麼意思，但從紙團上的字，這似乎是來自一位里奇蒙爵士（Syr Richmond）的委託。
餐點一道一道上，國王的饗宴和其他餐點比起來，似乎非常划算，有沙拉、湯品、麵包，還有吟遊詩人讓你點一首歌來表演。連正餐都還沒上呢。在阿龍出現以後，原本一臉嫌惡的服務生似乎態度變得唯唯諾諾，甚至後來還換了個態度和善許多的服務生。
在正餐上之前，毛毛已經喝了半杯羅羅點的「麥丁頓精髓」，醉意不小心就露出了馬腳。這時，大家聽見了門口傳出了物品掉落的聲響。一名披著斗篷的人正蹲在地上撿東西。毛毛想起剛剛感覺被塞東西時，似乎有個穿斗篷的嫌疑人士。躊躇著該怎麼辦時，阿龍早已起身向這人走去。
那人頭一抬，遮起的帽兜掉了下來，是名蜥蜴人，而他和阿龍一樣，有著亮麗的藍色尾巴。除了身上的斗篷外，雷亞的手上，也拿著一件斗篷，依他有限的語言表達能力，他似乎也注意到了一名想動他包包的人，但只抓到他的斗篷而已。雷亞將背包內的物品收好，在阿龍的引導下往圓桌走，但他並沒有意識到掉在地上的兩團紙。眼看兩團指沒有被拿走，羅羅趕緊從座位上衝了過來，把它們撿走。而它們正是最後的兩塊拼圖。

眾人看見了「委託書」上的寶箱與重賞，雖然還不知道是怎麼回事，但都起了野心，想嘗試一番。在討論與詢問之後，他們得知自己所在的貝瑟頓便是被稱為貿易之都的地方，附近似乎有座「幽深林」，很有可能就是委託書中提到的森林。而至於海妖墓園是什麼地方，或更根本的，海妖是什麼生物？他們也無從得知。最終，在夜色尚未太深時，五名初次見面的冒險新手們便踏出酒館，朝著他們在這座城市探索時，似乎有經過過的一處宅邸—里奇蒙爵士的宅邸前進。

走在大街上，殿後的雷亞和羅羅感覺到似乎有人正在跟蹤他們。情急之下，羅羅一回頭，便轟出了一發攻擊，那人便倒在地上，失去了意識。推著推車的阿龍和推車上的鑰與毛毛一回頭，發現地上竟然有個臉近乎毀容的死人。毛毛跳下了推車，在屍體周邊打量一番，發現了屍體的脖子後似乎有個刺青：R.I.L.E.Y.。而這名屍體手上握著的棍棒正下方有一圈文字，Rebels of Intellect Liberation and Empowered Youths（R.I.L.E.Y. 破謀青叛會）。在衛兵趕到前，五人趕緊將屍體搬到鑰的推車上，故作正常的趕往目的地。
來到里奇蒙爵士的宅邸門口，破舊的環境，看起來荒廢一段時間了，但從裡面傳出「艾格尼絲」還是「安格斯」的聲音，肯定是還有住人的。阿龍大力敲門，一名傭人打開了門。在一陣溝通後，傭人便讓冒險者們進到宅邸拜訪爵士。
在傭人去找爵士時，冒險者們在客廳打量環境。除了幾幅肖像畫外，客廳還懸掛著一張族譜。族譜上，有兩名艾格尼絲：艾格尼絲・諾曼以及艾格尼絲・瑞文。
不久後，傭人推著輪椅走回了客廳，輪椅上的里奇蒙爵士看起來兩眼無神，聽傭人的說法，爵士已經失智十年了，而他也是兩年前才從前一位傭人手上接下這份工作，幸好每個月的薪水優渥（似乎是爵士的女兒萊里固定寄來薪水），否則四層樓的宅邸，只有他一人照顧爵士，也是很辛苦。
毛毛得知爵士失智，且除了他之外只有傭人後，便藉著去「上廁所」的名義，偷溜到了二樓探索。在其中一間房間，毛毛翻到了一件斗篷，上面的藍色布料，像是緩慢流動一樣，色彩不斷變動，外圈還鑲有一長串金色的字，但是對毛毛而言，那是陌生的語言。他趕緊將這好東西塞在自己的腰間。

此時，傭人覺得毛毛廁所上太久，有點問題，便跑去廁所找他。羅羅和雷亞藉機也跑到樓上去了。羅羅在二樓探索，雖然一無所獲，但與毛毛見到面了；雷亞則跑到三樓，卻沒能開啟任何門。毛毛和羅羅趕到三樓時，正和雷亞說著話，但此刻他們聽見了樓梯下方傳來了腳步聲，羅羅趕緊在三樓樓梯間製造了雲霧。傭人和阿龍一同走入了雲霧之中，但很快便走了出來。傭人看見他們竟然跑到了三樓，表示他們如果想要在這邊借住一晚，也是沒問題，但只能待到隔天早上早餐吃完就得離開，然後他便帶著四人回到一樓。
四人和僕人又問了一些事，以及和依然無法溝通的里奇蒙爵士說了說話後，他們便決定準備要休息了。鑰因為上樓梯不方便，在一樓沙發睡；雷亞和羅羅在二樓的兩間客房休息；阿龍和毛毛則選擇三樓的兩間客房。
睡前，雷亞將此時放在他房間的屍體經過一點時間的手工，取出了她的脊椎，並將其他皮肉骨頭裝進袋子，準備丟掉。在羅羅的幫忙下，他們將裝滿屍體的袋子從二樓房間的窗後扔在街道旁。雷亞將被他視為「新武器」的脊椎用布料包起來，變準備睡了。

毛毛的好奇心沒有被滿足，因此躡手躡腳地走到了傭人口中「很久沒有在用」的四樓探索。地面上確實都是灰塵，看起來沒有人活動。四樓的四間房間都打不開，於是毛毛便回頭準備回去休息。然而，他似乎聽見了其中一間房間傳來人聲。仔細靠近一聽，是兩名年輕男子正在對話。雖然大多數內容聽不清楚，毛毛仍聽見了一個他從未聽過的名字：秘血菁英（T.I.D.E.S.）。這串很長的名字聽起來像個組織，但無從得知他是什麼組織。毛毛趕緊跑回三樓，打斷正在祈禱的阿龍，兩人一起回到四樓。

在阿龍的敲門聲得不到結果後，他回房間拿了巨斧，將這個解不開鎖的門敲開，卻發現裡面沒有人，但看著大扇的窗戶，人大概就是從這裡逃走的。毛毛發現兩名逃走的斗篷人，正從窗戶外地面準備跑走。其中一人回頭看了一眼，毛毛清楚記住了他有個跨過鼻樑，環繞整張臉的繃帶。經過毛毛的同意，在狂暴過後，阿龍揹著毛毛，一口氣從四樓窗戶跳了下去。沒有失去意識，但阿龍也受了重傷。毛毛輕巧地從趴在地上的阿龍身上跳了下來，看見兩名斗篷男已經消失在視線範圍的極限外了。雖然身高相差極大，毛毛還是努力撐著阿龍重傷的身體，繞回宅邸大門並敲門。
鑰想起傭人提到擔心晚上會有奇怪的人闖入宅邸，因此將大門深鎖，讓他對此時突然響起的敲門聲感到有點緊張。他用雙手拖著缺少後肢的人魚尾巴，努力往前爬動，終於走到門前。經過確認後，他才打開大門，讓狀況極差的阿龍和毛毛進了宅邸。
在阿龍的叫喚下，傭人也從樓上下來，並得知剛剛有人闖入宅邸的事。傭人趕緊將大門再次深鎖，便上樓休息了。為了表示關心，鑰簡單幫阿龍做了治療，接著毛毛和阿龍便回到樓上休息了。
睡前，毛毛拿出他藏在腰間的斗篷，鋪在床上。這斗篷的材質似乎挺好的，不久，毛毛便睡著了。
一大清早，冒險者們依序醒來，稍做準備後，便來到了一樓。毛毛趁著還沒看見傭人，先到後方的廚房探索，卻發現除了麵包外，只有早已酸臭的牛奶。他偷拿了點麵包藏了起來，便跑回客廳。
傭人從樓上下來後，冒險者們聊著天，發現傭人竟然是從一樓大廳後通往庭院的後門將里奇蒙爵士推了出來。
毛毛試著將昨晚聽見的T.I.D.E.S.說給爵士聽，雖然爵士也只是一直重複著T.I.D.E.S.這個字眼，但很明顯的，他的雙眼有神，睜得很大。很顯然，他認得這個名字。
吃完早餐後，冒險者們決定先到城鎮上採買所需的用品，再出發前往幽深林。
In Batherdon, known throughout the Kingdom of Mattington as the "Town of Trades and Goods," dusk was settling in, and the town's most famous tavern, Song of the Bards, was as busy as ever.

Using a cane to propel her cart, the merfolk, Kaname Peresia, smoothly slipped into the tavern without needing anyone to push her from behind. Yet shortly after entering, she had the distinct feeling that someone had tampered with her bag. She stopped his cart to check and found two crumpled pieces of paper that had not been there before, though the writing on them was incomplete. There was still an empty table on the tavern's first floor, so Kaname quickly rolled over and casually ordered a meal.

Not long after, a small tabaxi had a similar experience at the tavern entrance and also found two crumpled notes in his own bag. Seeing that the round table was occupied only by Kaname, Fur, quickly went over. After a bit of naturally charming pleading, Kaname generously pulled out her own money and ordered food for Fur as well. The two of them then took out their mysterious notes and tried fitting them together, but the information remained frustratingly incomplete.

The cold-faced elf Roel Lancelot drifted into Song of the Bards almost without realizing it. He was not entirely sure how he had ended up deciding to come here, but he knew well enough that he could not truly make decisions according to his own will. Everything had to pass through "its" intentions. That hand. That thing that floated in the air and appeared now and then. "There's an open seat there, go sit down." The voice directed Roel, and so he reluctantly joined Kaname and Fur at their table. The others could immediately tell that the newly arrived elf did not seem especially interested in interacting with them. After their warm greetings, Roel said he had not been slipped any note, which only left Kaname and Fur even more confused. The problem remained unsolved.

A large looming figure drew some attention inside the tavern as a blue skinned dragonborn in a somewhat tattered uniform entered. His name was Al-lon Riversend. Without overthinking it, he noticed the round table with open seats and joined Kaname, Fur, and Roel, who sat with them but did not seem socially engaged. After introducing himself to the three, Al-lon pulled out his purse, brazenly counted how much money he had, and ordered the tavern's most expensive meal: the King's Feast. Though Al-lon had not noticed anyone rummaging through his bag, after hearing Kaname and Fur talk about the notes they had found, he searched his own pack. Roel saw this and decided to check again as well. When the two of them also produced notes, Roel, suddenly intrigued by the mystery, pieced together the scraps from all four of them. Only one little gap remained. It seemed...... there was still someone else yet to appear? They had no idea what it all meant, but from the writing on the note, it appeared to be a commission from one Syr Richmond.

The dishes arrived one by one, and the King's Feast seemed incredibly good value compared to the other meals. It came with salad, soup, bread, and even a bard who would perform a song of your choice. The main course had not even arrived yet. After Al-lon's arrival, the server who had initially worn a disgusted expression suddenly became much more timid, and before long was even replaced by another server with a noticeably kinder attitude.

Before the main dish was served, Fur had already drunk half a glass of the "Essence of Mattington" that Roel had ordered, and his tipsiness began showing a bit too obviously. Just then, the group heard the sound of something falling near the entrance. A cloaked figure was crouched there, picking something up. Fur recalled that when he had felt someone slip something into his belongings earlier, the suspect had seemed to be someone in a cloak. While everyone hesitated over what to do, Al-lon had already gotten up and begun walking over.

When the person lifted her head, her hood fell back, revealing a lizardfolk. And like Al-lon, he had a strikingly bright blue tail. Besides the cloak he wore, Leah also had another cloak in her hand. Given her limited ability to explain herself, it seemed she too had noticed someone trying to get into her bag, but had managed to catch only the person's cloak. Leah put the contents of her bag back in order and, guided by Al-lon, headed toward the round table. She did not notice the two scraps of paper he had dropped on the ground. Seeing that they had been left behind, Roel immediately sprang up from his seat and picked them up. They were the final two missing pieces of the puzzle.

When the group saw the treasure chest and promised reward on the "commission letter," ambition stirred in all of them, even though none of them really understood what was going on. After some discussion and asking around, they learned that the town they were currently in, Batherdon, was indeed the place known as the Town of Trades and Goods, and that a nearby place called Deepwood might well be the forest mentioned in the commission. As for where the Siren's Cemetery might be, or more fundamentally what a siren even was, they had no clue. In the end, before night grew too late, the five novice adventurers who had only just met stepped out of the tavern and headed toward a manor they seemed to recall passing while exploring the city, Syr Richmond's estate.

As they walked along the main street, Leah and Roel, bringing up the rear, got the feeling someone was following them. In a split-second reaction, Roel turned around and fired off an attack, dropping the person unconscious to the ground. When Al-lon, pushing Kaname's cart with Kaname and Fur on it, turned around, they found what appeared to be a corpse on the ground with its face almost destroyed. Fur leapt down from the cart and examined the body, discovering what looked like a tattoo on the back of its neck: R.I.L.E.Y. Beneath the club clenched in the dead person's hand was an inscription: Rebels of Intellect Liberation and Empowered Youths, or R.I.L.E.Y. Before the guards arrived, the five of them hurriedly hauled the corpse onto Kaname's cart and proceeded toward their destination as though nothing were wrong.

At the entrance to Syr Richmond's estate, they found a run-down scene that looked as though it had been neglected for quite some time. Yet they could hear a voice from within saying something like "Agnes" or perhaps "Angus," which meant someone was definitely still living there. Al-lon pounded on the door, and a servant opened it. After some back-and-forth, the servant allowed the adventurers inside to visit the Syr.

While the servant went to fetch him, the adventurers looked around the drawing room. Besides several portraits, there was a family tree hanging on the wall. On it were two people named Agnes: Agnes Norman and Agnes Raven.

Before long, the servant wheeled Syr Richmond back into the drawing room. The Syr in the chair stared blankly into space. According to the servant, the man had been senile for ten years, and the servant himself had only taken over the job from the previous one two years ago. Fortunately, the monthly pay was generous, apparently sent regularly by the Syr's daughter Riley, because caring alone for both the Syr and a four-story manor would otherwise have been a hard life.

Once Fur learned that the Syr was senile and that only the servant lived here besides him, he used the excuse of needing the toilet to sneak off and explore the second floor. In one of the rooms, he found a cloak. The blue fabric on it seemed to flow slowly, its colors constantly shifting, and around the edge ran a long line of golden lettering in a language unfamiliar to him. He quickly tucked this treasure into his waistband.

By then, the servant had begun to suspect that Fur was taking suspiciously long in the bathroom and went to look for him. Roel and Leah took the opportunity to head upstairs as well. Roel searched the second floor and found nothing, though he did run into Fur. Leah went up to the third floor but failed to open any of the doors there. By the time Fur and Roel joined her on the third floor and were speaking with her, they heard footsteps coming up from below. Roel hastily created a cloud of mist on the third-floor stairway. The servant and Al-lon stepped into the mist, but emerged from it almost immediately. When the servant discovered that the others had gone all the way up to the third floor, she told them that if they wished to stay the night here, that was fine, but they would have to leave after breakfast the next morning. She then brought the four of them back downstairs.

After asking the servant a few more questions and speaking a bit more with the still-unresponsive Syr Richmond, the four decided to turn in for the night. Since climbing the stairs was inconvenient for Kaname, she slept on the sofa downstairs. Leah and Roel took two guest rooms on the second floor, while Al-lon and Fur chose two guest rooms on the third.

Before sleeping, Leah spent some time working on the corpse currently stored in her room, removing its spine and stuffing the remaining flesh and bones into a bag to be disposed of. With Roel's help, they tossed the bag containing the body out the second-floor window to the side of the street. Leah wrapped what she considered her "new weapon," the Spine, in cloth and then prepared to sleep.

Fur's curiosity remained unsatisfied, so he crept quietly up to the fourth floor, which the servant had described as a place that had not been used in a long time. The floor was indeed coated in dust, and no one seemed to move there. None of the four rooms on the fourth floor could be opened, so Fur turned to head back. Yet he thought he heard voices coming from one of the rooms. Pressing closer, he made out two young men speaking inside. Though most of what they said was inaudible, Fur clearly caught one unfamiliar name: The Incognito Descendants of the Elite Society, or T.I.D.E.S. It sounded like the name of an organization, though he had no way of knowing what kind. He dashed back to the third floor, interrupted Al-lon mid-prayer, and brought him back upstairs.

When knocking produced no response, Al-lon returned to his room, grabbed his great axe, and smashed open the locked door, only to find the room empty. Judging from the large open window, the people inside had likely fled that way. Fur spotted two cloaked figures outside on the ground, preparing to run. One of them glanced back, and Fur clearly memorized the bandages wrapped across the bridge of his nose and around his face. With Fur's approval and a burst of fury, Al-lon hoisted Fur onto his back and leapt straight out the fourth-floor window. He did not lose consciousness, but he was badly injured. Fur lightly sprang off the prone Al-lon and saw that the two cloaked men had already vanished at the far edge of sight. Despite the huge difference in size between them, Fur did his best to help support Al-lon's heavily wounded body as the two of them circled back to the manor's front door and knocked.

Kaname recalled the servant mentioning that he was worried strange people might break into the estate at night, so she had locked the front door securely. That made the sudden knocking quite unnerving. Dragging herself forward with her arms and the portion of her merfolk tail lacking hind fins, Kaname slowly made her way to the door. Only after confirming who it was did he unlock it and let the badly injured Al-lon and Fur back inside.

At Al-lon's call, the servant also came down from upstairs and learned that someone had broken into the manor. She immediately locked the front door tightly again, then went back upstairs to rest. To show concern, Kaname gave Al-lon some simple treatment, and after that Fur and Al-lon returned upstairs to sleep.
Before bed, Fur took out the cloak he had hidden at his waist and spread it across the bed. The material seemed quite fine, and before long Fur drifted off to sleep.

Early the next morning, the adventurers woke one after another and, after getting ready, came down to the first floor. Before the servant appeared, Fur sneaked off to explore the kitchen in the back, only to find nothing but bread and long-soured milk. He stole a bit of bread and hid it away before scampering back to the drawing room.

After the servant came downstairs, the adventurers chatted for a while and then realized that the servant had wheeled Syr Richmond out from the rear door of the first-floor hall that led into the courtyard.

Fur tried saying the word T.I.D.E.S., which he had heard the night before, to the Syr. Though the old man only repeated the word T.I.D.E.S. again and again, his eyes were suddenly bright and wide open. Clearly, he recognized the name.
After breakfast, the adventurers decided to head into town first to buy the supplies they needed, and only afterward set out for Deepwood.

雷亞和羅羅兩人決定先去附近的商店街逛一逛，他們和路人打聽之後，找到了三間甜點店。第一家很明顯是間連鎖糖果店，繽紛的色彩，商業化的設計，以及擠不進去的店鋪，整間店都是孩子們的吵鬧聲；第二家店看起來是雜貨店，外面有各種甜點；最後一家看起來十分破舊，但有時候最好吃的東西總會出現在這種地方。兩人最終先擠進去了第一家糖果店，頹妮甜心，以秤重的方式買了兩袋糖果，要價十分昂貴。羅羅似乎發現老闆可能和他一樣，是個妖精。
接著，雷亞想起自己有抓小動物的捕獸夾，想去附近的森林抓隻小動物，透過動物溝通術，來打聽關於幽深林的事。於是兩人走到貝瑟頓側邊城門的樹林入口處架設陷阱。
因為時間不夠的關係，兩人回程後只去了最破舊的甜點店，老比爾。在老闆的介紹下，他們試吃了一桶老闆自製的各色糖果，味道十分鮮甜可口，價錢也便宜到羅羅最終買了一大麻布袋的糖果背在身後，還比第一家店的一小袋還要便宜。
兩人接著回頭檢查捕獸夾，發現有一隻松鼠被夾在上面。聽到松鼠吱吱叫，雷亞使用動物溝通術，馬上聽見松鼠一連串的粗口。在雷亞嘗試溝通失敗後，他威嚇了松鼠，卻發現松鼠嚇暈了。於是他將松鼠先裝到自己的小袋子內，兩人決定去一趟鐵匠鋪換武器，以及去雜貨店補充物資，就到貝瑟頓的正門口和其他人會合。

經過一番討論，阿龍、毛毛和鑰決定先去昨晚相遇的酒館「吟遊詩人之歌」打聽關於幽深林的情報。一大早的酒館內客人很少，和前一晚的擁擠截然不同。老闆和他們聊過後，表示大家只知道幽深林很危險，不要進去，但裡面到底有什麼？為何危險？沒有人清楚。買了一些食糧後，阿龍詢問老闆是否有賣菸草。老闆自己從口袋中掏出一點自己在抽的菸草，分享給阿龍。只見阿龍從背包拿出一個不成比例的小的煙斗，嘗試使用。他和其他人說明，這是他爸爸留給他的東西，因此他很想要用用看。第一次抽菸草，控制不好的力道，不僅讓阿龍不斷咳嗽，吐出的煙也燻的其他人十分不舒服。離開前，冒險者們也問了老闆是否有懸賞令。他們有點懷疑身分不明的羅羅（到現在他們還不知道羅羅的名字）是否有可能是通緝犯，因此想確認看看。老闆拿出了一張懸賞令，上面有個大鬍子，但似乎這名大鬍子還沒有出現在貝瑟頓過。這個人很明顯和羅羅長得不一樣，因此冒險者們稍微放心了一點。

離開酒館後，他們依照酒館老闆的建議，來到附近的煙斗店煙煙一息。這家店只有賣比較平價的煙斗，但阿龍還是看得很開心。購買煙斗後，老闆還給了他一張會員卡，表示這家店是連鎖店，到其他店都可以使用，會有會員的優惠價。冒險者們也向他詢問關於幽深林的消息，他並不知道，但也表示好奇。老闆和同行的毛毛和鑰答應，如果他們去了幽深林，回來以後告訴他那邊有什麼狀況，他會再給他們兩人各一張會員卡。毛毛也得到了許可，之後要和他拿他們用來製作煙斗的木頭原料。

三人花了一些時間，詢問到了附近一間魔法用品店，巫師先生的各種藥水。走入巷弄中的店內，左右兩側都是玻璃櫥窗，放滿常見的生命藥水，但也不便宜。經過店內員工的介紹，擺在櫃檯前的事比較特別的藥水，顏色琳瑯滿目，但價錢都至少要 10 枚金幣以上。店員介紹了幾款，包含要價15金幣的黃色藥水，可以讓人身體發光一分鐘；要價20金幣的綠色毒液，可以用來塗在武器上、敵人皮膚上，或是讓人喝下去；要價50金幣的藍色藥水，可以讓人飛在空中五分鐘。最後，櫃檯後方還有一罐看起來用金色裝飾雕琢的藥水，要價1000金幣。根據店員的說明，喝下去以後可以跟一名你認識的人交換身份。冒險者們看了很心動，但最終還是決定先不花錢買這些。
最後，冒險者們來到正門口的衛兵站，和衛兵詢問懸賞令的事。公告欄上，除了賞金高達1000金幣的大鬍子外，還有一些其他的臉孔，但都和羅羅完全不像。底下兩排則是失蹤孩童的肖像，但有些已經過太久，孩子的長相大概不會是現在這樣了。而這些失蹤的孩子，有可能就是走失在幽深林中的。
冒險者們會合完成後，大家在城門口就地用午餐，同時羅羅也在大家的請求下做了個較為完整的自我介紹，大家得知他是個有一定歲數的妖精，而他的很多所作所為，都是因為一個神秘的「祂」的緣故。

午餐後，大家便動身前往幽深林。此時已經清醒的松鼠被安置到了鑰的推車內，在鑰的照顧下穩定許多，而他似乎也把鑰是為了夥伴，讓原本抓到他的雷亞有些失望。走入林中，光線與聲響逐漸消失，像是被下了咒一般。冒險者們緩步前進，四周安靜的像是生命不曾存在過一樣，直到他們聽見了遙遠的腳步聲。毛毛爬上樹，快速地跑到前方偵查，看見了兩名拿著火把的衛兵朝他們走來。這和在衛兵站打聽到的消息一致，幽深林除了固定來巡守的衛兵外，基本上不會有任何人進來。
冒險者們等到衛兵接近後，便和他們打聽消息，得知這條路沒有岔路，最深處即是「海妖墓園」，那裡有個給守墓人休息的小木屋。衛兵也透露他們因為年資較淺，被要求定期來幽深林巡守。
繼續往前數個小時，冒險者終於看見陰影在一處硬生生地斷開。對於這奇異的景象，冒險者們也感到十分緊張。阿龍往前走，踏出了陰影，接著他便聽見了嘎嘎作響的木板聲，在他眼前數個棺材開始翻開。
冒險者們進入了戰鬥，棺材內的骷髏一一爬出，部分冒險者們甚至在腦中聽見了美妙的歌聲，讓他們難以行動。在雷亞施放了雲霧術，限制了冒險者們和骷髏的視線範圍後，戰局才稍微被控制了下來。重傷的毛毛逃到了前方的小木屋內，發現骷髏的攻擊似乎打不到小木屋內，暫時可以得到一點時間休息。
最終，在阿龍、雷亞和毛毛的揮砍、羅羅的遠距離輸出，以及鑰適時輔助之下，骷髏們終於被打倒。冒險者們搜刮了戰場後，得到了數根完整且質地良好的骨頭，接著便走入了小木屋內休息。此時的天色也暗了。

Leah and Roel decided to first stroll through the nearby shopping district. After asking some passersby, they found three dessert shops. The first was obviously a chain candy store, all bright colors, commercial design, and such a packed interior that you could barely squeeze in, filled wall to wall with the noise of children. The second looked more like a general store that happened to sell sweets outside. The last one looked terribly shabby, though sometimes the best food turns up in places like that. In the end, the two of them squeezed into the first candy shop, Tweenie's Sweeties, and bought two bags of candy by weight, at a very steep price. Roel seemed to notice that the owner might be an elf like him.

Next, Leah remembered that she had an animal trap and thought of catching a small creature in the nearby woods so she could ask it about Deepwood using Speak with Animals. So the two went to the wooded entrance near Batherdon's side gate and set the trap there.

Because they were short on time, on the way back they only visited the most run-down dessert shop, Old Bill's. At the owner's recommendation, they sampled a whole bucket of his homemade assorted sweets. They were wonderfully rich and delicious, and so cheap that Roel ended up buying a huge burlap sack of candy to carry on his back, for less money than the tiny bag from the first shop.

Afterward, the two went back to check the trap and found a squirrel caught in it. Hearing the squirrel squeaking, Leah used Speak with Animals and was immediately met with a nonstop stream of foul language from it. After failing to communicate with the squirrel, she tried intimidating it, only to discover that it had fainted from fear. So she stuffed it into her small pouch for the time being. The pair then decided to visit a blacksmith to swap weapons, stop by a general store for supplies, and meet the others at Batherdon's main gate.

After some discussion, Al-lon, Fur, and Kaname decided to return first to the tavern where they had met the previous night, The Bard's Song, to ask about Deepwood. The tavern was nearly empty that morning, in stark contrast to how crowded it had been the night before. After chatting with them, the owner said that everyone knew Deepwood was dangerous and that people should stay out, but no one really knew what was inside or why it was dangerous. After buying some provisions, Al-lon asked whether the owner sold tobacco. The owner pulled out a bit of the tobacco he was smoking from his own pocket and shared some with Al-lon. Al-lon then produced an absurdly tiny pipe from his backpack and tried using it. He explained to the others that it had belonged to his father, and he had always wanted to try it. Because he could not control his first attempt at smoking, Al-lon ended up coughing nonstop, and the smoke he blew out made everyone else deeply uncomfortable as well. Before leaving, the adventurers also asked the owner whether he had any wanted posters. They were a bit suspicious that the unidentified Roel, whose name they still did not know at that point, might possibly be a fugitive, so they wanted to check. The owner pulled out a wanted poster showing a large bearded man, though apparently that bearded man had never appeared in Batherdon. The man looked nothing like Roel, which reassured the adventurers a little.

After leaving the tavern, they followed the owner's recommendation and went to a nearby pipe shop called Smokey Smokey. The shop only sold cheaper pipes, but Al-lon still looked delighted. After buying one, the owner also gave him a membership card, explaining that the store was part of a chain and that he could use the card at other branches for discounted member prices. The adventurers asked him about Deepwood too. He did not know much, though he admitted he was curious about it. The owner promised Fur and Kaname that if they went into Deepwood and later came back to tell him what it was like, he would give each of them a membership card as well. Fur also received permission to ask him later for some of the wood material used to make pipes.

The three spent some time asking around and eventually found a nearby magic shop called Mister Wizard's Potions of Everything. Inside the little shop in the alley, glass cases lined both sides, filled with ordinary healing potions that were common enough but hardly cheap. The shop staff introduced the more unusual potions displayed near the counter, a dazzling array of colors, each priced at no less than ten gold coins. Among them were a yellow potion costing fifteen gold that made a person's body glow for one minute, a green venom costing twenty gold that could be applied to a weapon, smeared on an enemy's skin, or forced down someone's throat, and a blue potion costing fifty gold that let a person float in the air for five minutes. Finally, behind the counter was a bottle ornamented in gold that cost one thousand gold coins. According to the clerk, drinking it would allow you to swap identities with someone you knew. The adventurers found it very tempting, but in the end decided not to spend money on any of those potions just yet.

Finally, the adventurers went to the guard post at the main gate and asked about wanted posters there. On the notice board, besides the bearded man with a bounty of one thousand gold, there were several other faces, but none of them looked anything like Roel. Beneath those were two rows of portraits of missing children, though some had been missing for so long that they surely no longer looked as they did in those pictures. These missing children might well have been the ones who had wandered off into Deepwood.

Once the adventurers had reunited, they ate lunch right there at the gate. At the others' request, Roel also gave a somewhat fuller introduction of himself, and they learned that he was an elf of some age, and that many of the things he did were because of some mysterious "it."

After lunch, everyone set out for Deepwood. The squirrel, now awake, had been placed in Kaname's cart, and under Kaname's care it had grown much calmer. It even seemed to regard Kaname as a companion, which disappointed Leah somewhat, since Leah had originally been the one to catch it. Once they entered the forest, light and sound gradually seemed to disappear, as though the place were under some kind of curse. The adventurers moved forward slowly. The surroundings were so quiet that it felt as though life had never existed there at all, until they heard distant footsteps. Fur climbed a tree and quickly rushed ahead to scout. He saw two guards carrying torches walking toward them. This lined up with what they had learned at the guard post: aside from guards who routinely patrolled it, basically no one entered Deepwood.

Once the guards drew near, the adventurers asked them for information. They learned that this path had no forks, and that at its deepest point lay the Mermaid Graveyard, where there was a small hut for the gravekeeper to rest in. The guards also let slip that because they were relatively new to the job, they had been assigned regular patrols into Deepwood.

After several more hours of travel, the adventurers finally saw a strange sight: the shadows ahead ended abruptly, as though cut off by force. The group was understandably tense at this bizarre phenomenon. Al-lon stepped forward and crossed out of the shadow. The instant he did, he heard the creaking of wood, and several coffins in front of him began to open.

The adventurers were thrown into battle. Skeletons climbed out of the coffins one by one, and some of the party even heard beautiful singing in their minds, making it difficult for them to act. Only after Leah cast Fog Cloud, limiting the vision of both the adventurers and the skeletons, did the fight come somewhat under control. Badly injured, Fur fled into the small hut up ahead and discovered that the skeletons' attacks did not seem able to reach inside, giving him a brief chance to recover.

In the end, thanks to the slashing attacks of Al-lon, Leah, and Fur, Roel's ranged support, and Kaname's timely assistance, the skeletons were finally defeated. After looting the battlefield, the adventurers obtained several intact, high-quality bones, and then entered the little hut to rest. By then, night had already fallen.
擊敗了骷髏後，冒險者們決定先在小木屋過夜，隔天再回爵士家。小木屋內只有一張床，羅羅率先佔領了那張床。同時，阿龍開始翻找爵士信中提到的「寶物」到底在什麼地方。他發現在床底下有個很大的木箱，於是連同床上的羅羅，將床搬起。在大家的合作下，終於將木箱搬了出來。
木箱上沒有明顯的鎖或是能夠撬開的地方，在各種嘗試都失敗後，冒險者決定隔天直接將箱子搬回去，畢竟信中只有提到要把寶物帶回，並沒有要求要打開。
除了羅羅外，大家基本上沒有地方可以睡。雷亞走到房外，將一個空的棺材搬入小木屋內，躺進去後便開始睡了。阿龍將木箱搬到鑰的推車上後，靠著推車睡了。鑰倚著木箱也睡了，松鼠則睡在他身邊。毛毛率先守夜。
整夜大家輪流守夜，也發生了一些小插曲。
阿龍守夜時，因為想到剛才聽到海妖的歌聲傳入耳中受到影響，於是趁著毛毛睡著時從他的腿上砍下了一點毛，嘗試做成耳塞。在他砍下第二刀時，毛毛醒了，對此十分不爽。於是阿龍改為對松鼠下手。在松鼠被砍下毛時，他大聲尖叫後便昏倒了，因此鑰也被驚醒了。經過鑰的指點，阿龍才意識到放在毛毛頸部底下的枕頭內其實就有足夠的棉花可以做成耳塞。鑰也將松鼠抱在懷裡，以免他再受到任何襲擊。
輪到雷亞守夜時，閒著的他跑到外面，將裝有骷髏的棺材一個一個排好，並整理好裡面的骷髏，整整齊齊，他認為這是榮耀涅西斯的一種表現。
羅羅守夜時，則在骷髏堆中找到了兩把用過的短刀，他打算隔日帶回城鎮中賣掉，換點錢。
天亮後，冒險者們吃過早餐，便出發下山。大家分工搬著箱子，大約中午時便回到了爵士家。
僕人見到他們把箱子帶回來，感到十分驚訝，在大家點完自己要吃的食物後，僕人便出發去採買了。見到在客廳還是失智的巴托斯爵士，大家將箱子拿到爵士面前，也不確定到底期望看到什麼。誰知，爵士伸出手後，盒子發出了亮光，蓋子飄了起來，掉落在地上。盒子內是空的。冒險者們發愣之際，爵士竟然開口說話了。
冒險者們非常驚訝，這個「失智」的爵士，怎麼突然說起話來，甚至還能從輪椅上站起來。冒險者們趕緊向爵士詢問，得知他過去是T.I.D.E.S.的高層之一，現在由他的女兒萊里接替，而這個組織的高層可以與智慧之神喬里森溝通。阿龍得知自己信仰的喬里森竟然同時也是智慧之神，內心瞬間充滿了自信。說起獎賞，爵士便走到宅邸後方的小房間，拿了一個小盒子回來，裡面有五個不同顏色的戒指，讓冒險者們一一挑選。
冒險者們問題還沒問完，卻發現坐回輪椅上的爵士竟然開始石化，一時間內便再也沒有動靜了。此時僕人剛好買完食物回來，雖然相信冒險者們的說詞，卻也不知道該怎麼辦。大家吃著僕人買回來的雞腿、魚和其他各種食物，同時讀著僕人從大門口門縫撿到的紙條。
經過了一些時間，他們拼湊出了兩條訊息：「15049年3月18日23:59」，以及「貝瑟頓第1410頁書店T.I.D.E.S.馬車」。冒險者們決定先去探勘一下，同時在剩下的半天時間，處理一下需要在城鎮內完成的雜事。
大家一起先去光顧了糖果店。在上次兩家糖果店外，羅羅和雷亞還有一間還沒進去過。他們走入店內，買了一些糖果，其他冒險者們也推斷羅羅似乎對糖果有非常嚴重的成癮。
離開糖果店後，大家也在阿龍的帶領下回到煙煙一息煙斗店。老闆聽了冒險者們說明幽深林內發生的事（包含會偷刮人腳毛的骷髏）後，給了鑰和毛毛他答應的會員卡以及梳子。同時他也推薦阿龍一款他們今天剛進貨的菸草，裡面有薄荷和胡椒的辛香味，十分特別，阿龍也豪爽地買了一份。
走出煙煙一息，冒險者們兵分兩路。羅羅和雷亞再度嘗試使用陷阱，卻發現毫無所獲。

鑰、毛毛和阿龍則先去找「第1410頁」。毛毛想起，這是他過去常去的書店，因此知道怎麼走。書店內，熟悉的店員湯普生親切的和毛毛打招呼，並以他的全名「黎輝毛」稱呼他。對於這家書店十分有興趣的鑰翻到了一本「喬里森與其神話」，其中一則神話讓他特別注意到，裡面提到「從河流漂下的孩子，是被喬里森選中之子」，剛好與阿龍的遭遇相同（不過那時阿龍還是顆蛋），在阿龍開心之餘，他們便把書買下了。鑰在尋找與T.I.D.E.S.相關的書籍時，湯普生表示他們今晚搭上馬車後，會得到更多答案。同時他也表明自己算是T.I.D.E.S.的外圍人員，但並非T.I.D.E.S.的成員。鑰認為湯普生不錯，因此也分享了關於他上岸後收集書的位置，歡迎湯普生去參觀。
在湯普生為鑰、毛毛和阿龍準備晚餐（當然包含毛毛最愛的雞腿）後，大家想起羅羅和雷亞可能不知道怎麼來這邊，於是毛毛便跑回爵士家去接剛吃飽的兩人一起過來。
接近午夜，冒險者們聽到書店外傳來馬蹄聲。打開門，在馬車駕駛的協助下，他們將鑰的推車綁在馬車後方，大家上了車，看見車上已經有個人在了。
馬蹄聲再起，冒險者朝著T.I.D.E.S.的方向前進。

After defeating the skeletons, the adventurers decided to spend the night in the cabin first and return to the Syr's estate the next day. There was only one bed inside the cabin, and Roel immediately claimed it. At the same time, Al-lon began searching for the "treasure" mentioned in the Syr's letter. He discovered a large wooden chest under the bed, so he lifted the bed up along with Roel, who was still on top of it. With everyone's help, they finally managed to drag the chest out.

There was no obvious lock on the chest, nor any place where it could be pried open. After every attempt failed, the adventurers decided to simply carry it back the next day. After all, the letter only said to bring the treasure back, not that they had to open it.

Other than Roel, there was basically nowhere for anyone to sleep. Leah went outside, carried an empty coffin into the cabin, climbed inside, and promptly fell asleep. After placing the wooden chest onto Kaname's cart, Al-lon slept leaning against the cart. Kaname also fell asleep resting against the chest, while the squirrel slept beside her. Fur took the first watch.
Everyone took turns standing watch through the night, and a few incidents occurred along the way.

During Al-lon's watch, he remembered how the siren song he had heard earlier had affected him, so while Fur was asleep, he cut off a little fur from Fur's leg in an attempt to make earplugs. When he went for a second cut, Fur woke up and was thoroughly annoyed. So Al-lon switched targets and went after the squirrel instead. The moment the squirrel got some fur cut off, it let out a loud scream and fainted, which woke Kaname as well. After Kaname pointed it out, Al-lon finally realized that there was already enough stuffing inside the pillow under Fur's neck to make earplugs. Kaname also gathered the squirrel into her arms to keep it from being attacked again.

When it was Leah's turn to stand watch, he had nothing better to do, so he went outside and lined up the coffins containing the skeletons one by one, arranging the skeletons inside neatly and carefully. He considered this a way of honoring Necis.
During Roel's watch, he found two used daggers among the pile of skeletons. He planned to bring them back to town the next day and sell them for a bit of money.
After daybreak, the adventurers ate breakfast and set off down the mountain. They took turns carrying the chest, and by around noon they had returned to Syr Richmond's estate.

The servant was astonished to see that they had actually brought the chest back. After everyone finished choosing what they wanted to eat, she set out to buy the food. Seeing the still-senile Syr Richmond in the drawing room, the group brought the chest over and set it in front of him, though they were not entirely sure what they expected to happen. To their surprise, the Syr reached out a hand, the chest began to glow, and its lid floated up before dropping to the floor. The chest was empty. As the adventurers stood there stunned, the Syr suddenly spoke.

The adventurers were shocked. How had this "senile" Syr suddenly begun speaking, and even managed to stand up from his wheelchair? They hurriedly questioned him and learned that he had once been one of T.I.D.E.S.'s upper-ranking members, and that his daughter Riley had now taken his place. They also learned that the leaders of this organization could communicate with Jeorisan, the god of wisdom. When Al-lon found out that Jeorisan, whom he worshiped, was also the god of wisdom, he was instantly filled with confidence. As for their reward, the Syr went to a small room behind the manor and returned with a little box containing five rings of different colors, inviting the adventurers to choose one each.

Before the adventurers could finish asking their questions, they discovered that after sitting back down in his wheelchair, the Syr had begun turning to stone. Before long, he stopped moving entirely. At that moment, the servant happened to return with the food. Although she believed what the adventurers told her, she had no idea what to do either. The group ate the chicken legs, fish, and various other foods she had bought while examining a note she had picked up from the crack beneath the front door.

After spending some time piecing things together, they extracted two messages from it: "March 18, 15049, 23:59" and "Batherdon, Page 1410 Bookstore, T.I.D.E.S. carriage." The adventurers decided to go scout things out first, while also using the half day they had left to take care of some errands in town.

The first place they all went together was the candy shop. Besides the two shops they had visited last time, there was still one more candy shop Roel and Leah had not entered yet. They went inside and bought some sweets, and the other adventurers came to the conclusion that Roel seemed to have an extremely serious candy addiction.

After leaving the candy shop, the group also returned, under Al-lon's lead, to the pipe shop Smokey Smokey. After hearing the adventurers describe what had happened in Deepwood, including the skeletons that would secretly shave fur off people's feet, the owner gave Kaname and Fur the membership cards and combs he had promised them. He also recommended a newly arrived tobacco blend to Al-lon, one with mint and peppery notes that was quite distinctive, and Al-lon readily bought some.
After they left Smokey Smokey, the adventurers split into two groups. Roel and Leah tried setting traps again, only to discover they caught nothing at all.

Meanwhile, Kaname, Fur, and Al-lon went to look for "Page 1410" first. Fur remembered that it was a bookstore he used to visit often, so he knew the way. Inside the store, the familiar clerk Thompson warmly greeted Fur and addressed him by his full name, Li-Hui Fur. Kaname, who was very interested in the bookstore, picked up a book called Jeorisan and His Myths. One myth in particular caught her attention: it said that "a child carried downstream by a river is a child chosen by Jeorisan," which happened to match Al-lon's own experience exactly, though he had still been an egg at the time. Delighted by this, they bought the book. When Kaname searched for books related to T.I.D.E.S., Thompson said that once they boarded the carriage that night, they would receive more answers. He also made it clear that he was something like an outer associate of T.I.D.E.S., but not an actual member. Kaname thought Thompson seemed like a decent person, so she also shared where she had been collecting books after coming ashore and invited Thompson to visit sometime.

After Thompson prepared dinner for Kaname, Fur, and Al-lon, naturally including Fur's favorite chicken legs, they remembered that Roel and Leah might not know how to get there. So Fur ran back to Syr Richmond's estate to bring the two of them, who had just finished eating, over to the bookstore.

Near midnight, the adventurers heard the sound of hooves outside the bookstore. When they opened the door, the carriage driver helped them tie Kaname's cart to the back of the carriage. They boarded and saw that someone was already inside.
The hooves sounded out again as the adventurers set off toward T.I.D.E.S.

paragraphs: 冒險者們上了馬車後，發現已經有一人在馬車上了。這名紅髮的年輕男子不多話，從袍子底下看了一眼冒險者們，便繼續沈浸在自己的世界內了。在阿龍的搭話下，才得知他名為賽希爾，是一名貴族法師學徒。同時，阿龍也向賽希爾介紹了同行的夥伴們。見到羅羅那標誌性的妖精耳朵，他不自覺得微微露出了輕蔑的神情。
因為已經是半夜，雷亞和羅羅上車不久後便入睡了。賽希爾從背包中拿出一張紙，開始書寫。在鑰和毛毛的好奇心下，賽希爾解釋他正在寫自己的遺書，他的背包內有不少過去寫過的版本。在賽希爾的同意下，鑰拿走了一份作為留念，也藉機教不識字的阿龍認普通語的字（阿龍學會了爸爸、媽媽、遺產等字後，便覺得今天學夠了）。
對於這趟車程的時長，賽希爾表示他上次來的時候，睡了一覺就到了，雖然不確定這一覺到底是多長，但冒險者們還是決定先睡了再說。
幾個小時後，羅羅和毛毛兩人醒來了，拉開馬車的簾子，他們發現外面似乎是荒郊野外，顯然已經離開貝瑟頓好一段距離了。毛毛拉開前面的簾子，試圖從馬車車伕口中詢問剩餘的距離，但車伕對於還醒著很意外，表示不會太久，要他們先去睡。兩人決定保持清醒，隨時注意路邊的狀況。
同時間，對於陌生的賽希爾，毛毛也在確認賽希爾睡死的前提下偷偷翻了他身上的東西，發現口袋內有不少厚重的金幣，但他並沒有選擇拿走，只是把玩了一番而已。
幾個小時後，天已經亮了，馬車卻沒有停下來的意思，唯二清醒的毛毛和羅羅只好繼續等待。一段時間後馬車竟然停了下來，但車門並沒有打開，而且夥伴們也都還在熟睡之中。待馬車再度啟程後，他們才知道是車伕去買了食物，他們也從車伕手中取得了排隊排到的麵包。
這趟旅程異常的漫長，晚餐時間時車伕很自動的幫兩人也買了晚餐。而熬了一整天的毛毛最終還是決定先睡一會兒，只留下羅羅自己一人清醒著。
當馬車再次停下時，天已經亮了，冒險者們也一一甦醒了。車伕下了車後，把左右兩側的車門打開，便先離開了。大家紛紛下了車，看見旁邊也停了滿滿的馬車，少說有二三十輛，更外側則有花園，有不少穿著貴族裝束的人們正在逛著。而在正前方，則是一棟又大又華麗的宅邸聳立。然而尷尬的是，放眼望去，除了冒險者外，並沒有其他非人類的存在。
阿龍因為尿急，快速跑到了花園邊小解，旁邊看見的貴族們紛紛露出嫌惡的表情，與阿龍保持一段距離。
冒險者們站在馬車邊，不太確定接下來該去哪裡，甚至也不太確定自己為何會在這裡。不久後一名傭人來到冒險者面前，逐一和他們確認身份，接著便帶他們一同走入宅邸。
推開雙開的大門，冒險者們沒見過這麼大的豪宅。在傭人的說明下，他們在晚宴前可以隨處逛逛，唯一的規定是不得爬上三樓諾曼爵士的私人空間，地下一樓、一樓和二樓，甚至外面的花園、賓客大樓都可以走走。
冒險者們先走到一樓底端交誼廳旁的更衣室，選擇了自己喜歡的服裝後，便各自分開了。
換裝後，鑰和推著他的阿龍一起行動。鑰先詢問了一名看起來飽腹詩書的賓客，想詢問關於今日活動的流程。這名名為賽門・李的賓客說明了今天晚上晚宴後，明天會有正式的集會，兩天一夜的活動便結束了。

接著兩人決定到外面去晃晃。走到花園，阿龍看見一名比他體格還要壯碩的女子，十分開心，便找他攀談。然而這位名為克莉絲汀・亨佛瑞斯女士的女子是名貴族子嗣，雖然身體壯碩，卻喜愛較為文靜的活動，其中他最喜歡的是大自然的各種生物，如花園內的花草等。阿龍聽了十分失望，便詢問是否有地方能找人比武。克莉絲汀・亨佛瑞斯女士指著後側的花園，表示那邊有一群人聚集著正在打鬥，阿龍一聽便興奮地嚎叫並大步邁去，留下鑰和克莉絲汀・亨佛瑞斯女士談天。

後側的花園聚集了一群人。在阿龍暫定不久後，便有一名賭頭來詢問他是否要下注？從精壯的艾凡・卡爾斯登和普通身材的歐謝・沐兩人中，阿龍毫無遲疑地選擇了肌肉，而他的選擇也給了他值得的回報，艾凡在一陣拼搏中贏了下來。興奮的阿龍表示他也想參加，便踏入了競技圈內。大家在阿龍喊話後感到十分興奮，場子被炒得頗熱。而一名比克莉絲汀・亨佛瑞斯女士又更為壯碩的男子站到了阿龍的對面，比賽即將開始。聽見場邊的鼓噪聲，還在前側花園談天的鑰在克莉絲汀・亨佛瑞斯女士的幫助下也來到了場邊加油，同時注意著是否有需要從中介入的時機。從場邊的喊聲聽起來，兩方的支持人數相當，但僅過了幾秒，對面的男子便被阿龍揍到倒地了。
阿龍興奮的叫著，希望有其他人上來和他比武，但場邊的人竟然紛紛散去，只剩下裁判、賭頭，以及鑰，和躺在地上的對手。從離場的人們耳語中，阿龍得知這是他的對手第一次在這裡倒下，令阿龍聽了更為興奮。不久後，對手清醒了，和阿龍寒暄了一番，表示自己名為布魯斯・塔里斯。鑰也幫布魯斯做了簡單的治療，以免剛從昏迷中甦醒的他很快又倒下。三人決定先去地下室的宴會廳拿點吃的，補補體力。
毛毛換完衣服後便直攻酒吧。他點了杯啤酒，雖然酒保僅僅是拿出了一瓶罐裝的啤酒倒入杯中，但在毛毛口中，這啤酒竟然異常的好喝，讓他感到十分驚艷。
接著毛毛看見了他位子旁邊的兩人，試圖加入他們的話題。坐在他旁邊的女子名為朱諾・霍普金斯，而朱諾身邊的則是提摩西・溫斯頓。在朱諾的說明下，朱諾和毛毛一樣都是被稱為「基礎級別」的最基礎階級，而提摩西則是高了一層的「天賦者」，他們有較好的住宿和集會時更好的座位，除此之外，他們還有機會可以挑戰更高階級的「方尖碑」。
在毛毛好奇求問下，他得知 T.I.D.E.S. 組織的架構大概如下：

最基礎的層級是「基礎級別」，是被邀請加入組織的，具體原因不清楚。

向上一級是「天賦者」，共 10 人，在人數有漏缺時，會由高層從「基礎級別s」欽點加入。「天賦者」有機會利用挑戰的機制，升級為向上一階級的「方尖碑」。挑戰的方式為找到其中一名「方尖碑」的專屬寶物，若挑戰成功，則會加入該階級，被挑戰的成員則會被逐出組織，他和家族成員皆永遠不得再加入；若挑戰失敗，則為挑戰者被逐出組織，他和家族成員永遠不得再加入。

「方尖碑」共有 4 人，為世襲制或由「天賦者」挑戰成功升上。他們與「至高領導」，即諾曼爵士，為組織的高層核心，不過他們到底有什麼權利，並不清楚。其中萊里・里奇蒙便是此階層的成員之一，由巴托斯爵士傳位給他。

「至高領導」，即弗雷德里克・諾曼爵士。組織中最高且不會被取代的人，世襲制。
在酒吧待了一陣子後，毛毛決定到樓下宴會廳繞繞。毛毛看見熟悉的賽希爾正在和兩名陌生人聊天，便湊了過去。這兩位自稱為凱瑟琳・慕恩和崔斯坦・派瑞，而從他們的口中得知，這次集會似乎會宣布「天賦者」有人員的異動，而三人也十分興奮期待自己有沒有機會被選上加入該階層。
接著毛毛跑去找其他賓客，看見了兩名女子，便爬到他們旁邊的椅子上賣萌。名為菲比・馮・洪的女子穿著很明顯是貴族，但從他的口吻中，他似乎有挺嚴重的歧視觀念；羅莎琳・陳則給人一種聰明犀利的感覺。
羅羅在更衣室內並沒有換任何裝束，但雷亞現身時換了一身女僕裝。他急切地想要嘗試扮演女僕，便在和旁邊的女傭詢問後，端走對方的托盤，但他並不知道自己要將上面的餐點送到哪邊去。直到最後女傭告訴他客人就在原地後雷亞才停下腳步，客人面露不悅的取走了自己的餐點，雷亞才把托盤還給女傭。

接著羅羅和雷亞也去了酒吧。他們兩人挑了位子後，便和酒保點了個甜的。沒多久後，兩杯液態甜點便送上了桌。眼看漂亮的外型，一喝，羅羅馬上就滿意了。然而，在雷亞暫時離開時，一名男子自行坐在了雷亞原本的座位上，而且對羅羅搭訕，要請他喝一杯。在男子的堅持下，羅羅又點了一杯甜的，然而整段時間內男子竟然沒有對羅羅說任何其他的話或做任何事，只有在雷亞回來時示意他羅羅旁邊還有一個位子可以坐。離開前，男子表示自己叫喬吉歐・勒伯朗，若有任何需要幫忙，在這兩天內都可以找他。

離開酒吧後，兩人步出了宅邸外。雷亞難得看見了一名沒有閃躲他眼光的人，是一名看起來不到十歲的小女孩。雷亞試圖利用糖果吸引小妹妹的注意，但小妹妹僅對他微笑，並沒有接近他。最終雷亞還是和他直接對話，得知這名自述被稱為「小神童」的小女孩叫英格麗・貝爾。對於小神童這個綽號，羅羅和雷亞都感到有點起疑，但兩人還是繼續和英格麗對話。不久後，小神童似乎失去了對兩人的興趣，於是就離開了，雷亞和羅羅只好默默走回宴會廳去吃點東西。
在鑰暫時離開時，阿龍和布魯斯聊起了「當貴族是什麼感覺」的話題，因此開始玩起了「貴族遊戲」，兩人輪流扮演貴族和僕人，貴族可以無條件要求僕人做某件事，而僕人必須順從。最終布魯斯在阿龍的要求下必須把盛的滿滿的兩盤肉全部吃完，讓他感到十分絕望。幸好鑰及時看見，阻止他們。
在這個「僕人必須無條件聽命於貴族」的貴族遊戲中，阿龍想起了以前在村中被同齡人霸凌的經過，心中為以前傻呼呼的自己感到不值得。又發現新朋友布魯斯在貴族遊戲之後竟然有意地在躲避自己，這讓阿龍的又一次想起被排擠的難過。此刻阿龍的腦子依舊沒有多少智慧，心中卻是五味雜陳。他想著「貴族=欺負人=讓人不開心=壞蛋=需要被推翻」？
也許是思考太費力了，阿龍又餓了起來，他於是放棄思考，將注意力集中在桌上的美食。

鑰和阿龍發現同行的毛毛正在和兩名女子聊天，甚至讓女子們摸他的毛。當鑰和阿龍提及剛剛阿龍和布魯斯在玩的「貴族遊戲」時，菲比詢問了毛毛是否有興趣在集會後一起去他家，讓他做他的僕人，可以給他很多錢，還有無限多的雞腿。聽到這樣的內容，一旁的羅莎琳尷尬地默默離開座位。菲比從包包拿出一張制式但顯然有很多漏洞的合約時，毛毛心動了，鑰趕緊勸說毛毛要他仔細想想，最終菲比要毛毛在集會結束時再告訴他他的答案，然後便離開了。對話結束不久後，雷亞和羅羅也加入了其他人。
大家討論著接下來晚宴前要做什麼事情。鑰感到疲倦，想要先去客人房找個房間休息一下；雷亞邀請剛吃完盤內所有肉的阿龍來個大胃王競賽；毛毛和羅羅私下討論一起上去三樓探索，但羅羅在嘗試擲硬幣數次，都接不住硬幣的情況下（被他視為厄運），決定不去了。
鑰慢慢移動到客人房，在一樓找了間空房間。走進去後，聽見了機械化的聲音，以他的名字稱呼並歡迎他，然後自動將門關上了，令他感到十分驚奇。放完行李後，鑰來到了一樓的酒吧，看見了一名稍微年長的紳士，詢問後便與他同桌。
希奧多・伊登爵士禮貌的和鑰打招呼，並表示自己是方尖碑階級的，同時也說明了當時是透過「挑戰」制度才上到這個階級。鑰對於組織的運作等有些興趣，因此伊登爵士也對他稍作解說。
鑰在這裡慢慢休息，直到聽見晚宴的鐘響，才和伊登爵士一起移動到宴會廳。
在雷亞的邀約下，阿龍繼續吃東西。不久後，雷亞便投降了，阿龍的胃像是毫無限制般，直到傭人前來請他留些食物給其他客人，他才停了下來。
毛毛先爬到了二樓，看見二樓的房間門上都有印上名字。除了他知道的萊里・里奇蒙女士以外，也看見了稍早在酒吧認識的提摩西・溫斯頓的房間，因此他敲了敲提摩西的房門，房門便打開了。
毛毛看見提摩西的房間十分寬敞，桌上放著雜亂的紙張，而且上面有不少名字。在詢問後，毛毛得知這是提摩西意外得到的賓客名單，他正在對一些名字做研究。不久後，毛毛便先行離開了。
毛毛小心翼翼地走上三樓，卻發現毫無阻礙。他看見左右兩側皆有很大的房間。仔細聆聽後，右側房間沒有任何聲音，左側房間則傳來一名老年男子、一名中年女子和一名中年男子的說話聲。
毛毛悄悄的走過房間，看見有一扇雙開的大門，小心翼翼地拉開，同時感覺到了一隻手壓在他的肩膀上。毛毛回頭，一名老人微笑著，自我介紹自己是諾曼爵士。諾曼爵士向毛毛說明，這扇門是通往智慧之神喬里森的祭祠。對於毛毛可以順利走到這裡不被阻攔，諾曼爵士表示自己感到十分印象深刻，因此把門拉到全開，讓毛毛可以好好看一看裡面。
毛毛看到一大面橫幅的牆，上面有海水、浪潮、風暴的雕刻，十分精美。諾曼爵士表示這道牆後就是祭祠了，是他們和喬里森溝通的地方，因此不能讓他再往後走了。同時，諾曼爵士邀請他一起向喬里森禱告，毛毛學著爵士雙手合十，似乎從喬里森那裡聽到一點聲音，但並不清楚到底聽見了什麼。
諾曼爵士護送毛毛走下二樓，內心還對於自己剛被宅邸主人抓到而震撼不已的毛毛默默走回一樓，和前來迎接他的羅羅相會。
除了鑰之外的冒險者們回到了地下室宴會廳，看見傭人們正在移動場內的佈景，將椅子全部搬走，搬來了不少檯子，上面放了一盅一盅漂亮的骰子。正中央的空間被清的很空，自助餐區則換上了更漂亮的容器。
舞台的簾幕被拉開，樂手們隨著鐘聲響起後開始演奏。

After boarding the carriage, the adventurers found that someone was already inside. This red-haired young man was not very talkative. He gave the adventurers a glance from beneath his robe, then sank back into his own world. Only after Al-lon started talking to him did they learn that his name was Cecil, a noble mage apprentice. Al-lon also introduced the rest of the party to Cecil. At the sight of Roel's distinctive elven ears, Cecil unconsciously showed a faint look of disdain.

Since it was already the middle of the night, Leah and Roel fell asleep soon after getting on board. Cecil took out a sheet of paper from his pack and began writing. Out of Kaname and Fur's curiosity, Cecil explained that he was writing his will, and that he had quite a few older versions in his bag already. With Cecil's permission, Kaname took one copy as a keepsake, and also used the opportunity to teach the illiterate Al-lon a few words of Common. After learning words like "father," "mother," and "inheritance," Al-lon decided he had studied enough for one day.

When asked how long the trip would take, Cecil said that the last time he came, he slept once and arrived. Although he was not sure how long that sleep had actually been, the adventurers decided they might as well sleep first and find out later.

A few hours later, Roel and Fur woke up. Pulling back the carriage curtain, they found that they seemed to be out in the middle of nowhere, clearly far from Batherdon by now. Fur opened the front curtain and tried to ask the driver how much farther remained, but the driver seemed surprised they were still awake and told them it would not be much longer, so they should go back to sleep. The two decided to stay awake and keep watch on the roadside conditions.

At the same time, Fur, still wary of the unfamiliar Cecil, secretly searched through his belongings after confirming that Cecil was sound asleep. He found quite a few heavy gold coins in Cecil's pockets, but chose not to take any, only to toy with them for a bit.

Several more hours passed. Dawn had already broken, yet the carriage showed no sign of stopping, so Fur and Roel, the only two still awake, could do nothing but keep waiting. After a while, the carriage did stop, but the door did not open, and the others were still asleep. Once the carriage set off again, they learned that the driver had simply gone to buy food, and he handed them bread that he had waited in line to get.

The journey was unusually long. By dinnertime, the driver had automatically bought dinner for the two of them as well. After staying awake the entire day, Fur eventually decided to sleep for a while, leaving only Roel awake.

When the carriage stopped again, daylight had already come, and the adventurers woke one by one. After the driver stepped down and opened the doors on both sides of the carriage, he left them there. Everyone got out and saw rows upon rows of other carriages parked nearby, at least twenty or thirty of them. Beyond them lay gardens where many finely dressed nobles were strolling about. Directly ahead stood an enormous and lavish manor. The awkward part was that, as far as they could see, aside from the adventurers themselves, there were no other nonhumans present.
Needing to relieve himself urgently, Al-lon quickly ran to the edge of the garden to pee. The nearby nobles all showed expressions of disgust and kept their distance from him.

The adventurers stood beside the carriage, not quite sure where they were supposed to go next, or even why they were really here. Before long, a servant approached them, confirmed each of their identities one by one, and then led them into the manor.

Pushing open the double doors, the adventurers found themselves inside the largest mansion they had ever seen. According to the servant, they were free to wander about before the evening banquet. The only rule was that they were not to go up to Syr Norman's private quarters on the third floor. The basement level, first floor, second floor, the outer gardens, and even the guest building were all open to them.
The adventurers first went to the dressing room beside the lounge at the far end of the first floor. After choosing outfits they liked, they split up.

After changing clothes, Kaname and Al-lon, who pushed her cart, stayed together. Kaname first approached a guest who looked scholarly and well-read, hoping to learn the schedule for today's event. The guest, a man named Simon Lee, explained that there would be a formal gathering tomorrow after tonight's banquet, and that the two-day, one-night event would end after that.

The two then decided to stroll outside. In the garden, Al-lon spotted a woman even more heavily built than he was and was delighted, immediately striking up a conversation. This woman, Lady Kristen Humphries, was of noble birth. Although powerfully built, she preferred quieter pursuits, and her favorite things were the various forms of life in nature, such as the flowers and plants in the garden. Al-lon was very disappointed to hear this, and asked whether there was anywhere he could find people to spar with. Lady Humphries pointed toward the back garden, saying that there was a crowd gathered there fighting. The moment Al-lon heard that, he howled with excitement and strode off, leaving Kaname to chat with Lady Humphries.

A crowd had gathered in the rear garden. Not long after Al-lon arrived, a bookie came up and asked whether he wanted to place a bet. Faced with the choice between the well-built Ivan Karsten and the more ordinary-looking O'Shae Moo, Al-lon chose muscle without the slightest hesitation, and his choice paid off when Ivan won after a hard-fought struggle. Excited, Al-lon declared that he wanted to join too and stepped into the fighting circle. The crowd became energized by his shouting, and the atmosphere grew lively. A man even more massive than Lady Humphries stepped up to face Al-lon, and the match was about to begin. Hearing the commotion from ringside, Kaname, who had still been chatting in the front garden, came over with Lady Humphries's help to cheer him on while also keeping an eye out in case she needed to intervene. Judging by the shouting around the ring, both sides had about the same number of supporters, but only a few seconds later, the man opposite Al-lon was punched to the ground.

Al-lon shouted excitedly, hoping someone else would come challenge him, but the onlookers actually began to disperse, leaving only the referee, the bookie, Kaname, and the fallen opponent. From the whispers of the people leaving, Al-lon learned that this was the first time his opponent had ever gone down here, which only made him even more excited. Before long, the man regained consciousness and exchanged a few words with Al-lon, introducing himself as Bruce Tallis. Kaname also gave Bruce some simple treatment so he would not collapse again right after waking up. The three decided to head to the basement banquet hall first and grab something to eat to restore their strength.

After changing clothes, Fur headed straight for the bar. He ordered a beer. Although the bartender simply poured canned beer into a glass, Fur found it astonishingly delicious and was deeply impressed.

Fur then noticed the two people sitting next to him and tried to join their conversation. The woman beside him was named Juno Hopkins, and next to Juno sat Timothee Winston. Juno explained that she and Fur were both at the most basic rank, called the "Field," while Timothee was one level above them as a "Gifted." Gifted members received better lodging and better seats during gatherings. On top of that, they also had a chance to challenge for the higher rank known as the "Obelisk."
Out of curiosity, Fur asked for more, and learned that the structure of T.I.D.E.S. worked roughly like this:

The most basic level is the "Field." These are people invited into the organization, though the specific reason why is unclear.

The next level up is the "Gifted," of which there are ten. Whenever there is an opening, the higher-ups personally choose someone from the Fields to fill it. The Gifted also have a chance to advance to the next rank, the "Obelisk," through the challenge system. To issue a challenge, one must find the personal treasure of one of the Obelisk members. If the challenger succeeds, they join that rank, and the challenged member is expelled from the organization, with both they and their family forever barred from rejoining. If the challenger fails, then the challenger is the one expelled, and they and their family are likewise forever barred from joining again.

There are four "Obelisk" members. Their positions are hereditary, or can be earned by a successful challenge from a Gifted. Together with the "Supreme Leader," Syr Norman, they form the organization's high-ranking core, though exactly what powers they possess is unclear. Riley Richmond is one of the members of this rank, having inherited the position from Syr Bartosz.

The "Supreme Leader" is Syr Frederick Norman. He is the highest-ranking person in the organization, cannot be replaced, and the position is hereditary.

After staying at the bar for a while, Fur decided to wander downstairs into the banquet hall. There he spotted the familiar Cecil chatting with two strangers and went over to join them. The two introduced themselves as Catherine Moon and Tristan Perry. From their conversation, Fur learned that this gathering would apparently announce some changes among the Gifted, and all three of them were excited to see whether they might be chosen for that rank.

Next, Fur went looking for other guests. Spotting two women, he climbed up onto a chair beside them and tried to look cute. One of them, Phoebe van Horn, was very obviously dressed like a noble, but from the way she spoke, she seemed to hold some rather severe prejudices. Rosaline Chen, on the other hand, gave off the impression of being sharp and intelligent.

Roel did not change into any special outfit in the dressing room, but when Leah emerged, she was wearing a maid uniform. She eagerly wanted to try acting as a maid, so after asking one of the nearby maids a few questions, she took the other's tray, though she had no idea where she was supposed to deliver the food on it. Only after the maid finally told her that the guest was standing right there did Leah stop walking. The guest took the food with visible displeasure, and only then did Leah return the tray to the maid.

After that, Roel and Leah also went to the bar. Once they had picked their seats, they each ordered something sweet from the bartender. Before long, two liquid desserts were placed on the table. One look at the elegant presentation, one sip, and Roel was instantly satisfied. However, while Leah had briefly stepped away, a man sat down in Leah's seat and started flirting with Roel, insisting on buying him a drink. Under the man's insistence, Roel ordered another sweet drink. Yet throughout the whole exchange, the man did not actually say or do anything else to Roel, only gesturing when Leah returned that there was still a seat beside Roel. Before leaving, the man introduced himself as Georgio LeBlanc and said that if they needed any help over the next two days, they could come find him.

After leaving the bar, the two stepped outside the manor. For once, Leah saw someone who did not avoid her gaze: a little girl who looked to be less than ten years old. Leah tried to lure the girl over with candy, but the girl only smiled at her and did not come closer. In the end, Leah spoke to her directly and learned that the girl, who called herself a "little prodigy," was named Ingrid Bell. Both Roel and Leah found the nickname a little suspicious, but they continued talking with Ingrid anyway. Before long, the little prodigy seemed to lose interest in them and left, so Leah and Roel quietly returned to the banquet hall to get something to eat.

While Kaname was away for a while, Al-lon and Bruce got onto the topic of what it felt like to be a noble, and this led them to start playing a "noble game." They took turns playing the noble and the servant, where the noble could order the servant to do anything unconditionally, and the servant had to obey. In the end, at Al-lon's demand, Bruce had to eat two plates piled high with meat, which left him feeling utterly miserable. Fortunately, Kaname noticed in time and stopped them.

In this "noble game," where servants had to obey nobles without question, Al-lon was reminded of how he had once been bullied by children his own age back in the village, and he felt that his old foolish self had not deserved that treatment. Then he noticed that his new friend Bruce was deliberately avoiding him after the game, which made Al-lon once again think of the sadness of being excluded. His mind still held little wisdom, but his heart was full of tangled feelings. Was the equation "nobles = bullying = making people unhappy = bad guys = need to be overthrown"?
Perhaps thinking was simply too exhausting, because Al-lon soon became hungry again. So he gave up on thinking and focused his attention on the food before him.

Kaname and Al-lon noticed that Fur was chatting with two women and even letting them pet his fur. When Kaname and Al-lon mentioned the "noble game" Al-lon and Bruce had just been playing, Phoebe asked Fur whether he would be interested in coming home with her after the gathering to be her servant. She said she could give him lots of money, along with unlimited chicken legs. Hearing that, Rosaline awkwardly got up and quietly left her seat. When Phoebe pulled a standard contract from her bag, one that very obviously had plenty of loopholes, Fur was tempted. Kaname quickly urged Fur to think carefully. In the end, Phoebe told Fur to give her his answer when the gathering was over, then left. Not long after that conversation ended, Leah and Roel joined the others as well.

The group discussed what to do next before the banquet. Kaname felt tired and wanted to go find an empty guest room to rest in for a while. Leah invited Al-lon, who had just finished all the meat on his plate, to a gluttony contest. Fur and Roel privately discussed going up to explore the third floor together, but after Roel tried flipping a coin several times and failed to catch it every time, which he took as bad luck, he decided not to go.

Kaname slowly made her way to the guest rooms and found an empty one on the first floor. After entering, she heard a mechanical voice greet her by name and welcome her in, then automatically close the door behind her, which she found astonishing. After putting down her belongings, Kaname went to the bar on the first floor, where she saw a somewhat older gentleman. After asking a few questions, she ended up sharing a table with him.

Syr Theodore Eden politely greeted Kaname and explained that he was of the Obelisk rank, and that he had reached that position through the challenge system. Kaname was interested in how the organization operated, so Syr Eden offered her a brief explanation.
Kaname rested here quietly until she heard the bell for the banquet, at which point she and Syr Eden moved together to the banquet hall.

At Leah's invitation, Al-lon continued eating. Before long, Leah gave up. Al-lon's stomach seemed to have no limits at all, and he only stopped when a servant came over and asked him to leave some food for the other guests.

Fur first climbed up to the second floor and saw that the doors to the rooms there all had names on them. Besides Lady Riley Richmond, whom he already knew about, he also spotted Timothee Winston's room, the man he had met earlier at the bar, so he knocked on Timothee's door, and it opened.

Fur saw that Timothee's room was very spacious. There were messy papers spread across the table, and many names were written on them. After asking, Fur learned that this was a guest list Timothee had obtained by accident, and that he was researching some of the names. Before long, Fur took his leave.

Fur carefully crept up to the third floor, only to find that nothing stopped him. He saw large rooms on both the left and right sides. Listening carefully, he heard nothing from the room on the right, while from the room on the left came the voices of an elderly man, a middle-aged woman, and a middle-aged man.

Fur quietly passed by the room and saw a pair of double doors. He carefully pulled them open, only to feel a hand rest on his shoulder at the same time. Turning around, he saw an old man smiling as he introduced himself as Syr Norman. Syr Norman explained to Fur that this door led to the shrine of Jorisen, the god of wisdom. He said that he was deeply impressed that Fur had managed to make it this far without being stopped, and so he pulled the doors fully open to let Fur take a proper look inside.

Fur saw a huge wall like a hanging banner, carved with seawater, waves, and storms, all beautifully made. Syr Norman explained that the shrine lay beyond that wall, and that it was the place where they communicated with Jorisen, so he could not allow Fur to go any farther. At the same time, Syr Norman invited him to pray to Jorisen together. Fur imitated the Syr and clasped his hands, and seemed to hear a faint voice from Jorisen, though he could not make out what it said.

Syr Norman escorted Fur back down to the second floor. Still inwardly shocked that he had just been caught by the owner of the manor, Fur silently returned to the first floor, where he met up with Roel, who had come to find him.

All of the adventurers except Kaname returned to the basement banquet hall and saw the servants rearranging the room. They removed all the chairs and brought in a number of tables, each set with elegant cups full of beautiful dice. The central area had been cleared wide open, while the buffet area had been replaced with finer containers.
The curtain on the stage was drawn back, and as the bell rang out, the musicians began to play.

paragraphs: 隨著鐘聲響起，鑰跟隨著西奧多・伊登爵士一起移動到了宴會廳。
「歡迎西奧多・伊登爵士入場！」
冒險者們看見了一對對舞伴步入舞池，跳著正式的舞步；檯子邊聚集了賭客，莊家開始主持骰子遊戲的賭局；而自助餐區則有了專門的傭人幫忙打菜；部分傭人擇端著飲料穿梭在客人之間。
「歡迎托瑪辛・風暴女士入場！」
阿龍與雷亞加入了舞池，但兩人對於正式的舞步完全不了解，笨拙的腳不斷踩到對方，很快地，兩人便逃出了舞池。
冒險者們也加入了骰子遊戲的賭局，但在幾場遊戲後，幾乎都輸了錢。
「歡迎萊里・里奇蒙女士入場！」
冒險者們聽見熟悉的名字後，目光便轉向宴會廳入口。趁著沒有多少人圍繞在萊里身邊時，他們趕緊和萊里談話。冒險者們確認自己是被萊里邀請來到這裡的，同時萊里對於他父親的狀況有所掌握，而鑰也為傭人蒂娜請願，不要馬上把他開除。
「歡迎班尼狄克・亞索爵士和弗雷德里克・諾曼爵士入場！」
毛毛看見諾曼爵士朝著他從遠處眨了眼，便也回了個眼，然後諾曼爵士便被其他賓客團團圍住了。
冒險者們看見舞台上的樂隊換了人，樂曲從原本正式的舞曲，換成了較為輕鬆的鄉村音樂。
宴會盛大而熱鬧，冒險者們各自享受喜愛的環節，不論是吃東西、與人攀談，或是觀察其他人都在做些什麼事。不久後，大家開始發現有人陸續從宴會廳悄悄離開了，冒險者們也各自離開。
在大宅外，冒險者們閒逛著花園，或移動到客人房。大家最終在客人房一樓的酒吧集合，慢慢度過這個夜晚。（暈倒的布魯斯則是被阿龍強行帶到同一間客房一同入住。）
As the bell rang, Kaname followed Syr Theodore Eden into the banquet hall.
"Welcome, Syr Theodore Eden!"

The adventurers watched pairs of dance partners step onto the floor and perform formal dances. Gamblers gathered around the tables as the dealers began running dice games. In the buffet area, dedicated servants helped plate the food, while some of the other servants moved among the guests carrying drinks.
"Welcome, Lady Thomasine Storm!"
Al-lon and Leah joined the dance floor, but neither of them understood formal dance steps at all. Their clumsy feet kept stepping on each other, and before long, the two of them fled the floor.
The adventurers also joined the dice games, but after a few rounds, almost all of them had lost money.
"Welcome, Lady Riley Richmond!"

When the adventurers heard the familiar name, they immediately turned toward the entrance to the banquet hall. Taking advantage of a moment when not many people were surrounding Riley, they hurried over to speak with her. The adventurers confirmed that it was Riley who had invited them here. At the same time, Riley seemed to understand the situation with her father, and Kaname also pleaded on behalf of the servant Tina, asking that she not be dismissed immediately.
"Welcome, Syr Benedict Yaso and Syr Frederick Norman!"
Fur saw Syr Norman wink at him from afar, so he winked back. After that, Syr Norman was quickly surrounded on all sides by the other guests.
The adventurers noticed that the band on stage had changed. The music shifted from formal dance pieces to more relaxed country tunes.

The banquet was grand and lively, and each of the adventurers enjoyed the parts they liked best, whether that meant eating, chatting with people, or watching what everyone else was doing. Before long, they began to notice that people were quietly slipping out of the banquet hall one after another, and the adventurers gradually left as well.

Outside the manor, the adventurers wandered the gardens or made their way to the guest rooms. In the end, they gathered at the bar on the first floor of the guest quarters and slowly passed the rest of the night there. Bruce, who had fainted, was forcibly dragged by Al-lon into the same guest room to stay the night.
一早，冒險者們便被爵士宅邸客房內的魔法廣播系統喚醒，請大家移動到宴會廳，參與年度集會。冒險者們在各自的座位上簡單用了早點，集會便開始了。
一開始，諾曼爵士先再次介紹了組織的編制，包含各大階級，以及高層及人士分別的個人護衛（同時也提醒大家在集會中禁止使用暴力）。然後他便和大家簡單報告了本年度T.I.D.E.S.組織的變動狀況，包涵伊許頓・懷斯的逝世，組織高層決議讓奇斯・楊升上天賦者的階級。
接著，進到了挑戰方尖碑階級的環節。天賦者中，一位名為蘿拉・費許朋的女子站了起來，表示他要向萊里女士進行挑戰。在萊里點頭接受了蘿拉使用魔法的請求後，蘿拉便伸出他的手，指尖冒出了一股異樣的氣。冒險者們盯著萊里看，發現他的右眼開始滲血，接著，他的右眼珠便被用力地騰空挖出，直接掉到萊里正前方的地板上。蘿拉向諾曼爵士表示，萊里的右眼便是他的信物，而萊里一手捂著空洞的眼窩，一邊默默的點著頭。
諾曼爵士宣告，自此開始，萊里便不再是方尖碑的成員，更不是T.I.D.E.S.的一員了，同時也請萊里步出會場。看著蘿拉慢慢地走上舞台，坐上原本屬於萊里的座椅，冒險者們心中除了詫異外，更有著惋惜與氣憤。不過，在諾曼爵士宣布，被萊里邀請的他們也必須離場時，他們也沒有別的話能說了。集會則繼續進行著，但這已經與冒險者們沒有關係了。
走出爵士的宅邸，僕人引導萊里走向其中一輛馬車，表示這是諾曼爵士賜予萊里的最後一份禮物，讓萊里和冒險者們登上馬車。萊里駕起馬車，準備出發。在冒險者們的詢問下，萊里也和他們說明，他預計帶他們到一個名為「土城」的地方，他在那裡還有屬於自己的一些資源可以使用。不過對阿龍而言，更重要的是，土城，是他的家鄉。

Early that morning, the adventurers were awakened by the magical broadcasting system inside the guest rooms of the Syr's manor, instructing everyone to move to the banquet hall for the annual gathering. After having a simple breakfast at their assigned seats, the gathering began.

At the start, Syr Norman once again introduced the structure of the organization, including its major ranks and the personal guards assigned to each of the higher-ranking members. He also reminded everyone that violence was forbidden during the gathering. He then gave a brief report on this year's changes within T.I.D.E.S., including the death of Ishton Weiss and the decision by the leadership to promote Keith Young to the rank of Gifted.

Next came the portion for challenging the Obelisk rank. Among the Gifted, a woman named Laura Fishburne stood up and declared that she wished to challenge Miss Riley. After Riley nodded to allow Laura to use magic, Laura stretched out her hand, and a strange energy rose from her fingertips. The adventurers stared at Riley and saw blood begin to seep from her right eye. Then, with violent force, her right eyeball was torn free into the air and dropped directly onto the floor in front of her. Laura informed Syr Norman that Riley's right eye was her token, while Riley covered her empty eye socket with one hand and silently nodded.

Syr Norman declared that from this moment onward, Riley was no longer a member of the Obelisk, nor even a member of T.I.D.E.S., and ordered her to leave the hall. As the adventurers watched Laura slowly walk up onto the stage and sit in the seat that had once belonged to Riley, they felt not only shock, but also regret and anger. But when Syr Norman announced that those invited by Riley would also have to leave, there was nothing the adventurers could say. The gathering continued, but it no longer had anything to do with them.

After leaving the Syr's manor, a servant guided Riley to one of the carriages and said it was the final gift Syr Norman was granting her. Riley and the adventurers boarded the carriage, and Riley took up the reins, preparing to depart. In response to the adventurers' questions, Riley explained that she intended to take them to a place called Mudtown, where she still had some resources of her own available. For Al-lon, however, the more important fact was this: Mudtown was his hometown.
