paragraphs: 當馬車停下時，除了阿龍之外，大家都下車了。近鄉情怯可以說是阿龍最貼切的心情寫照。
赫洛登瀑布內的峭壁上，迎面而來的是一座看起來有點現代化的神殿。萊里向大家介紹，這是他的研究機構，同時也是風暴與智慧之神喬里森的神殿，名為「渡鴉中樞」，或是當地人習慣的稱法：「瀑布後面」。
當眾人走入渡鴉中樞一樓時，躲在鑰的推車上的阿龍心情又更不好了。眼前，一個熟悉的人影正在一樓櫃檯和服務人員交涉。那人是艾迪・蘋果木。大家疑惑著阿龍到底在扭捏什麼，阿龍則趕緊催促大家離開，萊里才把大家引導到後方的升降梯，到三樓的客房去放置行李。
大家簡單休息後，來到二樓準備見萊里。二樓是一座堂皇的教堂，此刻還沒有任何信徒朝拜。大家朝著內部走，推開了後方的門，便是萊里的研究室了。萊里先向大家說明自己的助理因為出差，暫時不在，不然應該是由他來帶大家進到土城去的。

接著，萊里簡單說明，要請冒險者們協助他搜集一項材料：「在被喬里森祝福過的河水中漂流的蘋果樹漂流木剪下的枝幹，長度需要有成年男子的前臂長，且不能有任何分枝」。在萊里的解釋下，冒險者才知道，搜集這個材料的目的，是為了製作一個能讓萊里回到T.I.D.E.S.的神秘器具（只流傳在像里奇蒙家族這種組織創始家族的歷史中）。萊里也承諾會給冒險者們每人 50 金幣作為獎賞。阿龍知道在土城，蘋果樹是由蘋果木家族管理的，絕對不能隨便亂砍，否則會有很嚴重的懲罰。
萊里也簡單介紹了一下關於土城的重要景點，如：城鎮外的海雅特山、流經城鎮中央的維爾河、城鎮的市中心軸恩廣場，以及太陽議會。萊里也說明，如果要去議會談重要的事，建議在他的助理回來後，正是登門拜訪。
接著萊里便要大家先進城，了解一下土城這個城鎮的生態。走到軸恩廣場，阿龍先看到了過去曾霸凌他的其中兩名年齡與他相仿的年輕人。同時，阿龍也向夥伴們說明了這群被當地人稱為「壞蛋四人幫」，被他簡稱為「壞四人」的霸凌們：喜愛勒索的葛林德爾、脾氣暴躁的湯博、骯髒惡臭的皮柏，以及破壞公物札菲。
一小列隊的人走向冒險者們。走在最前面的年輕女孩自我介紹為瑪莉貝爾，請冒險者們在明天的春天精靈投票投給他。列隊離開後，冒險者們向阿龍詢問關於這個「春天精靈」的投票，得知在瑪莉貝爾口中霸榜數年，名為潘妮洛普・蘋果木的女孩，是阿龍的舊識，甚至是他的初戀。而那名他們在渡鴉中樞看見的艾迪，則是佩妮的父親。
不久後，一群鬧哄哄、更大的隊伍出現在市中心，身旁還有不少奏樂聲，以及壞四人等人圍繞在旁。阿龍轉頭一看，隊伍最前面的人便是他思念已久的佩妮。此時，佩妮似乎也看見阿龍了，但因為周圍太嘈雜，加上隊伍不斷前行，阿龍只能看見佩妮的嘴型好像念著他的名字。
冒險者們迎頭趕上，停在佩妮前面。佩妮和鑰簡單說了幾句，佩妮也悄悄請他告訴阿龍今晚約在「咖啡廳」見面。

隊伍離開後，冒險者們決定先去太陽議會（上頭有著布條，寫著「謝謝太陽與河水，賜給我們小麥、蘋果和玉米！」），拜訪艾迪。因為知道土城的蘋果樹都是由蘋果木家族負責照料的，直接找大家長艾迪談談，似乎是最好的選擇（而且在冒險者們的認知中，阿龍與蘋果木家的佩妮關係似乎不錯，應該可以有較好的談判空間）。阿龍也想起土城的議會由被他暱稱為「蘋果先生」的蘋果木先生負責外交；「小麥先生」惠頓先生負責內政；「玉米小姐」康乃爾小姐負責娛樂–明日的春天精靈投票，便是由他負責。
然而，此時蘋果木先生並未在議會內，冒險者們只好在惠頓先生的招待下休息了一會兒後，便離開了。

推開太陽議會的大門，一名孩子出現在大家面前。阿龍一看，這是佩妮的弟弟，凱許・蘋果木，凱許正用他水汪汪的大眼睛看著阿龍。凱許與冒險者們一同離開議會後，便說了他來此行的目的。他要參與明天的春天精靈投票。依阿龍所知，參選春天精靈的條件是未成年的女子（就算是外地人也可以，因此冒險者們一開始也鼓吹毛毛參加），但凱許很顯然是個男孩子。不過過去的確是有男生扮裝成女生來參選，也被接受的案例。然而，這個一直以來把它當成大哥哥偶像來看待小弟，竟然也要參選，讓他感到大為震驚。凱許說道，他知道姊姊佩妮這三年來當春天精靈其實很辛苦，但他也知道擔任春天精靈可以為家裡得到的優勢太大，姊姊願意忍辱負重，繼續參選。較年輕個幾歲的凱許，希望能代替姊姊來參選，讓姊姊可以卸下重擔，同時又不會失去蘋果木家的優勢。阿龍有聽說，過去土城的妓院，很多是招募過去的春天精靈作為頭牌，雖然知道現在妓院產業已經沒落了，但他也知道沒選上春天精靈，似乎對佩妮來說也會有不太好的結果。冒險者們討論後，決定邀請凱許晚上也一起來咖啡廳，與佩妮一起商議。
接著冒險者們決定前往阿龍家拜訪。來到土城後，已經聽過不少人向阿龍提起，應該要去見見他父親的。但阿龍離開土城時，便是因為誤傷了自己的父親，因此內心難以面對。
經過「土堤學習中心」，阿龍也告訴其他夥伴，這是他以前上學的地方。然而冒險者們也很疑惑，怎麼上了學，阿龍還是個文盲？
來到家門前，冒險者們推著阿龍前去敲門，但阿龍敲了門就跑走了。最終阿龍終於鼓起勇氣。阿龍的媽媽看見自己的孩子終於回家了，露出慈祥的笑容，也歡迎阿龍的朋友們一起進來家裡。阿龍和夥伴們一起坐在沙發上，看著也在沙發上的阿龍爸爸，拄著拐杖，表情木然。
在阿龍媽媽煮了家常菜，端上客廳的桌子後，大家邊吃邊聊。阿龍對於自己誤傷爸爸這件事很感到愧疚，但還是問了爸爸他的傷勢。阿龍爸爸則回答他，他是爬山時不小心摔到腿，所以才拄著拐杖的。冒險者們也讀了拐杖上刻的字，上面寫著「願我的孩子出外冒險平安歸來」。
離開阿龍家後，阿龍先帶著大家到市區尋找裁縫店，希望能有一套正裝，以赴今晚和佩妮在咖啡廳的約。裁縫店老闆在收了阿龍額外的錢後，要他在日落前再來拿衣服。
接著，大家回了一趟渡鴉中樞，碰巧遇上出差回來的萊里的助手，綠先生，大家也和他打了招呼，了解平常都是綠先生到土城內和議會人員溝通。明日的春天精靈投票，也將是他會協助執行。
冒險者們趁著下午的時間，往山邊去，來到農地區。他們盤算著該如何才能成功採集到萊里要求的蘋果木，卻被負責栽種與守衛農田的農人們發現。冒險者們也得知海雅特山上似乎有一群山賊。在密謀竄到農田內的計畫失敗後，冒險者們只能先慢慢回到市區，做別的計劃。
時間差不多，大家在陪阿龍拿完他的衣服（一套帥氣的西裝，以及一個紅色的小領結，穿在阿龍身上十分帥氣）後，便一併前往當地人習慣簡稱「咖啡廳」的波德里克咖啡廳。
在咖啡廳前，大家看見凱許和佩妮兩人似乎起了點口角，得知佩妮並不知道凱許今晚也要一起來咖啡廳。他們兩人先後進到咖啡廳後，冒險者們才進入。在服務生的引導下，阿龍走入了咖啡廳後頭最右手邊的包廂，而其他冒險者們則與已經入座的凱許共用兩張桌子。

包廂內，青春而亮麗的佩妮與阿龍思念的模樣別無二致。阿龍在談話過程中得知了關於「春天精靈」投票的不少內幕。土城的居民每戶每個月都需要上繳 10% 的收入或農作物給海雅特山的山賊，而春天精靈的家庭則可以免除此項規則，因此有很多家庭為了這個好處，紛紛推舉自己家的孩子去參選。然而，不為其他人所知的，春天精靈在被選上後，會被議會的玉米小姐以一個法器在肩膀上印上一個被稱為「翠綠印記」的標記，而且每個月要在印記發痛時被玉米小姐帶去見山賊一次。依照玉米小姐的說法，翠綠印記只有辦法印在女生身上，因此要是凱許以男兒身被選上春天精靈，也是無法履行春天精靈的義務的。
阿龍聽了感到恐慌。山賊，是真的存在的。而在佩妮的訴說下，他得知這個翠綠印記，是山賊首領奧斯華・克雷頓拿來執行用來控制自己山賊手下的儀式所用。他也威脅，如果不每月執行儀式，山賊們會控制不了自己燒殺擄掠的衝動，下山把土城給滅了。

然而，在佩妮口中，他每個月上山去，這個被他稱為大奧斯的山賊首領其實對他挺好、挺溫柔的，也不會傷害他。他認為自己是愛上大奧斯了。另阿龍更心痛的是，佩妮覺得自己在大奧斯身上看見了很多與阿龍相似之處：壯碩寬闊的肩膀，善良的本質，以及總是為人著想的心。佩妮說他試著說服大奧斯和他私奔，兩人一起逃離這個無法改變的命運，但大奧斯為了自己的群落，割捨不下，讓佩妮也不知道該怎麼辦。阿龍看著餐前點的蘋果汁，不知怎麼喝下，只能衝出包廂外跑進廁所，對著鏡子就是一陣猛搥。
包廂外，冒險者們問著凱許關於春天精靈的事，卻發現他除了姊姊佩妮一個月會消失一兩天以外，什麼都不知道。而對於隔天的春天精靈投票，凱許除了求冒險者外，根本沒有別的對策。雷亞過了一段時間，決定去廁所變身成蒼蠅，飛入阿龍和佩妮的包廂，試圖竊聽，然而，此時正好是阿龍衝出包廂外跑去廁所的時間，因此雷亞什麼都沒聽到。
阿龍走出廁所，來到凱許和其他冒險者們的桌子，將領結扯掉，喊了幾聲生氣的話，口中說著什麼討山賊之類的，甚至還想出了以討伐山賊來和議會談判，做為拿蘋果木的交換條件。其他人對於阿龍突然吐出這麼多資訊，還腦袋清楚到這種程度，大感意外。不久後包廂傳出了佩妮的尖叫聲。
冒險者們一同衝了過去，發現雷亞躺在佩妮面前的桌上。原來是佩妮看見桌上有隻蒼蠅，順手揮過去，雷亞來不及躲開，一被打到便變回原形，嚇著了佩妮。
冒險者們也順理成章全部進了包廂。大家與蘋果木姊弟一同將已知的資訊統整，並在佩妮的提議下，在明天選完春天精靈後，後天應該可以一起上山去見山賊。依照佩妮的計算，沒意外後天應該會是他的印記發痛的日期。
冒險者們先讓蘋果木姊弟回家去，也接了阿龍的父母來到渡鴉中樞過夜。接著冒險者們便回到渡鴉中樞二樓萊里的辦公室，與萊里和綠先生稟報他們的計劃。

冒險者們回到三樓，準備就寢。原本想和阿龍的父母聊聊天，鑰卻發現阿龍父母對阿龍的管教方式似乎有很大的問題—不知道這是阿龍父母的問題，還是地侏的文化就是如此？因此鑰和毛毛便到阿龍的房間安慰阿龍了。同一時間，雷亞帶著羅羅（將羅羅綁在他身上）到附近的樹林走走，想摘採幾顆水果送給阿龍。雷亞也在樹林中感受到涅西斯的光輝，似乎自己離涅西斯有那麼近了一點。然而好不容易找到的兩顆果實，其中一顆在雷亞冥想時被羅羅吃掉了，只剩下一顆能帶給阿龍。
一早起床後，大家一起到二樓辦公室去找萊里和綠先生，簡單吃了他們為冒險者們準備的麵包作為早餐。綠先生表示他接下來會先準備等等的春天精靈投票—他負責擔任公正第三方的監票人。
冒險者們決定在投票前剩餘的一兩個小時，先去拜訪蘋果木家。艾迪和此時已經離開家裡，前往議會，準備投票的工作了；佩妮則早已和他的遊行隊伍們在廣場繞境了。因此冒險者們決定也前往議會去。

到了議會，綠先生還沒抵達前，議會的休息區只有三名代表。和議會簡單溝通後，冒險者們確認了「山賊」確實存在，也得知了這群山賊團體有個響亮的稱號：海雅特山交響樂。他們也得知被稱為玉米小姐的康妮・康乃爾，他負責的各種「傳統」，都是傳承下來的，稍微減低了冒險者們對他的敵意。不過，冒險者們也從康妮口中得知，給春天精靈用的翠綠印記，似乎和春天精靈體內的月經週期有很大的關係，因此他們也更清楚知道原本想參選的凱許，是不可能被選上的了。
玉米小姐和小麥先生先暫時離開，留下冒險者們與艾迪私下談談。冒險者們提議上山剿匪，以和艾迪換取萊里請他們尋找的蘋果木枝幹。除此之外，也會給他們等同於居民人數的金幣作為報酬。艾迪對提議沒有太大的反彈，但請冒險者們在投票後，再去找他，他得先和議會成員們討論出個結果。
離開了議會，冒險者們先前往投票場地。他們正好碰上佩妮的隊伍，浩浩蕩蕩，佩妮也特別和阿龍打了個招呼。情緒複雜的阿龍不知道該擺什麼表情。冒險者們在投票前也找到了他們前一天遇到的另一名春天精靈候選人：瑪莉貝爾。瑪莉貝爾很清楚知道自己沒什麼勝算，但還是堅持想選下去。基於大家對佩妮傷了阿龍的心，冒險者們決定要幫瑪莉貝爾一把，瑪莉貝爾也感謝了冒險者們，承諾他們不管投票結果如何，今晚都要請他們吃一餐。

時間到了，議會的康妮和綠先生先生一同站上了舞台。康妮簡單說明了本次投票的方式：每個人都會到台前領取選票，並在另一張紙上簽名，以示自己已領票，接著在選票上寫上自己中意的春天精靈人選，投入箱中。接著康妮介紹了本次春天精靈的候選人：蟬聯三年的現役春天精靈佩妮・蘋果木，以及他的競爭對手瑪莉貝爾・莫德維克。兩者的氣勢差距極為明顯，除了冒險者們外，很顯然瑪莉貝爾沒有任何的支持者。冒險者們也發現，佩妮稍微有些身體不適的症狀，再次提醒他們從康妮那兒聽到與翠綠印記，和月經週期有很大的關聯。他們也想起前一晚佩妮提到又快上山了這句話。
開票的結果，佩妮拿了一百多票，瑪莉貝爾則只拿了6票，除此之外還有20票以上的廢票。瑪莉貝爾輸的心甘情願，雖有不甘，但也無可奈何。在康妮的主持下，佩妮欽點了自己的春天騎士團：阿龍口中的「壞四人」，以及「阿龍和他的朋友們」。
隨著春天精靈的投票結束，土城的居民們熱烈慶祝著。冒險者們聽見康妮宣布今晚午夜，佩妮就要以春天精靈的身份，在春天精靈的護送下，前往海雅特山去一趟。想著要和壞四人一起行動，冒險者們不禁感到身體不適。
想著壞四人，冒險者們就聞到惡臭的皮柏。冒險者們試圖幫他清洗，土城的居民們在狂歡的氣氛下，也跟著起鬨。大家一同把皮柏丟到穿越廣場的維爾河內，強迫皮柏搓洗身體。在快半小時的時間後，皮柏的身體已被洗得視覺上完全看不出髒污，但走出河後，身上的惡臭卻還是讓人感到暈眩。這場鬧劇居民們也看夠了，也就離開了。
冒險者們在附近看見一個人的瑪莉貝爾，和他搭訕。瑪莉貝爾很感激他們為他投下的票，也邀請他們一起到他家去，他要做午餐給大家吃。

冒險者們發現瑪莉貝爾獨自一人住在家裡，家裡的狀況看起來挺不錯的，雖然稱不上豪華，但裡面的擺設和書籍都十分有品味。瑪莉貝爾表示自己的父母外出旅行兩年了，至今尚未歸來，但也讓他練就了可以好好照料自己的各種生活技能。鑰和毛毛發現瑪莉貝爾的書籍十分多樣，瑪莉貝爾也表示自己平常就是以閱讀為樂，什麼都看。抽出其中一本，竟然是與克里歐門王國的科技發展史有關，而且內容是用矮人與寫的。鑰大力邀請瑪莉貝爾去他陸上的藏書處拜訪他，但瑪莉貝爾表示希望先把自己還沒看完的書看完，才有想出去旅行的心。

菜色擺上桌，冒險者們發現瑪莉貝爾的廚藝也極佳。瑪莉貝爾要冒險者們先吃，自己會陸續上更多菜，但冒險者們不忍心，要等他一起用餐。餐桌上，冒險者得知瑪莉貝爾其實聰明勇敢，又十分有獨立思考的能力。瑪莉貝爾對於山賊的事也略有耳聞，也可以猜想到春天精靈和山賊的是脫不了關係。他期望如果能選上春天精靈，有機會可以上山去和山賊們進行談判，找出對山賊和土城都有利的解方。然而，明年他就成年了，不符合參選春天精靈的資格，因此這個願望就只能隨風而去了。
對於如此讓人心疼的瑪莉貝爾，冒險者們想方設法想邀請他加入冒險團隊，認為他一定也會喜歡一起冒險的生活，但瑪莉貝爾很顯然沒有共同的想法。
午餐後，冒險者們前去拜訪太陽議會。艾迪表示他和議會達成了共識，願意以冒險者們剿除山賊為條件，給予他們包含他們要的蘋果木枝幹。除此之外，也會給他們等同於居民人數的金幣作為報酬。
When the carriage came to a stop, everyone got out except Al-lon. If anything could describe how he felt, it was homesickness mixed with dread.

Set into the cliff within Heloden Falls was a temple that looked strangely modern. Riley introduced it as her research institute, as well as a temple to Jeorisan, god of storms and wisdom. Its formal name was the Raven Nexus, though locals were used to calling it simply "Behind the Fall."

When the group entered the first floor of the Raven Nexus, Al-lon, still hiding in Kaname's cart, felt even worse. Right in front of them, a familiar figure was speaking with the front-desk staff. It was Addie Applewood. The others wondered what exactly Al-lon was being so awkward about, but he hurriedly urged them to leave, and Riley led everyone to the elevator in the back and up to the guest rooms on the third floor to put down their luggage.

After a short rest, they went to the second floor to see Riley. The second floor was a magnificent chapel, though there were no worshippers present at the moment. The group walked deeper inside, pushed open the door at the back, and found Riley's study beyond it. Riley first explained that her assistant was currently away on business; otherwise, he should have been the one guiding them into Mudtown.

Riley then briefly explained the material she wanted the adventurers to help collect: "A branch cut from driftwood of an apple tree that floated in river water blessed by Jeorisan. It must be as long as an adult man's forearm and have no offshoot branches." From Riley's explanation, the adventurers learned that the purpose of gathering this material was to craft a mysterious device that could allow Riley to return to T.I.D.E.S., something preserved only in the histories of founding families like the Richmonds. Riley also promised each adventurer fifty gold pieces as a reward. Al-lon knew that in Mudtown, apple trees were managed by the Applewood family, and chopping them carelessly was absolutely forbidden and carried severe punishment.

Riley also gave them a simple introduction to the important landmarks of Mudtown, such as Mount Hyatt outside town, the Vay-El River that ran through the center of town, the central Zoan Plaza, and the Council of Sols. Riley added that if they wanted to speak to the council about anything important, it would be best to pay a formal visit after her assistant returned.

Riley then told them to head into town first and get a sense of Mudtown's general atmosphere. Upon reaching Zoan Plaza, Al-lon immediately spotted two young men around his age who had bullied him in the past. He also explained to his companions that these bullies, known locally as the "Four Bad Guys," and shortened by him to the "Evil Be-4," consisted of Grindle the extortionist, hot-tempered Tumble, filthy and foul-smelling Pibble, and Zaffie the vandal.

A small procession approached the adventurers. At the front was a young girl who introduced herself as Maribel and asked the adventurers to vote for her in tomorrow's Spring Spirit election. After the procession moved on, the adventurers asked Al-lon about this "Spring Spirit" vote, and learned that the girl who had dominated the title for several years, Penelope Applewood, was someone Al-lon had known for a long time and even his first love. The Addie they had seen earlier at the Raven Nexus was Penny's father.

Not long afterward, a larger and far noisier procession appeared in the town center, accompanied by music and surrounded by the Evil Be-4 and others. When Al-lon turned to look, he saw that the person leading the procession was Penny, the one he had missed for so long. Penny seemed to spot Al-lon too, but because the surroundings were so noisy and the procession kept moving, all he could make out was that her lips seemed to be forming his name.
The adventurers hurried ahead and stopped in front of Penny. Penny exchanged a few words with Kaname and quietly asked her to tell Al-lon to meet her tonight at "the cafe."

After the procession left, the adventurers decided to first visit Addie at the Council of Sols, where a banner overhead read, "Thank the sun and the river for granting us wheat, apples, and corn!" Since they knew that all the apple trees in Mudtown were cared for by the Applewood family, going directly to the family patriarch Addie seemed like the best option. In the adventurers' minds, Al-lon and Penny seemed to be on fairly good terms, so that might create more room for negotiation. Al-lon also remembered that Mudtown's council handled foreign affairs through Mr. Applewood, whom he nicknamed "Apple Mister"; domestic affairs through Mr. Wheaton, whom he called "Wheat Mister"; and entertainment through Miss Cornell, "Corn Miss," who was also in charge of tomorrow's Spring Spirit election.
However, Mr. Applewood was not at the council at that moment, so after resting for a while under Mr. Wheaton's hospitality, the adventurers left.

As they pushed open the doors of the Council of Sols, a child appeared in front of them. Al-lon immediately recognized him as Penny's younger brother, Cassius Applewood. Cash gazed up at Al-lon with watery eyes. After leaving the council together with the adventurers, Cash explained why he had come. He wanted to take part in tomorrow's Spring Spirit election. As Al-lon understood it, the qualification for being a Spring Spirit candidate was being an underage girl, even an outsider could qualify, which was why the adventurers had initially joked about having Fur enter. But Cash was very obviously a boy. Still, there had apparently been past cases where boys dressed as girls and were accepted as candidates. Even so, the fact that this younger boy, who had always seen Al-lon as an older-brother idol, also wanted to run left Al-lon deeply shocked. Cash explained that he knew his sister Penny had suffered a great deal these past three years as Spring Spirit, but he also knew that the advantages it brought to their family were enormous, which was why his sister had endured the humiliation and kept running. Younger by several years, Cash hoped to take her place so she could lay down that burden without the Applewood family losing its advantages. Al-lon had heard that in the past, many of Mudtown's brothels recruited former Spring Spirits as their headliners. Although he knew that industry had now declined, he also knew that losing the Spring Spirit election did not seem likely to lead Penny anywhere good either. After discussing it, the adventurers decided to invite Cash to the cafe that evening as well, so they could talk things over together with Penny.

After that, the adventurers decided to visit Al-lon's home. Ever since arriving in Mudtown, plenty of people had told Al-lon that he ought to see his father. But when Al-lon left Mudtown, it had been because he had accidentally injured his father, so he found the idea extremely hard to face.

Passing by the Tutty Learning Center, Al-lon told the others that it was the school he had once attended. The adventurers could not help wondering how he could still be illiterate after having gone to school there.

When they reached his front door, the adventurers pushed Al-lon up to knock, but after knocking he immediately ran away. In the end, though, he finally gathered his courage. When Al-lon's mother saw that her child had finally come home, she smiled kindly and welcomed Al-lon's friends inside as well. Al-lon sat down on the sofa with his companions, facing his father, who was also seated there with a cane and a blank expression.

After Al-lon's mother cooked a home-style meal and brought it out to the living room table, everyone chatted while they ate. Al-lon felt deeply guilty about accidentally injuring his father, but still asked him about his leg. His father answered that he had hurt it by accidentally falling while climbing a mountain, which was why he used a cane. The adventurers also read the words carved into the cane: "May my child return safely from adventures abroad."

After leaving Al-lon's house, he first took everyone into town to look for a tailor. He hoped to get a proper outfit for tonight's date with Penny at the cafe. After taking some extra money from Al-lon, the tailor told him to come back before sunset to collect the clothes.

Next, the group returned to the Raven Nexus and happened to run into Riley's assistant, Mr. Green, who had just come back from his trip. They greeted him and learned that it was usually Mr. Green who went into Mudtown to communicate with the council members. He would also be helping oversee tomorrow's Spring Spirit election.

Taking advantage of the afternoon, the adventurers headed toward the mountains and reached the farmland district. They began plotting how they might successfully gather the Applewood branch Riley needed, only to be spotted by the farmers responsible for planting and guarding the fields. The adventurers also learned that there seemed to be a group of bandits on Mount Hyatt. After their scheme to sneak into the fields failed, they could only slowly head back into town and make other plans.

Once the time was about right, and after accompanying Al-lon to pick up his clothes, a handsome suit with a small red bow tie that looked very dashing on him, they all headed together to Podrick's Cafe, which locals simply referred to as "the cafe."

Outside the cafe, they saw that Cash and Penny seemed to be having an argument, and learned that Penny had not known Cash was coming to the cafe that night as well. After the two of them went inside one after the other, the adventurers entered too. Guided by a server, Al-lon was led into the booth at the far right in the back of the cafe, while the other adventurers shared two tables with Cash, who was already seated.

Inside the booth, the youthful and radiant Penny looked exactly as Al-lon had remembered. As they talked, Al-lon learned quite a bit of hidden truth about the Spring Spirit election. Each household in Mudtown had to pay ten percent of its income or crops every month to the bandits of Mount Hyatt, but the family of the Spring Spirit was exempt from this rule. Because of that, many families pushed their own children to run for the role. What others did not know was that after being chosen, the Spring Spirit would be branded on the shoulder by Corn Miss of the council using a magical artifact with a mark called the Mark of Verdant, and once each month, when the mark began to ache, Corn Miss would bring the Spring Spirit to meet the bandits. According to Corn Miss, the Mark of Verdant could only be placed on girls, so even if Cash were somehow elected as Spring Spirit while remaining male, he would not be able to fulfill the role's obligations.

Al-lon was horrified to hear this. The bandits were real. From Penny's account, he learned that this Mark of Verdant was part of a ritual used by the bandit leader Oswald Creighton to control his own followers. Oswald had also threatened that if the ritual were not carried out every month, the bandits would lose control of their urges to burn, kill, and plunder, and would come down to wipe Mudtown out.

Yet according to Penny, every month when she went up the mountain, this bandit leader she called Big Os was actually kind and gentle to her and never harmed her. She believed that she had fallen in love with Big Os. What hurt Al-lon even more was hearing Penny say that she saw many similarities between Big Os and Al-lon: broad powerful shoulders, a good heart, and a nature that always thought of others. Penny said she had tried to persuade Big Os to run away with her so the two of them could escape this unchangeable fate together, but Big Os could not abandon his people, leaving Penny at a loss for what to do. Staring at the apple juice he had ordered before the meal, Al-lon found he could not bring himself to drink it. Instead, he bolted from the booth to the bathroom and pounded furiously at the mirror.

Outside the booth, the adventurers asked Cash about the Spring Spirit, only to discover that apart from noticing that his sister Penny disappeared for a day or two every month, he knew nothing. As for the next day's Spring Spirit election, Cash had no plan at all besides begging the adventurers for help. After some time, Leah decided to turn into a fly in the bathroom and fly into Al-lon and Penny's booth to eavesdrop. However, this happened to be exactly when Al-lon burst out of the booth and ran to the bathroom, so Leah ended up hearing nothing.

When Al-lon came out of the bathroom and returned to the table with Cash and the other adventurers, he tore off his bow tie, shouted several angry things, and started ranting about wiping out the bandits. He even came up with the idea of negotiating with the council by offering to eliminate the bandits in exchange for the Applewood branch they needed. The others were stunned that Al-lon had suddenly spilled so much information and was thinking this clearly. Not long after, Penny's scream rang out from the booth.

The adventurers rushed over together and found Leah lying on the table in front of Penny. It turned out Penny had seen a fly on the table and casually swatted at it. Leah had not been able to dodge in time, and the moment she was hit, she reverted to her true form, terrifying Penny.

This naturally led to all of the adventurers entering the booth as well. Together with the Applewood siblings, they gathered all the information they knew so far, and at Penny's suggestion, decided that after tomorrow's Spring Spirit election, they should be able to go up the mountain together the day after that to meet the bandits. By Penny's calculation, barring any surprises, that should be the next time her mark started to ache.

The adventurers first sent the Applewood siblings home, and also brought Al-lon's parents to the Raven Nexus to stay the night. Afterward, the adventurers returned to Riley's office on the second floor of the Raven Nexus and reported their plan to Riley and Mr. Green.

The adventurers returned to the third floor and prepared for bed. Kaname had originally wanted to chat with Al-lon's parents, but she quickly realized that their way of raising Al-lon seemed seriously flawed. She could not tell whether the problem was with his parents specifically or whether earth gnome culture was simply like that. So Kaname and Fur went to Al-lon's room to comfort him. At the same time, Leah took Roel, literally tying Roel to herself, for a walk in the nearby woods to pick some fruit to give Al-lon. In the forest, Leah also felt the radiance of Necis, as though she had come slightly closer to the god. Yet of the two fruits they finally managed to find, Roel ate one while Leah was meditating, leaving only a single fruit to bring back to Al-lon.

After waking early, everyone went together to the office on the second floor to see Riley and Mr. Green, and had the simple bread they had prepared for the adventurers as breakfast. Mr. Green said he would next go prepare for the Spring Spirit election, where he would serve as the neutral third-party vote supervisor.

The adventurers decided that during the hour or two remaining before the election, they would first visit the Applewood family. Addie had already left home and gone to the council to prepare for the voting, while Penny had long since set out with her parade through the plaza. So the adventurers decided to head to the council as well.

When they arrived, before Mr. Green had shown up, only three representatives were in the council's waiting area. After a brief discussion with them, the adventurers confirmed that the "bandits" were indeed real, and learned that this bandit group had an impressive name: the Mount Hyatt Symphony. They also learned that Connie Cornell, known as Corn Miss, handled all these various "traditions," and that they were inherited customs, which slightly reduced the adventurers' hostility toward her. However, from Connie they also learned that the Mark of Verdant used on the Spring Spirit seemed closely tied to the Spring Spirit's menstrual cycle, which made it even clearer that Cash, whom they had hoped might run, could never actually be chosen.

Corn Miss and Wheat Mister temporarily stepped away, leaving the adventurers to speak privately with Addie. The adventurers proposed going up the mountain to wipe out the bandits in exchange for the Applewood branch Riley had asked them to find. On top of that, they would also receive gold equal in amount to the town's population. Addie did not strongly object to the proposal, but asked the adventurers to come find him again after the vote, because he needed to discuss the outcome with the other council members first.

After leaving the council, the adventurers headed to the voting grounds. They happened to run into Penny's grand procession, and Penny made a point of greeting Al-lon. Torn by complicated emotions, Al-lon had no idea what expression he ought to wear. Before the voting began, the adventurers also found the other Spring Spirit candidate they had met the day before: Maribel. Maribel clearly knew she had almost no chance of winning, but still insisted on running. Because everyone felt Penny had broken Al-lon's heart, the adventurers decided to help Maribel out. Maribel thanked them and promised that regardless of the election result, she would treat them to a meal that night.

When the time came, Connie and Mr. Green stepped onto the stage together. Connie briefly explained the voting procedure: each person would come up to receive a ballot, sign a separate sheet to confirm they had received one, then write down their chosen Spring Spirit candidate on the ballot and place it in the box. Connie then introduced the candidates: the three-time reigning Spring Spirit Penny Applewood, and her challenger Maribel Muddlewick. The difference in momentum between the two was overwhelming. Aside from the adventurers, Maribel quite obviously had no supporters at all. The adventurers also noticed that Penny looked slightly unwell, reminding them again of what they had heard from Connie about the Mark of Verdant's strong connection to the menstrual cycle. They also remembered Penny's comment from the previous night that she would soon have to go up the mountain again.

When the votes were counted, Penny had received over a hundred, while Maribel got only six. There were also more than twenty invalid ballots. Maribel accepted her loss with grace. Though naturally disappointed, there was nothing she could do. Under Connie's direction, Penny named her own Spring Knight retinue: the "Evil Be-4," as Al-lon called them, and "Al-lon and his friends."

As the Spring Spirit election came to an end, the people of Mudtown celebrated enthusiastically. The adventurers heard Connie announce that at midnight tonight, Penny would go to Mount Hyatt in her role as Spring Spirit, escorted by the Spring Knights. The thought of having to act alongside the Evil Be-4 made the adventurers feel physically ill.

Thinking of the Evil Be-4 brought Pibble's stench to mind, or rather directly to their noses. The adventurers tried to wash him clean, and the people of Mudtown, swept up in the celebratory mood, joined in the commotion. Together they threw Pibble into the Vay-El River that ran through the plaza and forced him to scrub himself. After nearly half an hour, Pibble looked visually spotless, but once he stepped back out of the river, the foul stench clinging to him was still dizzying. The townsfolk eventually grew tired of the farce and drifted away.

Nearby, the adventurers spotted Maribel alone and struck up a conversation. Maribel was very grateful for the votes they had cast for her and invited them all to her home, saying she would cook lunch for everyone.

The adventurers discovered that Maribel lived alone in a rather nice house. It was not luxurious, but its furnishings and books were all tasteful. Maribel explained that her parents had been away traveling for two years and still had not returned, but that had also forced her to develop all the practical skills needed to take care of herself. Kaname and Fur noticed that Maribel's books covered a wide variety of subjects, and Maribel said that reading was simply what she loved to do, and that she read almost anything. When they pulled one book from the shelf, it turned out to be about the history of technological development in the Kingdom of Cliomen, and it was even written in Dwarvish. Kaname strongly invited Maribel to visit her land-based book collection someday, but Maribel said she first wanted to finish reading the books she still had before she would feel like traveling.

When the food was set on the table, the adventurers discovered that Maribel was also an excellent cook. She told them to begin eating and said she would keep bringing out more dishes, but the adventurers felt bad and wanted to wait until she could sit down and eat with them. At the table, they learned that Maribel was actually clever, brave, and very capable of independent thought. She had also heard a little about the bandits, and could already guess that the Spring Spirit and the bandits were deeply connected. If she had been chosen Spring Spirit, she had hoped she might have had the chance to go up the mountain and negotiate with the bandits, and find a solution that would benefit both them and Mudtown. But next year she would come of age and no longer qualify to run for Spring Spirit, so that wish would simply have to drift away on the wind.

The adventurers felt so sorry for Maribel that they tried all kinds of ways to invite her to join their adventuring party, convinced that she would enjoy the adventuring life as well. Maribel, however, clearly did not share that idea.

After lunch, the adventurers went to visit the Council of Sols. Addie said that he and the council had reached an agreement: if the adventurers would eliminate the bandits, the council would give them the Applewood branch they needed, along with a reward in gold equal to the town's population.

wilds-c03-chpt02.title: Chapter 2: Banditry is a State of Mind

image.alt: Banditry is a State of Mind chapter art

paragraphs: 距離康妮與冒險者們說好的午夜還有很長的時間，冒險者們思索著該如何妥善利用。在阿龍的帶領下，大家先到了城內的雜貨店，進行補給。阿龍買了一些釘子，以預備上山後和山賊們的戰鬥。其他冒險者們也進行了簡單的補給。
雜貨店內沒有阿龍想買的藥水，因此大家就到了隔壁的藥品店。然而因為藥水的要價不菲，大家決定作罷。毛毛的神色卻有些不自然，似乎是趁著老闆不注意時，幹了什麼勾當。
離開藥品店後，冒險者們決定分頭進行。雷亞看見了阿龍買的釘子，腦中冒出了些點子，因此動身前往附近的樹林，找尋他眼中合適的樹枝；鑰和毛毛先返回渡鴉中樞見見阿龍的父母，順便簡單休息；羅羅去了趟武器行，買了一把輕弩和一組箭。不久後，雷亞將樹枝帶回，和阿龍要了釘子後，便簡單的手工做了一把釘頭錘，雖然沒有像武器行那麼穩固，不過還算堪用。
接近傍晚，冒險者們都已回到了他們在渡鴉中樞三樓的客房。大家各自取了晚餐，阿龍也特別為綠先生準備了一份。接著大家便一起走到了二樓的萊里和綠先生的辦公室。
此時冒險者們只見綠先生一人獨自在辦公室內。阿龍將晚餐遞給綠先生以釋出善意，同時大家也和綠先生詢問著稍晚上山「剿匪」的計劃。他們這才發現，綠先生從來沒有跟隨康妮或春天精靈上山過。起初，綠先生對於上山這一件事，也沒有多大的興趣，但在冒險者們的請求下，他才勉為其難的答應。同時，萊里正好回到辦公室，也答應了讓綠先生一起上山的計劃。
不過，由於冒險者們需要在午夜時和康妮等人集合，雖然此時才剛日落左右，也得先休息了，以免精神不濟。
門口傳來叩叩叩的敲門聲。萊里在完成公務後，一一朝冒險者們的房間敲門，提醒他們起床準備。
冒險者們帶著與山賊奮戰的心，來到二樓與綠先生會合。大家一起走向與康妮說好的集合地點—議會門口。然而，此時冒險者們看到的就只有提前抵達，正在玩鬧的「壞四人」。
阿龍試著和壞四人溝通，要他們安靜點，不要吵到其他居民，但他很快地發現壞四人和他離開村莊前相比，沒有什麼長進，根本難以溝通。甚至稍早他手動洗過的皮柏身上的味道早已恢復成原本的狀態了。
不久後，遠方傳來兩人的腳步聲。毛毛雨下，康妮撐著傘，傘下的佩妮踏著輕快的步伐，高聲朝著大家打招呼。雖然面對佩妮的情緒已變得有些扭曲，阿龍還是挺開心的。
康妮看見初次加入隊伍的綠先生，有些困惑，但在佩妮認為沒有妨礙的前提下，也就讓綠先生同行了。
午夜，春天精靈與他的春天騎士團們出發，前往海雅特山，準備去見名為「海雅特山交響樂」的山賊。
路程中，壞四人聒噪又忍人厭的各種胡鬧，讓阿龍看了很不開心，內心也質問著「到底佩妮為什麼會把這些人要召進他的春天騎士團內？」但當然，他也沒有得到答案。
早餐與午餐都在路邊簡單用過後，日落前，春天騎士團終於來到了海雅特山交響樂的領地口。康妮提醒大家，要大家不要招惹山賊，如果他們不讓大家進去，也不要強迫闖入。這讓大家也感到有些困惑—既然大家是要去與山賊交戰，還談什麼禮節呢？
領地口兩根高聳的樹幹前，各站了一名山賊，而其中一名很顯然的就是大奧斯了，佩妮一見到他，彷彿身體沒有任何不適，快速地衝了上去抱緊他。看在阿龍眼裡，格外眼紅。
佩妮請求大奧斯讓他的春天騎士團一起進入領地內，而大奧斯看了看所有來訪的人們，最終決定，除了「議會的走狗」康妮外，其他人都可以進去。對於第一次來就能輕鬆進去的綠先生，康妮很不是滋味，他試圖與山賊們溝通，卻只迎來大奧斯呼喚一名女性山賊同胞將康妮接到領地口外的帳篷休息區。

隨著康妮消失在視野外，大奧斯和他的夥伴像是鬆了一口氣般，卸下了嚴肅的神情，嬉鬧著、笑著，迎接春天騎士團們一起走入領地。他招呼著大家，關心著大家是否肚子餓了還沒吃晚餐？接著帶著大家朝著領地中心走去。大家詫異著，這群「山賊」竟然毫無惡意，還如此友善，與土城內大家描述的「收取過路費的惡霸」完全不一樣。大奧斯也笑著說，這就是為何不讓康妮進來的原因—不能讓議會知道真相。冒險者們似懂非懂，但對於「討伐山賊」這件事，也更沒有把握了。
一路上，大奧斯快速地向他們介紹，他們有自己的農場、牧場、餐廳、酒館，可以說是自給自足，比起山賊的營地，更像是個小型的聚落。來到中央的廣場，幾名山賊正用木柴搭建起一座營火，大奧斯示意大家先坐下來休息，他也和佩妮找了個角落坐了下來，看得阿龍又眼紅了。
一名山賊彈奏著魯特琴，一名則身著類似涅西斯風格的教袍，像個牧師一樣，還有一名山賊遞了酒給大家喝。冒險者們與山賊們漸漸開啟了溝通。雷亞和牧師習得了許多他不知道的關於涅西斯的教義；鑰也和當地的「財務官」山賊拿到了他們詳盡的收支記錄，發現從土城徵收的錢，除了部分繳交給他們的上級組織外，其他幾乎都是拿來買作物或和附近的聚落打交道用的。
除此之外，還有一名看起來有點笨拙的新手打鐵匠山賊，十分討冒險者們歡心。

在冒險者們的詢問下，他們得知海雅特山交響樂的上級組織，是自稱「砍殺交響樂」的組織—他們視殺戮為一種美妙的音樂，享受其中。而砍殺交響樂的組織龐大，除了如海雅特山交響樂這種聚於山上的「山賊」外，各大城市內的黑道、黑市等也幾乎都是他們的下線，影響力擴及整個帝國。介於砍殺交響樂與土城之間的海雅特山交響樂則身份尷尬，他們對土城的惡形，幾乎都是基於要交代給砍殺交響樂的目的，要是逃跑，只會被取下人頭拎回來示眾。對此，冒險者們聽了，提供了大奧斯一些建議，但對大奧斯來說都不夠好。
在佩妮的同意下，大奧斯也提出了佩妮過去的提議：他曾私下和大奧斯提出私奔的想法，兩人一起逃離這是非之地，換個身份，浪漫的活下去。佩妮認為家人什麽都他都能拋棄，但對於大奧斯的愛，他放不下。而大奧斯也因為放不下對他的手下，他的兄弟們的義氣，而無法承諾私奔。
吃飽喝足後，在牧師的引領下，佩妮踏出營火圈，走向營火邊的牧師。儀式就要開始了。
在牧師帶頭吟誦後，佩妮身上的翠綠印記開始發光，而佩妮則面露難色，但不久後，佩妮的神色開始緩解。冒險者們仔細一看，發現營火圈外的山賊們此時卻直冒冷汗，咬牙切齒—就像是佩妮身上的痛處，轉移到他們身上去了一樣。這讓冒險者們更困惑了。
儀式結束後，佩妮很明顯的看起來舒服與開心很多。他大聲謝謝牧師與其他山賊後，便快步回到大奧斯身邊。對此，冒險者們有很多疑惑，便向牧師詢問。牧師表示這個儀式是古老的 Nessis 儀式，用處是分攤痛處，而把他用在春天精靈身上，只是他們的主意罷了，說白了，和砍殺交響樂也沒有什麼關係。佩妮看向冒險者，表示自己說每個月上山很辛苦的部分，其實是爬山的時候，他很感激山賊們為他分攤痛楚。
冒險者們繼續詢問，得知砍殺交響樂會不定期上山來催款，如果沒有繳出應有的款項，就會有人頭落地—就算有繳出，也不保證所有人都能安全活下來。也因此，海雅特山交響樂幾乎每個月都在徵招新人，那名呆呆的新手打鐵匠，就是上個月剛加入的新人。
阿龍的內心很混亂：面對如此難以預測又霸道的上級組織，海雅特山交響樂卻也不逃脫、不反抗；說好上山要剿匪，結果這群山賊竟然是一群請大家喝酒吃肉、唱歌跳舞的山民；還有，佩妮的手什麼時候才要從大奧斯身上拿下來，不對，他的嘴唇怎麼貼上大奧斯的臉頰了！？
山賊們向冒險者們介紹了提供給他們過夜的空間：一個人一間獨立的小木屋，讓大家不受打擾。（鑰決定先把毛毛安置在和他相同的房間，以免入夜後阿龍跑去刮毛毛的毛，或是像之前一樣把毛毛當成毛巾來用—而毛毛在營火前，似乎已經從眾山賊們口袋中摸走了不少錢。）
大奧斯也告訴大家，明天早上在大家下山前，可以讓大家參觀一下他們這裡的各個環境。
冒險者們睡前簡單討論了一下明天的計劃：「剿匪」這條路似乎是行不通了，甚至可以說，上山這趟根本就是白費了。要拿到蘋果木，最簡單的做法，似乎還是下山後偷偷潛入 Applewood 家的領地，砍斷蘋果木，讓它從維爾河順流而下，達成萊里要的條件。
醒來後，冒險者們簡單收拾，來到已熄滅的營火前，和山賊拿了早餐。
雷亞在一名曾任警官的山賊的帶領下，到附近的樹林深處，感受 Nessis 的力量。他發現，在這裡，是近期他所能感受最強烈的神性，甚至沒有任何殺戮的痕跡，讓他感到非常平靜。
冒險者們、綠先生與壞四人等在大奧斯的帶領下，走到了領地口，此時康妮也在負責他起居的山賊帶領下，與他們會面。佩妮依依不捨地和大奧斯道別，眾人準備下山。
「—他、他們來了！」一聲喧囂打破佩妮和大奧斯的離別之情，也敲醒了阿龍逐漸消去的戰意。

There was still a long time to go before the midnight meeting Connie had arranged with the adventurers, so they considered how best to make use of it. Led by Al-lon, they first went to a general store in town to resupply. Al-lon bought some nails to prepare for the battle with the bandits after they headed up the mountain. The other adventurers also did some simple restocking.

The general store did not have the potions Al-lon wanted, so the group went next door to the apothecary. However, since the potions were quite expensive, everyone decided against buying any. Fur, however, looked slightly unnatural, as if he had gotten up to something while the shopkeeper was not paying attention.

After leaving the apothecary, the adventurers split up. Leah saw the nails Al-lon had bought and got a few ideas, so she headed to the nearby woods to look for branches she considered suitable. Kaname and Fur returned first to the Raven Nexus to see Al-lon's parents and get a little rest. Roel went to a weapons shop and bought a light crossbow and a set of bolts. Not long after, Leah returned with some branches, asked Al-lon for the nails, and quickly crafted a crude nail-headed mace by hand. It was not as sturdy as anything from a weapons shop, but it was usable enough.

By early evening, all the adventurers had returned to their guest rooms on the third floor of the Raven Nexus. Everyone picked up dinner for themselves, and Al-lon also specially prepared a portion for Mr. Green. Then they all went together to Riley and Mr. Green's office on the second floor.

At that moment, they found only Mr. Green alone in the office. Al-lon handed him the dinner as a gesture of goodwill, while the others asked him about the plan to go up the mountain later and "wipe out the bandits." They only then discovered that Mr. Green had never accompanied Connie or the Spring Spirit up the mountain before. At first, he had little interest in going, but after the adventurers pressed him, he reluctantly agreed. Just then Riley returned to the office as well, and also approved the plan for Mr. Green to go along.
However, since the adventurers needed to meet Connie and the others at midnight, even though the sun had only just set, they still needed to rest first so they would not be exhausted.
A knocking sound came from the door. After finishing her work, Riley went around knocking on each adventurer's room to remind them to get up and prepare.

With their hearts set on battling bandits, the adventurers met up with Mr. Green on the second floor. Together they headed to the agreed meeting point with Connie, the entrance to the council hall. However, the only people there when they arrived were Evil Be-4, who had shown up early and were fooling around.

Al-lon tried to talk to Evil Be-4 and tell them to quiet down so they would not disturb the other residents, but he quickly realized that compared to before he left the village, they had not improved at all and were impossible to reason with. Even Piper, whom he had personally scrubbed earlier, already smelled just as bad again as before.

Not long after, the sound of two approaching sets of footsteps came from the distance. In a light drizzle, Connie walked under an umbrella, while Penny beneath it stepped forward briskly and greeted everyone loudly. Even though Al-lon's feelings toward Penny had become somewhat twisted by now, he was still happy to see her.
Connie looked a little confused when she noticed Mr. Green joining the group for the first time, but since Penny said it would not cause any trouble, she let him come along.
At midnight, the Spring Spirit and her Spring Knights set out for Mount Hyatt to meet the bandits known as the Mount Hyatt Symphony.

Along the way, Evil Be-4 carried on with their loud, irritating antics, which made Al-lon deeply unhappy. Inwardly he kept asking himself, "Why on earth would Penny recruit people like this into her Spring Knights?" Naturally, he got no answer.

After eating a simple breakfast and lunch by the roadside, the Spring Knights finally reached the entrance to the Mount Hyatt Symphony's territory before sunset. Connie reminded everyone not to provoke the bandits, and said that if they were refused entry, they should not force their way in. This left everyone somewhat confused. If they were supposedly here to fight bandits, why were they worrying about manners?

At the entrance, two bandits stood before a pair of towering tree trunks, and one of them was very obviously Big Os. The moment Penny saw him, she rushed over and threw her arms around him as if her body felt no discomfort at all. To Al-lon, the sight was especially painful.

Penny asked Big Os to let her Spring Knights enter the territory with her. Big Os looked over everyone who had come and eventually decided that everyone except Connie, "the council's lapdog," could enter. Connie was clearly displeased that Mr. Green, who had never come before, was being allowed inside so easily. She tried to argue with the bandits, but all that got her was Big Os calling over a female bandit companion to escort Connie to a tented rest area outside the entrance.

As soon as Connie disappeared from view, Big Os and his companions seemed to breathe a sigh of relief. Their stern expressions dropped away, and they laughed and joked as they welcomed the Spring Knights inside. He greeted everyone warmly, asking whether they were hungry and had not yet eaten dinner, then led them toward the center of the territory. Everyone was stunned. These "bandits" were not hostile at all, and were in fact so friendly that they were nothing like the toll-collecting brutes the people of Mudcastle had described. Big Os laughingly said that this was exactly why Connie was not allowed in, the council could not be permitted to learn the truth. The adventurers only half understood, but they felt even less certain than before about this supposed "bandit extermination."

As they walked, Big Os quickly introduced the place to them. They had their own farms, ranches, restaurant, and tavern. It was basically self-sufficient, less like a bandit camp and more like a small settlement. When they reached the central square, several bandits were building a bonfire out of firewood. Big Os gestured for everyone to sit down and rest, and he and Penny found a corner to sit together in, much to Al-lon's jealousy.

One bandit played a lute, another wore robes in a style similar to that of Nessis and looked almost like a priest, and yet another passed around drinks for everyone. Gradually, the adventurers and the bandits began talking. Leah and the priest exchanged a great deal of doctrine about Nessis that Leah had never known before. Kaname also obtained the group's detailed records of income and expenditures from the local bandit "treasurer," and discovered that apart from the portion sent up to their superiors, almost all of the money collected from Mudcastle was used to buy crops or trade with nearby settlements.
There was also a somewhat clumsy novice blacksmith among the bandits, and the adventurers found him extremely endearing.

In response to the adventurers' questions, they learned that the Mount Hyatt Symphony answered to an upper organization calling itself the Slaughter Symphony, a group that viewed killing as a beautiful kind of music and took pleasure in it. The Slaughter Symphony was vast. In addition to mountain "bandit" groups like the Mount Hyatt Symphony, the underworld, black markets, and similar organizations in major cities were almost all subordinate to them, and their influence spread across the entire empire. The Mount Hyatt Symphony, stuck awkwardly between the Slaughter Symphony and Mudcastle, was in a difficult position. Their cruelty toward Mudcastle was almost entirely for the sake of having something to report upward to the Slaughter Symphony. If they tried to run, their heads would simply be chopped off and brought back as a warning. The adventurers listened and offered Big Os some suggestions, but none of them were good enough from his point of view.

With Penny's consent, Big Os also brought up a proposal Penny had made in the past. She had privately suggested that the two of them elope, escape this tangled place together, take on new identities, and live a romantic life elsewhere. Penny believed she could throw away everything else, even family, but she could not let go of her love for Big Os. And Big Os, unable to abandon his bond with his subordinates, his brothers, could not promise to run away with her.
After everyone had eaten and drunk their fill, Penny stepped out from the ring of the bonfire and walked toward the priest standing beside it. The ritual was about to begin.

Once the priest began the chant, the Verdant Seal on Penny's body started to glow. Penny grimaced in pain, but before long her expression began to ease. Looking more closely, the adventurers realized that the bandits standing outside the bonfire circle were instead sweating heavily and clenching their teeth, as if Penny's pain had somehow been transferred onto them. This only left the adventurers more confused.

When the ritual ended, Penny very clearly looked far more comfortable and cheerful. After loudly thanking the priest and the other bandits, she hurried back to Big Os's side. The adventurers had many questions, so they asked the priest. He explained that this ritual was an ancient Nessis rite used to divide and share pain, and that using it on the Spring Spirit was simply their own idea. To put it bluntly, it had nothing to do with the Slaughter Symphony at all. Penny turned to the adventurers and said that when she had complained about how hard it was to come up the mountain each month, what she had really meant was the climb itself, and that she was grateful to the bandits for sharing her pain.

The adventurers kept asking questions and learned that the Slashing Symphony came up the mountain at irregular times to collect dues. If the proper payments were not made, heads would roll, and even if payment was made, there was no guarantee that everyone would survive safely. Because of that, the Mount Hyatt Symphony recruited new members almost every month. That clumsy novice blacksmith was one such newcomer, having joined just last month.

Al-lon's heart was in utter chaos. Faced with such an overbearing and unpredictable higher organization, the Mount Hyatt Symphony neither fled nor resisted. They had come up the mountain to kill bandits, yet these bandits were mountain folk who invited everyone to drink, eat meat, sing, and dance. And another thing, when exactly was Penny going to take her hand off Big Os? No, wait, when did her lips get pressed against his cheek?!

The bandits showed the adventurers the sleeping arrangements they had prepared: one private cabin per person, so everyone could rest undisturbed. Kaname decided to keep Fur in the same room as her for the time being, lest Al-lon decide in the middle of the night to shave Fur's fur again, or use Fur like a towel as before. Fur, meanwhile, seemed to have already lifted quite a bit of money from the pockets of the gathered bandits while they were around the bonfire.
Big Os also told everyone that the next morning, before they went back down the mountain, he could show them around the various parts of the settlement.

Before going to sleep, the adventurers briefly discussed their plan for tomorrow. The route of "bandit extermination" seemed completely unworkable. In fact, it almost felt as though this whole trip up the mountain had been pointless. If they wanted to obtain the Applewood branch, the simplest method now seemed to be sneaking into the Applewood family's land after going back down, cutting off an apple branch, and letting it float down the Veil River to fulfill Riley's condition.
After waking up, the adventurers tidied themselves up and came to the extinguished bonfire, where the bandits handed them breakfast.

Led by a bandit who had once served as a police officer, Leah went deep into the nearby woods to feel the power of Nessis. She found that here, more than anywhere she had been recently, she could sense the strongest divine presence, and there was not even a trace of killing in it, which left her feeling deeply peaceful.

The adventurers, Mr. Green, and Evil Be-4 followed Big Os to the edge of the territory, where Connie was waiting for them as well, having been brought there by the bandit assigned to care for her. Penny reluctantly said goodbye to Big Os, and the group prepared to head back down the mountain.
"T-they're here!" A sudden shout shattered the tender mood of parting between Penny and Big Os, and snapped Al-lon's fading fighting spirit awake once more.

paragraphs: 細劍戳向從遠方跑回的海雅特交響樂山賊背後，阿龍即時將細劍撥開，拯救了山賊的性命。
三名穿著黑色皮甲的人—方才拿著細劍的人類男子、一名咧著嘴笑的大型哥布林，以及一名壯碩、灰色皮膚的魔人—停下馬，緩緩走了下來，阿龍也第一次看到大奧斯的眼神充斥著恐懼。哥布林雙手各拖著一個麻布袋。
在魔人的威嚇下，大奧斯衝動地表示，這次他們沒有要繳錢給上層了，他們將反抗到底。此時，哥布林將一個布袋遞給了細劍男，兩人分別將布袋打開，並把武器架在從布袋中露出的俘虜的脖子上。那是一對年長的地侏男女。阿龍睜大眼睛一看，幸好不是他的父母，但他和綠先生都只記得看過這兩人，卻認不得。
細劍男子要男地侏留下他的遺言，這名地侏說道：「如果你們回到土城，請轉達給我的女兒，瑪莉貝爾— 這世界遠比她想的更廣闊。不要把自己被土城。土城無法理解她，但這個世界的其他地方，都將為她閃耀。」而當女地侏正要開口時，哥布林將巨斧砍向他的脖子，細劍男也在男地侏的脖子上劃了一刀。
隨著兩名地侏應聲落地，戰鬥一觸即發。
康妮在第一時間便撤離回海雅特交響樂的營地內，壞四人當中的其中兩人也跑了進去，但他們的兩名同伴慌亂之際，撞到了彼此，雙雙倒臥在地。
佩妮慌了，大奧斯則分心作戰，掩護佩妮的同時盡可能地擊退敵人，還要鼓舞他的山賊夥伴們。冒險者們從各個不同的位置分別向不同的敵人攻擊，而海雅特交響樂山賊們也盡可能地對敵人造成傷害，但他們的損傷很顯然的更嚴重。
突然，一陣音樂響起。戰場外，一名身著黑色皮衣，手持吉他的紅髮女子赫然出現在大家眼前，聲波讓大家感到暈眩。「海雅特終章」的成員就此到齊。

冒險者們發現在海雅特終章面前，山賊們的戰力根本無法相比，而他們嘗試施放的法術，甚至還有可能會被魔人的力量所抵消。鑰決定施法，將戰場轉換成一個沒有聲音的環境。無聲的戰鬥依然血腥，山賊們一一倒下。一瞬間，魔人現身在佩妮身邊，而佩妮看起來像是只剩一口氣了。大奧斯看了一眼阿龍，唇語說著「對不起，阿龍，我想你能理解的」。語畢，大奧斯將戰錘揮向魔人的手，將佩妮營救出來，便馬上往樹林跑去。魔人愣了一下，很快就追上。
細劍男子很快被山賊們、綠先生，以及冒險者們擊倒，冒險者們也發現他的臉上竟然是貼著一張人皮。不久後，在無法用聲波攻擊的前提下，吉他女子也只剩下將他的吉他當作武器，因此很快也就倒下了。最後，在所有剩下的人圍攻下，哥布林終於倒臥在地，但山賊們也少了不少夥伴。
眼看魔人追著大奧斯和佩妮，阿龍大喊著：「你最好給我跑的遠遠的！」接著，他和毛毛便快速跟上。阿龍眼眶滿是淚水，還不慎摔了一跤，背在背上的毛毛則看見魔人將抱著佩妮的大奧斯拐向旁邊，便消失了蹤影。
阿龍和毛毛蹣跚地走回營地口。眼看戰鬥結束，山賊們紛紛落寞地走回營地內，開始收拾家當。沒了他們的領袖，大家沒有任何眷戀，都打算下山去了。阿龍聽說有個魔法，可以透過所屬者的物品，找到他的位置，因此他到處翻找，找到了一件應該是屬於大奧斯的背心，收在了背包內。雷亞拾獲了哥布林留下的巨斧以及紅髮女已經被敲碎的吉他碎片。
康妮和清醒的兩名壞四人各騎上了一匹馬（兩名壞四人各帶著一名昏迷的同伴），羅羅則騎上最後一批。鑰將瑪莉貝爾的父母用布袋裝好後放進他的推車內。眾人在雨中，回到了土城。
土城剛入夜，雨勢則已經大到有些難以控制了。
康妮先帶大家回到了太陽議會。他敲了敲門，艾迪開了門後，眼睛直盯著阿龍，問他任務是否完成，緊接着也問他是不是已經將他女兒安全的送回家了？阿龍一時語塞，表示現在沒有山賊的問題了，但也表示佩妮沒有跟著他們回來。他向艾迪發誓，他會將佩妮找回來。
艾迪臉色鐵青，剛剛阿龍說的話，他彷彿都沒有聽進去一樣。
「你說你要蘋果木是吧？好啊，走啊。」艾迪逕自走向雨中，朝著他們家的蘋果林走去，阿龍等人則跟上。「你要蘋果木？好啊，我就砍給你啊！」艾迪抄起放在農地的斧頭，大力地、隨意地向隨意一株蘋果木揮砍，眼神夾雜著癲狂與憤怒。阿龍也像失去理智一般，拿起武器，也大力地砍著。
蘋果木隨著艾迪與阿龍的揮砍，丟入了維爾河，慢慢地朝下游流去。羅羅見狀，趕緊朝下游奔去。
累攤了的艾迪，將斧頭丟向河裡。他雙腿發抖，靜靜的走下了山。阿龍與其他人也一併跟上。
同一時間，抱了滿滿的蘋果木，羅羅決定先回渡鴉中樞。萊里看見羅羅依約帶來他所要求的蘋果木，十分開心，也先將賞金給了羅羅，但也表示其他人的錢，必須要等他們回來後再給他們。
回到議會前，艾迪伸手，敲響了議會門口的鐘。土城的人們冒着雨，紛紛從家裡走了出來，聚集在議會前。
艾迪一手握着掛在胸前的金色蘋果，一邊大聲的地對着群中喊着：「我，艾迪・蘋果木，要動用我身為議會一員的權力。」接着，艾迪看向阿龍。「何阿龍，我在此將你從土城驅逐出境，永世再也不得踏入這裡一步。同時，我也要剝奪你的姓氏，從今以後，你再也不是何家人了。」眾人震驚之餘，艾迪用力捏碎手握的金蘋果，金色的碎屑掉落在了潮濕的地上。
「我要請辭我身為議會一員的身份。」艾迪平靜地說道。「我要把身份遞交給我的兒子，凱許・蘋果木。」凱許在人群中，用力掩飾內心的慌亂，慢慢走向他的父親，但艾迪的眼神中只有憤怒、狂亂，與道不盡的哀愁。
「將家族的榮華富貴建立在自己女兒的犧牲和痛苦身上，你竟敢還引以為榮。你是個可恥的人！保護他從來都是你的責任，不是我的。」阿龍憤怒的看向艾迪。「我會找到佩妮，不是因為他是你的女兒，而是因為他是我的春天精靈，從三年前到現在，他，一直都是我的春天精靈。」
阿龍憤怒地看向逐漸遠去的艾迪，人們紛紛低頭，只有瑪莉貝爾・莫德維克 一雙堅定的眼，看着他。阿龍也看見他的父母在人群中拭着淚。
「阿龍，對不起。」凱許從其他議會成員身邊走向阿龍。「我想動用我議員的權力撤銷我父親的決定，但我剛剛問了其他議員，他們說我父親的決定是無法撤銷的，對不起……」他用力抱了抱阿龍，哭得和阿龍一樣傷心。
人群們紛紛散去。阿龍拖着落寞的神情，看了最後一眼他的家鄉，然後朝着土城的入口走出。瑪莉貝爾與冒險者們會和，看見冒險者們對他有些支吾其詞，他大概猜到些什麼了。冒險者們將瑪莉貝爾父親的遺言轉達給他，他們也看見瑪莉貝爾眼中的憤怒。「離開吧，這是一個愚昧的小鎮。」阿龍對着瑪莉貝爾說道。
土城的入口，一座原本平滑乾淨的巨大石頭，現在上面刻了一行字：阿龍。
來到渡鴉中樞的門口，鑰詢問了瑪莉貝爾的意願後，讓瑪莉貝爾看了他的父母最後一面。瑪莉貝爾輕輕的在他父母的額頭上吻了一下，用雙手將他們的眼皮闔上，便頭也不回地走入了渡鴉中樞。
在雷亞的主持下，冒險者們為瑪莉貝爾的父母進行了簡單的葬禮，將他們小心埋入阿龍與綠先生在渡鴉中樞入口旁挖出的兩個洞內。
阿龍走入渡鴉中樞的一樓，看見他的父母，找他回他們在三樓的客房。其他冒險者們則先到了二樓萊里的辦公室去。
阿龍的父親將一個珍藏的盒子拿了出來，裡頭有兩個東西：一根翠綠色的角，以及一封信。他告訴阿龍，當年他們在河裡撿到阿龍時，除了他的但，還撿到了這兩個東西。當初，他們不知道那根角是什麼，但隨着阿龍長大，他們便發現，這是與阿龍相同族類的角—那是一根龍角。信上寫了滿滿的文字，但阿龍的父母看不懂，阿龍發現他也看不懂，便先收藏了起來。阿龍的母親表示，希望這些能讓阿龍更清楚找到自己的身世。
阿龍和父母道別後，便也來到萊里的辦公室內，瑪莉貝爾也在裡頭。萊里正將答應的酬勞分給冒險者們。
大家向阿龍詢問了剛才他與父母的對話後，阿龍便將信拿了出來，表示自己看不懂。雷亞一看，這是他懂的龍語，便從阿龍那拿來讀。不看也罷，一看，雷亞得到了一個簡單卻巨大的結論：「阿龍，你是王子！」
萊里看了也好奇，不過他只看懂當中的地名：達納迦。他仔細一看，發現這是個回文—倒過來看的字，是一個他知道的地名，拉撒拿。
萊里眼睛一亮，便告訴綠先生，這地方就在上次綠先生出差去的城鎮的隔壁。萊里請綠先生駕馬車，帶冒險者們前往拉撒拿，同時也能在回程時取得上次在隔壁城鎮請人做的分析結果。綠先生感到無奈，不僅與冒險者們出生入死後卻沒拿到金幣，下山後隔天還得馬上再出發出差去。但身為萊里的員工，他也沒有辦法。
在阿龍的答應下，雷亞借了阿龍取得的綠色龍角，決定將它做成一個項鍊，讓阿龍可以掛在脖子上。
瑪莉貝爾則下定了決心，離開土城這墮落的小鎮。在鑰和毛毛的陪同下，他們一起先走回了土城，讓瑪莉貝爾回家打包行李。他要遵循他父親的遺言，踏入這寬廣的世界。
走入土城時，瑪莉貝爾的眼神被一旁樹上的某個東西吸引了注意，不過他很快地就撇頭回來了。鑰和毛毛只注意到瑪莉貝爾的異狀，詢問後也沒得到結果，也就不追問了。
A rapier thrust toward the back of a Mount Hyatt Symphony bandit who had just run back from the distance, but Al-lon knocked the blade aside in time and saved the bandit's life.

Three figures in black leather armor, the human man who had been holding the rapier, a large goblin grinning broadly, and a burly gray-skinned tiefling, reined in their horses and slowly dismounted. It was the first time Al-lon had ever seen Big Os's eyes filled with fear. The goblin dragged a burlap sack in each hand.

Under the tiefling's intimidation, Big Os impulsively declared that this time they would not be paying the higher-ups any more money, and that they would resist to the bitter end. At that, the goblin handed one of the sacks to the rapier-wielding man. The two opened the sacks separately and put their weapons to the throats of the prisoners whose heads protruded from within. It was an elderly earth gnome couple. Al-lon widened his eyes and took a good look. Thankfully, they were not his parents, but neither he nor Mr. Green could recognize them beyond vaguely remembering having seen them before.

The rapier-wielding man demanded that the male earth gnome leave his final words. The gnome said, "If you return to Mudtown, please tell my daughter, Maribel, that the world is far broader than she thinks. She must not let herself be trapped by Mudtown. Mudtown cannot understand her, but elsewhere in this world, she will shine." Just as the female earth gnome was about to speak, the goblin swung a greataxe into her neck, and the rapier man slashed the male gnome's throat.
As the two earth gnomes fell to the ground, battle erupted instantly.

Connie immediately retreated back into the Mount Hyatt Symphony camp. Two of the Evil-Be4 also ran inside, but in their panic, their other two companions crashed into each other and both went sprawling onto the ground.

Penny panicked, while Big Os fought distractedly, trying both to shield Penny and to beat back the enemies as much as possible, while also rallying his fellow bandits. The adventurers attacked different enemies from different positions, and the Mount Hyatt Symphony bandits did their best to wound their attackers as well, but their losses were plainly much worse.

Suddenly, music rang out. Outside the battlefield, a red-haired woman in black leather, holding a guitar, appeared before them, and the sound waves made everyone dizzy. The members of "Hyatt Finale" had all arrived.

The adventurers quickly realized that the bandits were no match at all for Hyatt Finale, and that the spells they tried to cast might even be negated by the tiefling's power. Kaname decided to cast a spell that transformed the battlefield into an environment without sound. Even in silence, the battle remained bloody, and the bandits fell one after another. In an instant, the tiefling appeared beside Penny, who looked as though she had only a single breath left in her. Big Os glanced at Al-lon and mouthed, "I'm sorry, Al-lon. I think you understand." Then he swung his warhammer at the tiefling's hand, rescued Penny, and immediately ran for the forest. The tiefling froze for only a moment before quickly giving chase.

The rapier-wielding man was soon brought down by the bandits, Mr. Green, and the adventurers, and the adventurers discovered that his face was actually covered with a layer of human skin. Not long afterward, unable to use sonic attacks, the guitar woman was reduced to using her guitar as a weapon and was swiftly defeated as well. Finally, under the focused assault of everyone still standing, the goblin too collapsed to the ground, though the bandits had lost many companions in the process.

Seeing the tiefling pursuing Big Os and Penny, Al-lon shouted, "You'd better run as far away as you can!" Then he and Fur hurried after them. Tears filled Al-lon's eyes, and he even stumbled and fell. Riding on his back, Fur saw the tiefling force Big Os, who was carrying Penny, to turn aside, and then the three of them vanished from sight.

Al-lon and Fur staggered back to the camp entrance. With the battle over, the bandits walked back into camp in dejection and began packing up their belongings. Without their leader, none of them felt any attachment to the place anymore, and they all planned to head down the mountain. Al-lon had heard of a spell that could locate a person through an object belonging to them, so he searched everywhere until he found a vest that likely belonged to Big Os, and put it into his pack. Leah recovered the greataxe left behind by the goblin, as well as the smashed fragments of the red-haired woman's guitar.

Connie and the two conscious members of the Evil-Be4 each mounted a horse, with each of them carrying one unconscious companion, while Roel took the last horse. Kaname placed Maribel's parents into burlap sacks and loaded them into her cart. Together, in the rain, they returned to Mudtown.
Night had only just fallen on Mudtown, but by then the rain had grown so heavy it was hard to manage.

Connie first led everyone back to the Sun Council. She knocked on the door, and when Addie opened it, his eyes fixed directly on Al-lon. He asked whether the mission had been completed, and then immediately asked whether his daughter had been safely brought home. Al-lon fell briefly speechless. He said that the bandit problem was no longer an issue, but that Penny had not returned with them. He swore to Addie that he would bring Penny back.
Addie's face turned deathly pale. It was as if he had not heard a single word Al-lon had just said.

"You said you wanted Applewood, right? Fine. Come on, then." Addie marched straight out into the rain and headed for the family's apple grove, with Al-lon and the others following behind him. "You want Applewood? Fine. I'll chop it down for you!" Addie grabbed an axe that had been left near the fields and began hacking violently and indiscriminately at a random apple tree, his eyes full of rage and madness. Al-lon, as if he too had lost his reason, picked up a weapon and began chopping hard as well.
As Addie and Al-lon hacked away, branches of Applewood were thrown into the Veil River and slowly drifted downstream. Seeing this, Roel immediately sprinted after them along the river.
Exhausted, Addie hurled the axe into the river. His legs trembling, he quietly walked back down the mountain. Al-lon and the others followed him.

At the same time, carrying an armful of Applewood, Roel decided to head back first to the Raven Nexus. Riley was delighted to see that Roel had brought the Applewood she had requested as promised. She gave Roel the reward money immediately, though she added that the others would have to wait until they returned before receiving theirs.
Before going back inside the council, Addie reached out and rang the bell at the entrance. The people of Mudtown came out of their homes into the rain and gathered in front of the council.

Holding the golden apple hanging from his chest in one hand, Addie shouted loudly to the crowd, "I, Addie Applewood, am invoking my authority as a member of the council." Then he turned toward Al-lon. "Ho Al-lon, I hereby banish you from Mudtown. For all eternity, you may never again set foot here. At the same time, I strip you of your family name. From this day forward, you are no longer a member of the Ho family." As the crowd stared in shock, Addie crushed the golden apple in his fist, and glittering fragments fell onto the wet ground.

"I resign my seat on the council," Addie said calmly. "I hand that station over to my son, Cassius Applewood." From within the crowd, Cash forced down his panic and slowly walked toward his father, but Addie's eyes held nothing except anger, madness, and immeasurable grief.

"You built your family's wealth and glory on your own daughter's suffering and pain, and you still dared to take pride in it. You're a disgraceful man! Protecting her was always your responsibility, not mine." Al-lon glared at Addie in fury. "I will find Penny, not because she's your daughter, but because she is my Spring Spirit. From three years ago until now, she has always been my Spring Spirit."

Al-lon glared at Addie's retreating figure in anger as the townspeople lowered their heads one by one. Only Maribel Muddlewick met his gaze with firm eyes. Al-lon also saw his parents in the crowd, wiping away tears.

"Al-lon, I'm sorry." Cash came over to Al-lon from beside the other council members. "I wanted to use my authority as a councilor to revoke my father's decision, but I just asked the others, and they said my father's ruling can't be overturned. I'm sorry..." He hugged Al-lon tightly and cried just as hard as Al-lon did.

The crowd gradually dispersed. Wearing a desolate expression, Al-lon cast one final look at his hometown and then began walking toward the exit of Mudtown. Maribel rejoined the adventurers. Seeing how hesitant they were with her, she seemed to guess that something had happened. The adventurers passed on her father's final words to her, and they also saw the anger in Maribel's eyes. "Leave," Al-lon told her. "This is an ignorant little town."
At the entrance of Mudtown stood a huge rock that had once been smooth and clean. Now a single line had been carved into it: Al-lon.

When they reached the entrance to the Raven Nexus, Kaname asked what Maribel wanted, and then allowed her to see her parents one last time. Maribel gently kissed each of them on the forehead, closed their eyelids with both hands, and then walked into the Raven Nexus without looking back.
Under Leah's direction, the adventurers held a simple funeral for Maribel's parents and carefully buried them in two holes that Al-lon and Mr. Green had dug beside the entrance to the Raven Nexus.

Al-lon entered the first floor of the Raven Nexus, where he found his parents, who called him back to their guest room on the third floor. The other adventurers went first to Riley's office on the second floor.

Al-lon's father took out a treasured box. Inside were two things: a green horn and a letter. He told Al-lon that when they had found him in the river years ago, they had found these two items along with his egg. At the time, they had not known what the horn was, but as Al-lon grew older, they realized that it was the horn of the same kind of being as him, a dragon horn. The letter was filled with writing, but Al-lon's parents could not read it, and Al-lon discovered that he could not read it either, so he stored it away for the time being. Al-lon's mother said that she hoped these things might help him better understand his origins.
After saying goodbye to his parents, Al-lon also went to Riley's office, where Maribel was already present. Riley was in the middle of distributing the promised reward to the adventurers.

When everyone asked Al-lon what he and his parents had just discussed, he took out the letter and said that he could not read it. Leah took one look and recognized it as Draconic, a language she understood, so she took it from Al-lon and began to read. One glance was enough to give Leah a simple but enormous conclusion: "Al-lon, you're a prince!"

Riley was curious as well, though the only thing she could make out from it was the place name Danahtar. Looking more carefully, she realized it was a palindrome. Read backward, it became the place name she did know: Rathanad.

Riley's eyes lit up, and she told Mr. Green that this place was right next to the town he had traveled to on his last business trip. Riley asked Mr. Green to drive the carriage and take the adventurers to Rathanad, while also picking up the analysis results that had been commissioned in the neighboring town on the return trip. Mr. Green felt helpless. Not only had he risked life and limb alongside the adventurers and still not gotten any gold, but the very next day after coming back down the mountain, he would have to leave again on another business trip. Still, as Riley's employee, he had no choice.
With Al-lon's permission, Leah borrowed the green dragon horn Al-lon had acquired and decided to turn it into a necklace so Al-lon could wear it around his neck.

Maribel, meanwhile, made up her mind to leave the rotten little town of Mudtown behind. Accompanied by Kaname and Fur, they walked back to town with her so she could pack her things. She intended to follow her father's final words and step out into the wider world.

As they entered Mudtown, something in a tree to the side caught Maribel's eye, though she quickly turned away again. Kaname and Fur only noticed that something seemed off about her, and when their questions got no answer, they let the matter drop.

wilds-c04-chpt01.title: Chapter 1: Lunch with the 艾瑞利斯s

image.alt: Lunch with the 艾瑞利斯s chapter art

paragraphs: 從土城，加入了瑪莉貝爾的冒險者們花了一個月左右的時間，乘坐綠先生駕駛的馬車，終於抵達了拉撒拿。
拉撒拿是一座建立在山丘上的城鎮，走入入口後，便是一路向上的緩坡，而最接近天際之處，是一座宏大的宅邸。冒險者們一眼望去，除了他們之外，舉目皆是龍人。
想著從父母手上拿到的信件，阿龍意識到自己是以「貴族」、「王子」的身份，回到拉撒拿，讓他興奮不已。然而，身為龍人的他，卻不諳龍語，因此只能透過普通語，嘗試和「他的子民們」分享他的喜悅。阿龍的行為，卻只換得當地龍人的碎語（唯一聽得懂龍語的雷雅，可以聽得出來，阿龍得到的回應，盡是覺得他是白痴、瘋子）。不久後，他們也才發現，其實這裡的龍人們多數都是懂普通語的，也讓大家稍微鬆了一口氣。
隨著夜色漸黑，冒險者們決定還是得先找個下榻的地方。他們找了附近的一間酒館，拉了兩張桌子坐下，準備開始點餐。這裡的餐點似乎主要以肉類為主，佐以麵包，而不知道是酒館的關係還是拉撒拿當地的特性，酒類只有啤酒而已，但也是有不同款式的啤酒可以做選擇。
冒險者們發現了不遠處的一張桌子，有一名龍人引起了他們的注意。那是一名角不對稱的老年龍人，喝著酒，說話顛三倒四，而他身邊則是一隻看起來舉止優雅的中年銀色龍人。冒險者們想起阿龍信中那名斷了角的老僕人，莫非，這就是他？
在與這兩名龍人攀談後，冒險者們邀請他們加入他們的座位，並請他們喝了酒。老年龍人自我介紹名為尼克索，或是大家喜歡稱呼他的方式，老尼克索，而他旁邊的則是在拉撒拿唯一一家魔法商店當老闆的哈洛・米佐。阿龍心急地掏出那塊他父母交給他的龍角，嘗試對著老尼克索的角進行比對，而老尼克索也認了出來，那便是他快二十年前折斷的那支角。
「少爺，你終於回來了！」
阿龍拚命詢問老尼克索與哈洛關於自己的事。他得知，這裡的領導者，被稱為「龍冠」的存在，是艾瑞利斯家族，而他是艾瑞利斯現任龍冠唯一的子嗣，卻也的確是被他父母拋棄的孩子。他甚至有個自己的名字，賽拉尼爾・艾瑞利斯。
阿龍焦急著自己該怎麼做。他對於自己的繼承權並沒有太大的渴望，但他的確想見見這兩名當初將他拋棄的父母。同時，他也更希望這個以魔法為傲的家族，有辦法幫他追蹤到他苦覓不得的佩妮與大奧斯。比起自己，這件事似乎成為了他冒險主要的驅動力。
老尼克索鼓吹阿龍明天去見見他的家人，但瑪莉貝爾希望阿龍不要馬上答應。他認為太輕易的相信這兩名剛認識的陌生人，不一定是件好事。哈洛提議，冒險者們可以想想，如果要的話，明天早上到他在中城區的魔法商店找他，他在帶大家去接老尼克索，大夥兒在一起去見艾瑞利斯家。
阿龍也透過哈洛，得知現在艾瑞利斯家除了他的父母外，他的叔叔一家也住在那，包含他的叔叔、嬸嬸、堂姐、堂妹，以及堂弟。而當然，他們一家也都會魔法。
不久後，哈洛攙扶著酒醉的老尼克索走出了酒館，冒險者們則紛紛和酒館老闆付了住宿的錢，上樓休息了。瑪莉貝爾堅持自己一間，寧可多花一些錢，來得到一些獨處的時間。
「我有兩對父母，但一對不是親生的，一對把我拋棄了，跟你沒有父母好像也差不多欸！」
阿龍試圖透過開玩笑來和瑪莉貝爾拉近距離，但很顯然的，他沒有發現自己只是讓瑪莉貝爾更傷心了。
一早，瑪莉貝爾就來到一樓用早餐，也利用冒險者們還沒下來前，繼續寫他的筆記本。但冒險者們一旦出現，他便將筆記本收好，裝作沒事一樣。
冒險者們吃完早餐，便出發尋找哈洛的魔法商店。

商店內除了哈洛外，沒有其他人。哈洛輕輕微笑，歡迎著冒險者們。雖然他曾說他的東西都不太貴重，只是花俏的小玩意，但冒險者們看到標價後，發現多數的東西都是他們合資也買不起的。最終，在他們詢問哈洛後，哈洛搬出了一大桶的魔法小石頭，價格稍微可以接受些，但這些石頭的功效為和，冒險者們還是摸不著頭緒，甚至當雷雅嘗試偵測魔法時，還發現他的偵測被阻擋住了。哈洛表示，這是他之前和其他商人買的，他也不知道這些石頭的功效。裡面各種大小、材質、顏色、形狀，也許每一顆的功效都不同。最終，哈洛決定讓冒險者們一人挑選一顆，作為他的小禮物。
阿龍挑了一顆綠色的石頭，不清楚他的功效，於是他決定將石頭含在嘴裡。將石頭取出後，他還是不知道到底發生什麼事，但很顯然他的夥伴們都發現了什麼。很快的，他們便告訴他他的聲音變得極度高亢，像是吸了氦氣一樣。阿龍知道他不能以這樣的狀態去拜訪艾瑞利斯家。
鑰挑了一顆顏色混濁，形狀像是海膽的石頭。他搖了搖石頭，突然聽見裡面傳來一個人聲，好像是打招呼，於是他也應了一聲招呼，卻發現自己的聲音也被存了進去。他仔細收好這顆石頭，心想著也許未來有用。
其他冒險者們各自取了不同的石頭，但都決定先收好，不使用他們，以免這些石頭一旦使用就不能再用第二次了。
在老尼克索未妥善整理的房子前，哈洛請冒險者們稍等，讓他進去找老尼克索。等他出來時，老尼克索已經將自己打理地十分體面，準備出發了。然而，阿龍的氦氣嗓音還沒消除，也不確定會持續多久，於是老尼克索邀請他們先進去坐坐。
接近一小時的時間，阿龍終於在瑪莉貝爾的提示下，得知自己的嗓音恢復了，大家也就出發了。
走上山坡，偌大的宅邸在眼前越來越大。而除了艾瑞利斯家之外，這裡也還有其他的貴族，但房子沒有這麼宏偉。上城區除了這些貴族的家之外，還有一處議會廳，是龍冠辦公的地方。
由於抵達時已屆中午，老尼克索建議直接拜訪艾瑞利斯的宅邸。他敲了敲門。不久後，一名藍色，中老年的女性龍人開了門。阿龍眼神對上，用普通語喊了一句「媽媽」。這名龍人瞪大眼睛，回了一句「賽拉尼爾？」他先禮貌地邀請冒險者們入門，讓他們在客廳休息，然後要冒險者們等一會兒，他得去找「阿龍的父親」出來。
毛毛維持他的老習慣，在這貴族的客廳看看有沒有什麼值錢的東西。但縱使所有擺設都是非常華貴得，唯一吸引他注意的，是艾瑞利斯的家譜。
費洛登和瑟萊拉沒有意外就是阿龍的父母吧？那空白的位置，似乎缺少個名字。好像是「賽拉尼爾」來著？
不久後，當阿龍的母親瑟萊拉自己回來時，他邀請冒險者們一同與他們共進午餐。
餐廳擺了兩張長桌，一桌已經坐了快滿，桌上的飯菜也擺好了，另一桌則是空的。瑟萊拉邀請阿龍加入主桌，也請其他人們坐在一旁的客桌。等大家都入座後，主桌那幾名阿龍的平輩，很顯然是他的堂姐妹弟便到廚房幫忙將餐點端上客桌上。

阿龍的家人們紛紛自我介紹或互相介紹。他的父親，現任的龍冠名為費洛登是一名紅龍人，表情嚴肅但不嚴厲，歲月在他的臉上留下不少痕跡；費洛登對面的是他的叔叔，紅龍人瑟拉蒙，他們倆兄弟長得挺像的，但瑟拉蒙比較爽朗親切一點，阿龍仔細觀察他，感覺他不太像那種別有心機的人；瑟拉蒙一旁的是阿龍的嬸嬸黃銅龍人艾內莫，十分低調，有著貴族的典雅；坐在艾內莫旁邊的是一名與他身形相當的年輕紅龍人，他的堂姐瑟拉斯，眼神充滿殺氣，毫無友善可言；與瑟拉斯對比，一旁的堂妹紅龍人奈梨紗則友善親人，甚至主動伸出手與阿龍握手，表示自己十分熱愛藝術；最後則是阿龍的堂弟，黃銅龍人維瑞克，依照奈梨紗的說法，是在場所有家人當中最最聰明的人。而用餐的過程中，冒險者們也發現阿龍的堂妹奈梨紗似乎與哈洛有些私交，奈梨紗時常跑來客桌與哈洛攀談。
待用完餐後，費洛登提及阿龍身份一事。他先向阿龍道歉，說明當初拋棄還是蛋的他，是他們的過錯，但事情都是有理由的。他也說道，這個家族以使用魔法為傲（阿龍詢問家人們是不是都會魔法，維瑞克瞬間做出了一個阿龍的小幻象作為回應）。不過，這並不會改變阿龍是他與瑟萊拉的親生骨肉，他還是有辦法讓阿龍取得他應有的權利。對此，瑟拉斯的表錢顯然有些許不滿，但也沒有無禮地在長輩面前表示些什麼。
費洛登提議，讓阿龍通過一項試煉，來取回他繼承人的身份。
城鎮外的洞穴有一頭龍。去找那頭龍，取得與他接觸過的證明。
那樣，就不會有人對他的繼承權有任何意見了。
After about a month of travel from Mudtown, the adventurers, now joined by Maribel, finally arrived in Rathanad in the carriage driven by Mr. Green.

Rathanad was a town built on a hill. Once through the entrance, the road became a long upward slope, and near the very edge of the sky stood an enormous manor. At a glance, the adventurers saw that apart from themselves, everyone in sight was dragonborn.

Thinking of the letter he had received from his parents, Al-lon realized that he had returned to Rathanad as a "noble" and a "prince," and the thought thrilled him. However, though he himself was dragonborn, he did not know Draconic, so he could only try to share his joy with "his people" in Common. All this earned him was muttering from the local dragonborn. Leah, the only one who understood Draconic, could tell that most of what they were saying was that he was an idiot or a lunatic. Not long after, they discovered that most of the dragonborn here actually understood Common anyway, which made everyone relax a little.

As darkness fell, the adventurers decided they first needed a place to stay. They found a nearby tavern, pulled together two tables, and prepared to order food. The menu seemed to be mostly meat served with bread, and whether because it was a tavern or simply a trait of Rathanad, the only alcohol available was beer, though there were several kinds to choose from.

At a nearby table, one dragonborn caught their attention. He was an elderly dragonborn with mismatched horns, drinking heavily and speaking incoherently, and beside him sat an elegant-looking middle-aged silver dragonborn. The adventurers recalled the old servant with the broken horn mentioned in Al-lon's letter. Could this be him?

After talking with the two dragonborn, the adventurers invited them over to join their table and bought them drinks. The elderly dragonborn introduced himself as Nixul, or Old Nixul, as people preferred to call him, while the one beside him was Harrel Mizel, owner of the only magic shop in Rathanad. Eagerly, Al-lon pulled out the dragon horn fragment his parents had given him and tried comparing it to Old Nixul's horn. Old Nixul immediately recognized it as the horn he had broken nearly twenty years ago.
"Young master, you've finally returned!"

Al-lon desperately questioned Old Nixul and Harrel about himself. He learned that the rulers here, known as the Crown, were the Aryliths family, and that he was the only child of the current Crown, though he truly had been the child abandoned by his parents. He even had a name of his own: Cyrinel Aryliths.

Al-lon anxiously wondered what he should do. He did not especially crave his inheritance, but he did want to meet the two parents who had abandoned him. At the same time, he even more strongly hoped that this magic-proud family might be able to help him track down Penny and Big Os, whom he had failed to find. Compared to his own identity, that had become the stronger driving force behind his adventure.

Old Nixul urged Al-lon to go see his family the next day, but Maribel hoped Al-lon would not agree too quickly. She felt that trusting two strangers they had only just met so easily might not be wise. Harrel suggested that the adventurers think it over, and if they wanted, they could come to his magic shop in the middle district the next morning. He would take them to pick up Old Nixul, and then they could all go visit the Aryliths family together.

Through Harrel, Al-lon also learned that besides his parents, his uncle's family also lived in the Aryliths estate, including his uncle, aunt, older female cousin, younger female cousin, and younger male cousin. And naturally, that whole family also practiced magic.

Before long, Harrel helped the drunken Old Nixul out of the tavern. The adventurers each paid the tavernkeeper for lodging and went upstairs to rest. Maribel insisted on having a room to herself, preferring to spend more money in exchange for some time alone.
"I have two sets of parents, but one pair isn't my birth family and the other abandoned me, so that's kind of almost the same as you having no parents at all, right?"
Al-lon tried to use humor to get closer to Maribel, but very obviously failed to realize that he had only made her sadder.

Early in the morning, Maribel came down to the first floor for breakfast and used the time before the other adventurers appeared to continue writing in her notebook. But the moment they showed up, she put the notebook away and pretended nothing had happened.
After breakfast, the adventurers set out to find Harrel's magic shop.

There was no one in the shop besides Harrel himself. With a slight smile, he welcomed the adventurers inside. Although he had claimed his wares were not very valuable, merely fancy little curiosities, once the adventurers saw the prices, they realized that most of the items were beyond what even pooling their money together could buy. In the end, after they asked Harrel further, he brought out a large barrel full of tiny magical stones. These were somewhat more affordable, but the adventurers still had no idea what any of them actually did. When Leah tried to detect magic on them, she discovered that her detection was blocked. Harrel explained that he had bought them from another merchant and had no idea what their effects were either. The stones varied in size, material, color, and shape, and perhaps each one did something different. In the end, Harrel decided to let each adventurer choose one stone as a small gift.

Al-lon picked a green stone. Since he had no idea what it did, he decided to put it in his mouth. After taking it back out, he still had no idea what had happened, but clearly his companions noticed something. They soon told him that his voice had become absurdly high-pitched, as though he had inhaled helium. Al-lon knew he could not visit the Aryliths family sounding like that.

Kaname chose a murky-colored stone shaped like a sea urchin. She shook it and suddenly heard a voice inside, sounding as though it were greeting her. So she answered with a greeting of her own, only to discover that her voice had been recorded into it as well. She carefully put the stone away, thinking it might prove useful in the future.
The other adventurers each picked different stones, but all decided to store them away without using them, in case using them once meant they could never be used again.

Outside Old Nixul's poorly kept house, Harrel asked the adventurers to wait while he went inside to fetch him. When he emerged again, Old Nixul had made himself quite presentable and was ready to leave. However, Al-lon's helium-like voice still had not faded, and since nobody knew how long it would last, Old Nixul invited them to come inside and sit for a while first.
After nearly an hour, Al-lon finally realized, thanks to Maribel pointing it out, that his voice had gone back to normal, and so they set out.

As they climbed the hill, the vast estate before them grew larger and larger. Besides the Aryliths family, there were other nobles in this district too, though their houses were not nearly so grand. In the upper district, alongside these noble homes, stood a council hall where the Crown conducted official business.

Since it was already around noon when they arrived, Old Nixul suggested going straight to the Aryliths estate. He knocked on the door. Not long after, a blue, middle-aged female dragonborn opened it. Al-lon met her eyes and said in Common, "Mother." The dragonborn widened her eyes and replied, "Cyrinel?" She politely invited the adventurers inside first and had them rest in the drawing room, then asked them to wait a moment while she went to fetch "Al-lon's father."

Fur maintained his usual habits and looked around the noble drawing room to see whether there was anything valuable. Yet despite every furnishing being luxurious, the one thing that truly caught his attention was the Aryliths family tree.
So Vaerodan and Selyra must be Al-lon's parents, then? And that blank space seemed to be missing a name. Something like "Cyrinel," perhaps?
Not long afterward, when Al-lon's mother Selyra returned on her own, she invited the adventurers to dine with the family.

The dining room held two long tables. One was already nearly full, with the food already laid out, while the other stood empty. Selyra invited Al-lon to join the main table and asked the others to sit at the guest table beside it. Once everyone had taken their seats, the younger relatives around Al-lon's age at the main table, clearly his cousins, went to the kitchen to help carry dishes over to the guest table.

Al-lon's family members introduced themselves, or introduced one another. His father, the current Crown, was a red dragonborn named Vaerodan, stern-faced but not severe, with many marks of age on his features. Across from Vaerodan sat Al-lon's uncle, a red dragonborn named Theramond. The two brothers looked quite alike, though Theramond seemed more cheerful and approachable. After observing him carefully, Al-lon felt that he did not seem like the sort of person with hidden ulterior motives. Beside Theramond sat Al-lon's aunt, a brass dragonborn named Enelmor, quiet and possessed of noble elegance. Next to Enelmor sat a young red dragonborn of similar build, his older female cousin Serathe, whose eyes were full of hostility and held no friendliness at all. In contrast, his younger female cousin, the red dragonborn Nylessa, was friendly and outgoing. She even took the initiative to shake Al-lon's hand and said that she loved art. Finally there was Al-lon's younger male cousin, a brass dragonborn named Vaelric, whom Nylessa described as the smartest person in the family. During the meal, the adventurers also noticed that Nylessa seemed to know Harrel personally, since she often came over to the guest table to chat with him.

After the meal, Vaerodan raised the matter of Al-lon's identity. He first apologized to Al-lon, explaining that abandoning him while he was still an egg had been their fault, though there had been reasons for it. He also explained that this family took pride in its magical talent. When Al-lon asked whether everyone in the family knew magic, Vaelric instantly replied by conjuring a tiny illusion of Al-lon. Even so, that did not change the fact that Al-lon was the biological child of Vaerodan and Selyra, and Vaerodan said he still had a way to ensure that Al-lon could reclaim the rights that should have been his. At this, Serathe's expression showed a trace of displeasure, though she did not say anything rude in front of her elders.
Vaerodan proposed that Al-lon undergo a trial in order to reclaim his status as heir.
There was a dragon in a cave outside the town. He was to find that dragon and obtain proof that he had come into contact with it.
Then no one would have any grounds to dispute his right of succession.
